Name: "Fenn"
Physical Description: Fenn is a short foxlike humanoid with wild hair and a ceramic white mask that covers her face.  She wears simple clothing, and has emerald green eyes that can sometimes be seen behind her mask
Quirks:
**Outcast Fairy**
Speak to Beasts, Elementals, Plants
Learn 1 spell (Drain Spirit)
Do rituals
Use rituals to transport creatures into/out of faerie realm
Weakness: When Fenn loses their mask, they have to obey all commands they're given by the first person who's eyes they look into.  This effect is broken if she wears her mask again.
Story Summary:
-Kicked out of Fairy Realm
-Kidnapped by a noble to Lastport
-Escaped and left him for dead
-Lived in Gwaed Forest
-Stole to survive

Name: "Redwood"
Physical Description:
He's old! By no means should he be walking about, he must have the world's worst case of arthritis at this point, right? He needs to walk around with a cane, he's practically in rigor mortis!

Looks can be deceiving, though!
Story Summary:
* Used to be a martial arts teacher in Daermon. Military-grade. Quit because people weren't in love with the art.
* Moved to Moteus to continue teaching and refining his craft. Quit because people weren't in love with the art
* Moved to Rocade to live in the woods. Turns out nature spirits aren't too keen on that.
* Moved to Ardevor, living in the outskirts, sometimes trekking to Aberdon for the fun of it. Tries to live in touch with nature.
* And now there's people breaching the Runewall (good!) and cultist activity near his new home (bad!)
* Time to warm up these old bones, it seems...

Name: "Trillion"
Character Sheet Link: [*"Any powerful demon's best kept secret is their true name." - "Trillion"*](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1cscZWGXFaK-OtjjxxgLYjW-U8lW7lm0-lZ6JMSQPDiY/edit?gid=0#gid=0)
Physical Description: "Trillion" stands at a modest height of 5'9", with a slim, athletic frame akin to that of a young adult. His youthful appearance is marked by his vibrant blue hair and glowing golden eyes; however, he is also easily distinguished by his demonic features that have manifested with his time as a revered Witch of Aaruna. Equally vibrant blue scales fleck across his face, neck, and limbs; and his slender fingers are complemented by long and sharp, black nails. Despite this, there is an overall welcoming warmth to his composure.
Story Summary:
- Once the leader of a great Circle in Idyll's Third Layer.
- No longer a Witch of the Circles, he now seeks to find a new way of surviving.
- Wishes to spread his pacifistic ideals in order to hopefully bring peace to Kuzunoha of Idyll.

Name: A'shibah
Physical Description: A'shibah is tall, even for Hiear standards, and stands at an impressive 6'3" (7'2" with his ears perked). His hair and fur are a shock of white, as is iconic for the Hiear of his family, and his eyes are a piercing gold. Though fraternal twins, A'shibah is actually quite different than his brother, Levan, putting the obvious hereditary genes aside. He seems to bear an oppressive aura of intimidation and despair as he rarely speaks anymore; however, despite this, there still appears to be a hint of good and kindness about him, especially with regards to his brother.
Story Summary:
- Born the seventh son of a Hiear merchant family.
- Family was killed; but used his body to shield his twin brother, Levan.
- Levan failed a ritual to revive the family, A'shibah took the consequence by making a deal with Akhir.
- A'shibah promised his soul to oblivion, but Musta'khan managed to save him by binding the brothers together.
- Now lives inside of Levan, sharing the same soul vessel.

Name: ALEX ADDAMS
Physical Description:
Despite the experimentation, Alex was able to maintain his humanoid form due to the nature of his new body; He simply holds his form with the memory of his prior form, albeit with some imagination to make him look his proper age. This does have the unintended effect of making him look a lot like his father, due to his memory being mixed in with his form.

Due to the nature of his altered body, Alex doesn't necessarily need a body type to stick with, however he most commonly keeps a toned mesomorph-like shape due to being in Terra's Saitos gang. He considers it useful for fitting in with the rest of the group, as well as with intimidation.
Story Summary:
• Alex's Father, Ressler Addams, worked for DHK in an unknown capacity; It was through this connection that DHK kidnapped Alex for their experiments. Whether or not Ressler was blacklisted, kidnapped as well, or just killed after or during the event is unknown.
• The experiments on Alex were to splice his and other creatures' DNA with the attributes of a monster with mimicking properties. It was known as 'The Janus Project', a secret program they created with the intention of creating a brand new product for their customers to become dependent on: A complete body reformation... provided the product was applied daily, that is.
• After escaping from captivity- with some assistance from fellow experiment 'Joey'- He and his new companion wandered the desert for a few months before The Saitos came across him and took him back to Haven. Wanting to pay them back, he decided to join The Saitos and help to protect Haven, eventually becoming a respected member and well known amongst the locals.

Name: Abaddon Throné
Physical Description: Abaddon is a delusional man dressed in royal looking costume garb. He's dressed culturally out of place for his home of Myist. He's dramatic and verbose, even if he's not always accurate in his descriptions. His belief in his delusion almost makes it feel real.
Story Summary:
A man cared for by SIA. He is seen roaming the streets with a woman who is presumed to be his caretaker, though he claims she's his 'Retainer'. He's infamous as a strange man, claiming to be the "Prince of the Obsidian Throne" or the "Maleficent Heir of Terror and Shadow".

Little is known about him, and he is not often allowed to speak to others.

Name: Abhila (Asva)
Physical Description:
A long green snake.....That is sadly is Asva who still holds glimmer of human sadness in his eyes. 
Now with his human voice stolen he fully fits the part of a snake.......he also got bigger.

Name: Abigail Byrne
Physical Description: A pale woman with red hair and dark eyes usually dressed in worm clothes a cloak
Story Summary:
-Grew up in Snowmaw parents died raised by her grandmother

-Grandmother taught her magic and told her stories of the fae 

-As a teenager she grew to love nature and outdoors help out foraging for Helga’s shop

-Her magic grew as she got older she crafted a broom that made her and her alone capable of flight

-Bound her raven as a familiar with the aid of her grandmother

-Was a wilderness guide as an adult, in her latest trek she got caught up in a snowstorm that had a realmstorm hidden within and transported to the worldhelm

Name: Absalom Kasand
Physical Description: A 5'3" Leirsin with long brown hair, wearing a simple dress shirt, a vest, and slacks.
Story Summary:
- Stratford-born Leirsin studying with the Disciples of Wisdom
- Likes to learn a wide array of studies, dipping into the healing arts along with studying the Stone of Wisdom itself
- Sent to the Runewall as an attempt by the Beacon of Wisdom to find more knowledge after Silverdale closed its border. Goldhearted shenanigans ensued.

Name: Adelaide Cartwright
Physical Description: Blonde with hair tied into a braid behind her, Adelaide wears armor borrowed from Galius academy. She has all the hallmarks of an honor roll student - except for the whispers that her family aren't real nobility.
Story Summary:
- Eldest daughter of a single mother

- student at Galius Military Academy, working for the Rehinsfal family to settle her own family's debt

- followed the Rehinsfal's wayward daughter into the Runewall

Name: Adelphel Durand
Physical Description: A man standing at about 5'11, medium length dark brown hair and a darker yet vibrant and lively olive skin tone with hazel hued eyes, they have a sun like radiance about them, a corona that glows vibrantly around both body and within his eyes. Holding a genuinely young and ever-loving kind expression that easily shifts to earnest one in times of hardship and danger. Their hands are somewhat bruised and rough from work and battle. They are very well acquainted to physical labor of many kinds for long hours just to get by during travels and it shows.
Rare Equipment:
Heaven's Defender | Runic Plate
1. Resistance to Dark
(Villain buff)
2. Immune to Shaken
3. Resistance to Bolt

Shrine Maiden's Gohei | Accessory | Blessed Bonds

Wall of Inferno and Frost | Shield | Dual Resistance (Fire/Ice)

The Chronicles of Those Before Us
Arcane | One-Handed Melee | [WLP] + [WLP] | [HR + 5] Physical
Quality | Arcane Reservoir: When you Merge with an arcanum with an Arcane Resource, you start with 1 Arcane Resource instead of 0. You can spend Opportunities to gain an Arcane Resource.
Story Summary:
- Adelphel was initially a formless spirits that simply existed in nature until captured by a Necromancer to be used in a magical experiment for a subservient creation in the wake of recent disasters. They were augmented, altered and bound into a humanoid body, however all the changes caused instability in the magic and retained free will to act independently. Deemed a failure as a result.
- They have traveled throughout Kor'Tarion helping those they come across of all kinds when able without discrimination.
- They offer aid for many issues, from things like helping with a farm or defending people from life or death situations, doing so without want of reward in return.
- They appears to be a knight of some kind in attire but holds no real symbol nor claims any titles.
- They don't appear to have memories of their past, in a sense of they remember having parents and living in a nice village but nothing solid. The lack of past and memories causes them to cherish new meetings.

Name: Aelina Van Deivoet
Physical Description:
A purple haired woman wearing a prom and proper uniform of the Gnosis Academy, Aelina has fair skin and bright violet eyes. Two black horns poke out of the top of her head and her hands are adorned with 9 metal rings of various colors. 

Her sword form is a large curved blade with holes in the back with loose rings hanging from each one but the first.
Story Summary: A student of the Gnosis Academy House of Treasures, Aelina has become a regalia of Kaiway. At home in Ripplith she is from a former noble house of storm sorcerers that is under the Mermaid Queen.

Name: Aer Drasil
Physical Description: Aer stands tall at 6'0", her posture ever straight, radiating poise and grace. Her long, curly brown hair cascades down past her waist, framing her commanding presence. She dons armor adorned in rich tones of brown, brass, and deep blue, exuding both strength and elegance. Black feathers accentuate her ensemble, lending her an air of formidable beauty and otherworldly might.
Quirks:
You have spent a long, long time here in Idyll. Maybe a year, maybe a hundred. It's hard to tell. But you feel different now - more natural to the realm that has become your home. You've changed, hopefully for the better. Angel of Nimue

You may verbally communicate with any creature belonging to the demon, elemental, and undead Species.  

You learn one spell of your choice among those in the lists for the Elemental, Entro and Spirit Classes in the Core Rulebook: [Heal]

Weakness: Valkyrie's Mercy
Aer feels an unshakable compulsion to offer solace to the spirits of the dead or dying, unable to ignore their suffering or pass them by without a gesture of comfort
Story Summary:
Aer Drasil was a fearless huntress and protector, renowned for her skill with a spear and unwavering resolve. After falling heroically in battle, she awakened in Asga, a warrior’s paradise in the afterlife, where honor and strength were celebrated. However, this realm soon fell into madness, its duels turning into an endless cycle of carnage and death. Refusing to succumb, Aer became a Valkyrie, finding refuge in Salmon’s Reach and dedicating herself to shielding lost souls from the corruption that tainted her once-ideal afterlife. 

Yet now, with the chaos subsiding and her quarry defeated, she faces a new challenge. Discovering who she is beyond the battlefield and what her future may hold.

Name: Aerah
Class List: Pilot ★ | Chanter 8 | Guardian ★ | Weaponmaster 1 | Martial Artist 2
Physical Description: Aerah is a 19 year old girl who is 5' 7". She has long black hair with a bit of green tones in it. She is typically walking around in a body suit and fancy skates to allow her quicker movement.
Quirks:
Heirloom - Vocal Stabilizer
Flaw - Flaw - When trying to speak or using abilities that require creatures to hear you this device may malfunction.
Rare Equipment:
Vocal Stabilizer - Resonant
Aetherquartz Arm Shield - Mindful
Soothing Necklace - Anti-Status (Shaken)
Story Summary:
- Was born with a magical mutation that causes her voice to be volatile if uncontrolled, as such she was told not to speak.
- Due to an outburst she ended up accidently killing one of her bullies as a child and harming other.
- This lead to law suits putting her family into debt, which her mother tried to gamble to get out of.
- 777LC saw potential with Aerah's talents and offered her a job to help pay off her family's debt.
- This lead to her joining their Roller Derby circuit that people bet on.

Name: Agata Nergoth
Physical Description: Agata is a young woman standing at about 5'10 in height. She has long blonde hair tied back in a pony tail most times. Her clothes usually are stained with oil and grease as the scent of machinery follows her around.

Name: Agrippa Molide
Physical Description:
Agrippa stands at an impressive 6'7, accentuated by a good deal of muscle to her tanned body, something she credits to healthy living (as she understands it). When out of costume, her dark brown hair is left in a messy mane, and her choice of clothing can be described as lazy, with pyjamas, hoodies, and sweatpants being the preferred sort of getup. This tends to somewhat hide her musculature, while her slouch conceals some of her height.

As Punchriot, she's much more impressive in the ring. Standing up straight and proud while flexing, to impress the crowds, she sports a red wrestler's getup, with boots, armbands, white kneepads, and a colorful mask over her eyes, while her hair is kept in a ponytail. Any belt she may have recently won would be worn at her waist.
Story Summary:
* Raised by a single mother working as a nurse, doing the best she can in North Rock
* Grew up watching Saturday morning cartoons, after-school specials, and wrestling matches on TV, all giving her a fanciful idea of ethics and values
* Inspired to eat her veggies, workout, and be a good person from those TV personalities
* This contrasts with her easy-going nature and affinity for junk food
* In an effort to follow her ideals, as well as help her mom pay bills, she joined the Terra Wide Federation (T.W.F.)
* Under the identity of the babyface wrestler PUNCHRIOT, she fights evil in the ring, while advocating healthy living to the children watching
* Has been experimented on, without her knowledge, by TWF, to add to her strength in the ring
* Sent to the Worldhelm while lazing about at home, between two matches.

Name: Ai Xianyu
Character Sheet Link: ["Through the lay of the land and with strength in my heart, I will be the light that shines at the end of this abyss. T-That's how that should go, right...?"](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1zKtdkEWjZOjii5zFV99m7gt68dJ6T6kcAQquF1upB5Q/edit?gid=0#gid=0)
Physical Description:
A bishi'e standing at 4'9" with purple scales and long flowing violet hair. She covers her misty green eyes with a blindfold and her jagged antlers with a cloth covered in gold trims. She typically wears a dark blue uniform specifically tailored to her martial arts style, with several gold trims and a long pendant with two bright gems dangling between her neck.
Her tail has a red ribbon wrapped around the edge.
Quirks: Hunted Emmisary (Boon of Auspicious Wisdom) (Curse of Heavenly Enmity) (Spell: Elemental Shroud)
Story Summary:
Born in a temple on the edge of the Skysea to a small family who wanted a strong, healthy daughter. As a bishi'e, Xianyu was heralded by the small community as one who would eventually become a cultivator, with ancient texts that survived the War Against Heaven scattered in the temple that detailed their feats and abilities throughout Wujing Guo. However, she had a defect in her eyes, filled with mist and fog. Was this part of heaven's enmity...?

She spent most of her life training and meditating, reading the texts and resonating with the land. She listens to the ancient echoes of techniques passed down from cultivators past. She becomes adept in Abyss Cultivation, pulling the qi from the land to overcome the impossible, to see, to sense clearly in the cloudy darkness of her sight.

The pressure to perform to expectations became too strong. She heard whispers of an ancient vessel that arrived in Heaven's War. She went to locate this vessel, falling into a storm over the horizon...

Name: Aijing Minli
Physical Description: Often described as frail, standing at 4´9, and not a single developed muscle found on his body. Often hunched over and looking around nervously, potentially scared even.
Story Summary:
- Had a decent childhood, despite beeing a Bishè
- Eventually corrupt cultivators took notice
- His parents got sacrificed to further the corrupt 
cultivators power
- got taken in by Hengs master
- discovered he has an affinity for cultivation, but also healing. (with medicinal tools)
- found an aincent manuscript of the legendary alchemist Keng Sien-Seng
- stopped cultivating for a bit in order to fulltime 
heal people, eventually returned to it.
- got called onto the worldhelm while running away from corrupt cultivators

Name: Aile Forrester
Character Bio Link: ["You wish to know about me? Of course! What would you like to know?"](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1xzd1LpAkwx11FUcDQy8Z0UfRwfwhfLJVYz9LPl5W918/edit?usp=sharing)
Character Sheet Link: ["The stage is set and the curtain's raised. I'm ready..."](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/12-OYpOvN94NkRXO4oZ55GKED1-8QlsqQnW0AgN3DZuA/edit?usp=sharing)
Class List:
Dancer - ⚜ 

Spiritist - ཐི༏ཋྀ󠀮

Chanter - ♪

Orator - 2

Arcanist - 1
Physical Description:
An average sized woman of 5'5 , Aile's flowing auburn hair is let loose.

Her regular attire comprises of a cropped light blue jacket complimented with  a black and white dress top. 

Complimenting this is black shorts , with a loose skirt tied at her waist which flows behind her, wearing a pair of leather heels that match the colours of her jacket and lastly a necklace that was given to her by her grandmother which she never takes off.

The outfit is flashy but practical, reflecting her friendly but introspective nature.
Story Summary:
A performer raised by her grandmother in Lastport 

Spent her childhood helping at her grandmother's apothecary store

Studied song and dance at a young age, tutored by a travelling performer

After being brought to the Worldhelm, she began searching for a missing friend who  had soothed her grieving heart when her grandmother passed. 

Anytime her spirit waned on her journey,  she found herself reinvigorated by the people of the ship.

Eventually, in an encounter facing off against the demon Anatherium she had found her friend as a brainwashed servant of the demon.

Through the aid of her companions , she was finally able to fulfil the promise she'd made to her friends sister.

Now works to support others as she had received.

Name: Akahime Fuyumi
Physical Description:
Akahime, the Winter Serpent, is an ethereal being with a long, serpentine lower body that is is cloaked in obsidian-black scales, coiling with silent grace across the frozen wastes she calls home. Towering and poised, her upper half bears the countenance of a pale, silver-haired Ald—yet her piercing gaze and the faint, otherworldly glow in her pale eyes betray something far older and deeper.

She dons ornate, silver-on-black armor. Flowing silks trail from beneath the plate, catching ghostlight as she moves. In her hands, she wields the Night Lantern, a staff bound with chains and a crimson lantern that bleeds spectral mist. Its flickering light draws spirits near, some seeking peace—others, prey.
Quirks:
Heirloom: The Night Lantern

The Night Lantern guides the lost—those whose spirits wander through the bleak blizzards where even Akahime's sirenic voice cannot reach. Yet, the lantern’s light pierces through. Suspended from its chain at the end of her staff, it offers a sense of control, comfort, and quiet confidence to those nearby. In her hands, it becomes more than a beacon—it is a weapon, radiant and resolute, used to banish darkness in all its forms. Unfortunately, not everything the lantern attracts is friendly...
Rare Equipment:
The Night Lantern

Custom Item: 
Base Form: Arcane, melee, [HR+7], [WIL + WIL], Transforming, Magic Defense Boost, Defense Boost, Damage type: Light
Transformation: Flail, melee, [HR+12], [DEX + WIL], Transforming, Accurate, Powerful, Damage type: Light
Rare Item Quality: Harmonious, Damage Change - Light"
Story Summary:
- Serpentine yokai who guides lost souls through frozen Aldistir.

- Found the glowing Night Lantern at the Grasping Tree.

- Became a beacon for the lost- and threats.

- Trained to protect the souls she ferries.

- Hunts godblood corrupted beings to free them from torment.

- Thanks to the Worldhelm, she now travels between realms, continuing her sacred task.

Name: Akali Amari
Character Sheet Link: ["A Peek at the skill I have been taught"](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1lOn1Hs3s1rHBcXCKH-ge0RR_LqjJwfEF8so1B1er0Z8/edit?usp=sharing)
Physical Description: Akali Amari appears as a 5'7" woman. She wears an assortment of jewelry on her character. A bone necklace with a golden medalion hanging off of it. A pair of earring with the tusk of a creature on it. And an amber ring upon her right hand. Clothing wise she wears a long black and white dress. Upon each of her arms she wears a black and yellow bracelet.
Quirks:
**Heirloom - Amarian Box of Crystals**
This box, passed down by the many members of house Amari. It is one of mystery. As no-one besides youngest member of the house can utilize this box. No other mage or power has been able to use this box besides members of this house. When a member of the house uses it, they are able to grab a number of crystals from it at random. It speculated that the crystals are to represent the Gaia crystals present within the world of Eurys. Though that is mere speculation and not confirmed. Regardless, when the right crystals are in the members hand. Magical effects tend to take place. Which may benefit them or make things worse for them.  

Flaw - Despite the box only able to be used by the youngest member of house Amari, many greedy men do try to take it. Be it bandit that have heard of the treasure, merchants who wish to attempt to profit from it, politicians who wish to use the boxes powers, or warmongers who too wish to use the boxes powers for conquest.
Story Summary:
- Daughter of Councilman Rabi Amari

- Was taught all her life skills in order to inherit his position. Including use of the family heirloom.

- She always yearned to do something more, but relented due to the roles importance.

- Outside of her fathers ear and sight, she typically hanged out with the locals.

- Eventually was caught and then sent to become a student of the Order of the Sealing Sands. A place where many councilman came before and to keep a stricter eye on her.

- Eventually news of the expedition of the Rune Wall reaches the city.

- In order to not seem small and weak before the other cities in Grestazs, they send some students of the college to the wall to join in their own expedition. Akail was involved in it and ventured with others into the storm.

- Made it to the Worldhelm where she has a chance to enjoy things without her father watching her.

Name: Akar Ceba
Physical Description:
Akar wears a comfortable, white robe and a heavy, black robe over his left shoulder. The seams of both his tunic and his robe are adorned with soft sheep wool. Both his lower arms and ankles are covered in red threads. Akar wears many decorative charms and colourful decorations, including earrings and a talisman in the shape of a bell, which is tied to his collar. He almost never seen without his shepherd crook, which is also adorned with the same charms and bells he wears on his body.

His long, red hair is tied into a casual braid. The young shepherd has small goat horns, growing from just above his ears. Usually his face has a soft expression with a bright smile on his lips and shining, green eyes.
Story Summary:
- Born and raised to a small family in the peaceful mountain ranges of Paradise on Idyll
- Shepherd of a small flock of sheep. He spent his time protecting and caring for them and his friends and family, with little of nothing to worry about.
- One day, one of his sheep, Nyima, gets lost in a Realm Storm and he goes off in search of her
- Now lost and confused in a world filled with strife and chaos, he tries to get back to his flock, but also take care of anyone he might meet along the way.

Name: Akiko
Physical Description: Akiko is a muscular young woman standing at 5'8" with long black hair and pale skin riddled with long-healed scars. Her eyes are a dull amber color, but a spark of light gleams within when she wields her black and gold shields that seem like two broken halves of one sun. Though once tense and rigid, she now smiles readily, and with fierce determination.
Quirks:
Heirloom | Amaterasu's Relic Shield Halves
Susanoo's anger towards those who would wield his ashamed sister's relics chases them even across realms. Wherever these shield halves are, storms pursue. Upon Tian Yin, Susanoo's followers seek out this broken relic, and the pieces are a beacon to hungering Yokai.
Rare Equipment:
Radiant Runic Half (Runic Shield- Memorize [Flare])
Sanctuary Runic Half (Runic Shield- Antistatus [Poisoned])
Dawn Mane Robes (Light/Fire res)
Fan of the Fallen Sea - Researcher
Moonlight's Blessing - Soothing
The Sun's Glimpse - Arcane Reservoir
Story Summary:
Akiko was born in the village of Ishiyama. The same as every other human, she fell under the thumb of the Oni; though, with natural fire Qi affinity revealed, she was claimed by a powerful red Oni. They took her to the Temple of the Rising Sun as a living forge to make a powerful arsenal. 

This was where she found her shields, hidden beneath the rubble in a relic room long forgotten. Taking them in either hand cast upon her soul a heavenly fire, at long last ridding her of the hopeless fog that left her willfully chained under the Yokai. She fled, falling into a realmstorm and finding a new home in the Worldhelm. She has spent much of her time in isolation to cultivate her connection to Amaterasu, but only after witnessing the desperate fight against Loftur did she awaken a deeper understanding of her Dao: the Sunless Dawn.

Name: Akino
Physical Description: Standing at 6'2", Akino is a Half-Yokai. She has a pair of horns atop her head, with some fabric tied or wrapped around them. She has a set of brown hair, some of which is eratic while some is tied up. She wears a white kimono with green outlines in the center and black shirt beneath. She wears brown shorts, a white hanao, and a geta.
Quirks:
Qi Specialist - Heavenly (Light) - Order Rituals - Vulnerability: Dark (Demonic)

Choose an Earthly Phase (water: ice, wood: poison, fire, earth, or metal: bolt) or a Heavenly Phase (heavenly: light, void: air, or demonic: dark). You gain resistance to the corresponding damage type. Additionally, whenever you deal damage, you may change its type so that it matches your elemental damage type. However, you also gain a Vulnerability depending on your choice. If you chose an Earthly phase, you also gain the ability to perform Rituals of the Elementalism discipline, but only if those Rituals manipulate your chosen element (respectively ice/water, plants/flora, fire, earth/rocks, metal). If you chose a Heavenly Phase, you instead gain the ability to perform Rituals of the Arcanism discipline with the domain of Order (Heavenly), Void, or Rebellion (Demonic).
The Vulnerability granted by this Quirk cannot be altered or overwritten by Qualities, or by Skills that grant you permanent Resistance
Story Summary:
- Born in Hanae, Akino always lived as an outcast due to their oni heritage.
- Was treated more harshly then most within Hanae, but regardless they kept their kindness
- Was raised by one person who lived within the outskirts. - A non-yokai folk who was simply just kind. Over time they taught them Sun cultivation as she fostered heavenly qi.
- Read tales of the  past involving the gods. Specifically about Amaterasu. Which she grew curious about.
- She dreamed of wanting to bring back the light to the skies in anyway possible. Despite how impossible such a goal may be.
- She wished to accomplish her dream. Sadly she could only stay at home.
- Regardless she wished to accomplish it by giving mercy to all. No matter what. Even if it was irredeemable. She had to try atleast once. As she believed the sun should be comforting and merciful to all.
And if she wanted to do her dream, she needed to imitate its merciful warmth
- While thinking about her dream, a realmstorm took her away.

Name: Alan Reverie
Physical Description:
Alan stands at 5'7". His demeanor most often seems to be that of tranquil serenity, even with the fact that his eyes are constantly concealed by a covering of some sort — typically a golden blindfold with a blue gem.

In present day, Alan's manner of dress, blindfold aside, typically consists of a metal suit of carefully-engraved armor that is entirely draped in a white-and-gold robe. Finally, he carries two sizeable shields, the backs of which have been customized with extra padding such that they can both serve as emergency pillows.
Story Summary:
- Alan was born blind; given Kor'Tarion's hero culture, he still trained in self-defense despite being blind.
- He learned how to use a shield, and actually got surprisingly decent at maneuvering with one.
- The Night of the Red Sky happens in Kor'Tarion, and Midholde is beset
- Alan does surprisingly well in fending off monsters with a shield, but not well enough, and was still knocked into a coma.
- Qilin took favor upon him for his efforts, and helped preserve his life by allowing the two to become bound.
- Midholde is now gone, but Alan survived and would continue to wander Kor'Tarion for another 1-2 years.
- The coma, followed by the new strength in his soul, left him chronically sleepy. Eventually, in his sleep, he awakened inside of The Worldhelm.

Name: Alaska Vertigo
Physical Description: Wrapped beneath a worn cloak, Aly occupies what was, at one point, clearly a streamlined, and admittedly compact, modern LUA chassis. She sports a concerning amount of wear and tear, along with mismatched and unlicensed replacement parts. From behind a cracked screen, she looks back at the world with eyes that manage to appear tired, despite their lack of detail.
Story Summary:
- Experimental digital backup of a Lorel.AI software engineer.
- Awoken under concerning circumstances with corrupted memories and a bounty on her head.
- Spent months evading Terra's authorities and doing soul net work for less than reputable benefactors to pay for repairs and upkeep.
- Became embroiled in the affairs of a group of Goldhearted, and took her chance to get aboard the Worldhelm to get out of dodge.
- Hoping to eventually figure out what she was doing before her memories were corrupted (and also who she even really is).
- Recently recovered data from a corrupted memory of her shooting someone.

Name: Albreich Surtova
Physical Description:
Albreich stands at about 6'2", 

Though he trains his body regularly he only does as much as he needs to wield his weapon comfortably, preferring to forgo the bulging muscles for a body that allows more dexterous movements.

He carries himself with the confidence and poise of a man with twice his experience, after all the best way to win a fight is to stop it from happening in the first place. 
(Will add more later, this is the thing I suck at most)
Story Summary:
A would be knight that ran away to become a mercenary after growing disillusioned by the crown's inability to take action. Deciding to serve his own interests rather than paying lip service to grandiose ideals like chivalry and knighthood.

After a couple winters working as a freelance mercenary he joined the Golden Claw Mercenaries, much to his surprise he was chosen as a Goldhearted a year after he'd joined the company.

Name: Alder
Physical Description: Straight, tall, and lithe, covered in silver and white dappled fur, he stands at 5'11'' (not including the antlers) on deer-like hooves, peering at you with what look like distant reflections of stars in his blue(?) eyes. He usually wears a combination of shirts under knit sweaters, and maybe a night blue coat lined with white fur. He adorns himself with a pair of simple, hand-made necklaces, and a single earring on his left ear.
Quirks:
Outcast Fairy
Drawback: Is compelled to heal nature that is hurting.
Rare Equipment:
- Fey's Light (Main hand.) (One-handed Staff. HR+3 Light.) (Blessed Bonds quality.)
- Tomagotchy Cell Phone (Accessory.) (Spell Splash quality)
Story Summary:
- Lived with his nomadic people and family, the Deerfolk, following the guidance of the elementals via a Hearer, nurturing life along the way. 
- Before becoming Goldhearted, he was suddenly, mysteriously, shunted out from his mother's domain, and hasn't been able to get back in or find his family. 
- He has recently found his mother, Willow, learning that the Wyld Hunt has been responsible for hunting and tearing Fey, particularly those of the Spring Court, from their domains. He has also learned that his mother has had dealings with the Spring Court as well, but doesn't quite know how deep it runs.
- He still doesn't know that his mother managed to get Caladrius' favor to bestow upon Alder some of his power to protect him.
- Has yet to become fully aware of his aptitude as a Hearer for his people
- Yuzuru Eiji of Terra is his boyfriend. c:

Name: Aldrich S. Escher
Physical Description: Slender and fragile-looking, but with a confident aura of power. Always carries his Tome, which doubles as his Journal, where he records his findings and experiment results.
Rare Equipment: Personal Tome (Tome + Spell Vamp)

Name: Alec Lyon
Class List:
Martial Artist 3
Spiritist ★
Guardian 2
Symbolist ★
Pilot 4
Physical Description: Alec is a tall, athletic man who stands at 5'11" (180cm). Usually wears a smile on his face when interacting with most people. Typically wears a set of battle armor when he's on the job, but otherwise the casual jacket and pants when not on the job. His grayish-white hair done in a stylish mess, with gentle amber eyes.
Story Summary:
Partner Bond: Mae

- Born to a working class family in Babyl City, Dawnstar Valley.
- Has a natural gift of controlling light and spiritual magic.
- Attended school normally, where he met and befriended Mae Lavery.
- Majoring in magic, he graduated and took a position in working for a subsidiary of NTTech that enforces the regulations on magic. Training in both body and magic, putting his skills to use.
- Due to budget reasons, ended up moving into an apartment with Mae about 3 years prior. Then eventually formed a romantic relationship with her.
- 1 year prior to today, Mae Lavery suffered a tragic accident and died. Then she became an Insolvent with a debt over her head. Doing their best to live with the circumstances.
- Thanks to the use of his own spiritual magic and martial training, he was able to successfully mitigate casualties during the events of the Skyfall. Soon leading him to arrive on the Worldhelm, becoming a Goldhearted.

Name: Alexander Romani
Physical Description: Light grey almost white hair, constant stern look on his face with piercing red eyes. Wears a formal but out of fashion suit with a red tie.
Story Summary:
- Born and Raised in Mount Providence having a passion for classical songs by hearing it from a radio

- Passed away due to illness before he could get a proper start in the singing industry and became an insolvent due loans from education as well as equipment

- After almost a decade of trying to pay the debt off working entry level jobs in Central, Alexander moved back to Mount Providence almost ready to give up and become a ghoul.

- Instead his passion for the classical music reignites as he a found a old oprea piece and sang his heart out.

- With a new sense of duty he goes out to abandon buildings and churches to find more pieces like the one he found that day to preserve them so that others can still listen

- Currently works at a SWORD affiliated branch at the Fortune Valley Casino where he entertains guests with songs and help remix classic sheet music for SWORD to reuse in their products.

- Got picked up by the realmstorm when scavenging for more antiques

Name: Alexandra Stuart Lancastrian
Physical Description:
Alexandra Lancastrian fills an imposing figure. She stands at 5'9, though she is often wearing heels or platforms that push her to 6'. Her long hair is nevertheless kept well groomed and straight, maintaining a professional appearance even in the air. And of course, her Service Uniform is kept immaculately pressed, cleaned, and ready for presentation.

Alexandra is an intense woman, with little patience for impropriety, and less for hooliganry or lawless behavior. The people who cross the line often quickly find themselves afoul of her custom service weapon, the 'Principles of Prosperity.'
Story Summary:
"* Born to the Prestigious Lancastrian Noble Family. Her father, Charles, is a Mid level Noble in charge of administration of one of the larger Imperial Provinces

* Was always a brilliant girl, and to many considered a Prodigy. 

* Joined the military on her 18th birthday.

* At 25, she was placed as part of the Sky Service, working on the Vigilant Watch to hunt down people who Violate the Delver's Code.

* Six months ago, upon the retirement of her Captain, Johannes Kranston, she was promoted to Captain.

* Two months ago, a confrontation with Charlotte Morgan caused a stir as Charlotte was briefly put under custody. This led to decommission of the ship and her being placed under leave.

* With her ship donated to the Adventurer's Guild, she followed the ship and agreed to join on the condition that she is allowed to keep control of her ship.

Name: Alexei Volkov
Physical Description: Alexei is of average to thin stature and around 5'7'' tall. He's pale, his eyes eerily empty of any colour besides white and grey, and his black hair mirrors this scheme with long streaks of white already showing on the otherwise seemingly young man's black hair. Most notably, Alexei has a large scar that runs down his left cheek, neck and further down. Its not certain how large the scar is, as it eventually disappears under his Gnosis Academy uniform.
Story Summary:
- Alexei attends Gnosis Academy and is on the Worldhelm as part of the school's new 'Exchange' program
- He has enjoyed a rather privileged life under his parents, who are both rather powerful spellcasters based out of Dreadlan
- Past encounters with members of Ursakk's Hoard have made him particularly opposed to the organization, though since entering the academy, he hasn't really had a chance to enact his negative feelings toward them

Name: Alice Aschenwald
Physical Description: A blonde girl that dresses in common Eurysian garbs, nothing fancy, no jewelry, clearly trying not to stand out from a crowd.  She walks with the posture of a trained military, even though her young face might tell you otherwise. When the coat is off, her arms are bandaged all the way up to the elbow, much like one of her eyes.
Story Summary:
- Grew up in a starving family on the outskirts of Reven.
- Passes a magic test from a visiting sorcerer and gets a mage apprenticeship at Bennigsen Military Academy.
- A teacher of arcane arts, Erasmus Bonafide manipulates her and her only friend, Brenno, to be his experiments.
- Brainwashes Brenno into killing her parents to spark their potential.
- Alice summons the Memory Stone for the first time, clearing his mind. Brenno disappears.
- She flees from Delsatz and Erasmus, eventually heading into the Runewall.

Name: Alira Spector
Physical Description:
An overly-critical gaze and pursed mouth that looks like it's just about to call out something wrong with whatever she's looking at makes up Alira's "neutral" expression. This is framed by long red hair which is largely unkempt.

The only thing that sticks out with her wardrobe is the eyepatch. It's a new addition to her clothing, a necessity given the serious damage inflicted to that entire side of the face due to the Photon Displacement Harness malfunctioning. Otherwise, she dresses plainly if professionally.
Rare Equipment: - Photon Displacement Harness (Sage Robe w/ Dual Resistance [Light & Dark])
Story Summary: Koralan professor with a skeptical streak. Learned to keep her head down until her student-turned-protege was made to disappear. Reawakened to the truth, she steals the prototype devices which they'd been working on rather than letting them be turned towards military applications. Narrowly escapes capture thanks to the call of the Worldhelm; now seeks to unveil all of Korala and Merrane's lies and secrets, with the foremost being the fate of her student Polli Magnic.

Name: Alois Wagner
Physical Description: Alois is a lean man with a pale complexion and a beauty mark under his lip. His outfit varies from place to place to ensure discretion but his normal attire is standard Wulfroh with purple replacing red. Covering one of his eyes is a sash, concealing his crystal he has as an heir. His demeanor is rather methodical and quiet, measuring everything around him with a hint of suspicion and distance. His weapon is a large scythe that thrums with thaumatergic power.
Story Summary:
- Born an ambitious boy in Markensburg with a magical talent and a burning desire to improve his skills. Family was supportive of it.

- Pulled by the desire stone into the cave and guided to it. Touching it and revealing his truest desire, his mind repressing the memories to prevent him from going mad. He remembers the feeling of contentment.

- Is carried out of the cave unconscious by the Desire Beacon, who introduces him to the new gem embedded in his eye, marking him as an Heir.

- He returns to his family and they still accepted him, he felt a shred of contentment, but they tried to ensure that his new power and path never consumed him.

- When he was in his late adolescents, he came back to his house to find his family killed and his house burnt to the ground. Going to the Desire Beacon.

- He swore his desire was to find those responsible and get his vengeance, became an agent of the Desire Beacon.

- Went to the expedition as an agent of Desire seeking to test his mettle.

Name: Alwyn
Physical Description: A relatively tall, well kept man with black hair wearing loose but well fitting clothes.
Quirks:
Old Transport (Skyship)
You own an old vehicle that you love dearly. Unfortunately, the cursed thing barely
holds together and won’t stop causing you trouble. Did you build this vehicle yourself,
or did you receive it from someone? What very specific flaw or quirk makes it unique?
What makes it extremely recognizable?


- Can have technical issues due to Alwyn's lack of technical know how. Can be minor as screens not turning on or as major as key components shutting off.
- Easily Recognizable to those who have knowledge on the Red Roses.
Story Summary: A wanted Sky Pirate whom currently flies alone. Though he is wanted for Theft and Assault, there is no evidence that he has done so to any non-noble/rich people/group.

Name: Alysone The Shadow
Physical Description:
Alysone is a 5'8" human woman with black, free-flowing hair.
Her face is scarred from a battle with the witch who cursed her, changing her remaining eye to have a yellow iris and black sclera while keeping her damaged eye shut at most times.

Her attire is a mix of her old military uniform plate and bandit band fabrics, creating an almost monochrome leather and steel outfit that has seen many battles on her journey.
Story Summary:
An ex-military, ex-bandit woman who got cursed over ten years ago, carrying anger in her heart after the loss of her family.
Entered the Runewall seeking death, but found an opportunity to change instead.

Name: Alyx Fauxmont
Physical Description:
Alyx is a broad-built woman adorned in a variety of unpolished metals, refined leathers, and multicolored gemstones. Her forearms are clad in thick, soot-stained mining gloves. Heavily reinforced breeches support the many items she tosses on the various belt loops and packs she has strapped across her body. Wild blonde hair curls down her back in a ponytail, with occasional streaks of crimson painting its ends. Piercings of varying sizes decorate her ears and brow, and thick smudges of ash line her eyes, intensifying her features. Alyx’s mint-green gaze is full of energy and, surprisingly, focus. She makes a point of maintaining eye contact in conversations, and is clearly well-practiced in people-pleasing despite her rugged appearance.

Carrying herself with immense pride, Alyx exudes a punkish demeanor that bleeds into her everyday attitude. A grin frequently lights up her beauty-marked face, and her jovial voice often trails into fits of hearty laughter when surrounded by others.
Story Summary:
- Alyx was the well-loved only child of the Fairmont merchant family in Markensburg, Wulforh. 
- Spoiled and secure, she was taught to ignore the struggles of others, but rumors of heroes risking life and limb across Eurys gnawed at her conscience. Every head turned for coin fed a growing resentment: life had to mean more than just cashing in Zenit, didn't it?
- Reaching her breaking point, she claimed she was traveling to Pragstenburg to study, but instead began moving across Eurys delivering much needed wares to those struck hardest by the calamity. 
- She saw a lot of strife and a lot of hope on the road. Meeting heroes inspired her. Giving them respite brought her great pride.
- Things changed when she came upon a strange creature in Grestazs. It longed for a home, somewhere beyond the Runewall. If she didn’t help, who would? After all, a merchant truly is a weary traveler’s best friend.

Name: Amaranth
Physical Description: Amaranth is a short traveler, with hair that takes the appearance of wheat, and a generally calm, and comforting aura. They travel with a flying magical beast, a strange fusion between a bird and an anteater, with whom they talk very, very often.
Rare Equipment:
**Left Phoenix Feather Blade** | 950 z |【**DEX + INS +1**】|【**HR + 7**】**Fire**
**Sword ◆ One-Handed ◆ Melee ◆** When you deal damage with this weapon, you can allow your **Faithful Companion** to regain Hit Points equal to half the damage dealt (to a maximum of 10).

**Right Phoenix Feather Blade** | 950 z |【**DEX + INS +1**】|【**HR + 7**】**Fire**
**Sword ◆ One-Handed ◆ Melee ◆** When your **Faithful Companion** loses Hit Points, you may choose to lose an equal amount of Hit Points in their stead.
Story Summary:
- Amaranth was once another person, who fell to their wounds, and died in the prosperity plains.

- The magic of the plains brought Amaranth to life as a new person, fused with the nearby plants.

- Amaranth has wandered ever since, with their wandering leading them to the Runewall expedition, which they now find themselves on the other side of.

Name: Ambrose
Physical Description:
Ambrose is a small person at only 4'5", whose lithe body is hidden underneath a couple layers of baggy mage clothing and alchemist tools laid atop them. He carries a large backpack covered in meticulously maintained labels. Any educated person in Kor'Tarion would quickly realize that this guy's inventory is stocked with magical payload that could easily raze a small town, if not most of a large city.

Dangling from a short rope attached to the wrist is a charred wand, with its core compartment and focus crystal empty, and waiting for its next configuration.

Name: Amelia Green
Physical Description: Amelia is a woman of average 5'4 stature with short pale yellow hair and bright red eyes. She often is dressed somewhat professionally and in light colors.
Story Summary:
- Was born in North Rock and had an uneventful life, coming from two hardworking, low-income parents.
- Taking a leap as a young adult, she took out some loans to begin her college education, reasoning that she could surely pay it off once she found a proper career after graduation.
- After graduating, her friends treated her out to celebrate. Being as ecstatic as she was, she overindulged and died that night due to alcohol poisoning. This also soured many of her friendships once she returned as an Insolvent.
- She spent the last 5 years trying to live a normal life, having found an entry-level journalist position for one of Galeforce's smaller newspaper subsidiaries and struggling to move up in the company.

Name: Amelie d'Artois
Physical Description: Amelie is a woman in her mid-20s with long blonde hair that falls down just past her hips. Her eyes are auburn, though noticeably glazed over, and her complexion seems oddly pale. Her clothes are usually black, to the point where they could maybe be mistaken for mourning clothes, were it not for the flower pattern embroidered upon her cloak. Most notably though are the golden chains around her neck, ankles and wrists as well as her arms that are unnaturally tinged blood red, up until just above her elbows.
Story Summary:
- Born to a declining noble family in Silverdale, Amelie ended up growing up in Rocade
- As her mother fell greatly ill, she learned from the druidic circle of Longevity, eventually joining it after her mother's death
- She became a notable druid, eventually to the point where she was assigned to assist in guarding a settlement as the spirits of the forest grew maddened by the Calamity
- During an attack, she was afflicted with the corrupt magic that the spirits are also suffering from
- Shackles were crafted to stem the surge of madness within her, sealing away her connection to Anima in the process
- Some time later, she joined the expedition into the Runewall, hoping to aid in discovering the solution to the end the suffering of Eurys

Name: Amina Grace
Physical Description: Amina is a tall woman, with her most striking features being her pallid skin and her dull red eyes. She's garbed in an eccentric outfit, blending together old styles with modern utilities that end in her appearing like some sort of cosplayer, rather than an adventurer.
Story Summary:
- In ancient Terra, a family of diviners made a deal with a dark group in the future, offering up one of their descendants as payment

- In the modern day, Amina, the last known descendant of that family and practitioner of their techniques, was wrapped up in a plot by ET Aquisitions, making her into an Insolvent 

- While using her predictive powers in service of ETA, she tried her best to help the people of Terra with her magic, efforts that eventually got her recognized by the Worldhelm

Name: Anais Penelle
Physical Description:
A pale faced beauty who carries with her the scars of a curse upon her face. Silver locks that end in pink hues and eyes of magenta that seem to be cast down at all times. 

Dressed in clothes that fit a woman of cloth, a brooch sits at her mid section, along with a book at her side carried by a single chain.
Story Summary:
* Born and raised in Stalmer by the Witch Ingrid
* Ingrid had left Stalmer years after to pursue a calling across Silverdale and had yet to return
* An incident with a man in Stalmer forced her to abandon the town.
* Having been cursed with dark anima, she bears the mark across her face. A constant reminder to any who look upon her.

Name: Anderth Rhastal
Physical Description: Anderth is a buff, stocky man who stands at 6'3". He wears a thin, patchwork shirt and a durable pair of trousers. His boots are so dirty it's hard to tell where they end and where his legs begin. He carries a beat-up pickaxe with a bunch of counting marks on it. He also wears a utility belt that has all the essentials for a miner. A lantern, oil, rope, a hunting knife, several maps, and various satchels and pockets. Anderth is usually wearing a scowl.

Name: Anise
Physical Description: Anise is a tall and imposing woman, standing at around 6'0" and wielding a large but otherwise ordinary greatsword. Her hair is light brown and often kept in the style of a chignon, pinned in place by the binyeo she wears. Up-close, scale-shaped brands can be seen going up her neck and parts of her face, though they are mostly hidden by her shawl and hair. Anise dresses in loose-fitting garb, accustomed to the heat of Nezmira. Other identifying features include her golden-yellow eyes, and small pieces of debris float around her at times, as if Anise had her own small gravitational field.

Name: Anki「暗記」
Physical Description: A relatively small Oni with subtle muscles and a relatively inconsistent bone structure. His face tends to twist between charming and innocent to unnatural and monstrous. He barely crests five feet tall, with bone spikes protruding from his chest, forehead, shoulders, elbows, and back.
Story Summary: Anki was born among yokai. As the child of two oni, he was not torn from a human life and into a wild one. He was raised as a devoted servant of the fox mother, and trained as a warrior under the Doom Seers of Tsukamu village. However, in recent times, their teachings have proven fruitless. Their visions are thwarted by outsiders. After a heated argument turned battle with his teacher over their purpose, Anki fled to Sunfire City, where he was caught up in a Realmstorm, and arrived on the ship. Now free of his prior roots, he searches for a reason to exist.

Name: Annelise Klein
Physical Description: A 5'7 polite-looking woman, often dressed in a more professional attire, her clothing ironed and pressed. To her side is often a rifle of magitech make, those who are aware can easily tell of its Merrani make.
Story Summary:
- Annelise was born into a notable Merrani family, though the Klein family has been known to be one of the more stubborn families against the crown.
- Annelise herself was given proper education and training in Korala before joining in her family's footsteps.
- She gained a leg up due to her family name and gained a promising path ahead of her.,
- When she entered her first proper task, she took well to her role until it came to the fact that she and her squad were sent to interfere with the transportation of supplies. When arriving it was also found to be transporting citizens.
- Annelise failed to commit to Merrane's edict and was caught trying to sabotage the mission to allow the citizens to escape.
- She was labeled a deserter and a traitor, being sent to Heaven's Gate due to her family name and those above her wanting to have one of the Klein's children with the intention of bargaining.

Name: Annette
Physical Description: Annette is a 5'4" girl with dirty blonde hair, and light brown eyes. She carries a brown bag full of paints and other art supplies with her at all times. When she speaks she has a noticable french accent. She's accompanied by a small water elemental named Flaque, who sometimes rides in a waterproof container in her bag.
Story Summary: Annette Desjardins was born and raised in Korala. She attended the Acadamy of Korala from a young age, possessing the rare gift of magic. She took mainly to the arts, and as the college became more focused on the war, she faced pressure to train as a battlemage. She hated the idea of contributing to the war, and chose instead to flee the college as the demands from above became more threatening. Along with her familiar, a water elemental named Flaque, she was travelling through the countryside when she was caught in a realmstorm and brought into the Heaven's Sea.

Name: Anri
Physical Description: Standing at just under 5 feet tall (not counting the ears), Anri is a white-and-grey-furred rabbit Yokai with distant silver eyes, blue markings on his cheeks, and a deceptively muscular build. Quiet and introspective to a fault, they always seem preoccupied with some question or other, often giving the impression that he does not notice-- or care-- about what's going on around him.
Rare Equipment:
- Magitech Hammer (Quantum Armament, Heavy Specialist)
- Moon Rabbit's Guard (Heaven's Defender)
- Stalwart Lantern (Composure)
Story Summary:
- Born to a family of Blacksmiths and Tubalcain devotees in a small village in the Kald forest
- An ald raid saw him taken from his home and separated from his family
- Was seen as a high-value captive due to his smithing skill; exchanged captors often due to trades, leadership changes, and short-lived escapes
- Eventually, gained freedom as a consequence of what he would one day learn - were the actions of Goldhearted.
- Brought to Hearthgarde, but didn't stay long, as he journeyed to find his old village; on arrival, found nothing but burned homes and shallow graves...
- ...Two of which were marked with the names of his parents.
- Convinced Aldistir held no future for him, he journeyed north, intent on reaching the world's edge and walking past Seraph's barrier
- Before he could get anywhere near there, was picked up by a Realmstorm.

Name: Anzai Midori 安斎 緑
Physical Description: A dark-haired individual dressed in a straw hat and flexible armor bearing spear and empty scabbard.
Story Summary:
- Former Samurai in service to Hakage Ito, a lord killed in a duel
- Became a mercenary instead of following an honorable end
- infected by negative energy, saved by a seal placed on the energy by a priestess from the Mugetsu region.

Name: Apollo Marinelli - ᵀʰᵉ Overture
Class List:
[★] Loremaster
[★] Chanter
[9] Arcanist
[★] Ace of Cards
[3] Entropist
[4] Orator
Physical Description: Standing at 5'7" and carrying himself with dignity. Apollo is a Yellow-olive scale colored Nezzim with a dainty form. He sports two sets of horns, green eyes, and a pair of glasses, likely to help with reading all the books he tends to carry around. He can typically be seen wearing his Kaiway uniform. A fuschia-colored top with baggy upper-arm sleeves, a crimson scarf, and a pauldron, along with a courier bag containing all of his necessities. He moves with grace and fluidity, often carrying a smug expression on their face.
Rare Equipment:
- Ornamental Red Crystal Necklace [Attr UP: WLP]
- Fermata of the Overture [Arcane Vitality]
- Lenses of the Lake [Jack of all Trades]
- Necrotic Ring of Relief [Constitution]
- "Pride and Joy"
Story Summary:
- Comes from a very toxic family of a distancing father and Egocentric mother
- Father is a well established and proficient paladin, Mother is a bureaucrat and spokeperson/negotiator for one of Heartdoms larger regions.
- At home was constantly abused for his lack of strength and capability. Mother only expects excellence to make herself look good, and her behaviour caused his golden child of a brother to do the same.
- Ran away from home to enroll into Gnosis Academy against his family's wishes, initially enrolled as a Paladin to get back at them by trying to be better than his brother.
- After his first year at the academy, seeing his overall results were not up to par, he changed to the House of Treasures to become a Regalia. Succeeding in the necessary measures to achieve that, Apollo now having become the Overture, he chose Perseus to become his Regent.

Name: Arasaka "Saki" Sasaki
Physical Description: Saki is a medium height at 4'11 very thin girl with long white hair. It often sticks up at odd angles either due to lack of care or to differentiate herself from her twin sister. Her normally blank expression hides eyes that seem to always be watching for trouble. She tends to wear heavier jackets that almost look too big for her and combat boots.
Story Summary: A twin born in Haven to an affluent mother, she abandoned that life to work as a temp to support her sister.

Name: Argad
Origin: Kor'Tarion: The White Feather House of Youth
Physical Description: Argad is a tall person with a bulky muscular body. His hair, almost as black as obsidian, a meticulously groomed beard, and intense black eyes give him an even more intimidating appearance. If it weren't for the almost constant smile on his face, no one would approach him.

Name: Aria (Isa)
Physical Description: Aria is a 5'4ft lady, with vibrant short red hair. She seems small at a distance but up close it easy to see she is containing muscles that have been honed for decades that allow her to back up the things she says.
Rare Equipment:
First Blade, Crownless (Specialist: Swords) | Physical

Second Blade, A Conflux of Rivers (World Saver) | Bolt | Elemental: Bolt | Defensive | Powerful

Third Blade, The Emerald Empress (Proof of Nobility) | Earth

Fourth Blade, Purifying Sun (Interrupt) | Fire

Fifth Blade, Veilspiltter (Possessed) | Air

Sixth Blade, Blade of the Patriarch (Unhealthy Luck) | Poison

Seventh Blade, Fang of Xuanwu (Anomalous) | Ice

Eighth Blade, Templar’s Blade | Light

Ninth Blade, Victory Squire's Arming Sword | Physical

Tenth Blade, 「རྡོ་རྗེ」 (Dorje) (Status Plus (Enraged)) | Bolt 

Eleventh Blade, Dual Form Sword (Quality: Multi) | Ice/Light

Twelfth Blade, Sword of Might (泰阿剑) | Cold

Thirteenth Blade, Blade of Greater Arson (Potent Damage (Fire) | Physical

Fourteenth Blade, The Hero's Journey | Light
Story Summary:
-Born to one of the Matriarchs of Tangbawan.
-Was taught cultivation from Kabiya and traveled with them from a very young age
-Powerful Yokai assaulted a group she and Kabiya was apart of. Kabiya passed but Aria found a new mentor among the group.
-Soon after fell into a realmstorm and brought to the Worldhelm

Name: Arin Sylvester
Origin:
Terra, Lumina Prime

[Currently Living In Vacay City in Dawnstar Valley]
Physical Description: Standing at 134 Cm Dark skinned with now yellow hair and black sclera eyes. The septid wears a yellow jacket, black leather pants, some brown boots and earphones around his neck.
Story Summary:
- Born in a Rich Family in Lumina Prime
- Was Born a Septid
- Was actually a really gifted Kid and had high grades
- Dropped outta school cause he hated the pressure and never got proper loving from his mother and father due to how he was born. Unlike his Brother and Sister both of whom were normal human born.
- He left to live in Vacay City in Dawnstar Valley away from his family
- Became the Drummer for the Local band called "The Misfits"
- The moon started being destroyed and it's shards crashed down onto terra. He got caught too close with one of them and it rapidly altered him giving him abilities he dosen't understand.
- One of those was Empowered strength and the power to control sound waves.
- The Second was the power to Manipulate electricity that empowered him but it's too chaotic for him to manifest.
- The band disbanded after that but he was able to get some work with SWORD getting him a Temp License
- Then Realmstorm happened
- Since joining the GH he became an Aegis TEMP

Name: Arsene Flamel
Origin: Kor’Tarion and he was born in midville
Physical Description: He is 5-7 150lbs with a decent build for running/walking long distances but can’t take many punches.
Story Summary: He wants to become the world’s best alchemist so he can find a cure for a mysterious magic disease that killed his father. One night during an experiment that was not approved by hudal academy led to him accidentally blowing up the lab and getting expelled. After this he tried to be a sailor and got caught up in the realmstorm leading to him meeting a Terran and being fascinated with their tech especially their medicine. This has sparked his new goal of becoming the greatest doctor in all of the realms. He wants to carry on his father’s memory by eradicating this disease that affected his father making the realms have a better tomorrow.

Name: Artemis Anderson
Physical Description: A spirited wheelchair-bound girl. 5'1" in height and a somewhat alarming 107lbs in weight
Story Summary:
* Born to a comfortably wealthy family in South Rock
* Diagnosed with a disease in her youth that would rob her of the use of her legs
* Her parents paid for a surgery to augment her spine to halt the damage, but the process was botched
* Parents tried suing the hospital but were destroyed in court and lost almost everything
* Parents then put themselves deep into debt to get her a far more underground solution from an independent lab
* Given her new lease on life, Artemis has decided to push her new augments to their limit to try and earn enough to save her parents from the possibility of insolvency when they pass.
* A mixture of running her top speed and her unstable augments misfiring at the same time transported her to the Worldhelm!
Theme: A girl given 4 legs up in life

Name: Arzen Algonst
Character Sheet Link: [The blight will know the strength of the Algonst bloodline!](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1GIuGP1eytzoRSVq3hGR3fr27fSJ6Um_2eB6FtzRCogI/edit?usp=sharing)
Physical Description:
One of the mice of Hearthome, large ears and a steeled gaze always looking to the horizon. One cannot doubt upon first look that this is a warrior of his people, a protector of the Firwood.

Standing with a stout build at 3'1", and a hefty 52lbs. A spindly flesh toned tail adorns his backside.
Rare Equipment:
[Accessory] Pendant of Cleansing Embers- Damage Change (Fire)
[Armor] Heavenly Lion's Plate- Heaven's Defender
Story Summary:
Eldest of five siblings, Arzen is son of King Harkon and as such has come to inherit the boon of the lion; a mark passed down from father to son. 
This mark has dictated future rulers of hearthome but only if they are found worthy. In effort to assist, the king has ordered Arzen to gather citizens of the Firwoods to establish The Fellowship to combat the encroaching blight.

Name: Asahi [旭]
Physical Description:
One of their main usual forms is a woman with long, brown hair who stands at 5'8" with a slender figure. Wearing a comfortable set of kimono robes with a checkered scarf, and a pair of rounded glasses that accentuates her brown eyes. Another common form would be a short brown haired man with green eyes, standing tall at 6'0". Typically wearing a more form fitting set of kimono robes to accentuate an athletic figure.

Usually Asahi speaks with a sense of wit, and often playful tone. Often teasing the other person. Carrying themselves in a rather refined manner. When in more private spaces, they're exhibit a much more comfortable demeanor.
Story Summary:
- Born in Mugetsu nearby a shrine devoted to Inari Okami to a pair of kitsune parents. Named Yuuka.
- Reached an age where found themselves traveling around across the isles of Nishibi, until they spent majority of their life within Ishihara. Living amongst a house of courtesans, where they picked up various tricks over the years. As well as learning to befriend humans while under a human guise.
- One day, their visit to a shrine devoted to Inari Okami brought about a peculiar visit from one of a many tailed kitsune that is said to be a divine servant of the Kami themselves. They befriended that divine servant, who in return enhance a blessing they always had since birth. Allowing them to call upon the blessing of Inari Okami.
- One day, found themselves under the employ of Clan Kujō who saw through their disguise. They swore before the current head, Miyuki, and worked under her as one of nd worked under her as one of spymasters of sorts. From there, they were given a new name: Asahi.

Name: Ascalon Forseti
Physical Description: A fair skinned male standing tall at 6'2'' with cyan hair. Decorated in earthern green heavy armor a look of starwartness and alertness is present on his face. At his side is a large regal axe and a shield matching the armor. Despite the weight or burden of the gear, his gait does not show strain or heavy steps.

Name: Aslatiel
Physical Description: blue robes, white hair, pointed ears, half side of body is covered in a shadowy scar
Story Summary: an elven student banished from the hudal academy. He now searches for new purpose through being a goldhearted.

Name: Aster Vayelia
Physical Description: A tall and skinny young woman with fair skin. Her reddish-brown hair is in two messy braids, with a tendency to frizz and have flyaway strands. Her wide blue eyes make it easy to get a read on her emotions, or at least on her anxiety in the moment, though sometimes they're concealed behind large round reading glasses. She tends towards the simple, pretty, and practical: full skirts and sturdy boots for afternoons out in the garden.
Story Summary:
- For generations the Vayelia family has trained one child to serve the Order and one for the Coven.
- Aster's older sister Laurel joined the Order and rose quickly. Aster joined the Coven and showed connection with nature and the Soul Stone, slowly building confidence.
- Laurel was selected for an expedition to the Runewall, but grew erratic and expressed doubt that the constant fight was worth it. She abandoned the mission and the Order, and is rumored to have joined the Rimelz Hounds.
- Aster blamed herself for not seeing her sister's fears. She prayed to the Soul Stone for how to make things right - and received a vision to bind the Stone as an Arcanist and go to the Runewall in her sister's place. This is how she came to join the Goldhearted.

Name: Aston
Physical Description: Aston stands just short of six feet tall, with a lean, athletic build. His hair is a dull silver, usually tied back and hidden beneath the demon fox-like mask he rarely removes. Most of his body is covered in dark tactical gear and red armor plating that’s seen its share of wear and tear. A katana rests across his back, and faint mechanical seams run along his arms.
Quirks:
Fugitive Experiment:

You were somehow created or fundamentally modified, and you could see it was not entirely positive.

When a rule or ability requires you to spend 100 or fewer Hit Points, Mind Points, Inventory Points, or Fabula Points, you may suffer 1d8 Instability Points to ignore that cost.
At the end of each session (approximately four hours of play), you lose 1d6 Instability Points (to a minimum of zero).

If your Instability Points ever reach 10 or more, you are immediately reduced to 0 Hit Points and Surrender. The consequences of this Surrender should be tied to you losing control of your abilities. Then, you lose all Instability Points.
Story Summary:
Grew up in a Cabre orphanage alongside his twin sister. Both displayed rare psychic affinity at a young age.

As teenagers, they were recruited by Tubal & Cain to work as “Temps” — contract operatives for testing experimental technology and performing Soul Network infiltrations.

- The sister’s esper talents outpaced his own. The two became a reliable team for deep-dive missions and prototype testing however.

- During a classified trial involving a modified RWO device, a malfunction caused his sister’s consciousness to be trapped within the Soul Network. Her body survived, but her mind never resurfaced.

- Tubal & Cain used his sister to keep him on a leash. black ops missions that often would go wrong, leading to increasingly more augmentations.

- During one of their latest attempt to dive, a storm would engulf his apartment. Transferring him to the Worldhelm.

Name: Aston Aldebrand
Physical Description:
Aston is tall (6'1"), grizzled, and rather well-muscled (220 lbs) - he walks with a noticeable limp, but is otherwise in great shape for his age and (last-known) occupation.

Being retired from active service, he no longer wears his old uniform anymore (doing so would draw too much attention anyway), although he still prefers clothes in similar colors, which he wears underneath his old gear. A small brass pendant is hung around his neck.
Story Summary:
- Born in Little Ottington in the Kingdom of Karlsgard. One older brother living in the Tundra, one niece who moved to the Bastion.
- Joined the military when his tavernkeeper parents died around twenty years ago. Assigned as an army cook after training.
- Survived the destruction of his battalion during one of the first Angel attacks of the Merrani invasion. Spent months in recuperation afterwards.
- Eventually helped with feeding and housing of refugees and wounded, instead of returning to the frontlines.
- Taken by the Realmstorm to the Worldhelm some time after, where he then joined the Goldhearted's embassy to the Dragon's Den, and learnt the true stakes of the Lhodos war.

Name: Asuka Senko
Physical Description:
A dark haired beauty that hails from Tokusou, with a soft smile and gives the impression she enjoys luxury and the nicer things that places have to offer.

Standing at an impressive height of 5'1'', she is often seen floating, carrying small pouches and instruments, as well as the faint aroma of incense on her person.

Often if not always accompanied by a strange masked bird she affectionately calls Kumo.
Related Arcana:
Path of Odyssey (Banshee)
Path of Valor (Seraph)
Story Summary:
* Asuka was born and raised in Tokusou. At the first chance she got, she joined the Trailblazers to escape the life she had lived and to explore and travel.
* On her journeys, she saved a Folkin Critter named Kumo that became her companion as she travels. Helping her utilise her skillset.
* Eventually she even left the Trailblazers to then join the Adventuring Guild; to explore further and to help others across the Land from the Taint.

Name: Asuka Yumiko
Physical Description: A woman standing at 5'8 with luxurious eastern clothing and a large bow. She stands with an aloof but scrutinizing look, judging all in her sharp eyes.

Name: Atticus Blackburn
Physical Description: Atticus stands at six feet tall with an athletic build. He has olive skin and keeps a shaved head. He wears a pilot's uniform consisting of a standard plug suit and a red coat over top
Rare Equipment:
LNT-450 Castor Coilgun (Pilot’s Blade)

Eerie Eel Spotting Scope (Efficient Barrage)
Story Summary:
After the fall of his home Vale Atticus immediately joined up with the KPLA.

As an adult he joined Phantom Squadron, a reconnaissance group for the KPLA.

Throughout his time in the KPLA Atticus proved himself as a Sniper and scout. His skill is impressive able to nail Merrane walkers and is able to takedown targets from 3871 yards out with a regular sniper rifle

After over two decades of dedicated service to the KPLA Atticus earned the rank of Wyrm and was chosen to be one of the members of Goetia Squad.

He now pilots the mech Balaam taking down enemies with frightening precision.

Name: Auro Benites
Physical Description: 5'9 (otherwise see art)
Rare Equipment:
Energizing Armband
Desert Duelist

Name: Aven Elmhorn
Physical Description:
When in his armor its brass in color and fairly standard, however from holes in the armor or from its joints a throned plant grows from it aggressively.

Out of armor he is a middle aged man, with darker colored hair and a scarred face. His eyes a bit sunken and dark.
Story Summary:
- Aven was a knight tasked with hunting down Fae and would travel most of Kor' Tarion to do so.
- Three years ago his squad went missing after being sent to the Howling Woods.
- Aven with no recollection of events after having arrived in the woods woke.
- Found himself questioning if he was himself or if he was something imitating himself.
- A thorny plant seems to be growing though his body and armor and wrapping around it, any thoughts of trying to remove it quickly leaving him.
- Saved Fae-Touched in the Gwaed when before he would have never, as a desire for retribution to those who wronged Fae and Fae-Touched built.
- A few days after his run in with Fae-Touched he was swept up in a strange storm and awoke on the Worldhelm.

Name: Axel Reed
Physical Description:
A massive man standing at a lean but towering 6'8", Axel Reed has the imposing, coiled presence befitting his reputation as a dangerous outlaw. His hair is a wild ruddy red that falls in jagged layers beneath a dark, gold-trimmed hat before being tied into a long decorated braid that hangs to his knees. His devil pact has marked him physically, leaving burnt brown scales creeping across his arms, chest, neck, and face that glow molten orange whenever the hellfire within him stirs. His eyes glow with that same heat, emphasizing a sharp grin that speaks to his confidence and enthusiasm for the chaos and fun to come.

His clothes are rugged frontier leathers and a long coat, with jagged blackened armor fashioned after snake skeletons fused over his limbs. At his side rests a massive custom revolver, built to fire specialized rounds infused with devilish magic so powerful its recoil could knock an ordinary person flat. Its metal still has a faint glow from the fire he used to forge it.
Quirks:
Lawless - Desperado
In Axel's early days as an outlaw, he once shared a fire with a quiet drifter on an open trail. The man never gave his name and spoke little, but when Axel told him his story and warned him about the law on his tail, the drifter only chuckled.

"Ain't no law out here but your own."

The next morning, the stranger was gone without a trace. But his words helped clear any remaining doubt in Axel's mind. He's taken those words to heart ever since.
Story Summary:
- Son of a frontier blacksmith from Jamestown and a witch from Copsehaven, Axel grew up between two worlds on the far frontier.
- Everything changed when a nearby gold vein drew Gold Standard and Proudrock west. Rumors spread that his mother hid liquid gold with witchcraft.
- When officials came to take her in, a scuffle broke out and Axel's brother was shot dead. The forge was ransacked and his family driven out.
- That night a devil answered Axel's grief, gifting him a fragment of hellfire to forge a gun and take vengeance.
- After killing the men responsible, Axel became a wanted outlaw.
- Years later, he sought pardon through a bounty on the witch Antikythera and her apprentice Isolde.
- Realizing the bounty was unjust, he turned on the other outlaws there. He and Isolde became gravely wounded in the fight, and Isolde saved them both by entwining her soul with his.
- Now unlikely partners, Axel and Isolde travel together handling personal business until being caught in Realmstorm.

Name: Azhtang Tenker
Origin: Temple of Fortutide, Leytik, Tian Yin
Physical Description: Tall at 200cm (about 6'7"), and fairly pretty, Azhtang wears traditional clothing, with geometric symbols along the hems of his deel, and symbols representing Tengri among the talismans and jewelry he wears. He usually keeps his long, blue-streaked silver hair kept in a braid, but his techniques often loosen it.
Story Summary:
- Azhtang was an orphan from a small village at the foot of the Tanggula Mountains
- He was a pickpocket and a thief
