- He tried to steal from a member of a local martial arts school, and got beaten half to death
- He vowed revenge
- He joined the Empty Monks to gain power
- His qi was incompatible with void qi, so he tried to develop his own cultivation method by journeying to each of the Temples
- At the Temple of Fortitude, he found tablets discussing a god that could grant him strength and a cultivation method to emulate the god's power
- While training with one of his new techniques, the Unbound Steps, he stepped into the void and found a realmstorm, which brought him to the ship

Name: Azik Eggers
Physical Description:
A dark skinned 5’ 8” man weighing around 183 pounds wearing black and white clothes (what a shocker)

He likes wearing firm and proper clothing to match his serious profession. Outside the myist they still end up being darker toned clothes however bronze detailing and shades of maroon under his black coat.
Story Summary: Up until the inciting incident that caused him to be connected to the black they lived a normal life in the city not knowing of the horrors that crept among the shadows. When he convicted the wrong man he was later kidnapped by them for a dark ritual to banish him to the black. SIA broke in during the climax of the ritual and stopped it before it could be completed however not before it could affect his very being. Now forever tied to the black he tries to coexist among those that know not the horrors, those who know the horrors all too well, and those who belong to the many horrors of this world.

Name: Azra Yıldıran
Physical Description: Azra has short, white hair styled in a tousled pixie cut. Her golden eyes hold a calm, steady focus beneath strands that frame her face. She wears a high-collared black outfit decorated with deep blue and violet floral embroidery and silver star patterns. Her right arm is entire made of crystal, adorned with an intricate prosthetic that glows faintly, its surface shifting with gold and green hues and releasing fragments of light. When she walks, she carries herself with a poised, confident silhouette befitting an heir of prosperity.
Story Summary:
- Born in Grestazs, Azra was a gifted child raised amid dust, salvage, and invention.
- As a teenager, she protected another during a leyline rupture. After the act, signs that she was an heir to the Prosperity stone started to appear.
- Wulforh took her by force, ignoring her village’s refusal and shattering her childhood.
- At Bruesen Academy, she designed her own prosthetic arm using her heir-stone and Enarch knowledge.
- She now studies magic while secretly rejecting Siegfrieds's despite her complicated relationship with him.
- Sent beyond the Runewall by Siegfried, she sees the mission not as a test but a chance to change her fate.

Name: BRONZE GOLEM
Physical Description: Kim has short and messy black hair, gray skin and red eyes. they are often seen wearing a lab coat alongside a purple shirt and black pants. they stand at a height of 171 cm (or 5,6 in freedom units)
Story Summary:
-father is biology teacher and they tried to follow in his footsteps by becoming a scientist.

-went into debt and let themselves get killed by a random gang  on purpose to become an insolvent. 

-became an insolvent  to stop aging and be able to do research forever

-had an assistant called Elena and considered her as an intelectual and friend but they unfortunatly stopped being friends after kim made the reckless decision of becoming an insolvent without informing her.

Name: BRONZE GOLEM (#2)
Physical Description: 6'3" human man with a lean yet muscular build & fashionable clothes. Wields a magical staff, and bears a tattoo of a dragon across his back.

Name: Baaxee
Class List:
Guardian ⋆
Fury ⋆
Darkblade ⋆
Floralist ⋆
Necromancer 3
Weaponmaster 2
Invoker 1
Physical Description:
Baaxee is a 3'5 goblin, with the standard green skin of her people and with messy hair tinted blue by forest berries. Her head is wide, and her sharp grinning mouth, wider still. The sclera of her eyes is yellow, and the iris a solid red. More often than not, she is clad in armor across her whole body, save her arms, though those are often, instead, protected by dome-like shields that can link together into a closed sphere.

After clashing with a Realm-ending meteor, her right arm has burnt away to the shoulder, and been replaced with a prosthetic of living wood.
Story Summary:
* Grew up amidst the tree of the Gwaed Forest like many goblins
* Would watch the actions of passing adventurers with rapt fascination
* Often attempted to perform heroic deeds like returning lost objects, finding children gone astray, and chasing away wildlife from human villages, to mixed reception
* Was taught the ways of the protector by an old hermit in the woods she kept bugging
* Found an abandoned keep and swiped equipment from it, right before being brought to the Worldhelm in time for the Bloodmoon
* Has accepted tutelage under Hopper as the next Knight of Vengeance.

Name: Barry Strike
Physical Description:
Barry Strike is an enthusiastic young man appearing to be in his late teens, standing at 5'6" with messy, fringe blonde hair and sparkling blue eyes. At first glance, it's his grandiose, larger-than life cowboy character that takes center stage. He's got the skills, looks, and attitude to back it all up-- but his excitable, youthful nature often cracks through his cool persona whenever he's caught unaware.
His attire consists of what you'd expect from a Lhodos gunslinger, his most notable accessories being a worn black hat and a tattered red scarf around his neck. In terms of demeanor, Barry carries himself with the exaggerated charm and bravado of a classic frontier hero, but what shines the most is the warmth of his presence-- bright, carefree, and impossible to ignore.
Rare Equipment:
* Trailblazer's Cowboy Hat (Lucky Bullet Accessory)
* Vibrant Red Scarf (Antistatus: Slow Accessory)
Story Summary:
* Born and raised in Vale, inspired by the arts and stories of grand heroes & stylish gunslingers
* Loses father as a young child during the attack on Vale ten years ago
* Family takes refuge in Bastion, persists through scavenging and survival skills
* Joins the KPLA as a teenager in hopes of fighting for freedom and becoming his own man
* Faces death's door when fighting to save allies during a skirmish
* Miraculously saved by a Realmstorm transporting him to the Worldhelm
* Aims to one day return to Lhodos with new allies and more experience to aid the resistance

Name: Basim Kivain
Physical Description: A tall and bulky human male standing around 6'6 with their brown hair tied into a ponytail. Basim's form covered with several burn marks inflicted on him, the most notable of which being the one over the bandages that cover his eyes.
Rare Equipment: Training Spear [Heirloom]

Name: Bear
Physical Description: A man standing at a strong 6'8" and with a Himbo build: broad shoulders, wide chest, muscular, sturdy, and "thicc." He has a moderately tan complexion, like that of a perfectly baked loaf of bread. His hair is a deep burgundy and he keeps his full beard. Wearing short sleeves and more airy clothes reveals the surprising amount of body hair that earned him the name "Bear," but he only wears so little while working out.

Name: Beatrice Verdenhart
Physical Description: Standing tall at 6'1, she has fair features with a carefree expression, wearing her plaid tabard over her armour, holding her cherished weapon Caladsin. Known for her quixotic disposition, she is almost always smiling.
Rare Equipment:
Caladsin
Rough Plate
Story Summary:
-Lived in Kor'Tarion as a local guardian, raised by the wilds, then willowbough
-Arrived on the Worldhelm with zeal and vigor, taking on many challenges and eager for more

Name: Bellamie Ghoroznova
Character Sheet Link: [Come, little soldier. Let's show these dogs what hope *really is.*](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1RtL-u0-PJy960wm-Z9nXVOJloE9j0iVBjwvpdYWx8vU/edit?gid=1509081562#gid=1509081562)
Class List: Sharpshooter ★, Tinkerer ★, Weaponmaster 7, Fury ★, Mutant ★, Arcanist 2, Guardian 1
Other Names:
Bellamie Ghoroznovich
Agent Lindwurm
Bella-Taisho
Bella
Physical Description:
Standing at 6'6 and some 200 pounds, Bellamie Ghoroznova stands at the peak of physical fitness. Her flesh, though newly regrown, still bears the scars of a life lived in battle - and she would have it no other way.

The old soldier lives her life in army fatigues and a military green jacket, though its not uncommon for her to experiment with other clothes - particularly those from Terra. In combat, though, Bella wears a suit of pure iron, decorated with reliefs of dragons and heroes and a single orange sash.
Story Summary:
Twenty one years a victim, eight years a soldier, nine years a monster...

Born and raised in Lhodos, scarred by war and turned into a weapon of her own volition to save her home, Bella shed her humanity.

Broken and made desperate by Tian Yin, Bella shed her humanity even further, delving into the safety of her role as The Lindwurm.

Healed by her friends, and made whole in the crucible of Terra - Bella finds herself human again, with a power greater than she had ever held. Though, within her, she holds the blood and might of the ARMY Grade Charibdys.

Name: Benjamin Moore
Character Sheet Link: ["Well hell, I guess I gotta show some no good doin' dastard the power of a solid barker, huh?"](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1SGoVkzFY8tnzK7I_2yoWNMiGziZFsMZ1OfQrV-bAhtw/edit?gid=0#0gid=0)
Physical Description: Older man, kinda pudgy, sharp eyed and always having an easy smile on his face

Name: Benício Galhardo
Physical Description: Dressed in a leather duster standing over five feet by a few inches. A rowdy looking kind of expression as a young man ready to tussle, yellow eyes and grey-ish feathers with sharp black talons. In his shadow looms the visage of jaws sometimes.
Quirks:
Heirloom: Father's Old Badge

(Flaw: The Badge has gained the infamy of Benicio's deeds, bringing with it drifters, outlaws and others that might want to test and pay back this bird for their reign of 'justice' or people simply aren't too keen to trust him for fear of being dragged into whatever storm he brings.)
Story Summary:
- Benício was born in a traveling trailblazer caravan with a very large family.
- His father through the travels kept the peace and the caravan safe as they traveled through Aranova.
- Eventually Benício left the caravan on his own due to being "Heavy Handed" when with dealing with outlaws and the like.
- He left of his own accord before relations could sour but was handed his father's old badge before leaving as a memento.
- Benício made home in Tessalia for a while and helped keep the peace of the roads.
- He ended up living along with some Drifters taking a proactive approach around Tessalia, changing his hunting to dealing with drifters who go too far and turn into outlaws and the like instead of the whole.
- His image became synonymous with three things, the Eldentech weapon he carried with him, the aged badge on his chest and the shadow of jaws that accompanied him when on the hunt, eventually earning a reputation for putting down many outlaws before leaving and ending up as one

Name: Bernard Cooke
Physical Description:
6'2" Caucasian Male
Slightly husky, muscular, ginger hair, glasses.
Dresses middle to high class normally.
Story Summary: Recently ended up in Worldhelm, backstory is all we've got right now.

Name: Bernhard Klausner
Physical Description:
An imposing man, standing at 6'6" with a powerful physique tempered by constant conflict and manual labor. His face and upper body show scars from fighting a large, clawed beast that took his right eye.

His equipment is well-worn, showing signs of intensive combat, wielding a spiked vambrace and a broad-axe. Around his neck is a seemingly hand-crafted pendant that depicts a bear.
Quirks:
**__Curse of the Calamitous Hunt__**
In addition to afflicting him with violent transformations influenced by the magic of the Calamity, the cursed magic seeps into his mind, twisting his thoughts into those of a beast (an effect which is reinforced by his perception of himself). In times of heightened emotion or distress, Bernhard may succumb to its influence, acting in a manner befitting a destructive monster.
Story Summary: A former soldier, turned mercenary who has experienced a life of misfortune caused by the Calamity. With little to his name beyond his basic possessions and a curse levied by the former Beacon of Soul, he fights as a Goldhearted...for as long as he doesn't become one of the very monsters he has trained to kill.

Name: Beryl Reynaud
Class List:
Arcanist | ★
Chimerist | 1

(Ego Class)  | ★

Elliot: Guardian

Origin:
Beryl and Elliot: North Rock, Haven, Terra
Zhen: Shattered Staircase, Wujin Guo, Tian Yin
Other Names:
Callsign: Basilisk
Blooky (from hte fob)

(Alter Egos)
Elliot Snider
Zhen Cheung
Physical Description: Standing at a modest 5'8, Beryl is usually dressed in a hoodie and baggy pants, with a large duffle bag that they use to carry their spray cans as well.
Quirks:
Fractal Soul
When you gain this quirk, choose one of your classes to be your Ego class. Then, create up to two alter egos. Alter egos have an associated class of their own, as well as their own identity, theme, origin, and set of bonds (Except Heroic Bonds, which are shared across all egos). Only one of your egos is active at a time; you do not have access to the ego classes, bonds, or traits of your inactive egos. This means you may lose access to heroic skills in your non-ego classes if you no longer meet their prerequisites.
   At the beginning of a session or when you Rest, you may spend 2 Fabula Points to switch which ego is active.
   Once per session (approximately four hours of play), the Game Master may give you 1 Fabula Point in order to have sudden complications arise due to your fractal nature (such as your other egos intervening in the scene, a sudden flash of information, or memory loss).
Rare Equipment: Dahaka's Bag of Holding | Hudal Shop
Story Summary:
- Born and raised in the Barrio
- Wasn't poor, but not very well off
- Some financial instability caused their parents to turn to gambling and drinking to cope
- They despised seeing their parents a mess and got into work as soon as they could
- Coincidentally got into work in DHK and dislikes the corp, but it helps keep their parents stable so they deal with it
- Got caught tagging one of the stores near the Barrio and got hired to make art for some bird guy as a side gig
- Was swept away while out tagging during a particularly bad storm, turned out to be a Realmstorm
Theme:
Beryl: Guilt
Zhen: Perserverance
Elliot: Belonging

Name: Bishop Ruthven
Physical Description: Always wearing a well kept red coat and holding a rather cold expression. His ears are pointed giving him almost an appearance that could suggest an elven origin if it weren't for the ominous red glow to his eyes.

Name: Bjorn
Physical Description:
At exactly 6'0, Bjorn is a rather broad individual who has seen his fair days at an anvil and other forms of strenuous labor. It's extremely rare for him to not be traveling in a full set of plate armor that he has crafted himself, though for those who are lucky to see beneath the mask see a rather normal-looking man with brown hair, silver eyes and half-shaven facial hair.

Since the encounter that led to his banishment from Dryholde, his silver eyes had always had the faintest of glows, as if a full moon was reflected on the surface of his eyes.
Story Summary:
- Born within the realm of Kor'Tarian, specifically within Dryholde

- He was a blacksmith for his father and was constantly being used for physical labor, paid and unpaid.

- Came across a mysterious white shard in a graveyard that gave him elemental powers, and since then been banished from Dryholde.

- Years later, news reached Bjorn about the demon invasion that had ransacked Dryholde, including everyone within. Now knowing that he turned his back on his friends and family back home, he vows to never let another innocent die again. He now travels within the Worldhelm to find a new purpose in life, no longer running from the past but instead walking towards the future.

Name: Blackthorn
Physical Description: Athletically built with long white hair and blue eyes. Wears natural colored clothes to help blend into nature. Rosebud is a black wolf with ice blue eyes.
Rare Equipment:
- Winter Jacket: Combat Tunic | Resistance to Ice Damage
- Hunter's Bow: [Dex + Ins] + 2 | [HR + 11] | Powerful, Accurate, Magical Defense, Efficient Barrager
Story Summary:
- Born to parents in Dryholde
- Fled with mom to Concordia when it burned down
- Arguments with mom eventually led to her leaving to live in the woods.
- Felt like a coward when Concordia was freed
- Joined up with Goldhearted Coalition after that to feel like she could help out.

Name: Blue Bolt
Other Names: Champion of Justice, Enemy of All Evil, Savior at the Broken Vortex, Divine Reckoner of the Reiki, Hero of Mount Providence (secret identity: Mercedes "Mercy" Soto-Mendoza)
Physical Description: The Blue Bolt, Champion of Justice and Enemy of All Evil, stands just a little over six feet tall and visually appears as a masculine (if a bit lean), armored warrior. His suit, the Battle Frame Ω, has a stark blue coloration and bears the hero's logo on its chest: two mirrored lightning bolts with a triangle between them. No part of the outfit visually reveals anything of the person within.
Quirks:
Elemental Soul
Bolt resist/rituals + Earth vuln
Story Summary:
The Blue Bolt, the Hero of Mount Providence, first popped up six years ago, beating up small-time thugs in a blue-colored outfit and masked by a bandanna around his face. Since that time he's upgraded himself quite a bit and, after a brief disappearance, has resurfaced aboard the Worldhelm! He's not an especially well known hero by any means, but to the people of Soledad Church, he's the symbol of justice!

|| The first Blue Bolt, Mateo, died in the line of duty, and was succeeded by his younger sister, Mercy. With his death, an ancient magic within their family's bloodline passed from Mateo to Mercy, giving her a bounty of electrical aether and the power to fight as the New Blue Bolt. ||

Name: Braxus
Physical Description: A tall human man draped in well forged steel that has seen better days. Carries and even sleeps hugging a vicious large waraxe.

Name: Brigitta - ᵀʰᵉ Superstar
Physical Description: Standing at a stunning 6'0, Brigitta sports a mane of sparkling, dark hair, with bangs that hide her eyes, but not her wide smile. It contrasts with her style of dress, favoring stage looks with bright, sunny colors, over-the-top choices like leotards and thigh-high gogo boots that have definitely had her yelled at by Gnosis faculty. Overall, it's hard to ignore, which is the point.
Story Summary:
* Born in the ruins of Heartdom, to a family of Lhodosian origins
* Would use the echo when climbing atop the metal skeletons of ruined skyscrapers to carry her words and song
* Applied to Gnosis Academy, intent on furthering her stage and find a cause
* Underwent the Rite of Bonding due to wanting to amplify other people's message, too, and be an echo for everyone
* Heads the Gnosis Student Radio, and spreads both upbeat song and a message against all tyranny
* Sent to remedial class due to a general flaunting of rules, especially dress code

Name: Bronzeheart
Physical Description: An elvish woman of average height and muscular build, typically clad in heavy armor. Her red hair is decorated with flowers and, in battle, a mask resembling winding branches.

Name: Brym Terablight
Physical Description: Blonde hair, orange eyes with a skinny build. He wears  a robe adorned with little decorations, The left side of his head containing a complicated brand running across his neck.

Name: Burkhardt Stahlgren
Physical Description: Tall at 6'3", and well-muscled at 224lbs, Burkhardt is a defender through and through. Armored in the best he could get during his career in the military, shrouded in the blue and orange of his house, and almost always with his personal tower shield, the Waste Warden, the glowing orange handprint in its center giving off a constant warmth. He also carries a giant blade, though it doesn't seem to really fit the word "sword", as it's too big for any normal person to reasonably wield, and it's not sharpened at all, almost like it's a blank slate for him to manipulate with his Anima magic.
Quirks:
Heirloom: Waste Warden
A shield with a spell of heat to protect against the cold and the undead. The magic in the shield can sometimes overheat, causing the temperature to skyrocket in only a few seconds.
Rare Equipment:
**Waste Warden:** Heirloom LVL 2: Otherworldly Veil Runic Shield
**Blank Slate:** attribute modified Bronze Sword
**Havoc-Bringer Scabbard:** Gnosis Academy Accessory
**Plate of the People:** Heaven's Defender (IM Weak; if Villain: RS Earth, +1 Def) Steel Plate
**Warden's Trench Hatchet:** Desperate Broadaxe
**Cursed Blade, Swordreaver:** Swordbreaker Waraxe
Story Summary:
- Raised in Gerlund by his mother and father, Ilva and Anders, along with his older brother, Liam
- Father was a soldier and told stories of their ancestors and their family history
- Brother became a recruit when Burkhardt was 7
- Became a soldier when he turned 12
- At 16, during a training drill near the Permanence Stone, he snuck off to see the stone, and through means he still doesn't fully understand, took some of its power
- Spent his life on the border of the Wasteveil, fighting undead, as did his father and his brother
- After years of fighting, his brother and his brother's squad died when undead swarmed him during one of Waste Warden's bouts of wild magic. Only the scout that returned the shield was left alive. Liam left behind a wife, two daughters, and a son
- Joined the Expedition to find a better way to help Liam's family and to maybe put an end to the undead scourge brought about by the Calamity

Name: Cadence Claudia
Physical Description:
Cadence is a 5'4" tall human (5'9" with the hat on).
She has long dark blue hair, that often borders on black in dim lighting, that she styles into two very long pigtails.
Her eyes are an intense shade of red that make her scowls more fierce than she intends to.
Story Summary:
- Raised by her mother alone.
- Her mother was cursed by a trickster demon.
- After her mother's death, she awakened her magic potential.
- Despite fey relations being positive, she distrusts fey.
- Cares a lot about intents and spelling.

Name: Caellica Ronara
Character Sheet Link: ["I'll figure out Fate's plan for all of us, even if I have to search past the storm, the sky, the stars, the entire universe!"](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1wefMli2Wtxq5dpVyVQR7cIsZlbOVCnJc3flti19NQF8/edit?gid=0#gid=0)
Physical Description: A small 3'3" moth with gray-blue fur and blue hair, hazel eyes and two scars across the sides of their face. They wear a large, oversized coat with a small cyan muffler and the wings on their back are slightly clipped.
Story Summary:
- One of the youngest seers of the Moth Tribe.

- Their birth was unusual. As a pupa, they had a vision of themselves as a warrior,  wandering an endless expanse of ice and snow as a blizzard rages against them. They have no idea where they are or where they are going. All they know is that they must go. A voice rings out, echoing throughout the pure frigid white.  

- "Grant us clemency. Grant us benediction. Grant us salvation. Grant us light."

- Cael was born shivering, housing an Elemental Soul from the Rootway. The prophecy and the pleads from this dream convince them to become a Seeker of Fate, trying to find the truth of their visions while trying to protect the land from the vicious Blight overrunning the wood.

- Cael joins their childhood friend's Fellowship  and is lured into a raging storm where they soon awaken to a cloudless sky and trickling water.

Name: Caelum Fulmin
Physical Description: A male Humanoid standing at 5'7, green eyes with a faint glow. Several black markings scattered across his body, birth marks. He wears a common grey shirt underneath his combat clothing. His combat clothing being a long black coat, dark grey slacks, and black gloves. He walks around barefoot, however due to Merrane experimenting on his body, combat boots are formed whenever his feet come into contact with certain molecules. His clothes differ immensely from what he would normally wear, as they were given to him by Merrane.

Name: Caerwyn
Physical Description: Caerwyn is a short, muscular blonde girl with a rigid stance and seething eyes. She will not be seen without her dark armor ridged in fiery red, an ashen cloak hanging from her shoulders.
Rare Equipment: Meteoric-Topaz Embedded Magi-Bracer

Class List:

Physical Description: 5'10, Brown-skinned, Androgynous, Well built. Wears beaten-up Karlsgard military surplus, customized through years of wear. Their pilot suit is armored, and directly links them into the machine interface of the Gallant Engine. Now, they wear a heavy captain's coat with a KPLA Wyvern's armband. Inactive circuit lines that look like tattoos to the unknowing eye extend from the corners of their eyes and from the tips of their fingers. Now, their right arm and left foot are mechanical prosthetic replacements after having been severed in combat.

The Baylore Ideal (Terra)

Yubel (Bunny)
The Echo of the 21st (Revelation)
Story Summary:
- From Pikeway, a town taken over by Merrane and made into a labor camp for honorary citizens
- Deported, saved by Goldheart though they didn't know that at the time
- Joined the KPLA, and assigned to 21st Magitech Procurement squad meant to track valuable tech
- 21st Magitech followed the trail of a Dupartist lab to find an experimental Walker.
- Merrani find them, ambush the lab, Calibre is forced to soul-link to the Gallant.
- On the run, was picked up by a Realmstorm and joined the ship before they could be caught
- Had their soul treasure stolen within Banshee's Wind Temple of Kor'tarion 
- After seeing the gates of Oblivion, entered a contract with ETA, and encountered Loftur face-to-face
- The Gallant was redesigned as the Cerberus, and it was discovered a demon of their dead mentor figure, Captain Lancaster, dwells within.
- After the return of their soul treasure, and laying Lancaster to rest, they built The Revelation and have now become a Captain in their own right.

Name: Califex Aleactea
Character Sheet Link: ["The game is afoot. Will you roll the dice? I don't believe in fortune, darling. Only the result."](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1xwyljm4jJc432_Wn1Nhq2l0KX3fP6hfYMGi7qfbaCSk/edit?gid=0#gid=0)
Origin: The Autumn Court, Fae Realm, Kor'Tarion
Physical Description: A beastly black creature, almost fox-like in nature. She is always wearing a skull mask with horns protruding from the side of it on her face. She always dresses sharply, with a pink vest and bright red tie, wearing a very large dress coat around her shoulders. A very large bushy tail always trails behind her.
Quirks:
Outcast Fairy (Spell: Divination)

Califex carries a lucky coin from her time as a court magician that she has a compulsion to flip whenever she is faced with a decision. If she loses this coin for whatever reason, she will go into a panic and become confused, lost, and dependent.
Rare Equipment: Quandrix's Demon Slaying Pin  - Damage Change (Light)
Story Summary:
Califex is a masked fae-touched who found herself lost in the Fae Realm of Kor'Tarion, eventually becoming into a beast-like creature capable of otherworldly, often frightening transformations.

She became a court magician for a small hedonistic dukedom located in the Autumn Court because of her devious card tricks, which blossomed into actual magic which could alter the concept of luck itself.

She fell in love with the duke, but was exiled to Kor'Tarion for accusations of cheating a royally sanctioned duel and attempts to seduce her way into queendom.

She spent her days of exile seeking challengers that could best her in games of chance, often becoming notorious around the Jarwood by Brightshield.

She makes her way to Hudal Academy, hearing of masters of magic who would provide the thrill of games she seeks, but is swept up in a storm which eventually sends her to the Worldhelm.

Name: Caliste Poe
Character Bio Link: ["Look if your interested. I ain't anything remarkable."](https://discord.com/channels/1169852846083153941/1170111183869706362/1411009714191335617)
Physical Description: Caliste is a simple woman who wears one simple outfit. Whether she is on the job or not. Black tie, white undershirt, black shirt, black slacks, and a brown coat with a badge indicating her TEMP license. She sports a rifle upon her back and has short black hair. At times when danger isn't present, a raven rests with her. The raven in question is named Edgar.
Story Summary:
Caliste lived amongst the streets of Haven her entire life, living off whatever she could fine on her own. She found she could not trust anyone, as like her. They were trying to survive and eat.

In her teens, when she was readying herself to apply for a TEMP License. She found herself an injured raven. Usually such a beast would be easy pickings for a meal. However, for some reason, she helped it back to health. Why she did such an action was a mystery to herself. When it was able to live on its own again, she then left it.

Though to her surprise, the bird stuck with her. It was strange, but for the years to come. The two were inseparable. The raven was her one and only friend. Something for the now roaming hirable soldier to trust. Something that won't hurt, nor betray her. Eventually she named the raven Edgar and took care of him. No matter how little she made with her work. He was going to stay till she laid dead upon some street

For now, it's time for the two live upon Worldhelm

Name: Calliope Florence Maier
Physical Description: A 5'5 woman dressed in fine clothing. Silvery white hair that hangs low past her shoulders. Dark sun touched skin, and vermillion eyes full of compassion and hope for better days. By her garments and style of clothing her lineage of Wulforh is rather obvious. By no means a warrior nor carries herself as such, instead bearing many tools and instruments to perform feats with magic.
Story Summary:
- Born within Wulforh as a servant family serving under House Baudouin.
- Held an affinity for Eidola & Enara magic.
- Baudouin family agreed to pay for her schooling within Breusen Mage Academy so long as she continues to work and serve the Baudouin house.
- She agreed, taking the opportunity to gain further prestige in magic.
- Became the charge of Callum Baudouin, and after she graduated Callum was sent off to travel the world in becoming a better leader.
- During her travels, she developed a resounding faith in all the Gaia Crystals and their Beacons, becoming a devout follower of the faith. She always held a love for the crystals but during this pilgrimage zeal manifested.
- Returned to Wulforh a changed woman along with Callum, and when he was casted out by his family she continued to walk alongside him.
- The duo now travel to the Rune Wall, Callum believing himself an exception. Calliope hoping her prayers get him and many others past the wall.

Name: Callum Baudouin II
Physical Description: A younger looking man in his mid twenties, with long blond hair tied back behind him that goes down to about his middle back. He wears regal looking golden armor cloaked in red fabric.
Quirks: Heirloom ( Baudouin's Left and Right Hand are a pair of weapons designed by the Baudouin family. They are designed with a fatal flaw, that their magical properties can be disabled, tracked, or otherwise manipulated by the family-and thusly, those in the know of the Merchant Council. )
Story Summary: A young man sent out by his noble family to explore the world, learned that his family was cruel. Confronting his parents about their houses practices, he was sent out to the Runewall to die. He is now searches for a way to solve the Calamity.

Name: Cameron Relsea
Origin: Scavenger with a Heart of Gold
Physical Description: Cameron is a Lepkin of middling height, with tanned skin, and pale pink hair that serves to give her a rather eye-catching appearance, despite her desire to blend in with the crowd. At her side is a well-worn walking stick; almost as well worn as the clothes she travels in. Despite her attempts to take on the appearance of a pauper, beneath her clothing lies an invaluable bauble - an amulet, that she keeps close to her at all times, and tries to hide from view.
Rare Equipment: Designation: Dahaka - Core; You gain a +2 bonus to Soul Steal checks.
Story Summary: Cameron is a scavenger from Lhodos. While she made good money, and had the respect of many of her peers, she was forced to leave her home once she was chosen to be a Goldhearted after saving her crew from the spawn of a Collossus. She hasn't looked back since, reveling in the opportunity for new treasures to be found, and adventures to be had.

Name: Captain Israfel
Character Sheet Link: ["Eyes forward. Stay focused. You don't have enough of them to look back."](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1xJCaU7pEZrq_mk0N657mPzQuFK0FJ7zFxr2rensfqIc/edit?usp=sharing)
Physical Description: Well-dressed and stoic, with a silk sash slung that it covers one of his eyes. Israfel is tall, broad, and thin. Rugged, he is nearing his middle-aged years but with an ageless and mature quality to him. He speaks and moves with a sense of calm determination and the kind of authority native to a seasoned veteran who's been through this before - no matter what it is.
Quirks: **AIRSHIP: The Red-Eye.** A heavily-armored strike team deployment vessel, it is designed specifically for sudden landings straight into hostile environments, whether seas or deserts, storm or sunshine. It can go in hot, crash, and be ready to lift back off in reasonable time. *It's made of scavenged parts and things go wrong all the time... but it just takes a licking and keeps on flying, at least enough to get back home for repairs mostly in one piece. Kinda like Israfel himself.*
Story Summary:
* Israfel is a respected captain of a mercenary clan from the deserts of Grestasz, known as the Unbroken. By reputation, contracts and pacts of any kind are a sacred matter to them and they complete every one if sealed with coin - at any cost.
* **Thus Empowered by Prosperity:** Israfel is bound to a mysterious legendary beast of the southern sands known as Dusk, which his clan holds sacred.
* A contract is what sent his airship through the Realmwall to unceremoniously collide with one end of the Worldhelm. By this time, Israfel had assumed he was on a suicide mission but proceeded anyway, unwilling to dishonor himself in accordance with his beliefs.
* **The airship.** A heavily-scavenged, heavily-armored "sudden landing" based vessel, the **Red-Eye** is well suited for such incidents. *Or, you know, travel.*
* He is weighing the value of inter-Realm contracting opportunities for the betterment of his clan.
* **Rough around the edges**. A straight shooter with words and guns alike.

Name: Carmelita
Physical Description: Standing at 5'8 wearing a somewhat traditional traveler's outfit with her hair tied up with this red cloth, wearing this white croptop and red scarf and a long cloth with black pants and brown boots.

Name: Carmine
Physical Description: A young woman of reasonably muscular and athletic build. Her hair is wild, fashioned into unkempt spikes with shaved sides. She wears light armor, with a re-breather hung around her neck. Beneath her gauntlets are a pair of pistols, designed to be accessible in an instant should she need to defend herself.

Name: Carol Belle
Physical Description: Carol is a relatively diminutive person, only standing to about 5'4" tall. This, combined with their cherubic, androgynous features gives them a very unthreatening appearance that makes it difficult for people to take them seriously. They are of fair skin tone, often somewhat flush. They have mid-length brown hair, impressing somewhere between tastefully curly and mildly unkempt. Their eyes are like plump cherries: red, wide, and bright. They wear practical adventuring gear, leather jackets, and are strapped with an array of gadgets. Their tools, trinkets, and otherwise useful items are kept in a large shoulder-strapped bag.
Story Summary:
Carol lived with their family, and many others in a frontier village at the very edge of the Marrane border. In semi-secret their family engaged in trade and barter with the travelers, settlers, and militia of Karlsgard. During this time Carol became a shrewd, and discerning businessman, but was later sent back to Korala to receive a proper education.

Carol received formal certification in R&D, and Engineering, as well as compelled military service training.

Upon returning home Carol discovered that their village, and others close to the border had been pillaged and bombarded in a push by revolutionaries to reclaim land. Despite only mild losses, the Marrane retaliation was massive, and deadly.

Carol was so distressed by the violence that they defected from Marrane, and assisted Karlsgard villagers in their efforts of recovery and defense. Despite their desperation Carols efforts were valiant, and in their darkest moment they were chosen to be Goldhearted.

Name: Caspian Riviera
Class List:
Arcanist ★
Weaponmaster ★
Guardian ★
Dancer ★
Martial Artist 2
Chanter 1
Orator 3
Physical Description:
A young man with long, platinum blond hair as well as red algae that grows much like his hair. With an athletic build, standing tall at 6 feet. With purple eyes and fair skin. Depending on the mood, he's dressed in a dark naval attire to represent his homeland in the deep sea Reflection of Ripplith, dressed in the blue Gnosis Academy uniform or more casual attire. With a hat on top of his head usually.

His vocal pitch is on the deeper side, with a hint of refinement to it. His mannerisms are usually on the reserved side, usually acting with some empathy.
Story Summary:
Rival Bond: Aelina
Partner Bond (for now): Aerah

- Born to House Riviera, a knighted family that originated from Kor'tarion that serves under Galeo Empire currently. Renown for their combat prowess.
- Caspian is the third generation of this family, with a very strict upbringing. However he is usually overlooked often in Ripplith society, and thus developed an inferiority complex to his peers.
- Enrolled in Gnosis Academy at age 17 under The Regal House of Paladins.
- Was chosen to be the Regent of Aelina Van Deivoet, but then promptly chose to reject their ceremony in front of everyone. Internally reasoning to break Aelina from blindly following the expectations set for her. He never openly stated this except to a select few.
- Became an Arcanist of Lilith.
- Caspian does suffer a very negative reputation in the Academy as a result.

Name: Cassandra Maldonado
Physical Description:
5'11"

Well toned body.

Often smells like grease and motor oil, occasionally covered in it.
(Will add more details later)
Story Summary:
She used to work at her grandfather's auto repair shop as a mechanic before he passed away. After the death of her grandparents she took over for a time before she was forced to sell the property to pay off some of the debt left to her.

She became a temp to try and maintain her younger siblings despite the risks.

Name: Cassidy Hertz
Origin: Lhodos, The Kingdom of Merrane - Morgan
Physical Description: Cassidy is a very short 5'1" pale-haired Felkin with matching feline ears often laid flat against her head. She has fair skin and unnerving gold eyes, and is usually wearing black Merrani pilot gear. She never smiles.
Rare Equipment:
Dusklight Choker - Therapeutic
Magitech Jumpstarter - Magicompression
Story Summary: Cassidy lost her home to the bombing of Morgan when she was a little girl, surviving only with her friend Esmon. She was saved and brought under the wing of Lady Charlotte Luther Von-Hardwick. Her desperation to prove herself and give whatever she could to the desires of Merrane left her an Esper at the behest of researchers, the demon merging unnervingly well with the mage Felkin. The government insisted she join WWA and become an Angel, and more than willing to continue giving, she did.

Name: Cassidy Price
Physical Description: Short Platinum Blonde hair, hazel brown eyes and slightly tanned skin. Wearing a Stetson hat, bandanna neck scarf and some old hand me downs under her flexible hydraulic exoskeleton making her appear like some cyborg centaur cowgirl. A railgun mounted to the side and connected via cable.
Story Summary:
Born to a large but fairly poor family, Cassidy aspired to join the 100g and be a gunslinging enforcer of the law, just like her Pa, unfortunately after he was killed and she paralysed in an ambush by some thugs, her dreams of being a self styled sheriff and following in his footsteps were dashed, until that is 100g approached her with an offer where she’d be given probationary employment in exchange for field testing a new experimental prosthesis for mounted units.

Now she is Terra’s first and currently only Cyborg Centaur officer, still sporting her Pa’s six shooter on her hip and his Stetson hat on her head.

Name: Cecil Wagner
Physical Description: Lean, human male with brown hair and tan skin, wearing what most would see as the main uniform for the SIA with some minor modifications.
Story Summary:
* Born into the city as the child of retired SIA operatives, inheriting a legacy of duty and sacrifice.

* Carries the scars of an experienced agent within the Department of Supernatural Enforcement.

* Joined by a lycanthrope partner from the Sundiszno tribe, forming a bond that evolved into a deep, sibling-like connection.

* Spent years hunting and maintaining the fragile peace between humans and wolves.

* Became the target of a relentless pursuit by other lycanthropes, who sought to reclaim his partner’s "potential."

* Endured repeated ambushes in the forests until there was nowhere left to run.

* Faced a final, desperate choice when his partner asked to be killed so the potential could be saved from their enemies.

* Fired the final shot as the tribe closed in, absorbing the power to keep it safe.

* Carries the weight of his friend’s power while continuing the hunt for his family and his mission.

Name: Cecile
Class List:
Rogue¹⁰
Dancer⁴
Entropist²
Tinkerer³
⁰ ¹ ² ³ ⁴ ⁵ ⁶ ⁷ ⁸ ⁹
Physical Description: 5'3'' Flyweight 125lb

Name: Celestyn Sokol
Physical Description: Standing at 5'10, Celestyn can normally be found wearing clothes more Terran in nature, covered in a large coat and long scarf with black gloves to cover his hands. Occasionally an eye can be seen opening up on his hand or cheek, though he tries his best to keep them covered.
Quirks:
Fugitive Experiment
When a rule or ability requires you to spend 100 or fewer Hit Points, Mind Points, Inventory Points, or Fabula Points, you may suffer 1d8 Instability Points to ignore that cost.

At the end of each session (approximately four hours of play), you lose 1d6 Instability Points (to a minimum of zero).

If your Instability Points ever reach 10 or more, you are immediately reduced to 0 Hit Points and Surrender. The consequences of this Surrender should be tied to you losing control of your abilities. Then, you lose all Instability Points.
Rare Equipment:
Weight of Sin (Dual Hunter: Beast, Humanoid)
Owl's Eyes (Encyclopedia)
Skysplitter (Quick, Potent Damage Air Weapon)
Echoes of Insight (Insightful Defense)
Story Summary:
- Born as the child of a Winged Blade member in Cneldera
 - Helped tame and raise the gryphons the Winged Blade members use
 - Mother was badly injured in an accident during a mission
 - Trained to take his mother's place in the Winged Blade
 - Meets Josef during his training years
 - Manages to become a Winged Blade member
 - Hears of the Expedition from Josef and sets off with them and Leopold to the Runewall
 - Finding himself aboard the Worldhelm, Celestyn works closely with a few folk to keep information flowing smoothly
 - Went missing for two weeks after a mission in Kor'Tarion
 - After being rescued, Celestyn has found himself changed and his body (as well as his magic) more sensitive to the world around him

Name: Chance Dastardly
Physical Description: A lanky, ashen, eccentrically dressed man with slicked back hair and a devilish grin
Story Summary:
* Integrated into human society early on, taking jobs in theater to eventually reach his target
* Eventually snagged the internship at a large radio station and worked his way from fetching coffee to DJing
* The eccentric behavior he used to hide his vampiric nature made him a strong personality on the air and finally netted him host status
* His personal show, a write in advice segment called "Chance at a better Tomorrow" took off like gangbusters, but in truth was a way for him to gather intel for the Atent family
* After years of his show however... he began to genuinely enjoy helping his listeners solve their problems and the info smuggling became secondary.
* This change of heart eventually led to his chance encounter with a realmstorm and arrival on the Worldhelm.

Name: Charlies erp Jagan
Physical Description: A faceless creature with long deer-like antlers and two eyespots. Vantablack like skin seemingly woven in with the colors of old pages. Looking at them feels like looking hundreds of compressed books bound together yet freely move. No smile but their "head" compresses and shifts to changes shape to match silhouette of someone who is. No words ever leave their person. Only the sounds of fluttering paper appear to escape them to convey thoughts.
Rare Equipment: [Removing Writing Mistakes](https://discord.com/channels/1169852846083153941/1170946655940530217/1286821888810815540)
Story Summary:
Fake eyes where real eyes would be; karmic sight.

They can only read in brail

Books are their hyperfocus

Through game consequences have had their origin/history moved to tian yin.

Can read people's futures/pasts

Will NEVER spoil anything.

cannot lie

goal is to write the greatest book of all time.

Name: Charlotte
Physical Description: A black spider standing at a proud 3’ 1” (2’ 9” without her heals) wearing the uniform she was given as the prince’s nanny. She likes to accessories with hats and glasses while keeping all but two eyes closed to let her kin feel at ease. She’s aware her appearance can frighten others so she likes to cover up as best she can without it getting in the way of work.
Quirks: Heirloom - (Beings that oppose the Spinner want me dead and want to destroy my heirloom, other worshipers of the Spinner want me gone and want my heirloom for themselves)
Story Summary:
• In her early years she worked as a spy and assassin for the criminal and nobility alike. Sometimes being a part of military operations.

• She retired to become a bodyguard under the guise of nanny for the eldest prince of the Mouse kingdom where she grew soft with love for the little prince.

• After the prince followed the king’s orders to fight against the blight as a fellowship she decided to take up arms alongside him and represent the spider tribe and the spinner herself.

Name: Charlotte Morgan
Physical Description: Charlotte is a short woman standing at 5'2", with fair skin and steel grey eyes. Her appearance is meticulously kept; her brilliant red hair rolls in waves down to the middle of her back, face done up with cherry red lips and perfectly shaped eyebrows, nails flawless, and always dressed in a blended mix of high fashion and adventurer's gear. Her gold hairband reveals matching goggles when she pulls it over her face.
Story Summary:
Charlotte was born to the esteemed Morgan family in the Empire of Aranova. Her family is responsible for vast swaths of factories across the Empire and a great many sponsored inventors with shining promise.

Her potent pride, fundamental disbelief in others to do what she could, and a passion for craftsmanship led her into dungeons to cclaim artifacts of ancient power and repurpose them. Breaking the Delver's code while delving tends to draw eyes though, and after a few clashes with Alexandra Lancastrian, the captain brought her under custody.

Her father bailed her out and pulled some strings, but he sternly demanded she join the adventurer's guild if she was so insistent on putting her hands on things. She has reluctantly agreed.

Name: Chieko Miyashiro
Physical Description: A medium tall woman at 5'4 with black hair and good posture, carrying a bow taller than she is and wearing classical archery outfit, but with the signature colours and insignia of the Kikugumi.
Story Summary:
Part of the private security force of the Kikugumi, a collective or organization for red light districts and bathhouses all over Nishibi.

Her base is in Ishihara, but her work has taken her several times from home to other settlements to do trade and help transport people.

Name: Chime Hong
Origin: Chung Lhasa - Lhasa Outlands - Leytik - Tian Yin
Physical Description: A short girl of 5'2" with long red hair, fair skin and blue eyes. She wears large earrings, a large moon talisman and a flower clip in her bangs. She seems to be lightly armored and almost ethereal at times.
Quirks: Souls Entwined  - Bound to Dujom Hong
Story Summary:
- Born to to the leader of a dojo.
- Has affinities to Heavenly and Demonic  Qi combining them to use Hell Qi.
- Was trained to be able to dual cultivate with her twin brother Dujom.
- Had to take fathers place with Dujom to answer a challenge from Empty Monks.
- Went to dual cultivate to prepare for the challenge but something disrupted it.
- Lost her ability to speak as well as her body as her soul bound to her brother's.

Name: Chloe Fant
Physical Description:
A medium height woman at a cool 5'6, Chloe doesn't cut an initially imposing figure. The plug suit armor she usually wears, though, adds about 50 pounds to a usually slender looking frame. Her hair is long, but always kept in a very professional ponytail, and her face does nothing to hide how young she is.

In battle, that calm is utterly destroyed by free streaming tears and a face that contorts with anger. The kind of anger that only someone who has lost everything might know...
Story Summary:
Born in a small town about five miles away from the Karlsgard/Merrane border.

Was a quiet, gentle girl. Was learning how to be a mechanic

When she was 14, her village was hit with a chemical attack while she was out exploring a forest. She was the only survivor. The chemical cannister had the name 'Nausicaa' on it when she found it later

In her rage, she joined the KPLA.

Was not allowed to fight until she turned 17, but used that time to learn how to pilot.

About 3 months ago, on her first assignment in a border fort, A Sub-designation of Vanagandr attacked. She jumped into a mech and distracted it to give the rest of her team time to prepare and sortie.

She lived through the experience, but her mech was destroyed and she was badly wounded. Recovery took a month

When she returned, she caught the attention of Goetia Squad and Vertigo Abrams.

Promoted to Rank, and given the experimental GKS-312 Belial.

During a routine mission, her heart becomes gold...

Name: Ci-Ci
Physical Description:
Ri-Ri is a energetic 4'11 girl with a lean but powerful physique. Her skin is a pastel shade of pink and her eyes sparkling a curious ocean blue. Her hair is dyed a midnight black with some of her normal shade peaking out.  Other notable features is the quite large tail which serves greatly in the ocean, but seems to only enhance the girl's clumsiness on land.

Her heirloom has long since been shattered, now replaced by the metallic twang of an anarchy amplifier laced with the shells power and propelled forward by a curse of misfortune which she weaponizes against the enemies of Gnosis
Rare Equipment:
Seamother's Pendant (No HR loss on vibrato when targeting ally with chant)

Wavebreaker (Big Axe with By your Side Quality)

Blessing of Wealth Laudor (At the start of your first turn during a Conflict Scene, you may destroy 1,000 z to immediately cast the Reinforce spell on yourself, even if you do not know the spell, without needing to pay the MP cost. If you unequip while the spell is active, it ends early. )
Story Summary:
- Cecillia was born in Ripplith as a man, Her family carried a gift from the Ocean Singers, a magical weapon that resonates with songs of the ocean. She at first couldn't lift it.

- Even before her transition, she was talented in the roles of a woman, taking the skillset far easier than the ones given to her as a man, this helped her realize that she was more comfortable presenting as a girl. She sought out a Seamother.

- After going through the ritual, she found a weight lifted off of her and was able to carry her family heirloom. Her family sent her to Gnosis Academy.

- She is quite the character, and so regularly had friction with stricter teachers due to her bubbly and excitable personality.

- She didn't get into too much trouble thanks to good grades. But that all changed when she heard about remedial classes and the opportunity to go to new places.

- Despite the look on her academic record, she tanked her grades to get into the remedial course. She is hungry for adventure.

Name: Circuit
Physical Description: Circuit's frame is compact (5'8"), but bulky (223 lbs). Their attire for jobs (unless requested) is a tailored suit with the sleeves rolled up to keep the arms (and gauntlets) free. Gotta stay professional!
Story Summary:
- Commissioned at the [request of a LUA couple](<https://discord.com/channels/1169852846083153941/1170110466299809873/1291077076010668072>) in Silver Rock, Haven.
- Really enjoyed watching boxing and gladiator style matches, "growing up".
- Wanted to become a prize fighter, but they could not make the cut for a SWORD sponsorship.
- Eventually saved up for an ETA license and started doing Temp jobs to make ends meet. Has cultivated the suit and gauntlets image to make themselves seem more professional!
- It was during one of these jobs where they (and some others) fell foul of the leader of the Olympians...and they made their escape through a Realmstorm to safety.
- They're still looking for that big break that will make them famous...and maybe this Worldhelm can help them in that regard!

Name: Claire le Blanc
Class List:
Rogue ★
Guardian 5
Entropist ★
Pilot ★
Weaponmaster ★
Arcanist 3
Fury 1
Physical Description:
A young woman with long black hair, a lithe build and light-brown eyes. She has wolf-like ears on top of her head, and a black wolf tail she maintains often. She stands at at 5'3"/160cm.

Within the Soul Network, her appearance changes to become moth-like. The most prominent being her wings.
Quirks: Cognitive Ghost - Resistance to Dark/Light; Vulnerable to Bolt. Access to Soul Network Rituals.
Rare Equipment:
Mage's Legacy
Padded Travel Robes
Olde Brightshield Emblem
Story Summary:
- From an orphanage, never knew birth parents. Briefly adopted by a retired People's Guard who owns a coffee shop, Louis le Blanc.
- Enrolled into White Wing Academy around age 12, meeting eventual Angels such as Moritz, Azzurra, Hailey, etc.
- Became an Angel, with Prince Dion overseeing her ceremony.
- Went on missions in either the warfront with Karlsgard or fighting the Colossi. Lost fellow teammates from the Colossi.
- Had to execute people in her squad after a disastrous loss in Karlsgard. Including her tactician, a loved one, named Estelle Richter. Driving her to desert from the military.
- Was declared KIA by the public.

Name: Clarissa Aspenfield
Physical Description:
A mass of unkempt and tangled black hair crowns a pale face, blood red eyes shining through the inky bangs with a calm and calculating gaze.

Clarissa stands at a staggering and imposing 5'3", her top half usually covered by some manner of baggy garment, whose purpose it is to hide a firearm she keeps safely tucked into her pants. Her style of clothing is almost always simple, practical, and maybe a little bland- the antithesys of flashy.
Story Summary:
Born into a decently opulent family in Legenried, Clarissa was orphaned from a young age, leaving her to fend for herself, with only a small inheritance from her parents and lacking their guidance throughout her life

Growing up, she began to frequent dubious social circles, an experience from which she obtained a fair few vices, a penchant for concealed carry, and a healthy dose of distrust for complete strangers.

Once of age, she moved to Breusen to distance herself from her previous life and study at the magical academy. Though her natural intelligence got her far, her terrible work ethic and self destructive habits caused her to fail her last year, and she lacked the necessary funds to give it a second attempt.

In a desperate and illogical bid for a semblance of purpose in her now empty life, she turned her attention to the Runewall, traveling to Grestazs and joining one the expeditions to cross into it, hoping to find something, anything.

Name: Clem Carmichael
Physical Description: A human standing only about 5'5" in height with straight brown hair kept in a pony tail. His green eyes are protected by a pair of glasses. Wearing a set of traveler's clothes, he's rarely seen without a large satchel containing maps and battle plans, along with an assortment of potions and camping supplies.
Story Summary:
- Born in Wulforh, Eurys
- Went to trade school for cartography
- Doesn't believe in the Cataclysm, but still wants to keep his fellow citizens safe from potential man-made disasters
-Navigated beyond the Runewall in an attempt to find a way to do so.

Name: Colin Subar
Physical Description: 6'8", thin, pale. Short, dark brown hair, pale indigo eyes, and a sharp nose. He has two lines on his face that run from beneath his eyes to his jawline. He tends to wear simple slacks with a button down, a necktie, and a dark topcoat, and a pair of glasses. He's much heavier than he looks.
Story Summary:
- Genius boy from the village of Hemsway in Karlsgard
- Village sponsored him to go to the Academy of Korala
- Felt like a failure because he could never perform magic or utilize magitech crystals
- Was offered a chance to gain magical powers through experimental trials
- Experiments ended up being an attempt at creating daemon-less espers by using physical parts of monsters instead of soul network daemons
- Sickened by the experiments, he dropped out and began his investigation into the Academy
- Still no magic powers, and no ESP abilities, but he feels the presence of the monsters within him and knows they can be used for something, he just has to figure out what and how

Name: Cora
Class List:
Arcanist Level 2
Orator Level 3
Spiritist Level 1
Physical Description: Tall and decently built, with brown eyes and short dark hair. Wears a blue gemstome necklace and a flower crown
Story Summary: Living in relative luxary, Cora was an up and coming student at an academy until an incident where her instructor Theodore forced her to explore the outside world to learn humility and worldly knowledge

Name: Coraline Silvermeadow
Physical Description: A slender woman standing at 5'5 in fine clothes, the scent of sweets constantly following her with a small cardboard box in hand suited for donuts and the like.
Story Summary:
- Coraline has lived a relatively quiet life in the bustling city of Veyrhold, a small bakery near various govermental buildings, a place at her brother's behest.
- Little does she know, her brother is a part of the Department of Supernatural Enforcement, masquarading as a public defender for the good people of Veyrhold.
- One day, her brother disappeared, she made several missing posters and went through the proper channels but when nothing showed up, she took matters into her own hands.,
- Just before she did, however, a realmstorm stole her away.

Name: Cordelia Hartwood
Character Sheet Link: [Cordelia Hartwood, on the case. Fire off on all 8's and we'll be done before 'noon.](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1PTYjvUR2LKG8uYfLwsir1qsuiFUggva22Pczsyg2JR4/edit?usp=sharing)
Physical Description:
A 5'6 woman with an cynical and laid-back demeanour.

Typically seen wearing her worksuit, white shirt, tie, overalls and her signature hat.
Story Summary:
* Reporter working undercover for the SIA

* Creates cover stories regarding supernatural incidents

* Was investigating a rogue group of SIA agents to avoid information leakage

* Found a werewolf girl named Petra who was kidnapped by said group

* Took her in since Cordelia was looking for some muscle & having her running around unsupervised could cause public to ask questions.

* Petra now acts as her assistant after saving her from a "kidnapping." Cordelia teaches her how to blend into humanity and the SIA agency.

* Is known for being quite callous in her approach to her work, IE taking in a werewolf purely since having muscle makes her life easier.

* Prioritises public safety , seeking results through whatever means necessary.

* "You just implicated yourself, sweetheart. Luckily for you I'm awful good at covering the truth. "

Name: Corgaven
Physical Description: About 5'4" Messy brown hair and brown eyes, slender but not unfit
Story Summary:
* Lieutenant in the People's Guard

* Rescued Karlsgrad civilians from haywire machina

* Began clandestine operations to get more civilians out, rescues medic who gives him Savior Rifle

* Eventually caught and arrested when spotted with said rifle. Tries to plead case but to no avail.

* Realmstormed to Worldhelm on day of trial and likely execution

Name: Cornelius Ribbib
Physical Description: A Blue and Teal Treefrog on the shorter end of 3 feet tall. He stands hunched over in muddy robes, and a worn wizard hat. He carries a thick waterproof tome on his back.
Story Summary: From those from Firwood in recent history might have met Cornelius on a trade caravan or in some camp. He talks about the wonders of the world with the love and vivaciousness of a fresh-faced youth. He is one of the former students of a frog by the name of Alabaster Croak.

Name: Corvin
Physical Description: Corvin is a tall, fair-skinned, well-muscled woman. Clearly built for a variety of manners of violence, as also evidenced by a number of scars on her face, arms, and body. She has fair hair, which is pulled back and braided, shortened on the sides. Typically dressed smartly in a vest or suit and pants. Little else adorns her, aside from a few tattoos.
Story Summary:
* Grew up the daughter of a mob boss
* Ended up becoming a hitman for the family, did quite well
* A hit failed when the target turned out to be a supernatural creature
* Lost most of the crime family to said failed hit
* Eventually arrested, sent to prison for a time
* Given offer to work off her sentence with the SIA
* Joined, did well and made an effort to turn her life around (to moderate success so far)
* Thanks to skillset, was selected for DSC

Name: Corwin Cruzik
Physical Description: Standing at 1,84 Corwin is a tall man with tanned skin. He sports black hair alongside a singular blue eye, his left orb has been long replaced by an eyepatch. He has a strong build and a calm and aloof demeanor. While traveling he usually wears simple, practical and discreet clothes, preferring function over form. While ready for combat he usually wears black plate armor and shield, alongside Blightbringer.
Story Summary:
-Born near Stratford in Eurys.
-Spends most of his early years traveling from village to village in the same region because of his family situation.
-Due to worsening conditions family tries to move to Grestazh, but the trip goes very poorly.
-Alone and lost tries the Runewall out of desperation.

Name: Cory Cash
Physical Description: Price is a tall, lean, dark-skinned man who takes his appearance quite seriously, being well-groomed and wearing a sleek business tuxedo. He carries a large suitcase with everything he needs to conduct business, whatever the situation may be.
Story Summary:
-Dad was a leader of a community owning a large company that was in real estate and urban development

-Dad Died when Bayton died leaving him and the rest of his family destitute on the streets.

-Spent the rest of his adult years on the streets growing up to become a Fixer/Dealer hustling and making connections so he could get enough money for his family and build up communities like his father once did

Name: Creed
Physical Description: Creed stands tall at an impressive 6 feet 3 inches, he weight approximately 240 lbs. He has a broad frame that exudes strength and resilience. His complexion is a nice brownish gold tan which speaks of a life spent constantly in the light of the sun.

Name: Cressida Octi
Physical Description: Her figure is long and thin, with sharp features so that more than one mistake her for a young man. White long and straigh hair encompass her face, and she's rarely seen wearing something different than a long robe and pointy hat. Her book of tarots always by her side hides a set of deadly magic cards.

Name: Crimson
Physical Description:
Height: 6'5"
Weight: 175 lbs

Name: Crystalia
Class List:
Chanter M
Pilot
Ace of cards
Physical Description: A women at a statuesque 6f 4I, her company gave her surgeries and implants to make her as appealing and enticing as possible.
Story Summary:
- Blue collar upbringing
- has a magical voice
- got borded by SWORD early
- is a very small performer
- augmented to look "perfect and sirenlike"
- sold her face to sword to join, doesn´t own her identity as "Crystalia"

Name: Cyph
Class List: Chanter [2] | Pilot [4] | Mutant [★] | Dancer [★] | Rogue [★] | Weaponmaster [5]
Physical Description: Cyph is a woman who stands at 5' 5" she has very long white hair and icey blue eyes. She seems to favor wearing an oversized jacket. Due to her weapon of choice being longer than she is tall she normally carries a zweihander over her shoulder as it's awkward to carry almost any other way.
Quirks:
__Heirlooms__
Sanguine Song and Acceleration Stabilizers. These are both pieces of experimental equipment.

__Flaws__
Sanguine Song - A weapon that can take a toll on its user after prolonged use.

Acceleration Stabilizers - Stabilization Braces that went put under too much stress may malfunction.
Rare Equipment:
Sanguine Song - Weapon Module withe the Symbiotic Quality

Acceleration Stabilizers - Accessory with the Potent Damage (Bolt) Quality

Chorus of Chains - Custom Weapon with the World Saver Quality

Veinsilk Shirt - Sage Robe Warlock Quality
Story Summary:
- Was placed into an experimental program of 100G's as a child by her parents for them to make a big paycheck.
- Most of her childhood is a blur because of this program.
- Program involved experimental weapons produced by Tubal & Cain that were biologically tied to the users.
- There were many complications behind the program that lead to its abolishment.
- Cyph being one of the promising users of one of these weapons came to an agreement with 100G that allowed her to continue to use her training and weapon for freelance work.

Name: Cypher Yuten
Character Sheet Link: [Want a booster pack? I got one right here, super exclusive!](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1FlshpGVcqaUkPo28JsETGRQlzZV-jTX0GJe49oxEVRI/edit?usp=sharing)
Class List:
Ace of Cards ★
Arcanist ★
Wayfinder ★
Guardian ★
Entropist
Weaponmaster
Spiritist
Physical Description:
A thin framed snow leopard, sporting eye catching hair. Attire from the upscale side of Silver Rock, showing a modicum of skill to live such a lifestyle.

A plethora of both physical and mechanical augmentations decorate their body. Giving the likeness of a snow leopard
Rare Equipment:
* [Accessory] Amulet of a Dreamer (Arcane Reservoir)
* [Accessory] A moment in time (Wanderer's Luck)
* [Accessory] Skill Card: Monster and Master (Wild Warden)
* [Armor] Coat of the Heart (Heaven's Defender)
* [Shield] Hand to Grasp the Stars (Magic Up)
* [Shield] Hand of the Mage's Shield (Abjurer's Shield)
* [Shield] Tome of Glacius (Flawed Immunity Ice|Poison)
* [Sword] Portable Card-Interface (World saver)
Story Summary:
* A no name pencil pusher borne into a pretty low end family. 
* Lived for years as a cog in the machine, dreaming of one day becoming something.
* With the help from his grandpa's inheritance, managed to afford the augments needed to distinguish himself, along with his current home.
* Soon left the company to create his own card game to compete with SWORD's Twin and Triworld. 
* Accidentally created a material daemon by feeding it card data. Re-writing it into a companion. Volt. 
* After assisting a friend in avoiding some loan sharks, he found himself upon the worldhelm. 
* Unexpectedly, he came across the curious fae Celine. And like it was written in the very stars, the two have become engaged to each other.

Name: Cyrus Sand
Class List:
Guardian *Mastered*
Chimerist *Mastered*
Pilot *Mastered*
Fury 7
Tinkerer 4
Symbolist 1
Physical Description: A 6' tall teal-scaled Nezzim rarely seen out of a scarred and scuffed suit of well-worn bronze scale armor. His bearing is just as rough and unpolished as his mail, and his movements, while lacking in grace, show unswaying confidence.
Quirks:
**Next in Line to Perfection**
Once per session (approximately four hours of play), after you make a check, you can choose to succeed regardless of the result. This manifests as you draw on the power of this strength. When you do this, your predestined strength cultivates. 

The nature of your power is that of preservation and endurance. One day, you will be great, whether of your own volition or otherwise. Your body is growing and expanding to reach a state it was not naturally intended for, this frequently pushes your body too far to achieve this destined state of perfection. Once per session (approximately four hours of play), the Game Master may give you 1 Fabula Point in order to have sudden complications arise due to this weakness. 

Once your predestined strength has cultivated 10 times, you may choose one of the following options: (See Sheet for specifics)
Reject this Power.
Embrace this Power.
Submit to this Power.
Rare Equipment:
- Scutum of the Sands: Runic Shield w/ Dual Resistance (Fire + Ice)
- Defender of the Desert: Runic Shield w/ Earth's Bounty
- Scarlet Shield: Runic Shield w/ decrease Protect damage by Bond Strength (before Affinities)
- Bracers of the Brave (Accessory: Composure)
- Aegis of AGES: Steel Plate w/ Otherworldly Veil
- Aegis of AGES (shield): Runic Shield w/ Earth Immunity
- The Dragon's Maw: Runic Shield w/ Magic Absorb

- Camouflage Cloak (Permanent Item)
Story Summary:
- Born Cyrus K'zzek in the City of Scales, son of a wealthy merchant family.
- Ran away from home at a young age due to overbearing expectations and a smothering lifestyle. He has come to hold a distaste for the very concepts of decadence and nobility ever since. Took on the surname "Sand" to further sever his family ties.
- Eventually became a shield-for-hire and monster hunter operating out of The Last Hold. He uses what he terms the "testudo style" of hand-to-hand combat, though it's more shield-to-hand.
- Enjoys meat and booze perhaps a little too much.
- Since arriving to Terra, he has undergone significant change. His time fighting in Termina City and assisting AGES has started to bear unusual fruit...

Name: Céline Brighttail
Physical Description:
"Many have told me that, when it comes to magic, the sky is the limit. I disagree. The sky is merely my starting point."

Céline is a rat-like fae with soft white fur, large rounded ears, and sharp violet eyes. She is most often seen wearing a set of deep blue scholar's robes along with a black mask and a matching hat. Standing just under 4ft tall-- which she insists is quite tall for her kind-- she sports a delicate frame, though her ears give a significant height boost to her silhouette.
Quirks: Outcast Fairy (Weakness: Can't Lie or break her word)
Rare Equipment:
- Stygian Deck (Damage Change: Poison)
- Lovesick Bracelet (Arcane Regen +2, can spend value to form Bonds)
- When Stars Align (Loaded Dice)
- Mayhem (Restore 10 MP on Dismiss)
- Cynosure (World Saver)
- Lunar Spellbook (Magic Up)
- Warden Battle Uniform (Arcane Vitality)
Story Summary:
- Grew up in a warren in the fae realm, forbidden to leave "for the safety of the clan"

- Dreamt of the night sky often, of asking the stars about the way the world worked

- One night, the stars answered, and led her to a ruined temple in the mortal realm

- She struck a bargain: the secrets of the stars, in exchange for one day restoring that place to its former glory

- To make good on that, she joined Hudal Academy to study magic and astrology

- After Project Bloodmoon shut it down for repairs, she took to wandering, eventually getting swept up by a Realmstorm and ending up in the Worldhelm

- Since, she has battled undead, outmaneuvered vampires, stood her ground against demons... And found a lifelong partner in Cypher Yuten, to whom she is now engaged.

Name: Córdoba
Class List:
Entropist Lv. ★
Loremaster Lv. 6
Spiritist Lv. ★
Symbolist Lv. 3
Physical Description: A slight beastkin, standing five feet tall, or six with his ears, recognizable by the usually-closed third eye on his forehead. He's always adorned with vast amounts of finery and golden jewelry - plates that line his inner ear, caps over his claws, shining eyeliner, golden teeth, and more. Despite the opulent appearance, he has next to no actual presence, constantly quiet and nervous.
Story Summary:
Comes from a line of Keepers known for their ancient oracular practice. When he used modern study and science to partake in the art despite his lack of natural affinity for it, his actions were deemed sacrilegious and he was shunned.

He then took to a life selling his divinations in the Bazaar, but even then, he was used by an aspiring Crystal Baron for his talents, and discarded again when his usefulness expired.

Now, he wanders, wondering what he did to deserve these isolations, but sure it was something.

Name: Daga
Physical Description: He is a pale skinned guy, with slim complexion and brown hair, he carries a scarf in his head and usually wears green and baggy clothes. His eyes are as sharp as his tongue and his way of walking and corporal language is filled with confidence on himself, aside from that there is nothing more remarkable on his person.
Story Summary:
He was a small boy with a huge dream, he wanted to scape from the earth and go to the sky, to the city on the sky.

To be able to do it so he became a scammer learned the ways of the tongue and made his way to obtain money in tons.

Achieving his objective becoming one of the best scammer in the city of the SandSailors, gathering money and power to acomplish his dreams. The after story of this is that, he became not only goldhearted but able to achieve his dreams for a better life, making money even if he had to risk his life to retire in abundance was a small price to pay.

Name: Dagna
Physical Description:
✧Tall (around 5'8")and slender, slightly stronger than she looks.
✧Earrings are a keepsake from her late sister, only takes them off when necessary.
✧Clothes are clearly worn yet well taken care-off.
Story Summary:
•Born in Lindstroffe, the youngest daughter in a family of 5 until her little brother was born.
 •She was conscripted a couple years after her older siblings.
•While defending a town from raiders she seemingly met an unceremonius end, 
left for dead only to wake covered in snow.
•Her time in the army lit a raging inferno inside her, she could no longer abide a king
 that would sacrifice his subjects without a second thought. She would bring the tyrant to heel one day but she lacked the money or steel for war, so she escaped to the south to become a mercenary, eventually joining the team that would cross into the runewall.

Name: Dai Shuye
Physical Description: A woman on the shorter side, with unnaturally red skin and yellow eyes. She is rather thin, teetering on the edge of what could be considered healthy. She walks with slow poise, and has an understated presence. Her resting expression is downcast.
Rare Equipment: Brother I'm level 40 I got hella shit. Prolly my emperor drip.
Story Summary:
* Grew up in the palace serving previous emperor
* Oni attacked, turned emperor into tengu
* Shuye served under oni
* Picked up by goldhearted
* Is now nominally emperor

Name: Daisy Starbloom
Physical Description: A 5'2" half-deer girl with dark-brown skin and white spots across her cheeks and ears. Voluminous, brown curls cover her shoulders and back, entwining the small antlers atop her head which bloom with seasonal flowers. Typically wears cottagecore dresses, sometimes paired with a half-apron. The sweet scent of honey, citrus blossoms, and fresh cinnamon follows wherever she goes.
Story Summary:
- Grew up with a coven of Forest Witches hidden in the far northeastern region of the Gwaed Forest below the Star Peaks.
- Received tutelage of a talented witch in the coven named Althea Starbloom, who became her mentor-mother figure.
- When Althea was called to perform an odyssey across Kor’tarion, she passed down her verdant locket as a gesture of motherly love.
- Upon adulthood, Daisy finally left her coven to attempt the odyssey herself, in hopes of one day reuniting with Althea and solidify her own competency as a green witch.

Name: Dandy The Hamster
Physical Description: A lavender swordswoman who leaves trails of vibrant peach blossoms in her path. Tall and slender woman with jet black hair tied in a high-top ponytail, eyes the color of violets, wears a slim battle tunic and pants, carries a Jian sword in the scabbard by hand. Height 5' 8".

Name: Danny
Physical Description: Danny is an augmented human with a draconic appearance. His body is covered in scales of varying shades of white, black, brown, and yellow. He has a large finned tail. He wears a fedora and a long coat, along with a pair of tinted glasses.
Story Summary: Danny was once part of a 100G force in Haven. After a case gone wrong, He left 100G and Haven to Downpour City where he began a private detective agency. Here he began to come accross strange occurances that would lead him on a path towards uncovering the truth about the realms and the Goldhearted. However during his quest for information he would find himself caught in a realmstorm and brought directly to the ship itself.

Name: Dante Calaviero
Physical Description: Well-built man of average height; there’s an air of gravitas around him that always seems to match the current circumstance. Long brown hair and the clothing and armor befitting the dashing hero that he is.
Story Summary: A slightly washed up street performer in Brightshield, Dante has a heart of gold and a drive to be an actual hero. Hopefully he’ll get there soon.

Name: Dante Sterling
Other Names:
Anderson’s Kid
Ex-100G Strategic Visibility Officer
Golden Boy
MITAMI Bearer
Physical Description:
Dante is a broad-shouldered, powerfully built figure with dense muscle and flashy blue-gold cybernetics. His hair is dark and swept back in black-blue layers, and his narrow gold eyes are usually paired with a wide, sharp-toothed smile that reflects his bold, charismatic nature.
