He sports a cropped blue-gold tech jacket worn open over bare skin, decorated with a collection of pins, buckles, and buttons. Below, he wears slim dark pants with a MITAMI logo emblazoned along one side, as if to openly claim the weapon and its branding as his own.

He carries himself with an easy confidence, standing relaxed and comfortable in being seen, heard, and relied on. A large mechanical sword rests across his back in a reinforced sheath, and his right arm is fitted with a matching magitech gauntlet. When he draws on elemental power, faint blue-gold light pulses through his cybernetics and equipment, and elemental wisps flicker into view around him, lively and eager to fight alongside their idol.
Quirks:
Heirloom
MITAMI Resonance Suite
A pair of experimental magitech armaments developed by 100G that draw in and interface with ambient elemental magic. Designed to allow non-magical operators to wield elemental forces without magical talent or knowledge, the MITAMI consists of a bonded blade that gathers and projects latent environmental energy, and a specialized glove that enables direct physical interaction with, guidance of, and release of that energy.

In Dante's hands, the system performs far beyond experimental projections, generating such a strong resonance that minor elemental spirits coalesce around him and willingly lend their aid. Unfortunately, activating the MITAMI is not without risk: the disturbance it causes in the ambient magical field is akin to lighting a signal flare within the magical ecosystem. Its presence is impossible to fully conceal, making Dante easy to track and occasionally drawing the attention of entities far more dangerous than the spirits that aid him.
Story Summary:
- The youngest son of 100G Board Member Anderson Sterling, Dante grew up surrounded by a corporate, morally compromising environment that he loathed.
- Rejecting the corporate game, Dante's father redirected him to a different role: 100G Strategic Visibility Officer. Sariel's Golden Boy.
- The role was exhilarating. Live missions, public trust, real impact. Dante felt he had something genuine, and 100G could drive up recruitment and showcase cutting-edge technology with a charismatic face behind it.
- Eventually, Dante learned the trade-off. Visibility was its own form of containment. If he pushed too far, the spotlight was used to pull him back in line.
- Dante realized he would never become more than a company symbol. At the recognition, he snatched some tech and left 100G to go rogue alongside his bodyguard Emile.
- Now carving his own path as an independent mercenary and corpo-pirate, Dante lives to prove, loudly, that he’s above 100G and any other system that would try to own him.

Name: Daphila "Daphy" Tinkertop
Physical Description: Daphila stands at a staggering 3'2". She has long sparkling purple hair and is usually carrying around a pack full of trinkets twice her size. Making jingles, and rattles everywhere she goes.
Story Summary:
- Born in a small community of fae creatures who are adept at magic

- Never leanred how to wield magic, instead learns how to craft toys

- Gets inspired to leave her home when her toys bring joy to those around her. She leaves and starts a career as a traveling toymaker.

Name: Darius Kallis
Physical Description:
A 6'0'' Leirsin, his hair white with occasional darker patches of grey, likening his Leirsin features more closely to that of a snow leopard.

He's often seen dressed in Silverdale noble garb, typically a fine suit with a coat hanging from his shoulders. One common factor of his clothing is a peculiar black and white emblem, one depicting the black king of chess embedded in a white hawk. Typically leans on a sharpened cane.
Story Summary:
The heir to Silverdale's noble house, Kallis. The house is known to most as one that deals in business and diplomacy. To an increasing number of others though, they're known as criminals and spies.

The main Kallis line are snow Leirsin chased from Rocade to Silverdale generations back. Their actions vary from hosting masquerade balls, to infiltrating smuggling operations to seize their stock.

Many accusations have caused the house to lose favor, along with general wariness of the Leirsin.

To restore Kallis' name, Darius proposed two things. One, the Kallis name can be earned by worthy employees. Two, he and his willing siblings would join the 1st expedition to the Runewall. Among them, only Darius survived.

Name: Dastan of the Swirling Sands
Physical Description: Dastan is a human, 5'11 ft tall with a well built body. He has tanned skin, shoulder length blue hair and golden eyes. Often wearing ornate clothing that as well as jewelry.
Quirks:
Heirloom:
Raging Sun

A large, blood-red gemstone set in brass. This cursed gem clouds minds with uncontrollable 
fury, driving nearby creatures into a frenzy of fight or flight. 
Forged from the crystallized blood of the Kiir, it irresistibly attracts them to its bearer.
Rare Equipment:
Raging Sun
Heirloom accessory with the goading quality

Flaw:
The Raging Sun attracts Kiir, it might also freak out other creatures triggering a fight or flight response.

Name: Datu Anahi
Physical Description: Datu Anahi is a genderfluid person with two forms. Her feminine form is muscular, standing at 5'11" with surprisingly soft skin. His masculine form is 6'7" with equal muscle in build, though he is always shirtless. Both wear traditional armor found in Sangang-Daan with gold embrodiery and natural dyes.
Related Arcana: Qinglong, Vanagandr, Yubel, Morning Dawn, Baihu
Story Summary:
- Born in Sampaguita Village, had two parents, a mentor, a loving home
- Was struck by a Chaos Beast from Mainland China in an attempt to save her mentor's life
- Woah she's a goldhearted
- Parents dead, lovers dead, children dead, she crashed out
- Post-Tribulation, realized she's a reincarnated version of her past life, a man literally named Datu
- Datu of Sangang-Daan by title AND by birth, she's working towards being the unwavering light of hope she inspired others to become in the past

Name: Deacon Farum
Physical Description: Dirty blonde hair, skin white, and eyes green like emeralds. Deacon stands at a height 5'7ft, his physique skinny and average in almost every way, save for the fact that his face is as beautiful as that of an angel. Upon his head is a reddish orange and gold cap adorned with the exotic feathers of orange and yellow birds. He wears baggy and poofy pants alongside a shirt of similar fashion, sporting colors of scarlet and a dark yellow. Around his shoulders and neck is an emerald green scarf of great length, long enough to almost seem like a cape at times. His shoes are rather goofy, but are made of good quality leather.

Name: Deckard
Physical Description: A man in a diving suit filled with black liquid that despite being 6’ 3” stands at 5’ 9”. They are almost always obscured by their suit and the water within but when push comes to shove tentacles spring out as a defense mechanism.
Story Summary:
• They don’t remember a lot of the details of it but as a child they were taken and experimented on using Seaborn dna to create the next step of human evolution. 

• They spent years in a lab being raised and tested until their experiments were found out and quickly shut down. All of their resources were thrown out or burned including Deckard who managed to escape as waste. 

• They took a diving suit they found in the dump and jumped into the nearby ocean as they swam to safety. They stayed in the ocean or always just within reach until they ended up in the worldhelm.

Name: Delphine Fiore D'Myrdel
Character Sheet Link: [I'll make the world bow at your feet... for the right price.](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1aPOMrr--du38S2FP5z_NeZ_yp2jDn8zOT53gpBJ6DbQ/edit?gid=0#gid=0)
Physical Description: Standing at 6'0, Delphine is athletically built and commonly dressed in the multi-colored patterns common to the Landschknects of Eurys. Bearing scars from 2 decades of work as a carrier soldier and mercenary, the most prominent Delphine has is her lost eye, typically hidden under an eyepatch with the golden inlay of the Scarlet Roar's emblem. Her equipment is as well-worn as she is, but the gaudy golden trinkets and adornments she wears as a symbol of her success typically blinds those unaware of her reputation to a storied military record.
Rare Equipment: Lioness' Flamberge ✦ - Lifesteal Custom Weapon
Story Summary:
- Once a commoner, Delphine had grown up hearing tales of adventurers, and left home.
- Trained under a knight serving the Lord of Fortress Town Myrdel, Ser Laugon Vishar. His tutelage came with a price, service to Wulfhor as a soldier, one Delphine gladly paid.
- Working as a career soldier under Wolfhor's banner, Delphine carried an impressive field record during a short border war against SIlverdale.
- She would find herself battling against one of the Scarlet Roar's Prides. Defeating a number of Partisans before being wounded and retreating, catching the eye of Valeria Fiore Moretti.
- Her accomplishments could not win a war as countless brothers-in-arms fell, the nobiles negotiated peace. The conflict ended with a bottle of wine, going on to be named the Vinifera Vendetta.
- Delphine wandered aimlessly until Valeria sought her for the Scarlet Compact.
- Going on to succeed in the trial, Delphine became a Firebrand, living only for zenit and without a banner.

Name: Desiree
Physical Description: Desiree is a modified LUA, forgoing the typical television head for a screen that more closely resembles the face of a cat. Aside from her cosmetic alterations, however, she is a rather standard looking LUA, with a body made of sturdy steel, joints surrounded by flexible rubber, and a charging cable cleverly disguised as a tail.
Story Summary: Desiree was a LUA who was lost, lacking direction and purpose in her life. She had begun getting involved in activities with unsavory people related to Terra's criminal underground. Seeing the whimsical nature of the girls who worked at EntroPRISM, as well as the adoration and validation they received, caused her to work towards eventually joining the group.

Name: Desoka Targandr
Physical Description: A dark skinned young man, about 5'10 in a white combat tunic with a cloak and a large katana with a bronze grip. He has black hair and icy blue eyes, he typically has a mean look about him and always seems to be cold.
Story Summary:
* Aside from Backstory content, Desoka is just now joining the rest of the goldhearted on their adventures

* Is eager to fight alongside the goldhearted and has been training alot recently to prepare himself

Name: Despina — ᵀʰᵉ Deliverance
Physical Description:
*Despina:*
5'2" (158 cm)
Curly red hair, shy of chin length
Brown eyes with rectangular pupils
Light brown skin
Spiraling sheep horns
Wooly tail, fairly long (like an undocked sheep), and woolly legs; white-cream with black stripes
Dressed in a Gnosis Academy student's uniform: a pink-purple shirt with gold accents, sleeves flaring at the elbows, with a darker undershirt going to the wrists; a red sash bearing the insignia of the Regal House of Treasures; off-white pants; and sometimes oddly shaped boots, othertimes bare hooves

*ᵀʰᵉ Deliverance:*
A one-handed axe with a haft that looks to be made of a long femur, cracked at its bottom. It is wrapped with fabric with white and black stripes to make a handle.
The axe is largely dark black, shifting to dark grey as it starts narrowing to the cutting edge. Symbols are etched onto the blade that dully glow when she is using her token magic while in her core.
Rare Equipment: Regalia: 1-handed broadaxe (heavy melee), +1 accuracy, Lifesteal Quality
Story Summary:
* Humanoid born in Dreadlan to Lost parents who lived with a pack of Wild Souls (striped hyenas)
* Was the 'runt of the litter' but definitely loved and felt loved by her packmates
* Constantly tried hard to prove her worth, unlike her parents who were more hopeless, listless, just trying to get by
* One day her pack saw a lone human and the attempt to hunt them went poorly
* The human was a mage and killed a lot of the pack, including her parents
* The rest scattered, but she was seeing too much red to run
* He saw some use in a humanoid who still had a spark in her and so after forcing her to listen, made her an offer
* Desperate to cling on to life, she swallowed her pride and sorrow and agreed to be his servant and student, studying magic under him for the next few years
* Eventually his own patron proposed to send her off to Heartdom to get a Knight in their service
* Enrolled in the House of Treasures because she wants to be something stronger than a puny little human

Name: Devendra Tharvani
Physical Description: Tall man with black hair and beard. Wears what seems like simple cloths however it has miltary armor underneath them. Always seems to have a jovial expression on his face.
Story Summary:
- Born in the House Bhavya lands

- As a child became inspired by Dharnim Savvat when he constantly spare those who tried to challenge him

- Devendra ends up joining the Slayer legion once he became of age.

- Showed great promise as a warrior in the legion though he always tried to do more beyond his station. (Be it move in to save a fellow soldier despite a retreat order or challenge demonkin before the main legion arrives)

- Soon he was starting to show signs of Purusa due to his deeds.

- Before he went to the wastes to practice his new strength Devendra was swept up by a realmstorm

Name: Devon
Physical Description: Devon is a 5-foot, 5-inch king. His whole body has been modified to look like a tiger shark, complete with teeth, webs between his fingers, and a fairly long tail. He's got short black hair, coffee-colored irises and the back of his tan-and-sand body is lined with darker stripes all the way down his tail.

Name: Dira
Physical Description: Dira is a slender green lizard with a decent build to her body and grey purple eyes. She also wears lighter clothing with lightish armor around her body that her family had made for her.
Story Summary: Dira, is a part of a family of 7. Mom, dad, and 4 other siblings + her (being the second youngest). Most of them handle the crafting and shop, with the eldest and Dira being the ones that goes out and get materials for them. Depending on what's needed might either be returning in the same day or a few days after. Dira does know how to craft a little though, just pretty average at it compared to the others in her family.

Name: Doctor Love
Physical Description: Flashily dressed scientist with pink/purple died hair constantly carrying gadgets
Story Summary:
-Parabellum field researcher
-Pirate Radio host
-Squatting in a super condemned mcmansion

Name: Dolce Amoretti
Class List:
Gourmet - 10 | Dungeon Cooking
Wayfarer - 2
Merchant - 1
Symbolist - 1
Physical Description: A small 3'5" tall creature called a Septid, they absolutely beam with energy. Instead of the normal smell of a Septid she radiates an array of various flavors almost as if being in a KAIJU production facility. She's always surrounded by a group of 12 snakes that wrap around her and/or fly around her. Their seem to be 2 groups within the swarm, The Rainbows & The Tropicals.
Rare Equipment: Promised Nametag - Quality: Kindred
Story Summary:
- Born and raised deep in Soda Gulch
- Exposed to extreme levels of Pentanoqium
- KAIJU PR Representative thanks to Septid relations

Name: Dolly Felton
Physical Description: Dolly is a fae, whose physical body outside of her realm consists of a small, stout plushie doll. From the first look, it is not too apparent that the doll is magical, but it is where her spirit is stored, made from a very soft, durable fiber.

Name: Donovan Goodwin
Physical Description: Donovan is a tall, stocky, slightly intimidating human man dressed in plain religious vestments. On his shoulder he carries a long, golden cloth he uses in tandem with his fans for his performances. Despite his grey hair, he is, in his words, "29 years young".

Name: Doragon
Physical Description: 6'5" and 200 lbs pale skin being with silver scales lining the sides of their head, neck, arms, torso and legs. Black wings expand from the back and silver horns protrude from their head. They have white strait hair. They wear a long combat tunic that looks like a trench coat and have high black boots. Shirt and pants underneath their tunic.

Name: Dorian
Physical Description: Dorian is an athletic human of slightly above average height from Kor'Tarion. He has black hair and brown eyes. Height 5'10" Weight 160 lbs

Name: Dr. Dorian De'Angelo
Character Sheet Link: ["All this greed for blood and zenit is a disease. Fortunately, I am a doctor."](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1ekMDzyOgGXCoHVXA2cD4i-z-3QDzePaoey3uhCLYpCo/edit?gid=0#gid=0)
Physical Description:
A tall and lean man, with long dark hair worn in a loose ponytail pulled back, and a few strands falling forward. His face is sharp, and his dark eyes often seem disinterested in the mundane.

Usually, he dresses in a black tailored coat, with a white ruffled cravat, looking the part of an aristocrat or noble.

His posture is of someone who knows something about you that even you are not aware, and he looks mildly disappointed at your self-ignorance.
Story Summary:
- Vampire from the Porumbel Family, and doctor at Brindlewatch.
- Attained a title of nobility for his deeds and influence with others, securing himself within human society.
- Understands that the human ignorance is a blessing and a weakness, and he must protect them to keep his species alive.
- When the hospital is attacked by a Forsaken, De'Angelo keeps it at bay just long enough for a DSE squad to arrive.
- After neutralizing the threat, De'Angelo volunteers to join, seeing that he could be doing much more by working with the SIA.
- Now works for the DSE as an informant, diplomat and epidemiologist for supernatural cases, being entangled deep into both societies.
- His vampiric peers aren't 100% fond of this, but De'Angelo insists on leading to a world where they can live in peace together.

Name: Dr. Eno Somata
Physical Description: Eno Somata is a green haired person who is entirely clad and masked, making his actual appearance difficult to read. He wears a recognizable face mask that has lizard-like features to it. His body seems very lanky, but there is a strange strength to it nonetheless.
Story Summary:
Grew up in the high-tech city of Haven, emotionally distant but intellectually gifted.

Earned a PhD in Genetic Bioinformatics, experimenting on himself to improve emotional processing.

Worked 10 years in biotech, specializing in genum-based health and cognitive tech.

Grew disillusioned by the lack of real impact of his work. Emotional numbness returned due to the sterile corporate environment.

Joined CLAW (QiLink) to apply his science in direct, real-world situations. The field work rekindled his empathy and gave him a renewed sense of purpose.

Name: Dr. Henry Calvin
Physical Description: Blond hair with a stubble showing a very easy going smile, despite his proffession his clothes are still unkept and a bit mismatch.
Story Summary:
- Born and raised in New Jamestown

- His father was a doctor who Henry lost during childhood after he died due to a deadly Standoff

- With limited notes from his late father and a sponsor from a shell company of Gold Standard, Henry was able to afford a custom wagon at the cost of being a Snake Olier

- Henry then started his journey going town to town going back and forth from New Jamestown and Proudrock peddling his wares with each stop in between.

- During his ride Henry's heart ache when seeing the Ghostowns though keeping that feeling suppressed in the dangers of traveling in the Gulch

- He ended up in a realmstorm after preventing one of his customers from dying due to using one of his own products.

Name: Dr. Lawrence Faust
Physical Description: Lawrence is a shorter man, with pale ashy skin, and faded crimson eyes. His hair is a light gray and he wears a similarly toned suit. He has minimal skin showing, and simple metal jewelry.
Story Summary:
- Nearly twenty years ago, he took out a simple and manageable loan to open a pharmacy with a friend. However, not long after, just as the business was beginning to take a dip, the Baylore Company collapsed.
- His loan was now in the hands of ETA, and there was little he could do about it. In a stress-enduced bender one evening, Lawrence attempted to return home, intoxicated. Unaware, and delerious, - 
- Lawrence stepped out into traffic, and passed away. Since then, he's managed his pharmacy as a diligent, passionless worker, with glazed red eyes. ETA had returned him as an Insolvent, and he was now to work for the rest of days.

Name: Dr. Sable von Nausicaa
Physical Description:
Usually found in a lab coat and with a concentrated that quickly breaks into a smile when disturbed. 
Just above average in height and slightly under average build, and always just a bit cold to the touch.
Story Summary:
- The middle daughter of a renowned Merrani scientist and decorated military woman.
- Went to Korala Academy
- Became a Biomagical Engineer and Surgeon, dealing with Colossi and grafting
- Starts working in a few different labs for The Merrani Empire

Name: Duan Nüying
Physical Description:
A woman standing at a proud 5'7, Nüying is often dressed in training clothing, and her long black hair pulled back. She holds a bamboo staff that has lost its vibrancy of life but still has yet to have rot stick to it.

The tips of her fingers seem to have been stained black due to her cultivation though she holds such things as a point of pride rather than worry.
Story Summary:
- Born to a one of Xiexie’s servants, Nüying showed a promise for death cultivation quite young.
- Quickly Xiexie took Nüying under her wing and she became enamored by Xiexie’s gifts.
- Seeing the positives that not only came to her but her family as well under Xiexie’s praise, Nüying took to her training with more vigor than any would expect from someone her age. Any negative side affects of taking in so much death qi was waved off by her.
- Now with Xiexie’s guidance and training, Nüying would be proud of her skill but still strives for more.

Name: Dujom Hong
Origin: Chung Lhasa - Lhasa Outlands - Leytik - Tian Yin
Physical Description: Dujom stands just shy of 6' at 5'10", he has a fairly athletic build and typically carries two spears with him at most times. His clothes are decorated with various talismans that he focuses his Qi though.
Story Summary:
- Born to to the leader of a dojo.
- Has affinities to Heavenly and Demonic  Qi combining them to use Hell Qi.
- Was trained to be able to dual cultivate with his twin sister Chime.
- Had to take fathers place with Chime to answer a challenge from Empty Monks.
- Went to dual cultivate to prepare for the challenge but something disrupted it.
- His siter lost her physical form and her soul bound to his, this process causing his own body to begin to fade as well.
- The desperate desire for knowledge to find a way to return his sister to her former self or to maintain his own form long enough to return hers caught Wen Qu's attention, to slowly guide him.

Name: Dull Ahan
Physical Description: 6:3 pumpkin headed man with an eternal lite in his eyes and mouth (literally) and eternal sinister smile. He is dressed in raggedy clothing with a cape and coat over his armor. The armor has a massive almost magical gash over its chest and a heart stitch where his heart SHOULD be. he has grafts over his body and clear stitching where he was sealed together
Rare Equipment: World savior weapon: The end and Birthright
Story Summary:
Soul defender of village from undead after father retired
Tried to fight a necromancer and lost
got his soul treasure stolen and put into a monster
Monsters creation killed necromancer
remembered old morals, a desire to help and do good
despite helping people, he was treated like a monster by fellow Kor'Tarians

Name: Dustin Ryder
Physical Description: White-haired, amber-eyed 5'8" man with a somewhat lackadasical disposition. Pleasant enough to look at, but otherwise not obviously remarkable. Dresses in typical cowboy attire that's a little odd-fitting.
Story Summary:
- Grew up in Netherhill, parents and many of the people he grew up around died during plague
- Moved to and lived a quiet but pleasant enough year at Eckard's Rise until Gold Standard Inc. started wanting to stir trouble with the coven town of Kereti
- After speaking to a certain drifter, elected to take matters into his own hands by sabotaging Gold Standard's efforts in the region
- Was cornered by their thugs when he was taken by a spontaneous Realmstorm

Name: Ebb
Physical Description: After being remade, Ebb now stands roughly at 5'7 feet tall. Usually in baggy clothing with a long white cloak over his shoulders. One eye is a vibrant purple while the other is an emerald green. A pair of antenna stick up through the back of his white hair which is tied off in a ponytail. With him is usually found some brown moths which would natively be from Kor'Tarion, but they seem to follow him everywhere.
Story Summary:
- Ebb only awoke after the moon's destruction. Leading to him not understanding fully what it  means to be a Cecrae.
- They stayed close to Elder's Crag. Watching the humans fish and collect sea glass while slowing understanding what his purpose was.
- A little over a decade ago a few sightings of Ebb lead to a small tale of a ghost who cared for humans started in towns near Elder's Crag. In reality it was Ebb making sure humans did not die prematurely while near his 'home'.
- During his time on the Worldhelm, Ebb had continued to experience emotions and learned what it meant to be a human. Taking his first choice of free will, he pieced together a body from the memories, emotions and fate of those he held close to him. Forming himself into a Nephilim with the assistance of Kviss and True Antikythera.

Name: Edward Lowell Jr.
Physical Description: 6'4" | 174 lbs | Blue Eyes
Story Summary:
- Edward Lowell Jr. (aka Ed) grew up with his retired executive mother and two brothers
- His father, Edward Lowell, is an ETA boardman who has pit the three brothers to aim for his seat
- Ed's time at Haven Prep changed him from aiming for perfection, making friends who inspired him to go solo on his own path
- Ed opens The Million Mystery (aka Mystery Gang), a private investigation company, after finishing college for about 5 years
- Skyfall forced the company to downsize
- Ed was subject to an attempted blackmail and kidnapping attempt by an unknown source, a realmstorm saved him

Name: Edwin Fairwright
Class List:
Elementalist Level 10
Pilot level 5
Entropist Level 2
Physical Description: Essentially an anthropomorphic black cat that looks a little bit on the scraggley side. After his introduction to the worldhelm and the realm sea. he's adopted a bit of a steampunkish look, with a bit of a butterfly motif to it as a way to symbolise his own growth and change after said introduction. He also has a steampunk monocle that he thinks makes him look cooler.
Story Summary:
born and raised in the southern colonies under NTT researcher parents

had a love of magic he could never engage with for years even after joining them and his parents became the heads of a project involving a dangerous beast.

Approached by olympia after an argument with his father where they offered him a deal. access to the project in exchange for knowledge and magic

Accepted, bot due to frustrations and being unaware of their true nature

once they had accessed, they sabotaged the project, and released the monster who proceeded to way waste to the area, killing his parents and barely surviving himself

The incident was quickly covered up, his parents disappearing off the face of the web, and leaving him to survive on his own

managed to repair a magitech mech and has been forced to survive until swept up by the realmstorm. he's found himself much more comfortable on the worldhelm then terra ever since. finally able to study magic fully.

Name: Elaine Sejr
Class List:
Esper ★
Pilot ★
Guardian ★
Arcanist ★
Rogue 3
Fury 4
Orator 1
Physical Description:
Height: 160cm

Elaine is a blonde feminine presenting TEMP; ranging from various clothes from loose, to suits and various in between. While on the job she seems more serious, but while off seems rather casual and laid back. Most noticeable is the eyepatch or eye covering the right side of her face. To those who know, she is blind and scarred over her right eye.
Rare Equipment: Theres a fair few... not enough room
Story Summary:
* Traumatic Childhood that lead to her Psionic Powers and ran away from home. Stole Tech from her father (working for SWORD) to build her stuff.
* Lives in a van. Donates blood and plasma to support herself as well as working for 100G and now A.G.E.S.

Name: Elara Fleiss Alksnis
Class List:
Commander ☆
Tinkerer ☆
Wayfarer☆
Pilot ☆
Sharpshooter [3]
Chimerist [4]
Merchant [3]
Other Names: Elara Alksnis Fleiss, Elara Lockflint, Elara Walden
Physical Description:
Wilkin girl, 155cm (5'1") and 59kg (130lb).
Has a cool flying motorcycle called Percival.
Accompanied by a cooler cyborg crow called Quill.
Rare Equipment: Multi, Extra INS, Healer's Ward, Last Hope, Hero Costume, FP on Discovery, Psionic Containment, Turning Leaflet, and other Lv 50 stuff
Story Summary:
- Orphaned and adopted by Caden Lockflint
- Raised to be a Magitech Engineer
- Latent unexplored magic made her fail Academy of Korala
- Sent out to become a mercenary with two full-metal animals
- Ended up at the Worldhelm a year ago
- Stayed mostly with Lhodos Goldhearted, both Merrani and Karlite
- Recently learned and accepted her past, unleashing her magic
- Abandoned the Lockflint name for Milo's Fleiss and Tika's Alksnis
- Taking the grand goal of making Lhodos better than it ever was

Name: Elias & Eugene 🦀
Physical Description: 5'-6", thin build, white collar
Story Summary:
Elias is artist who adds onomatopoeia to comic panels - creating images (Symbols) that imitate sound, movement, and emotional intensity, which depict wild adventures against fantasy creatures (werewolves and vampires included). Due to his work, he's regularly overworked and sleep deprived, which is why he's chronically a narcoleptic. He under surveillance from the Department of Magical Investigations due to his possession of what he calls "Eugene," a blood magic familiar which the SIA speculates is from Hollow Vast (unbeknownst to Elias). Eugene will occasionally draw a small amount of blood, making him more docile and friendly by reflecting Elias' likeness and creativity. Together, they help Elias' art come alive with Eugene as it's main action star.

Eugene is a familiar made with blood magic; a plant fused with shell of a dying crab and animating to its benefit. Eugene bumped into Elias passed out in the park, as he usually does, feasting on his blood and consequentially his dreams

Name: Elijah-2615
Class List:
Malefactor ★
Pilot ★
Elementalist ★
Chimerist ★
Arcanist 3
Wayfarer 1
Physical Description:
A lanky individual, a little over 6'1'' tall, with a face and body hidden inside an environmental isolation suit with a tabard, robes, and sigils atop, giving it the appearance of a strange armored mage's robes.

He carries a mechanized staff as well as a wide variety of stimulants and medicine at his belt should his body begin to fail.
Story Summary:
- Born to human parents living outside the Civilized Zone. Very sickly youth.
- Extended family chose to move to Refuge for his medical care
- Elijah was unable to leave bed for more than brief periods. Expensive and difficult to keep him alive.
- Watched family suffered on his behalf, and his father came to resent the burden
- Visited by a recruiter who took interest and pulled strings to get him an Envirosuit, allowing him to walk around
- Joins the recruiter and goes to Heartdom, joining the House of Paladins in Gnosis

Name: Elk
Physical Description: A well built, 6' tall figure decked in full armor, distinguishable by the mighty anklers on his helm. His arms, though well-maintained, curiously lack any markings or emblems.

Name: Elora Moonleaf
Physical Description: A Short young woman with Grey skin and white hair. She rarely smiles, but nevertheless always has a gentle aura of cheer. She carries a staff and wand, and her magic soothes the weakened.
Story Summary:
* Born in the Winter Court a mere 34 years ago.
* Was a quiet, but always kind child. This, of course, did not ingratiate her to the more severe Winter Court.
* So it was that a kindly summer Fae saw her nature and took her in, teaching her how to manipulate the world to help people.
* A particular Winter Fae did not like this. And so about 10 years ago, this Fae slew her teacher and had her banished from the Fae Realms.
* Elora traversed alone for a while, until she met Familade and Melancholia. Deciding that these people might need her, she began traveling with them and studying magic.
* It was in this moment that she found out about her fae weakness. Familade made an off handed comment about how warm it was, and she began sneezing uncontrollably.
* Despite this, they traveled together until they were suddenly picked up in a Realmstorm.

Name: Eluna
Physical Description: Eluna stands at 5'2" with silver hair, pointed ears and fangs. Most notably though is the faint fire the seems to dance in her the irises of her eyes that grows brighter as she sings.
Quirks: Outcast Fairy - Cannot refuse an encore to her singing or leave a song unfinished or else she will lose her voice. Until she is asked to sing without prompting or can soak in a flower petal infused bath.
Story Summary:
- Set out from her home looking to try and help make things better between fae and humans.
- Grew up in a village where singing is as second nature as breathing.
- Village did not fully support her goals, and doesn't wish to return until she has done so or has a very good reason.

Name: Ember Wake
Physical Description: Ember is a 6'5, bulky figure in maintenance gear suited for 0-G and Vacuum usage. His skin is a faded, darker grey with the classical glowing red eyes indicative of Insolvency for Terrans. His beard is trimmed but somewhat shaggy, as is his hair.
Story Summary:
- Came from a poor family
- Went into debt with ETA to get qualification through higher education
- Worked for Orrery for a long time, and finally got a chance to work in sub-orbital satellite maintenance through a work-visa for the Trans-Orbital Relocation Colum
- Skyfall destroyed many orbital structures, one of which he was working on
- He died, and was brought back as an Insolvent, and then got picked up by a realmstorm only days after

Name: Emi
Physical Description: Emi is a short, pretty woman with medium length blonde hair, bright blue eyes, and a slight build. Her hair seems to be styled differently every other day, and always has some streak of bright pastel. Her wardrobe seems to be constantly shifting as well, though short skirts with fun patterns, thigh highs, jackets and crop tops are more common than anything else.
Story Summary: Emi is the first daughter of a well-to-do corporate family. Tired of the pressure and responsibility, she ran away from home when her uncle died, changed her name, and started a new life as a musician. She's been playing shows and trying to make a name for herself in Haven ever since.

Name: Emile Ripley [C0M.3T_M31-0117]
Origin: PERSEUS Labs; Secura, Terra. South Rock, Haven, Terra.
Physical Description:
Armored
- He/Him, "Comet" or "Emile"
- Standing at 7'4", C0M.3T is covered in a black, iridescent, defensive exosuit called the STARFALL AEGIS. It operates with the predominantly analog GOR//GON system which reports vitals, suit integrity, and other statuses to its operator when directed
- An ionized comet-trail streams from his head and limbs when he moves. A sealed, unidentifiable energy core burns at the center of his chest and supplements power Emile can't provide
- Emile's voice is echoey and deep in this state

Unarmored
- She/Her, "Emile" or "Em"
- In contrast to her armored appearance, Em stands at 7' and has a muscular, full-figured body. Wispy purple hair trails down her back with a white patch centered above her forehead
- Scars can be seen along most of her visible pale skin, and her right arm is replaced with a metal, scarlet prosthesis. Her eyes are a similar color
- Em hides her spine, which is heavily cybernetically modified and grotesque
- She likes turtles a lot
Story Summary:
- One of nine survivors of 100G's PERSEUS Program, M31 was taken as a child and subjected to invasive augmentation to turn her into a "MEDUSA", a super soldier capable of synchronizing with GORGON-unit mech suits.
- Raised as an asset, M31 was trained to view themselves and their peers as human weapons. The life of a human was considered distant. Irrelevant.
- At 18, M31 was deployed onto their longest and most unusual assignment: an ongoing protection detail for 100G's public-facing asset, Dante Sterling.
- The corporate son was the first person to treat M31 as a person, naming her Emile and treating her as an equal rather than property.
- Through trust, honesty and friendship, Em's loyalty gradually shifted from corporate obedience to personal devotion. When Dante went rogue, she followed suit, marking her first true decision in life
- Now, Em continues to work with Dante of her own will, learning bit-by-bit about her own wants in life and what it means to be human as best as she can

Name: Emrik Renvald III
Physical Description:
Emrik is a shorter man with blue hair and a resolute look in his eyes. He's wearing a gleaming red riding gear and a green-and-yellow bow, obviously forged as the same set long ago, although impeccably maintained.
He's also accompanied by a large red dragon, some five meters from nose to base of tail, and that again for the tail and each wing.
Quirks:
Heirloom (Flamepiercer's Arc, Flamepiercer's Mantle)
Flaw: If he doesn't act daring and bold, the gear can force him to.
Rare Equipment:
Flamepiercer's Arc (Custom Bow, Interrupt)
Flamepiercer's Mantle (Armour, Composure)
Story Summary: Emrik Renvald III was born into greatness: his grandfather a living, albeit retired, legend among the Knights Wyvernia, and his father a noble with a high ranking office in the order. However, he was never pulled towards the official family motto of "win in a blaze of glory, or die trying", he was more tactically and academically minded. He still loved riding dragons, and was welcomed into the order himself, along with receiving the family heirloom riding equipment. Still, his predecessors' pressure looms over him, leaving him so desperate for acclaim that he signed up for what he believed to be a suicide mission: crossing the Runewall with his pen pal Galavan.

Name: Engh, Runaway Empty Monk Trainee
Physical Description: Engh is a short young man with a light brown skin tone and scraggly black hair. His deep red clothes are frayed and worn, and are usually covered by a similarly frayed and worn brown cloak. About the only thing on him that's been kept at a reasonable level of repair is his greatspear across his back, with a silvery broad head and finely carved black haft.
Story Summary:
Engh,  born in the subrealm of Leytik, was orphaned by a Spirit Beast attack when he was a child. Alone and lacking purpose, he was recruited by a sect of Empty Monks in an effort to gain the strength he would need to protect those he loved, should he ever find some of them again.

However, after years of training, he finally looked outward and saw the trouble caused by the empty monks, both among civilians and the recruits, and resolved to leave. He stole away in the night, carrying his only possessions, a brown cloak and the greatspear he was given as a gift for completing training.

For a while after, Engh hid in an abandoned outpost on the outskirts of a village, scavenging food and resources where he could. Unfortunately, he would again run afoul of a Spirit Beast, who nearly struck him down. If not for the sheer dumb luck of running into a Realmstorm, Engh would have perished.

But instead, he found himself aboard the Worldhelm.

Name: Enkh Tsering
Origin: Temple of Flow, Leytik, Tian Yin
Physical Description: Enkh stands at 5'11, wrapped in a flowing white dress and crowned in navy blue hair. They move with an air of grace and confidence, each step making their presence known.
Story Summary:
- Born in the Pravaha Mandira region
- Enkh grew up around the Empty Monks and eventually began helping them keep order
- Enkh eventually stumbled onto a manual labeled the Path of the Yeti
- During her attempts to learn more of this path, the Empty Monks found out about her discovery
- Enkh leaves the Temple of Flow, searching to understand more about the path she has found
- Enkh becomes swept up in a bad storm, arriving on the Worldhelm

Name: Enlai
Class List: Invoker 10, Dancer 10, Martial Artist 10, Fury 6, Ace of Cards 1, Arcanist 3
Origin: Bingchuan Village, Jijing Xiantiao, Wujing Guo, Tian Yin
Other Names: 恩来, Rowdy Farmer of Bingchuan, Drinker of Eighteen Barrels
Physical Description: The Vanara stands just over 5 feet tall with a lean toned physique earned from laborious farmwork. Wears peasant clothing, a straw hat slung over his back and a stalk of grass in their mouth. Rarely seen without a smile on his face and a bottle in his hand.
Rare Equipment:
- A fishing rod that floats in the sky!
- A five-coloured gourd that soaks up qi!
- A bamboo pole that can double in length!
- A set of robes especially for drinking and dancing!
Story Summary:
- Resident of Bingchuan village where he earned a living as an ordinary farmer, gifted with an affinity for the natural elements (or just plain good luck)
- Befriended a Jinshi martialist, Yang Xiang, who exchanges cups over discussing the Dao of the Drunken Master
- A yokai invaded the village and ruined their hard-earned crop, inciting Enlai to chase it furiously
- He unwittingly crossed a realmstorm onto the Worldhelm, and wishes to experience the joys of a broader world

Name: Enoch
Physical Description: An unassuming grey-haired young man, often seen with a mercenary jacket, a longsword and katana at his hip, and carrying a book that looks strangely like communist paraphernalia.
Rare Equipment:
Kisshoten-Ichimonji (Heirloom)
Invites misfortune to its wielder out of combat, or summons sword-wielding enemies

Name: Epsilon J. Affogato
Character Sheet Link: ["Greetings. My name is Epsilon J. Affogato, and I know it is in both our best interests if you humor me for these next 5 minutes."](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1mnw_5_iJcSS81vUy0zBVVFLCq5w1zaOfPruhyiW-SwA/edit?usp=sharing)
Physical Description: A slim person with light brown skin, hair made white by their own choice, and a terrifyingly professional business sense of dress.
Quirks: Beta-Stage Efficiency Upgrader Spinal Implant (Fugitive Experiment)
Story Summary:
- Managed to get a solid chemistry degree from school
- Immediately learned it wouldn't be helpful, ended up doing great in more administrative support type roles.
- Saw the worst of Terra office culture, started gigging jobs at bars
- Enjoyed bartending, but it doesn't pay the bills
- But what if he made his own bar?
- Now actively trying to schmooze a way into owning his own bar where he can control the shots and be better than what he's seen (he's unfortunately suspect to the wheel that grinds everyone under it).

Name: Erin Glassvelle
Character Bio Link: [I'll find the truth. No matter what it takes.](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1uGHxaQ9KCZuWVSqmTSFfS_zd7Eo05YBJnHzKhLnm0C4/edit?usp=sharing)
Character Sheet Link: ["My father taught me what I know. Namely in how to keep ones head on their shoulders.](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1uGHxaQ9KCZuWVSqmTSFfS_zd7Eo05YBJnHzKhLnm0C4/edit?usp=sharing)
Physical Description:
"I stand at 5'2 , my weight is my own business." (It's 48 kg)

"I adorn myself in the colours matching the house I serve, being blue & gold.

Hair tied back for practicality, tunic & boots. That's all that needs to be said."
Story Summary:
- I was born In Silverdale to the Glassvelle, long standing retainers for the Morris house of nobles.

- My father is a well-regarded advisor to the current head of the household.

- I worked as a tutor/retainer of their heir to the house, Master Lucien Morris,

- He, alongside my father were falsely implicated in a scandal regarding stolen jewelry from the queen and for conspiring against her.
 
- I managed to make a deal with the judge, to travel to the runewall in exchange for them to not be jailed and or executed if the worst comes to pass.

- "I'm hoping behind the Runewall I'll find the answers I'm looking for. That information could be the leverage I need to find my father & lord, alongside tracking down who is truly behind all this."

Name: Erin Shephard
Class List:
Pilot - 10
Tinkerer - 10
Guardian - 10
Arcanist - 10
Rogue - 3
Symbolist - 3
Daoist - 4
Physical Description: Erin is a 5' 10 young woman with tan skin and shaggy brown hair. She is often seen in her uniform though it has the wear and tear of being in it when she is both training and working. A mechanical surfboard-esque thing is often slung over her shoulder that has become a staple for many who see her.
Story Summary:
- Born and raised in Steelbin's Civilized Zone with her older brother, Anthony Shephard. Their parents made their living being mechanics for Machina.
- The two siblings were raised to be skilled craftsmen and Anthony gained patronage to the Academy due to engineering skills. Anthony then brought attention to his younger sister Erin, who held the same promising skills but seemed more focused on using it on her own projects.
- Under Anthony's recommendation, Erin received the same patronage but was more eager at the chance to leave Steelbin behind than learning new skills.
- Erin has been a student now for two years and while her brother was a perfect student, she failed to meet those expectations so she focused on proceeding to do the bare minimum to stay enrolled and no more than that.

Name: Ernest
Physical Description:
"An older human. Their face is ugly with age, but their lineaments still have a softness to them. Their white hair is usually messily tied back, and it is not uncommon to see them wear a beret or cap.
They are always dressed with modest clothing, kept to near perfection.
Their posture is usually weary and tense; could it simply be the weight of their years?
Strange, they only go by their first name."
Rare Equipment: \- **Arm-Mounted Cannon** [No Qualities]

Name: Esmon Stark
Class List:
Pilot 10
Tinkerer 10
Guardian 10
Fury 9
Merchant 10
Weaponmaster 1
Physical Description: A bit taller than average man, 5'10 in height. His slender form marked with black hair and various faded scars from the devastation of Morgan. He has stark purple eyes.
Story Summary:
- Esmon was born in Morgan. When the bombstrikes happened in Morgan, he survived from luck, chance, and strategic placement.
- As the building collapsed, Esmon was with Cassidy, the two children huddled under the ruins of Morgan for shelter until Lady Charlotte Luther Von-Hardwick appeared to save them.
- Charlotte took the two children under her and the two grew up together.
- Esmon growing to be overly aggressive and hot headed, especially when Cassidy would receive negative remarks - even from Cassidy themselves.
- When he learned about Cassidy's condition from Charlotte, he did what he was always going to do. Protect Cassidy.  She doesn't need to know. Not until she can stand up for herself.
- Esmon joined the Angels at the same time of Cassidy.
- After graduation, Esmon was in a pair grouping with Cassidy, making sure that her condition is under check. This is shown in the design of their mechs, both of them designed to meld with one another.

Name: Estelle Dubois
Physical Description: A 5'3 woman with brown skin and dark hair with bright red carnations that decorate her clothing and armor. She often is seen with a positive smile and the smell of different flowers surrounding her.
Story Summary:
- Single Daughter of a family that held the old teachings from forest spirits dearly, having taken the forest spirits' belief of caring for the land to heart.
- She was taught in the magical arts of Virelia and Anima due to her family's connection to the land they spent generations caring for.
- As time continued, the spirits began to become silent and no answers for the hostility that was once considered guardians and Leirsins who warned of worse to come.
- Estelle would try and beseech the spirits, but at no response, she began to look outside Rocade for help or answers.
- At the news of the Expedition to the Runewall, Estelle took it upon herself to join the numbers to find answers and something to help her home.

Name: Estrella Von Gilded
Character Sheet Link: [I, Estrella Von Gilded have come to assist you, do not resist](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1j3RXJrwdQ-qzw8qbkqwOKZ1rXJ2lSxbpMVpEnLr24wI/edit?usp=sharing)
Other Names:
- "The Monarch From Beyond The Veil of Time & Space",

- "The Crimson Blaze Searing The Corrupt",

- "The Gift of The Great Stars Above"
Physical Description:
About 5'6" in height, she wears a well-made short white dress with red spikes near the bottom. The brought together by a star coloredcloak she wears, tied together by a large white bowtie with a star emblazoned on it.

The most eye catching piece of her outfit, is the large hat she wears bearing a star at the tip of the hat and the crown created at the base. Both a sign of her magic expertise and "royalty".
Story Summary:
- Born in Belfrost, adopted daughter of Baron Von Gilded

- Underwent magical experiments, that overcharged both her body and soul

- Seems to be of the reality that she is a monarch from Eurys, but with no real titles or territory

Name: Eurydice
Physical Description: A woman that doesn't stand too tall, only at around 5'4, 5'5 if the day is going well for her. Her hair a stark white like the color has been shocked out of it, half her head shaven as long loose strands of hair hang down one side of her hair. When open her eyes are a sterling silver, a glint in them as if she's seeing more then she should. Adorned in golden jewelry and a mantle of white feathers along her shoulders, her clothes the simple wear of a traveling exorcist. On her person are always an assortment of weapons be them swords to firearms. Most notably are two, one a simple blade perfectly made for her while the other is a broken sword once made for two hands but now fits one. Always, spirits or other ghostly figures are near her person as if tied or drawn to her. A constant friendliness and passive gentleness to her nature.
Rare Equipment: Nah
Story Summary:
- Eurydice was born within the Bazaar, not only an accidental birth but one believed to be born stillborn or sickly if the birth was even successful. 

- she had a normal upbringing, her father a blacksmith and her mother a merchant so life within the Bazaar was tame for her. Her parents were Keepers of the 4th Grave, Ogum.

- however, at a very young age she was discovered to be a Herald, a walker of Eminence's Path. 

- due to this, she was picked up by the Seven Slaying Arms Sect and trained under them to better foster her abilities. 

- either by her own desires, or the sects, to better honor the Path of Eminence, they set out to conquer an impossible challenge of taking a pilgrimage to the 5th grave, Apep.

- many lost their lives on this pilgrimage, and once they did get to the grave they were attacked by ghosts and spirits. Eurydice herself doesn't remember fully what happened.

- Eurydice now has a connection to ghosts and the Afterlife, having spirits bound to her.

Name: Eusebiu "Seb" Atent
Physical Description: Slender dark-haired dark-eyed 6'3" man with a unnaturally pale complexion, even by Myist standards. Usually wears a longcoat. Always seems tired, and sometimes his physical form seems to waver or blend in with shadows. Bleeds black when manifesting the DMI's arcanum.
Quirks:
The Thinning
Weakness: Exposure to too many strong emotions causes him to feel faint and lose control of his powers.
Story Summary:
- Affected by the Thinning as a child, grew worse reaching adulthood
- Left family lands and went to Veyrhold to get more life experience and learn how to control the Black's influence on him
- Joined the DMI to access some of their research in exchange for being used for experiments with Vlach magic
- Cooperated enough to earn restricted permissions with the DMI's Arcanum

Name: Evelyn Antonov
Character Sheet Link: [Settle down and tell me what needs fixing, your meanderings is gonna break something in here..](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1OonNPxD7Ftkac2Q2cgdXwIYm8kEP7Rd2ejLkzNwpm_U/edit?usp=sharing)
Physical Description:
A blue haired Wilkin woman standing at roughly 5'8", a rather strong build bearing the scars of a mechanic across her arms.

Her eyes carry the energy of a tired but determined woman.
Story Summary:
* Orphaned at a young age, raised within a charity for the majority of her life
* Excelling in school, enrolled within the Korala Academy, Majoring in Magitech and Engineering. 
* Created the Prototype: SOROS, using scrap from damaged Merrane mechs. 
* Works as the Violet Baron's engineer

Name: Ezekiel Faranda
Physical Description:
Standing at 5'10". Ezekiel has canine Terran body mods to allegedly hide his insolvency. The scarlet eyes of his and his general slothful movements however make it still plainly obvious to anyone of his undeath status. He wears low quality plastic feeling clothing to save on money, and carries himself in a apathetic yet bold manner.

His mech, The Reliquary, is modeled to resemble a jackal with large blades floating behind it. One that Ezekiel helped design alongside Tubal and Cain while testing the experimental technology behind it.
Story Summary:
- Born into a rich family of a Start-up CEO and an entrepreneur, Lived a good early life.
- Goes into mechanical engineering and with an interest in machinery and weaponry, gets Military training.
- CEO Father fucked up royally and his company imploded on itself, was never able to stabilize, mother filed for divorced, and so turned to gambling to try and keep his bougie lifestyle, did not go well.
- Loan sharks step in and, while trying to resist, father dies. Insolvency starts. Forcing Ezekiel to pick up temp work.
- While trying to deal with an job regarding illegal drug dealing, Ezekiel ends up shot dead in an alleyway. Wakes up in ETA building as it's revealed how bad his fathers contract was. Generational Insolvency starts.
- Becomes ETA's lapdog and outsourced to multiple experimental projects with other companies, predominantly weapons testing with Tubal and Cain.
- Recently got their Insolvency contract and debt bought by A.G.E.S, and has ever since been working for them.

Name: Ezra White
Physical Description: A catboy with light red clothes and a fancy rapier at his side.

Name: Eʞo
Physical Description:
To the naked eye, Ekho resembles a green-skinned desert plant in the shape of a young woman, with black eyes and a stretched-out mouth, with a hair bun that allows this one to open their own head as one giant bulb.

Standing about five feet high, this one wears an old linen sack they were thrown in with, with a rope acting like a sash to hold some of their possessions, like water skins and seeds of "little ones". One may also spot this one with a wooden stake they use for movement, gardening and, occasionally, fending off hostile creatures.
Quirks:
Arboreal
- immune to **shaken**
- vulnerable to **ice**
- MP cost of Toxic Pollen reduced by 5 in sunlight
Story Summary:
- A cactus that somehow gained sentience
- Lived near the Hives, hunting down Kiir and scaring the travelers away from the hives
- Really likes plants and gardening. Futile as it may be in the desert, but there's ample fertilizer
- Managed to save a girl from dying once when her loved one ditched her
- Got picked up by a sandstorm and thrown aboard the ship in the same sack this one sleeped in
- Is blind, speaks only in words learned from others. Hence, Ekho

Name: Fable
Physical Description:
Fable is a little thing, still standing as tall as they can at 4' total (but they float to about 5'7", usually) A body, bleak as ink, is blotted with tufts of fluffy snow-white fur. Flanking each side of their head are two perky, long ears like a rabbits, and a crown of jagged horns like those of an upturned buck. A floofy white tail, like a wolves sways behind them, and their slender legs end in a pair of tiny paws. They are decorated with muted cloths of black, and blue, bits of armor and metal protecting important bits. A large, blue-green gem hangs off their neck on a thick loop.

In total shadow, their moony yellow eyes breach the dark, as do the ends of their horns, and the bases of their ears in an eerie white and violet glow.
Quirks:
Outcast Faerie
- Learned Spell: Drain Spirit
- Fae Weakness: Fable is unable to make willful contact with any iron or iron alloys unless it is to defend, save, or fight someone or something.
"Steel is not to be drawn, until it's purpose is to be fulfilled"

Name: Fabri Caetspells
Physical Description: A smaller slightly wider woman with sparkly eyes and large poofy curly hair tied back with blue highlights in it. She is dressed as a lightning themed magical girl with slight Mechanical accessories, including her gloves that has her magispheres inside. She also has a cute little umbrella as her spellcasting implement
Story Summary:
Comes from a family of rich celebrities from terra
Fabri's mother, Vindi, working for NTT is trying to rebrand magic to become a face of a group and gain even more fame
This skyrocketed the family into even more celebrity status due to controversy
Vindi as part of a magical rebranding stunt claimed that her daughter was a spell caster
Fabri being her oldest child was set up as said spellcaster despite not being able to cast spells
Uncle teaches Fabri to create spells via magisphere
uses it to "fake it till she made it"
Vindi uses Fabri to try and push magic to be more "friendly and light hearted" to change public opinion
uses her connections to make Fabri a storm "superhero" as part of her brand
Fabri believes every word of it

Name: Fafnir
Physical Description: Tall with a head of red hair like blood and fire, eyes that smolder like the inside of a volcano. Red scales lineing different parts of her body in clusters from her scaled and clawed hands and around her neck. Two black horns coming from the top that curve and curl into sharpened points along with large black wings that sprout out from the back. She stands at 6'3 normally, constantly radiating warmth and at times under certain situations smells of blood.

Name: Familade
Physical Description:
Familade is a 9’2 behemoth of a woman. From the waist up, she appears to be a tall figure with wild, messy hair, and ashen skin. She wears simple clothing, adorned with all manner of charms, trinkets, and magical components. Her arms are black, with short, fine fur covering their surface.

Below the waist, however, Familade is a massive beast. A furred, lupine body contrasts with her dragonlike wings, marked with patterns resembling eyes, and her large, violent looking spines, upon which several silver rings rest. There isn’t any one animal sue resembles most closely, but rather, a chimeric fusion of many different aspects of many different creatures.
Story Summary: Familade is a tall, proud woman, who always maintains a serious manner, addressing even the most trivial of situations as if they were of dire import. Despite her confident nature, however, she shies away from personal contact and having a close proximity to others, preferring to keep a moderate distance away from others. While she does not expand on her history too heavily, she does make it known that she hails from Kor’Tarion’s winter court, and was exiled due to a lack of discipline; a failing she seeks to remedy.

Name: Fang
Physical Description:
A quite effeminate young man with a lithe build, Fang stands at around 5’4” and 102 lbs. A pair of canine ears poke above a head of light auburn hair, tied back in a ‘stylishly unkempt’ ponytail and pigtails combo. A matching tail often swishes eagerly below any number of cute outfits, many of which were tailored by Fang himself.
He often wears a pair of odd gloves: stylish, but with a dull humming of magitech woven through the fabric that allows him to manipulate the small blades he utilizes in both dressmaking and combat.

Name: Fayn Silverheart
Physical Description:
Blue hair (shortish),
Golden Eyes,
5'9"/175cm,
144lbs,
White shirt,
Dark Blue vest,
Light Blue Neckerchief,
Grey pants,
Blue Boots
Quirks: Elemental Soul Affinity Ice Weakness Fire
Story Summary:
Father an Immortal Patriarch of the Wintercourt,
Mother Niad of the Court of Storms.,
Trains in Fae Magic.,
Wanders Kor'Tarion after Moonfall.,
Meets boyfriend in the Vicinity of Lastport.
helps boyfriend in Teashop with Magic.,
Boyfriend passes away.
Fayn's Greif phyiscaly manifests as Ice in his soul,
Fayn encounters a Realmstorm  while wandering again and ends up in the Worldhelm

Name: Felicia Rehinsfel
Physical Description: Dressed in comfortable and form fitting blue and black attire, contrasting with the typical attire one would expect from a noble daughter from Wulforh. Standing annoyed at five foot, six inches, she usually has her brownish red hair set out into a long ponytail with her leirsin ears and tail proudly on display. Carrying the air of almost always being annoyed.
Quirks:
Cursed
Complication: Part of Felicia is missing, there is a void in her that she seeks to fill by consuming (food or mana). Not doing so makes her irritated and hangry
Story Summary:
* Second daughter to a Wulforh noble family, and deemed a failure by her father due to her inability to use magic in a family filled with Mages.
* Was seperated from her twin sister when they were sent to Gaius Military school and  Breusen Mage Academy respectively due to her (intentional or unintentionally) distracting her twin sister, excelling in trouble making.
* From a young age, she could not explain why, but she always felt a hunger inside of her for as long as she can remember. It sometimes manifests as cravings for food, and biting.
* Upon hearing of what happened at the Breusen Mage Academy regarding her sister, she packed her bags, and abandoned the school without a notice to find her sister, and subsequently join her as they enter the Runewall together.

Name: Felicity Rehinsfel
Physical Description: Dressed in the standard Wulforh red and golds and the robes one would expect of a student from Bresun Academy, Felicity is an apprentice mage from the noble house of Rehinsfel. Standing at a proud five foot and five inches, she usually has her brownish red hair done up in a pair of twin tails with her leirsin ears and tail propped out of her outfit and hair. Along her right arm is her family's magical crest. Something their bloodline has worked on to perfection even before the colonists arrived in Eurys. It's bright, crimson markings hold the wealth of knowledge from her ancestors, waiting to be unlocked and added to with time.
Quirks: Magic Crest of the Rehinsfel Family (Mysterious Grimoire)
Story Summary:
- Eldest daughter to a Wulforh noble family, and entrusted with their magical crest which carried with it the legacy of their magical knowledge since before the colonization of Eurys.
- Was seperated from her twin sister when they were sent to Breusen Mage Academy and Galius Military School respectively. Excelled in her magical studies and met an heir of Prosperity named Alain Meyer.
- Alain convinced her to help him practice Briar magic in secret. She followed along in hopes she could make a name of herself sooner than later.
- A magical accident occurs and harms those around her in class along with an heir to Desire named Anastasia Fischer. Causing her to be sentence to execution via the Runewall for the damages done to the school and harming an heir of Desire.
- Before stepping through after being cast out from the Academy and the family she was joined by her twin sister to know that she wasn't alone in wherever they ended up.

Name: Fenja
Physical Description: Green skin, and a vinelike tail, dressed in comfortable clothes bordering on a militaristic style, and with a height of about 5'5.
Story Summary:
A subject of an old Baylore project in Termina.
The first successful human seaborn hybrid.
Been in stasis since the bombs fell.
Recently woke up and arrived to the world helm.

Name: Fernia
Class List: Wayfarer ★ | Floralist ★ | Guardian ★ | Weaponmaster 4 | Symbolist ★ | Loremaster 4 | Martial Artist 2
Physical Description: Dresses modestly with most of her body covered and has an eye patch over her right eye. Seems to wear several colorful flowers in her hair. But with close inspection or high observation skills can tell those flowers are actually growing from her body. While her hair split between white on her right side while the left is brunette.
Rare Equipment:
Ebonlight Vesture - Otherworldly Veil Runic Armor
Fernia's Parasol - Swordbreaker Runic Shield
Frozen Spark Lantern - Dual Resistance (Ice/Bolt) Runic Shield
Floracord Pendant - Kindred Accessory
Story Summary:
Partner Bond with: Saki

- Was a simple traveling botanist studying plants.
- While investigating the rumors of flowers she was attacked by something and blacked out.
- When she awoke she found a flowering plant she did not know growing on her and holding her injuries together.
- Over time the color in her hair and skin began to fade turning white and becoming pale.
- Due to encouragement from Saki, as someone she cares deeply about, she set off to find out more about this bloom.
- With assistance from Hudal Academy she was able to locate to origin of the bloom and traveled there to find out more.
- Upon finding where the bloom came from and she, with the assistance of Saki and Kawa,  defeated the creature that had originally attacked her.
- With the former host dead the bloom was freed from the Gloom's influence and become symbiotic instead.

Name: Ferry
Physical Description:
Ferry stands at a powerful 152 cm (5 feet) with a slim, almost malnourished build. Visibly swaying with the weight of his mechanical arm as he walks, the scavenger usually cradles it with his natural limb to help keep balance.

If he's out and about, one will normally find him with a sac fashioned from a patchwork of worn fabrics, undoubtedly jingling with the fruits of his labor from scrounging in junk piles and trash heaps.
Rare Equipment:
Arzet-Style Bionic Arm Mk2
Quality: Gambler’s Dice
Story Summary:
- Lived in the Vale all his life, both before and after its ruination.
- Raised by a scientist that left him later in life to join Merrane nationalists, believing that Karlsgard had destroyed their own city for a political cover up.
- Said scientist built his mechanical arm, secretly a prototype weapon created to enact revenge upon the operatives who destroyed the Vale.
- Chased by Merrane operatives in his adulthood for possession of the arm, only to be saved by a Realmstorm before he could be caught.

Name: Finch
Physical Description:
Height: 5'11" Eyes: Red
Weight: 195 lbs Hair: Light Red
Chest has a scar from his first battle against monsters. It is in the form of 3 claw marks.

Name: Finnley
Physical Description: An average height individual of slim build adorned in "stylish" attire ,and pale hair

Name: Flare
Physical Description: A man who has purple leaves instead of hair. Roots can be seen growing within parts of his skin. He wears a large cloak and long sleeves - likely to hide his unconventional appearance from others.
Quirks:
The Long Dream
At the end of each session (approximately four hours of play), before assigning XP, roll 2d20. If you roll equal to or lower than your current character level, the last farewell grows closer. When a rule or ability requires you to spend Hit Points, Mind Points, or Fabula Points, you may instead ignore that cost. If you do, the last farewell grows closer; after you ignore a cost this way, if the last farewell has grown closer at least 10 times, the moment has come to leave the world of humans.

Name: Florian Valstrider
Physical Description: Moderately tall, and wiry for a would-be soldier, Florian dresses in a variety of well-tailored paints and vests with a long formal coat. Soft leather boots, suited for hiking, are the only part of his outfit that would suggest he was anything different than the average Merrani young noble or academy student. Wearing glasses over green eyes, his intricate staff and a crystal amulet tucked under his vest are the only weapons and/or magitech visible.

Name: Franz Alberic
Physical Description: a man standing at 5'11ft and 190lbs with white hair and a fairly stylish outfit, is very rarely seen without their sword and even rarer seen with some some kind of small tome in which they use to take notes
Story Summary:
- Mage of both animism and thaumaturgy albeit at a fairly novice level
- left home after feeling that Delsatz's current political state was growing stagnate with very little action actually being taken
- values the prospectives of people who actually lived through problems rathe then the powers that be that refuse to take action

Name: Frederick Schmidt
Physical Description:
Frederick is a pale man, 5'3ft, 135 lb, with a gold left eye and a indigo right. He has blond and curly hair that he has stylized to cover his right eye and part of his face.

His typical attire consists of a long coat with a furred collar, sleeves, and bottom, a hat with one of its sides pinned up, adventuring pants, cuffed leather boots, and white gloves which blue roses embedded into the backhand of the design.
Rare Equipment:
Heirlooms: Allegro and Adagio. Two pistols with the Energy Vamp property.

Armor: Symphony's Scarf (Heaven's Guardian Armor set)
Story Summary:
-Friedrich "Frederick" Schmidt, was born into the Schmidt noble family of Silverdale.

-Raised alongside his twin brother Alphonse, and his older sister Morgan, Frederick has always had some sense of adventure. From a young age he knew of his parent's past as adventurers, and he wanted to have the same type of life. 

-As he grew up, he kept trying to explore the dangerous landscapes of Silverdale, coming back with many injury and treasures alike(even coming back one day with a set of magical crystals that Morgan, a skilled anarch, fashioned into pistols).

-One day, some Silverdale nobles gathered an expedition for the Runewall. Despite straining relations between House Schmidt and the rest of the families, Friedrich volunteered, and Alphonse followed alongside him. 

-When finally at the Runewall, the two lost each other in the chaos of the storm and Frederick was sent to this strange new place.

Name: Freyr Branson
Character Sheet Link: [I will etch my own story into Permanence.](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1JiCI7Th5R5LE0Ofnhrd0qJN0Rh2BLBTuKpP-2WC1ndo/edit?usp=sharing)
Physical Description: Freyr is a 6' Tall, well built man who often carries around a large sword on his back. He has a large scar that runs down his right eye, and between his one green eye, messy red-brown hair, and obvious Karsbren accent, it's no question where he's from.
Story Summary:
Born the Eldest Son of three in Gravslenge.

Spent over a Decade and a Half working in Smithies, Forges, and the Great Forge within Gravslenge.

Once tutored, and became close with, a particular Smith Slave. Was suspiciously absent when she later escaped, though nothing was ever traced back to him.

Headed to the Runewall expeditions in hopes to find someone, though he also plans to share his art of Permanence.

After being one of the few survivors of the Expedition, he arrived upon the Worldhelm.

Name: Frigg Engstrom
Physical Description: Lanky pale, and with slightly dead eyes. Long black hair usually at least partially braided in fine clothes with a clear Karsbren origin, perfect for cold weather.
Story Summary:
- Child of Jarl Warrior Kind Niklas Engstrom,
- Was kidnapped by their mother for a while, but got back to Karsbren a few years ago. There was even a celebration about it.
- Was sent to the great march as a representative of Karsbren.

Name: Fungee
Physical Description:
- 3'9" (114 cm) fey of fungal origin, with a soft, spongy body resembling living mycelium.
- Wide mushroom cap for a head, speckled with bioluminescent spots that shift color with mood.
- Communicates via melodic, vibration-born sounds.
- Emits faint ambient spores that glimmer softly in the air.
- Wears a layered robe stitched from petals, moss, lichen, and leaf-like fabrics.
- Makes squeaky noises when walking.
- Overall aesthetic is whimsical, organic, and otherworldly.
Rare Equipment: None
Story Summary:
- Grown from the mycorrhizal network—a vast, living fungal web that stores memory and emotional resonance across the land.
- Formed in a grove centered around Echobark, an ancient tree that serves as the deepest node of the local network.
- Regarded by some pilgrims as Echobark’s spirit or child.
- Spent early life listening and interpreting the network, gently resolving spiritual imbalances in the realm.
- Joined the Goldhearted seeking connection through joyful presence and emotional resonance.

Name: Féin of Lionheart's Reach
Physical Description:
She stands tall but not proud, no she stands resolute at 3'4ft to see her duties done. Grey fur with slight patches of black around the ears and on her back, Féin stands tall to walk the wall that oversees her charge until her final breath. To many she seems such a serious and possibly unfun person to be around but to those who serve with her, know how kind hearted and strong her heart is and unreasonably focused she is on what her duties are. Her steely eyes gaze ever onward to the threats and the weight bared.

She carries with her a weapon her back, far larger than her, too unwieldy looking to be a sword and too sharp to be maul. A Fang from The Great Wolf.
Quirks:
Heirloom: The Great Fang, "Cú Faoil"

The Broken Fang of the Great Wolf that once ravaged the land and began a Hunt along with their kin all through out Firwood. This is the supposed Fang of the Great Wolf that started the Great Hunt that slaughtered the Great Beasts. Well kept and filed to ensure sharpness, yet too unwieldy by most to be considered a proper blade and not blunted to be a hammer. The Fang Fashioned into a Weapon for only those who take up the mantle and are able to bare the weight can use. Passed down from Knight to Knight of the Faolán name.

||( Given its relation to the Mad Hound, it could bring about feelings of intense anger/hunger or sudden feeling of Fein being untrustworthy/threatening to the people around her due to the Great Wolf having gone mad. 

It would likely be some feeling or baleful aura that comes off of the fang itself.)||
Rare Equipment:
Great Fang "Cú Faoil"

【MIG + MIG】 | 【HR + 15】 Physical

Two Handed | Heavy | Dual Hunter (Demons/Beasts): This weapon deals 5 extra damage to creatures belonging to one of two particular Species.
Story Summary:
- She is the daughter of a once more noble family of the name Faolán.
- During the Great Hunt one of the Great Wolf's Fangs was said to have broken off by The Lion. This came in to possession of her family.
- The family's social favor with the people dimmed drastically due to their name, even though they had nothing to do with the great hunt. Even more so the fact they kept said Fang decreased favor even more.
- The family which initially held wolves favorably, all but officially exiled themselves from Hearthome to subject themselves to eternal vigil over the Murkwood due to feelings of betrayal and responsibility.
- Féin is the current wielder of The Great Fang, Cú Faoil. Having been passed down from generation to generation of those who stood vigil as Lionheart's Reach over the Murkwood as a Knight. She is called Faolán at times as a means of disrespect by some rather than her name or Wolf Knight Faolán by those who respect her and the sacrifice being made by taking the mantle.

Name: Féng Líhuà 「冯丽华」
Physical Description:
A blue and black caled Bishi'e with silver hair and tufts, Lihua stands at 5'7" and carries herself with a level of confidence and arrogance.
She wear a white and yellow robe along with baggy pants, around her wrists and neck are also bead bracelets and a long bead necklace.
Story Summary:
- Bishi'e born into a normal loving family within Yuānshì due to fervent prayers wishing for a healthy child. Seen as a great omen and overall liked by her village.
- Is told by villager elder Sūn Wǔhào that her parents got killed while out foraging in the Mòguāng jungle. A fabrication of events that Wǔhào created to keep Líhuà out of trouble. She is unaware of the truth and believes his story to be fact still to this day.
- Is taken in as one of Wǔhào's students in the form of body cultivation, creates a rivalry with his grandson Hàoyú.
- Is shown to have a massive innate affinity to Sun Qi, Reaches Qi condensation at the ridiculous age of 16 before Hàoyú even with a 9 year age difference, rivalry turns bitter as the clear Bishi'e advantage she has is obvious to anyone.
- Progress slows to a halt in her perspective so she starts her journey. Now trying to further hone herself to become as strong of a body cultivator as possible, while broadening her coddled views of the world.

Name: GARGOYLE
Physical Description: A purple haired young man with plant features and a burn scar on one side of his face.

Name: GROVE
Physical Description: Grove's body is made from the gnarled bark of an old tree, with vibrant green moss and small sprigs of life sprouting from its shoulders and head. A deep green, hooded cloak, the color of damp leaves, shrouds its form, and from beneath the hood, a featureless mask with glowing turquoise eyes peers out with an air of quiet wisdom. One hand gently offers a perch to a small, trusting bird, while the other firmly grasps a twisted wooden staff. With antlers like tree branches reaching from its head, Grove is a quiet, watchful guardian.
Story Summary:
When the druids of Willowvine Dell knew that their grove was doomed, they set about animating a protector that would outlive them. They created a being that was mighty, and durable, and most of all, insightful. It would act as the last living protector of their most sacred treasure: the last living cutting of the Starcradle Tree. They set this creature off into the wilderness with a critical mission: survive, and locate a new home for its charge.

Many, many long years have passed, and the being known as GROVE has wandered the world ever since, watching the world evolve and change around them.

Name: Gabriel Moonfallen
Physical Description: A six foot lean androgynous person, covered all over in white feathers with two large white wings on their back. They have clothing that covers part of their head and neck. Their chest is mostly exposed (they have a male body) and they have a skirt made out of their own feathers down to knee length. They have bird like claws instead of hands and feet.

Name: Gabriela Josephine Caladrius
Physical Description:
