Gabriela is a average height women adorned in white priestly robes with symbols bearing her lineage as a daughter of the High Priestess. Her eyes are a steely gray, remaining sharp and poised. Her stance is strong and regal, holding a dignity and grace in her steps. Her hair is a snow white, and cut short to ensure it does not get in the way.

Her disposition is cold and unflinching, and her head is always on a swivel.
Story Summary:
- On that faithful day, a Lunar Eclipse covered the sky instead, blocking the sun from the prophesized blessing of the High Priestess' Daughter. Gabriela has lived in the shadow of that event her entire life, far weaker than she should be.

- She took solace in her older sister's guidance, and her nephew, who was similar of age, and acted like her sibling. She found talent in her physical capabilities, a side effect of the Eclipse.

- Not a month after she turned 11, her sister was killed by demons during a mission to a Coven Town. This changed both her and her nephew's lives forever.

- She threw herself into her training, molding herself into a vessel for Exorcism, her touch of the eclipse able to channel the Sun's Wrath at high intensity.

- She continues her path of Fury, with Heron as her stalwart guardian. Following the path of righteous indignation.

Name: Gabu
Character Sheet Link: [The broken do not yearn for more. In want, in bloom, as we rise by reaching.](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1ePv5OUvq3tGibPqlx-xQb0tBk7K5yfC2c0oCRx-PdqA/edit?usp=sharing)
Other Names: Sir Gabu, First Knight of Dryholde
Physical Description:
The Protector of the Mirland Coast takes on the appearance of a young man wearing flowing clothes, with white hair and red eyes. What remains of his demonic origin are just his sharp, sharklike teeth - all in all, he looks like a pretty normal guy!

He's usually carrying a kite or two on him, since he loves flying them with friends!
Rare Equipment:
- Bzzt Amulet (Accessory, Resistance to Bolt)
- Sea Trickster’s Robe (Combat Tunic, Marked-Dazed)
- Domain: Chaotic Winds (Accessory, briefly gain flight after dealing Air damage)
- Domain: Water Currents (Accessory, Frostbite - Ice, Slow)
- Hull Breacher (Heavy one-handed weapon, [MIG+MIG]+1; [HR+11] Dark damage, Symbiotic Weapon)
- Friend's Hat (Accessory, Reassuring)
- Demonsteel Claws (Dagger one-handed weapon, [DEX+MIG]+1; [HR+6] Dark damage, [Soulspeed](<https://discord.com/channels/1169852846083153941/1188741294793691186/1323766516117671977>))
- Lead Promise (Dagger one-handed weapon, [DEX+DEX]+1; [HR+7] Poison damage, World Savior)
- Soulbite (Dagger one-handed weapon, [DEX+MIG]+1; [HR+8] Physical damage, Status Plus: enraged)
- Tarnished Sharknife (Dagger one-handed weapon, [DEX+DEX]+2; [HR+6] Light damage, Specialist: daggers
- In Want, In Bloom (Sword one-handed weapon, [DEX+MIG]+2; [HR+10] Light damage, Weapon Up: melee)
- Ugly Duckling's Golden Feather
Story Summary:
- Formerly the incarnation of the demon of Envy, whose essence was tampered with by the Dream Weaver to create something less dangerous
- He spent 72 years claiming a semblance of humanity, eventually making a name for himself as Gabu, protector of the Mirland Coast
- Eventually, to save a friend they turned back into his old form, temporarily regaining his more demonic and envious persona.
- During the confrontation with Loftur, he showed his best self and reclaimed his Gabu-ness.
- Was finally turned into *something more* by the Queen of Hearts, Song-5.

Name: Gadget
Character Sheet Link: [Lamp oil? Ropes? Bombs? You want it? it's yours my friend! As long as you have enough Zenit!](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1qDw9VfPbpr_hwwT3KVcsi_WHyFold46b4OyyUH2VU4Q/edit?usp=sharing)
Physical Description:
Standing at 4'7", it's very easy to pick Gadget out of a crowd alongside his Firwood peers. What stands out most is the portable marketstand he constantly carries on his back, always ready to make a trade!

The smell of herbs and other alchemical ingredients is apparent on him, with way too many pouches being hung from his belt.
Story Summary:
- Born within Firwood, a former member of the Malagar coven made up of around 80 kin. The majority of the coven went on the expedition te the north 10 years ago, albeit Gadget was not of age to go on this expedition.

- All but 5 of the coven had survived. With guilt on his conscious as well as a curiosity for why things happened the way they did, Gadget absconded from what little was left and found himself as a stray on the road.

- Has a pension for getting what he wanted, and went from begging to trading wares between other tribes. This hussle would go on until the present day, where after multiple encounters with the crown prince, found himself as a member of the Fellowship.

- While he maintains the Fellowships' agenda and will help them with their goals, he ultimately wants to find the other members of the Malagar one way or another.

Name: Gaius Decimus
Physical Description:
Gaius is of average high, but is obviously quite fit. His mid length hair is a wavy, dirty blonde and the most striking feature of his face are the odd-coloured eyes. One is brown and one is blue. He tends to wear rather light clothes under his armour and when he can he at least carries his weapon everywhere, but quite often he can be seen with his shield as well. 
While he often looks serious or even anguished, he has a light smile and a friendly demeanour once people talk to him, which can clash with his martial appearance.
Rare Equipment: None
Story Summary: Originally born in Last Hold, Gaius came into contact with several key aspects of the Culture of the empire early on: Being oppressed due to being a human, the branding and exploitation of mages and the hunters, going out into the desert to cull the Kiir. All of this has influenced him to go out into the desert himself, to escape the constant oppression, but also to hide his nascent magical abilities from the Nezzim. He became a skilled hunter relatively fast, but much changed when he stumbled upon an old stone tablet, talking about Falak-khan in the Short Peaks. He had heard rumours of this god in the past, but was now completely fascinated with him.  Nowadays, he's wandering the dunes, trying to find a sign of this god to enkindle the spirits of his fellow oppressed  against the Nezzim. To this end, he's seeking out everybody who might know more about the ancient stories, but also talking to other people, especially hunters, to slowly spread the tales and a hope for a new dawn.

Name: Galavan Riverstone
Character Sheet Link: [We will tell our story the way we choose!](<https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1cQW19uEf0_SL6KKGMDDj0ZEgBgoio8PO-ERO3-vYrxU/edit?gid=0#gid=0>)
Physical Description: A scrawny young man with unkempt red hair and inquisitive grey eyes hidden behind thick glasses. A permanent slouch usually steals a few inches from him, and the air of someone who's always lost in his thoughts follows him like a loyal dog. Usually clad in warm and sensible clothes, Galavan is just your average Silverdale inhabitant.
Quirks:
**__Wisdom's Book (Mysterious Grimoire)__**
Upon encountering a Danger, Discovery, or Villain, you may ask the Game Master a single question concerning the triggering event (you may ask it immediately or save it for later).  The GM answers truthfully, and describes how the answer appears in your book.

Once your grimoire has answered 10 questions, it has shared nearly all of its knowledge with you. Choose between Personal Revelation, Hidden Magic, or Awaken Conciousness. Then, the grimoire becomes a normal book, and the GM chooses one: it reveals a key clue about a current threat; or it reveals a new threat and reveals a clue about it.
Rare Equipment:
The Watcher's Tome (Magic UP arcane/sword weapon)
Skeleton Hand (Spell Splash accessory)
Hearthwool Coat (Reassuring Sage Robe)
Story Summary:
- Simple young man from Belfrost
- Seeks knowledge to the Sanctuary of Wisdom in Stratford
- Becomes a follower of the Beacon of Wisdom Julius Miquel, admires him a lot
- Julius sends his disciples out to seek wisdom, Galavan is one of them
- Tasked with understanding the Watcher's Tome by Julius himself
- Joins the expedition and goes through the Runewall together with his best friend Rhys
- Now holds a copy of Wisdom's Book

Name: Gareth
Physical Description: Gareth is tall and pale blonde, with tan skin and dark eyes. He dresses in light layers and carries everything  he owns in a bag strung over his shoulders.
Story Summary:
He has lived in Idyll for as long as he can remember. He was originally born on Terra, but the memory has faded such that he doesn't know what his life there was like. He doesn't even remember how long he'd been in Barza when he met Mya. She was exactly what he needed to face the layers of Idyll-- quick and decisive when he was uncertain, ruthless and cutting when he was gentle. They made a good team. They made their way down over the course of years, until Gareth could scarcely remember a time before he had Mya. Down they went, layer by layer, until they got stuck in the sands of Sum. And when she hardened too much, when she turned to stone... he couldn't lose that. 
For the last two years, Gareth has been painstakingly moving Mya's statue with him through the sand. He is determined to find a way to fix her and bring her with him when he finally escapes Idyll for good.

Name: Garmir Eidolon
Class List: Mutant 10 / Floralist 10 / Weaponmaster 10 / Dancer 6 / Darkblade 2 / Guardian 1
Physical Description: A muscular 6'9" wolfman with dark sclera and red irises. Wears a cap and an open jacket with leather pants. When fighting, summons additional appendages, usually dark vine-like tendrils brimming with elemental magic from his back, to help subjugate his opponents.
Story Summary:
- Fugitive experiment of T&C, kidnapped as an orphan, augmented with cybernetic tendrils and designed to be a living weapon in Cabre
- Has a (real) TEMP license using a fake name, after escaping did odd jobs around Haven until he crossed paths with a Realmstorm
- Grew close to a group of friends called the Wildcards, particularly after a certain incident with a certain other canine
- After retracing his steps in Cabre and obtaining a list of the remaining subjects of the same experiment series he was in, intends to look for them and see what he can do

Name: Garnier
Physical Description: An old man of surprisingly burly build, standing slightly taller than average,
Story Summary:
- Born to a peasant family in Pragstenburg
- Always admired knights, but couldn't join any due to birth status
- Trained on his own, until he heard about an order named "The Company of Goodfellows"
- Despite his lowborn status, he joined as a squire/page at 17
- Worked his way up to a full knight over four years, emulating the unorthodox Company's ways of equality under service, dispensing justice, chivalry and heroism
- The Company took a mission to try and depose a particularly powerful bandit lord, who posed as a sort of merchant king
- They failed, the entire Company died except him. He had been delayed to the mission due to a small dalliance.
- Falls into a deep depression, carried by charity borne from infamy at first, and then general pity for a shell of a man.
- 42 years pass, and joins the expedition into the Runewall in order to finally die in a way that would befit a "knight".
- Worldhelm.

Name: Gawain Elysia
Class List:
★ Arcanist
★ Weaponmaster 
6 Martial Artist
1 Guardian
2 Dancer
Physical Description: Standing roughly at 6'1 (185cm) Gawain is a fairly well built Lerisin man. Usually dressed without much armor he carries a multitude of swords with him at most times. Along his arms and some parts of his chest has blue crystals forming over where scars would be. Along the side of his face has a much larger and more pronounced blue crystal as well. He carries an aura of pride with him at all times.
Story Summary:
Born to a family in the New Moon Tribe. While growing up, other Leirsin would often keep their distance as Gawain never had the same potency Omen seeing abilities as others.

He would receive visions of great battles and other aspects of Victory in his dreams. Leading him to fight a Caravan along the road with some others of his kin when he was a teenager.

During the attack the Victory beacon showed mercy to him and took him to the Victory Stone to hone his abilities. Training him for years to come on how to best practice the teachings of victory and battle.

Now an adult, Gawain seeks a battle that could sate every desire he could ever want from life. Pushing him to leave the Victory Stone for now in search for his own way in life. His own victory.

Name: Gerard de Montagne
Physical Description:
Lean yet Athletic despite his advanced years.
6ft’6 in height 
Never seen outside of his lightly armored pilot’s suit, complete with the helmet that hides his face.
Always carried a pistol at his hip.
Were one to gaze beneath his helmet, they would find a rugged face with lines that show his age, a full fairly well kept beard that like his Raven black hair has begun to grey, Hazel coloured eyes and a scar across his left eye.
Story Summary:
A veteran soldier and angel pilot who attended the white wings academy with the backing of a noble. Lt.Gerard de Montagne rose through the ranks become a renowned and decorated officer within the imperial military.

However, during the crisis of succession he had already begun to waved on his faith to the empire as he was made to carry out orders he found questionable at best… when he received the news his wife, unborn child and parents had been killed amidst a power struggle his sense of duty became the only thing that tethered him to the empire. The only thing that prevented him from allowing the newly found hatred he felt for Merrane to consume him.

Now as the empire appears to be crumbling around him, all he desires is to do whatever good he can as penance for his past sins, chief among them his failure to save his family.

Class List:

☆ Sword Saint [Weaponmaster]
4 Emperor [Commander]
5 Awakened Soul [Esper]
1 Warlord [Guardian]
Origin: Tian Yin, Teisei, Shrine of Inexorable Tides
Physical Description:
A lithe swordsman with feminine features, Gin stands at roughly 5'3"/160cm. Cerulean hair cascades over sapphire eyes and porcelain skin.

Their neutral expression conveys mixed feelings. A stern countenance wrought by grief and obligation, but a soft look in their eyes that conveys deep empathy for the pain of others.

Name: Gladiolus Amendola
Character Sheet Link: [You need to be better than me. Think you can make it? *The bar is incredibly high.*](<https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/11wwmSLlXMU46CXyNg5AcfsJcwKWfwbL9jzyO9UISwhM/edit?gid=0#gid=0>)
Class List:

Orator [4]
Physical Description:
A somewhat strongly built septid that seems to always be walking around dancing from joy. They usually dress in heavy clothes that cover all of their body, enjoying baggy and larger ones as well as dresses. Strong cinnamon smell.
They have a tail-like implant that serves absolutely no purpose other than the fact of them having a tail, and slightly sharp teeth.
Bright yellow hair and the typical insolvent’s red eyes and pale grey skin, dotted by patches of flesh turned to porcelain.
They tend to act friendly and confident, a chuckle always in their speech.
Rare Equipment:
[**Vanagandr's Chains of Suffering**](<https://www.legendkeeper.com/app/clohkxnb34fbj08439mobcmjv/u66dkwth/>)
**Academy Battle Plate** (+2 to next roll when summoning an arcanum)
**Mayhem** (+10 MP when using an arcanum dismiss effect)
**First Line of Defense** (+5 HP recovery)
**Loftur’s Cornucopia** (Don’t Worry About It)
**SC4L2 Steel Plating** (+10 HP)
Story Summary:
- Septid, born and raised in South Rock, in an apparently well-off family. Used to be a problem child until the age of 14, kind of a jerk and a bully.
- Parents die and they're suddenly responsible for a younger brother and an incredibly high debt inherited by their parents.
- Decides they'd better work to repay every single zenit of it. Clean themselves up, tries becoming a better person and works for ETA as a debt collector.
- Went to get a payment, debtor pulled a gun on them. "Guess insolvency it is", they thought. Instead, they were summoned to the Worldhelm
- Eventually became an insolvent to save Termina and two ARMY-grades who just wanted to live.
- Had a close call with the son of Lilith Tychon and Utopia that brought tragedy to Terra, but they survived and are trying to clean up their messes.

Name: Godric
Class List:
Chanter ★
Esper ★
Guardian ★
Spiritist ★
Pilot [1]
Elementalist [1]
Physical Description:
Haughty looking 6'0" guy in shiny armor and a big shield.

In fights, he uses wide range aura magic that comes from his body, usually star-shaped through intentional effort.
Rare Equipment: Recover 5 MP on attack, Mindful and +2 SL on Resonance
Story Summary:
- Only son of a family of corrupt merchants in Brightshield that hates mages
- Learned magic despite parents disapproval, they cause an accident and blame him for it, forcing him to abandon magic for years
- Renounces his name after discovering what happened, becoming a "hero" and a failed mercenary
- __Ends up at the Worldhelm__
- Gets involved with the Yokai of Aldistir due to Sakura
- Works as a mercenary in Kor'Tarion and has to deal with Rosalia
- Grows close to Dai Shuye and works with Gin to save her
- After she was saved and became Emperor, he became a general and called himself the Shield of Teisei
- Has started his cultivation with help from Yubel

Name: Gojko
Physical Description:
An old bat of median stature, curved under the weight of age. He's crooked, stumbling, and unsteady, and sometimes might sound outright delirious to those who don't know him.
Always with a dumb grin on his face, he always carries with him bags of berries and pouches of poultices, bundles of bandages and tons of tinctures. All in all, he fits the image of an old wandering herbalist pretty well - then, one would ask why would he carry a spiked chain whip with him at all time, and where do all those scars come from...
Story Summary:
- used to be a high rank soldier among the mouse king's forces a long time ago
- made friend with the king and a certain former spy spider
- had to lead incursions against the Blight, a moth predicted he'd flee
- was scared and ran away, returned to the mouse king with great dishonor
- was exiled instead of being executed, roamed the woods for years and found a mentee in a blight-affected frog
- was called to the mouse king to mentor his oldest son

Name: Graveyard
Character Sheet Link: [Greetings. If I had a name, it is lost to me, but my favorite poem from a scroll I found on one of my friends is as follows: "Bitter Winter Ground, The Graveyard Empty and Still, Welcoming The Warmth"](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1JJj-cHTJJPxTGfQCFhQ_9tEjDA25Mv0UYPhfBOq5lMg/edit?gid=0#gid=0)
Origin: Teisei, Tian Yin [The Temple of Broken Blades]
Physical Description: Light brown skin, a youthful and hale visage, empty yellow eyes, and wisdom that also forgets how much time has passed.

Name: Grimalkin II
Character Sheet Link: [*"You look like fun! Let's play until Mother comes back."*](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1Bz840uXxcDw91U5jycAKlSN98RSBtuKLaHu6a5z6tRg/edit?gid=0#gid=0)
Physical Description: Grimalkin II is reminescent of a calico cat (albeit much larger), with the apparant mannerisms of housecat. The similarities stop there however, as Grimalkin II now walks on his hind legs for most of his immediate travel, he dawns a colorful cloak as a form of attire, and his tail is split in two at the base. When in his beastial form, Grimalkin II returns to his quadrapedal stride, and his body grows in proportion to that of a true coeurl (9 feet long, 600lbs).
Story Summary:
- A young cat yokai that has lost his mama
- Lived all around the forests of Aldistir
- Became blessed with speech by Kuzunoha one day
- Subsequently whisked away to the Worldhelm while searching for his mother, Grimalkin I

Name: Guo Mùchén
Class List:
Fury 10 ★
Martial Artist 10 ★
Weaponmaster 10 ★
Guardian ★
Orator 9
Origin: Tian Yin, Wujing Guo, Jijing Xiantiao, Bingchuan
Physical Description:
A dark skinned and tall man, bearing clothing of Tian Yin, specifically that of Wujing Guo. Loose and open robes along with more martially inclined clothing. Underneath these robes a more tight black outfit that hugs his body. Lion like ears sprouting from his head and a lion's tail flicking behind him. His eyes bear with them an animalistic look, his expression is usually calm or a tame smile. His body denotes one who relies on strength, having more of a "strong man's" build rather than one aesthetically please. Heavy and dense muscles lining his body from top to bottom. On top of his clothing he wears what looks like hand-made jewelry.

When he is fighting, on occasion scarlet red blood can be seen as he uses his very own blood as a form of cultivation. The energy itself being derived from both Wood & Water Qi, a crimson hue that matches his hair.
Rare Equipment: Path Towards Earthly Brutality - Dual Specialist (Brawling & Swords)
Story Summary:
- Born to a human mother and Cultivator father within Bingchuan Village. Marriage was unhappy, father abusive/prone to anger.
- Mother prayed to the God Li Jing, bearer of the hundred-tiered pagoda and god of protection. Desiring a son who would protect her from her partner and the village as a whole.
- Born a Jinshi with an innate connection to Blood Cultivation, a mixture of Wood & Water Qi.
- Raised into a protector of the village alongside other Jinshi.
- Upon being older, discovered his father was indulging in Corrupt Cultivation through cannibalism in secret.
- Had him thrown out to safeguard the village.
- Recently buried his mother as she succumbed to old age.

Name: Gwendoline of Hearthome
Physical Description: Standing at a titanic 3ft, Gwendoline bears the visage of many mousekin from Firwood. Dressed in armor and gambeson denoting her house, well cared for weapons on her person. The most stunning aspect to her attire is the gem like jewelry she wears.
Story Summary: The daughter of a noble house that lives within Pride Rock, a well known individual for her readiness to aid those in need. Many problems the common folk have that don't reach the attention of those of import found resolution from her. It's surprising she's not home, and even more so she's wearing the mantle of a knight given her father's dislike for such a station for her.

Name: Gwydion
Physical Description: A 6'2" (not including horns) tall faefolk. Broad-shouldered but willowy, shades of dark brown and black fur cover muscle across his lankey body. His fae being is unmistakable, with a goat's head, long ears, tail, horns adorned with small jewelry, and hooves. Orange eyes take in the world, moving constantly, seeing all he can with a smile on his face. Dressed finely and takes pride in his appearance. His movements are relaxed, even lazy at times.
Story Summary:
* Born and raised in the Faerie Realm
* Found a particular fascination with the mortal concept and art of dueling
* Served the Spring Court as courtier and later as an emissary
* Eventually started travelling more in the mortal realm despite the mortals distrust
* Found he enjoyed travelling, enjoyed helping people, and wanted to hone his dueling mastery

Name: Gwydion Tlepsh
Physical Description:
A mountain of a man with vulpine features, Gwydion is a middle-aged dreamite with a jolly smile constantly present on his face like it was painted there. He just really enjoys life is all.
His fantastical animal features present as tails and ears of a white and red fox, which compliment white hair kept in a long braid, and white beard.
Most of the scars on Gwydion's body are from accidents during the process of forging weapons or from the process of testing out such weapons with the knights who would wield them. As for himself, however, he does not use weapons or armor.
Story Summary:
- A blacksmith for Castle Ladon’s knights, so dedicated to the forge he was blessed to always have a part of its fire in him
- Dreamed of crafting marvelous legendary weapons during the mystical sleep created by Regus
- Woke up and realized his legendary crafts were just dreams, but instead of crying over it he became thrilled at the idea of bringing those marvelous dreams to life
- Joined the Goldhearted as where heroes go, legends follow, and he wants to see the stories of new and old friends become grandiose

Name: Gwyneth
Physical Description:
Taller than most. Carrying a larger axe than most. Eats more than most. What isn't clad in armor is her face. She wants to assure others that she isn't a threat.

Smiles often. Laughs even more.
Story Summary:
* Found in a basket, fished out of the ocean by fishers in Traeth Village.
* Grew up taller, stronger, much hungrier than a normal person.
* Took up the axe and armor to be the local guardian of Traeth.
* Inspired by the acts of heroism spreading throughout the realm, leaves to help who she can.

Name: Gyalwa Jigme「རྒྱལ་བ་འཇིགས་མེད་」
Character Sheet Link: [Let’s do it once again, from the beginning.](<https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/14lMl0yBd8qQ8ZYHbQziiEVfbuR1qRPa4ri8eYkCxNjo/edit?gid=0#gid=0>)
Origin: Tian Yin, Leytik, Temple of Strife
Physical Description:
A woman with a tan complexion, orange hair, and golden eyes. Her skin is covered in scriptures that shine in a golden light, enumerating the twenty-five postulates of the Golden Spiral Circulation and Harmonic Spiral Circulation, the sacred texts she has taken onto herself to master and one day teach. Her clothing is a mixture of Terran streetwear and traditional Leytik Empty Monk robes, decorated with accessories from her travels.
This is accompanied by an ever-present smile.
Rare Equipment:
- Protective Padding (combat tunic with Exotic Explorer)
- Snakeskin Vest
- GRANROJO (INS up accessory)
- The First Kanabo (lifesteal)
- Tamashi Dorobo (guard thief)
Story Summary:
- Used to be a problematic student at the Temple of Strife, often coming at odds with teachers and more diligent students.
- Discovered a passion for maths and physics, integrated those in her cultivation while leaning on her Heavenly affinity.
- Left the Temple and got swept up by the Worldhelm, her adventures in Terra bound her to the realm.
- She acted as Terran but had to change her cultivation completely to solve an unexpected issue, purifying herself.
- Now developing an understanding of the Dao of Time as she returns to her roots in Kalahala Mandira.

Name: Hamra Al-Ayn
Physical Description: A short 5'3" woman with a frail, delicate frame with bright red eyes. Unlike the typical crystal formations for heirs, her blue crystal shards are shattered and dig into her skin. Painful blue pulses of magic constantly alert others of her presence. She has a perpetually paranoid if not afraid expression, and her voice is raspy and dry with her words usually stuttered. Her steps jingle with a belt of nails, smith's tools, and wooden talismans, carrying an aroma of sandalwood and brown sugar.
Story Summary:
- Grew up in Ormen, Grestazs with Azra, talented in making devices to help the community increase QOL
- Enslaved at age 11 when Wulfroh mercenaries attack Ormen 
- Sold to Gravslenge, Karsbren to work in the forges and make weapons until she was 17
- Frees the enslavement runes on a newly hatched dragon and herself that imprinted on her instead of the Jarl
- Escapes thanks to riding atop the dragon, now named Aehzaaj (Zaj), as well as Frigg and Freyr
- Survives the north, tries to get to Mastrazs to join the Knights of Wyvernia, gets captured at the Wulfroh border 
- Joins the caravan for safety, choosing death over slavery

Name: Haoran
Origin: Tian Yin - Wujing Guo, Secret Fern Village
Physical Description: With a body mostly covered in shimmering scales the color of sapphires, he possesses luxurious white hair which winds down his back and along the thin tail behind him. Additional lengthy tufts at his elbows and knees lend a gentle countenance to him, reflected with his equine-esque face, plated ridges along the bridge of his nose leading to a single antler-horn arcing gracefully from the middle of his forehead.
Story Summary: Haoran used to be a dancer in his village, but was chosen as a sacrifice to the Beast King. He fled and ended up on the Worldhelm.

Name: Haruka Satsuki
Physical Description: Satsuki stands at a staggering 5’6” tall. He has hair that is brownish at the top and blonde at the tips. He dresses in a very ornate white and gold with filigree of the sky on the collar and sleeves.
Quirks:
Hierloom 

Vestments of the Sun Goddess (Combat Tunic)
When you cause one or more allies to recover Hit Points during a conflict, each of those allies gains Resistance to the next instance of physical damage they suffer before the start of your next turn. This benefit is not cumulative. 

Narrative complication Keep the dead goddess dead: Enemies of Amaterasu (Caladrius) Are drawn to you to destroy the vestments
Story Summary:
Haruka Satsuki was born in Sakai and at a very young age was blessed by a Yatagarasu. 

The shrine maidens seeing this knew it was a sign from Amatarasu that Satsuki was blessed by her.
Satsuki would spend most of his days with the shrine maiden learning their practices.
Honomi Moku, one of the Shrine Maidens and an older sister figure, taught Satsuki the basics of qi cultivation. He discovered that the qi affinities he had that mirrored what is understood about Amaturasu.


They would often sneak off to either train with some of the warriors, help out around Sakai or pull light hearted pranks to bring joy to Sakai.


As an adult he was assigned to go out with the samurai of the village as their assigned Shrine Maiden to fight Yokai Primarily fighting Tengu.

One stormy night in Sakai He gets caught up in a realmstorm getting sent to the worldhelm

Name: Hazel von Nausicaa
Class List:
Sharpshooter ★
Dancer ★
Tinkerer 4
Martial Artist 4
Rogue 3
Physical Description: A tall woman in her thirties with long, green-black hair. She tends to dress in stylish if somewhat avant-garde clothing, preferring presentation to practicality. She carries a magitek bow on her back.
Story Summary:
- The ~~eldest~~ youngest daughter of a renowned Merrani scientist and decorated military woman. 
- Graduated from Korala Academy, began working in a lab for Merrane.
- Arrested in place of her sister with appearance changing magic for the misuse of a chemical weapon resulting in civilian casualties
- Recently escaped imprisonment in Heaven's Gate

Name: Heinrich
Physical Description:
183 cm tall, average build

Usually seen in silver armor with blue accents covering his whole body, especially the helmet. Even without it he usually wears clothes with long sleeves and high collars.

His body is covered with ugly scars that glow and buzz with elemental energies, which is why he prefers to keep himself hidden beneath armor. His hair is green, short and unkept, his pale skin has strange green tinge to it that makes him appear sickly, his face seems to have settled into a permanent frown, and his nose looks like it got broken and healed improperly. His eyes too glow with elemental energies, changing colors with his surroundings, and his Heterochromia is the only part of his looks that he actually likes.
Story Summary:
- Believed in Merrane propaganda, wanted to join the army
- Got dragged into human experimentation
- Survived, gained Elemental powers
- Was to be tested on the battlefield, saw the reality of the war, deserted, managed to escape
- Became Goldhearted while planning to fight against the Empire

Name: Helios, the First
Character Sheet Link: ["Come, Phaethon. Let us show them our might."](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1B2bxA99PcXU-ypQWqVdBfZpTVLjrYL7bVUtFGKq_CqE/edit?gid=0#gid=0)
Class List:
Weaponmaster ★
Stormheart ★
Guardian ★
Arcanist ★
Wayfarer 5
Empath 4
Elementalist 1
Physical Description: Helios has been described as a stoic, but gentle person with a fierce aura of determination and purpose. He stands relatively taller than most of his kin at 6 feet, 6 inches tall (198cm), and sports a short cut to his shock white hair. His eyes are a piercing gold compared to his complexion and armor. He also has a notable scar across his left cheek and lips.
Rare Equipment:
Yubel's Light (Vitality Up)
Dawn Piercer (World Saver)
Daybreak Dragoon Armor (Otherworldly Veil)
Story Summary:
- His people are warriors that revere the Dragonlords; especially Sumi'shna
- Studied the ancient art of the Dragoons and fought in the Colosseum of the Ancient Dunes
- Has known only peace and prosperity, but fights to liberate the enslaved of Nezmira
- Stays aboard the Worldhelm so that he may better serve the realms, and so that he may gather the strength he needs to effect a change in Nezmira
- Soulbonded with the last vestige of love from Dragonlord Sumi'shna: the white and gold wyvern, Phaethon

Name: Henrik Nagy
Physical Description:
A man standing at 6'4 with dark black hair hanging down the sides of his face that occasionally catch on his beard. A set of sterling green eyes, the man himself very clearly is tribalistic in his style of furs, bone, and leather clothing. Tan skin that's been worn like leather, a number of scars and wounds all over his body. Burly and muscular with hair all over him even outside of his shifted form. Along his body now are red thorn like marks infused with his blood. A binding vow of his cooperation with another individual.

When shifted, he grows in about half his size, hulking out of his body into that of a werewolf. Grayish fur with blue eyes that almost shines like moonlight. His Sündisznó heritage only further showcased in this form as he towers as a powerhouse.
Story Summary: A young man born into the world of Humans as a werewolf, his life uprooted. He now carries the honor and expectations of one within the Sündisznó Tribe where weakness isn't tolerated. Now forced to work alongside a painful reminder of his past to find and kill one who dares threaten both werewolf and vampire kind.

Name: Heron Caladrius
Physical Description:
A young man with darker skin and crimson eyes. He has an impossible to ignore irritance about him, eyes cold and hostile. He walks with perfect posture, and every move he makes is disciplined and deliberate. 

He doesn't fidget or pace. He's focused and practiced.
Story Summary:
A child sworn to protect the only child of High Priestess Caladrius, Gabriela. He's served her loyally, but beyond that, much of his history and origin are a mystery to the people of Proudrock. He was born in secret, and raised in seclusion. He wasn't on the peoples radar until he was around 12, at which, he was always seen with Gabriela.

Since then, rumor has spread that he was the estranged child of the High Priestess, while some say he's an orphan raised in secret. Others in the know have let slip the truth, that Heron is the child of the High Priestess' first daughter, who went missing about a decade ago.

Name: Heywire
Class List:
Lvl 10  Elementalist 
Lvl 10 Pilot
Lvl 2 Guardian
Lvl 6 Esper
Lvl 2 Loremaster
Physical Description:
Physical Description
Heywire is short in stature of 166cm/5'4" ft. Her hair is about shoulder length with asymmetrical bangs, white in color with orange streaks. Her pupils are orange with four sided star irises.
Rare Equipment:
GN Bazooka MKII Xi  (1550z)
Spell Vamp

GN Condenser Gauntlets (500z)
Memorize - Flare

GN E-Carbon Plating
Vitality Up
Story Summary:
- A daughter of Marie Annette, a CEO of a minor subsidiary, Annette Line, under Qilink.  has been raised as a stand in for the late Marianne (the namesake) who died prior. Marianne and Annette would reconcile later 

- Years later, Maribeth goes missing after leaving for a business trip, or so everyone thought. Aside from searching for the whereabouts of Maribeth, Marianne would impersonate her own sister in looks and demeanor for political and personal reasons to keep her mother's company's reputation afloat. 

- She had been finding leads to Maribeth until it all pointed to Termina City. -||now found, infested in Coral and under AGES quarantine||,

- In the middle of a field test, Marianne gets caught in a realmstorm along with a prototype exosuit Anette Line had Developed.

- She eventually joins AGES to assure its goal of a better Terra is realized

Name: Hira Mae
Physical Description: Hira's usually in his knight's uniform, lightly armored and wielding his staff. His fighting style is similar to that of a lance user. They're about 5'7, and often seem rather distracted in demeanor, quick to apologize for it with a cheery smile.
Story Summary: A knight of Brightshield with a chaotic ability of unknown origin, that lets them see visions of the future. He wants to use his power to help others, and is currently looking for a lost friend, another knight named Heath, working with another adventurer named Aile to do so.

Name: Hiya Dai Salamin
Physical Description:
Hiya Salamin is a woman with much warmth that stands at 5'6. She holds a steady and kind air of hospitality. Her Hair cascades in three braids down her shoulders and her back. She wears robes fit for a princess, and is never not seen with her tiara. A symbol of status and pride of her parent.

She wields a lantern embedded into a spear, it's welcoming glow also the source of her spritely Apoy, fiery creatures that assist her and represent her adventurous spirit.
Story Summary:
- Coming from a long line of Glass Cultivators centered around the volcanic peaks of Pagapalay Village. Hiya despite being born a male in a matriarchal society was born into a hopeful position.

- As she practiced her lineage’s cultivation, she struggled to cope with her feelings of self-doubt to the dismay of those who practiced before her. Eventually, she learned to channel her cultivation into a glittery avatar of glass resembling one of the auspicious beasts.

- For a while, she was satisfied with that progress. It wasn't until her little insulated world was nearly shattered by a catastrophic event stopped by the gold-hearted that she finally dared to step away from her mundane existence to investigate the volcano.

- Fortune would have it that one decision would lead to her being taken into a realmstorm, displaced from her home, and joining the World-Helm.

- She was adopted by Dai Shuye, as well as defeated her mother in honorable combat, marking her as the Matriarch of Pagapalay

Name: Holt McLeod
Physical Description:
An offensive chanter, 32, with blue-haired wolf-like augments, a flying-V steel guitar, and a signature pair of pointed sunglasses. Standing 6’5” with a muscular frame, Holt typically wears a black leather vest and distressed jeans. A torrent of sonic energy fueled by his vocals swirls and reverberates around him during a fight.

His silver-chained wallet contains [a picture of his murdered bandmates from Stray Hounds](https://i.imgur.com/xF0SuVj.jpeg) to remind him of what he's fighting for.
Quirks: Fugitive Experiment (Being chased by T&C, 100G, and "multiple parties")
Rare Equipment:
Sharp Sunglasses [Composure]
Spiked Leather Vest [Retribution]
Punk Shock [Specialist - Arcane)
Story Summary:
(Update: 12/6/2025)

- Holt is being pursued by 100Gs and Tubal & Cain supposedly due to him having ingested an experimental serum unknowingly
- Three years ago, he was the lead guitarist of a metal band named Stray Hounds that became popular after releasing the "PRIME Suspects" album that called out every Prime Company in Terra
- The frontman convinced the band to get canine augments as a stunt, but he got them from a black market vendor who had bought stolen goods
- A fixer tracked the augments to Stray Hounds and killed everyone but Holt after his quirk triggered (Fugitive Experiment)
- On the run, he did gigs at underground punk rock clubs while using his powers to protect North Rock from corpos and gangs
- Holt now lives on the Worldhelm for safety but he goes back down to the streets when a hero is needed (or to get animal fries)

Name: Honeycomb Goldthread
Physical Description: Honeycomb is quite a bit shorter than the average person, standing at a total of 5 feet and 2 inches. He has long strands of black hair with a white streak that curls a little at the tips, and that he usually ties some up into a short ponytail. Having been made in the image of a real person, his skin is a porcelain tone… ironically. He also has several cracks on certain parts of his body, showing his age; the more visible ones are one under his right eye and one on his arm, but he has filled them in with little bits of gold when he repaired himself.
Story Summary:
• Honeycomb existed long before he was brought to life; originally a doll created in the image of a lord’s son and abandoned due to said lord’s displeasure, and passed from hand to hand before ending up in the faerie realm, where his creator- or the one he considers his creator- found him.
• His creator was a courtless fey, not attached to a specific domain or area, giving them both the freedom to travel in and out of the faerie realm. It is this freedom that eventually separated the two, as Honeycomb was sucked in by a realmstorm during one of his trips outside of the faerie realm, and he has yet to return home after that.
• How exactly Honeycomb was animated and can stay animated on his own is unknown even to him, but they can explicitly recall a few details that his creator told him about: There was a specific spell that his creator cast on him when he was an inanimate doll, part of that spell involved weaving ‘life threads’ into him, and his creator stuttered during the casting.

Name: Howi "Atlas"
Class List:
Weapon Master Lv. 1
Guardian Lv. 1
Fury Lv. 3
Physical Description: Standing at 10'5 wearing what most would consider rags or basic leather armor eitched with runes and markers. Brown fur with spots of reds mostly around the head with a small puff of jet black hair at the top.

Name: Hua Ying
Physical Description:
Hua Ying stands at a respectable 5'5" (horns and okobo included), paired with her slender and androgynous build people foolishly assume her to be younger than she actually is, much to her ire. For the sake of her pride she goes to great lengths to combat these assumptions, painstakingly curating every aspect of her appearance and the way she is perceived by others, making a point to always carry herself in a dignified and sophisticated manner.

In these efforts she takes special care of her hair horns and tail, despite the latter's constant betrayal of her emotions at inopportune situations.
Story Summary:
✦She was born and partly raised in Bingchuan by her adoptive father who taught her the art of cultivation. 

✦With each passing year her father grew more desperate to reach the peak of cultivation that his ancestors once did, causing them to isolate themselves from the village as their training became ever harsher.

✦One fateful day on a pilgrimage to Xiaohai she was suddenly attacked by her father, beaten within an inch of her life and left for dead.

✦Though she managed to survive she became a husk of her former self, now consumed with a burning doubt. She strives to learn the reason behind her father's change and will do so at any cost.

Name: Huong Jin
Character Sheet Link: ["Measure once, strike twice. Repeat until the job's done."](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1SxRirYw8H_lHRjdrSS-pgfrcgbxayAnfy6SJ0AtnyGg/edit?usp=sharing)
Physical Description:
Standing at 5'10" and weighing 145 lbs, Huong Jin boasts a slender but defined figure with feminine features, which they proudly boast through the crimson flak jacket, simple brown pants with a belt that stores their infusion ampules, and some leather boots made for kicking. They sport medium-length black hair, ruby red eyes and pointy ears.

A couple of braces contain Malice and Mayhem - the twin gauntlets that act as their self-forged weapon of choice, which are fed by the various ampules they carry on their belt.
Quirks:
Goldhearted Fairy
(Overwhelming Presence: Iron Key, High Volume, Haunting Tone)
Rare Equipment:
Comfy Flak Jacket - Accuracy Up
PROTOTYPE: Malice & Mayhem - Magitech Armament (Melee, Brawling)
~~Riot Gauntlet (x2) - Blunted~~
~~Warding Breeze Earclip - Dual Res (Wind, Poison)~~
Flux Capacitors - Cartridge Boost Plus
Story Summary:
- Lived in Hedgeburg doing odd jobs during their college years
- Had a rough childhood due to poor parenting, may as well be adopted
- Learned alchemy and chemistry during school and nurse side hustle, took on engineering based on their missing father's notes (or they think it's him)
- Despite all, worked in the lab built in the shed till it blew up and the Realmstorm sucked them in
- Co-founded The Future's Anvil, built their own warehouse called JR&D
- Ended up in a relationship with Gianna Tomaris
- Joined the Goldhearted Court as a fully-fledged fae

Name: Huxley Rubarb
Physical Description: A Leirsin with dark hair and a red poncho like robe over very common clothes. His nails are sharp but not long, and though he is shorter he stands very tall and with a smile.
Rare Equipment: n/a
Story Summary: - Huxley has come to the Ship to find a way to save his commune in Erdelward from disaster.

Name: Hydrangea
Physical Description: Normally seen in wooden armor, Hydrangea is a 5'8" collection of plants in the shape of an average human woman. Most of her leaves are a bright green in colour that get lighter in the face, with a large flower on her head that changes based on which magiseed she is using. She has short "hair" black eyes and a mouth with noticeable fangs. She is normally seen with a hopeful smile across her face.

Name: Héng Xià Xīn
Origin: Xuanwu city, Wujing Guo, Tian Yin
Physical Description: A tall man of well physique, he is fully clad in armor and metal fused with his skin. it is all generally several sheets of metal blended into one
Quirks: Qi specialist: Metal cultivator w/ fire weakness
Story Summary:
Naturally gifted metal cultivator
Trained to protect those weaker then him
Younger sister got kidnapped by corrupt cultivators
Forced to work for them in the blood mines using his cultivation to make him an asset
Found out that his sister was already dead
Raided the cultivators who stole his emotions
Feels more comfortable with metal then skin
“Metal is strong, flesh is week”
Now protects those as a metal husk of a man believing metal cold emotionless is superior to feeling and emotion

Name: Iara Amrade
Physical Description: Tall, Silver-eyed lady with blue eyes. Often gazing at the horizon when lost in thought.

Name: Icarus Vittore
Physical Description: Icarus is a very slender, young man with a permanent grimace towards the world. He moves with a graceful precision, and his fierce golden eyes convey a sense that he is always intently focusing on something about to happen. He has light skin, and even lighter, platinum blonde hair. When fully clothed in his traditional Terran streetwear, one would not be remiss to assume him to be a perfectly normal human being. However, when exposed, one can see transluscent feathers erupting from the skin on his forearms and calves. These are a mark of his experimentation, and he hides them at all costs, ashamed that they remind him of failure.
Story Summary:
- A "failed" experiment, created by a scientific collaboration between NTTech and DHK Heavy Industries.
- Left to die in NTTech Territories, but managed to survive despite the odds.
- Part human, part avian DNA with apparent Esper abilities.
- Worked as an assassin-for-hire as part of the Vignettes.
- Discovered his own humanity when deciding to decline a hit on children.
- Hunted down by the Vignettes, but suddenly appeared on the Worldhelm.
- Dreams of one day opening up an orphanage.

Name: Ineza Brightscale
Physical Description: At a mere 4’7”, the oversized merchant backpack Ineza carries around with her only serves to help make her look even smaller. Sporting bright red scales and the piercing eyes of a saleswoman always ready to make a deal, her practiced grin is about equally likely to bring comfort as it is mild suspicion.
Rare Equipment: Mom’s Old Pack (Heirloom)

Name: Iori Hirose
Class List:
Weaponmaster Lvl 2
Arcanist Lvl 2
Entropist Lvl 1
Physical Description: She stands at 5'8, carrying herself with unwavering pride, her stance firm and assured. Once a deep, natural black, her hair now bears a striking blonde hue. A permanent mark of her ordeal. She wears a modified yukata, tailored for combat, blending elegance with practicality.
Quirks:
Flight
You are able to fly. In addition to the obvious advantage in mobility, your melee attacks can target flying creatures and you cannot be targeted by melee attacks unless the attacker is flying or is somehow able to reach flying targets.

While in Crisis or unable to fly freely (such as when you’re inside a vehicle designed for human-sized creatures or in a narrow corridor), you lose all benefits granted by this Quirk. 

Additionally, when you suffer air, bolt or ice damage during a conflict scene, you lose the benefits of this Quirk until the start of your next turn. [Flavored as lightning stepping, teleporting with lightning, moving through metal as lightning, etc.]
Story Summary:
Born into the Hirose Clan, Iori was destined for a life of silk and servitude, but her father defied tradition, to forge her into a warrior. In Sakai, even daughters bore steel, and she was no fragile flower. She was a rose with thorns, both beautiful and deadly. When the Oni came, the capital fell, the emperor was slain, and the samurai, refusing to kneel, waged one final battle. Beneath a rain-darkened sky, they were defeated. Ready to die, Iori was instead forced to flee by her father, carrying the shame of survival.

Beneath the raging storm, she cursed the gods, demanding a reason for her survival. And one answered. Lightning struck, searing through her, leaving power thrumming in her veins. When she awoke, she was changed. Now she has vowed her blade to the Shogun. Never again would she bow to an emperor. Her sword would be sworn only to a cause worth dying for.

Name: Iris Blue, The Bleeding Heart
Physical Description: Iris is a 6:3 thin rail of a woman with the look of failure that can be easily spotted under the bags under her eyes. She has long black curly hair that looks unkempt and is over one of her eyes. she is wearing black leathers with a hunters skirt over her legs and riding boots, both with old insignia scratched out. around her wrists and her neck is a large thorned vine that moves on its own. the ones around the wrists curl up to the elbows and the ones around her neck dangle down like a danger scarf with a blue bleeding heart flower that hangs lie a tie in front of her
Story Summary:
Parents made a trade and cost Iris her freedom
had to work for a hivemind fae group to capture other people
was forced to be a slaver for a while and hated it
became a Kor'Tarian folk tale
Gold hearted did a hostage rescue and broke out a bunch of people
Iris used this confusion to break free and sneak onto a realmsplitter
it did not spit her out because she is a gold hearted and couldnt be teleported because of fae stuff

Name: Irius Barnes
Physical Description: Irius stands as a 5'8" male, brown hair and green eyes ready to see their job through, even if trouble gets in the way. A body fit for a physically inclined farmer and generally fair complexion despite his profession. He almost never leaves home without his weathered straw hat and industrial grade hoe he carries from his time in Terra, he typically wears lighter colors; most commonly his sand-colored overshirt, paired with typically a sky blue t-shirt or whatever color he decides to wear that day.
Rare Equipment: Kraken Medallion (Immune to Dazed)
Story Summary:
* Born and raised as a hands-on farmer yearning to expand opportunities; shortly finding them through a Temporary Limited Enforcement License, or otherwise known as a TEMP License.

* Went overseas to distant Sparrow occupied land to help with farming and any work requiring a TEMP License.

* Found his first time of TEMP License combat and his first kill during a bulk crop produce shipment on the road, leaving a deep impression of the state of Terra as a whole and what others try to do to survive.

* Irius barely manages to escape such aforementioned events after the delivery ended in a colossal failure. He will likely have a debt to pay because of it. On the plus side, his escape was possible from the local gang members after taking a last second turn around a corner and ending up in the Worldhelm.

* After such an escape; he had realized such problems had lengthy roots, so he sought to be able to one day uproot those problems with the precision of a farmer.

Name: Irobe Akinaga (色部 燦長)
Physical Description: Akinaga is a young girl with a tomboy-ish style. She stands at 5'5" and has an athletic build. She's usually found in a light suit of armor bearing the mon of the Koga Clan and Irobe Clans, and with an especially large bow. She is accompanied by her horse Fujiwara, a grey thoroughbred, and Nagazane, a strange, floating paper lantern.
Story Summary:
Akinaga and her twin Nagazane were born to the Irobe Clan. The Irobe produce an unusual number of twins and those twins have a mystical connection, being able to feel each other's pain, know what roughly the other is thinking, and other such things. 

A decade ago, during a conflict between the Koga and the Kujo, the Irobe sided with the Koga. For that, the Kujo invaded their island home of Irobejima and burnt down the clan's manor. Akinaga and Nagazane were separated, and only Akinaga survived the night.

Akinaga was taken in by the Koga and trained to be a warrior. Before she left to prove herself and restore her clan's honor she visited the ruins of Irobe Manor, and found there her sister's lingering spirit: an ember that would burn so long as Akinaga lived. Now reunited, the twins journey together.

Name: Isagani
Physical Description:
A muscular woman standing at 6' even. She has multiple piercings, tattoos, and scars, and its often indistinct which is which.

She wears simple clothing, usually favoring styles that fit lightly or that leave her arms bare. She moves with an easygoing confidence, though it is harder to read her expressions on account of her yellow, catlike eyes.
Quirks: Hunted Emissary - Boon of Self Perfection
Story Summary:
-Born in Tangbawan to the sister of a Matriarch, making her the Matriarch's niece.

-As a child, she was older and more skilled at cultivation than her cousin, the Matriarch's daughter. So, the Matriarch wants her out of the picture in order to secure succession.

-At 12, she is taken from her family and given to the Kabiya. She's old enough to understand why this is happening and is bitter about it.

-Lives among the Kabiya, learning how to survive the dangerous wilderness. Focuses on cultivation and self-reliance rather than trusting people.

Name: Iseult Medicus
Physical Description: 5'9" | 140 lbs. | Silver-y Blue Eyes

Name: Ishaan & Ignacio Vol Sieve
Class List: Wayfarer (★) / Commander (★)  / Weaponmaster (★) / Rogue (6) / Floralist (3) / Chimerist (1)
Physical Description:
Ishaan is a tan-skinned man with red hair tied in a ponytail, standing at 177cm (5'10"). He has a bit of fuzz of a goatee. He's adorn in a blue long coat with a sash around his waist, and beige pants with traveling boots.

Ignacio stands at 390cm (13') as a griffin of the twilight. His upper body is similar to an eagle with black, shimmering feathers while the hindside is that of a lion. Despite the black feathers, there is a hint of radiance from the griffin.
Rare Equipment:

Shining Force (World Savior; transforming custom wpn)

Beberoka Vest (IM: Poisoned)

Hand Telescope - Bypass Danger TR w/ Aerial Mount
Aina's Love (Wanderer's Luck)
Heartforge Pendant (Attribute Up - WLP)
Homebound Snowglobe (IMM - Origin Realm's  Environment Damage)
Story Summary:
- Earliest memory is surviving in the slums as a child.
- Rescued a poached griffin while stowing away in a merchant caravan.
- Raised by the Witch of the Jarwood alongside the griffin, Ignacio.
- Reintegrated into Tradefair under the Helping Hands guild, gaining renown as fearless couriers tackling extreme conditions.
- Earned heroic recognition for aiding Hafod (Midday Sun) and Doana Village (development & Night of the Red Sky defense).
- Knighted in Brightshield on ‘Knight’s Day’ during King Marcello’s coronation.
- Marked by battle scars from Sakura the Skald, slew the Sinner, and embraced the Vol Sieve family.
- During a battle for the fate of Kor'Tarion, as Ishaan rose back from defeat, Ignacio evolved into a more divine form
- Led the ousting of a ruler of fledgeling city-state, Concordia, and taking care of those that remained in the city

Name: Ishida, Yariko
Physical Description:
A tall, but not towering, woman, Yariko always seems to have some sort of grin on her face. She prefers simple clothing, a blue kimono tied with a plain white obi is more than enough. 

Despite her being from Teisei, Yariko is often smiling and even laughing. She brings a joy to combat that permeates in everything she else She does as well.
Quirks:
Heirloom: Arashi

A powerful naginata made of Metal Qi. Has a tendency to drain the user, especially in protracted combat. In worst cases, it could be lethal.
Story Summary:
* Born in Amagi to parents who served as Ashigaru to the former Emperor.
* Initially showed little talent for Cultivation, but showed herself to be rather physically powerful.
* When the Oni took over Amagi, she was one of many who found herself in their captivity. Father was killed trying to help people escape.
* While doing work in the fields around Amagi, she happened upon a cave, where she found a naginata called Arashi.
* She took the spear, and in that moment felt a massive influx of Qi hit her body.
* Her mother warned her to keep the naginata in the cave. At night they would sneak to the cave so mother could teach her the basics of Cultivation.
* Was freed by Dai Shuye, Gin, and others during the battle of Amagi. Became inspired by Dai Shuye's example.
* Started training harder to be ready to help the Emperor. Recently was yoinked into a realmstorm.

Name: Ishikawa Shishirō 「石川 獅子郎」
Character Sheet Link:
[Golden banners rise
Lion guards the flowing road
Steel waits without fear.](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/15Y6-zvcSz5lLatsWmOLSfb3l_KIiGBSTZI0kDsHEXTQ/edit?usp=sharing)
Physical Description: Ishikawa Shishirō is a tall, broad shouldered samurai with a hardened, practical appearance. His dark hair is worn long and tied back loosely, and a short, rugged beard frames his face. His one good eye is sharp and observant, while his left is covered by an iron eyepatch engraved with the lion crest of the Konoe Clan. He typically wears black and gold lamellar armor with a fur lined mantle, and carries himself with the steady posture of a veteran warrior of his station. A fluffy white and black cat named Koma is often seen nearby, usually looking far less impressed than its master.
Story Summary:
• Former merchant’s son raised along Nishibi’s river trade routes
• Survived a ronin attack that destroyed his family caravan
• Taken in by the Konoe Clan after refusing to surrender despite his wounds
• Endured years of training and scorn before earning samurai status
• Lost his left eye defending a Konoe battle banner
• Granted the name Shishirō (“Lion Son”) by his Daimyo
• Bound to the war-kami Hachiman
• Travels with a grumpy shrine cat named Koma

Name: Isobel Ashwynd
Physical Description: Tall, and with a body that shows clear signs of a physical life, one spent fighting. Those that knew her before would notice her slightly more angular features, and how her naturally tanned skin has grown ashy and pale from extended lack of sunlight.
Story Summary: Isobel, a wolf of the Ashwynd family, the heir to the legacy, or at least she was. But now she's been claimed by the Worldhelm, and has returned - changed. Can she find a cure or a way to channel these abilities to be worthy of going home? Will she find a new family in the mean time?

Name: Isolde
Origin:
Deadstone Gulch // 
Hermandad de las Estrallas
Physical Description:
Isolde looks almost hauntingly ethereal, everything on her swirls into glacial shades of purple or blue. 
She is short with a full-figured body and ghostly, pale skin that almost sparkles. Her white hair cascades down her back like snow caps upon a mountain. Icy horns curl up from the top of her head, and she stands on similarly-hued cloven hooves. A thickly furred, long tail trails down from the base of her back. Her eyes are a brilliant icy blue.
She is visually based off of the white bison, and has leucism.
Story Summary:
A child destined to be stillborn, Isolde's mother made a pact with a devil and fled Aztlan to escape execution.
Isolde was born alive but demonically marked. After years drifting, they settled in a frontier town willing to tolerate the cursed child.
As Isolde grew, strange powers awakened. When she tried to stop a fight involving her mother, she accidentally froze several townsfolk to death.
Exiled, they took a risk and sought refuge with Antikythera’s coven. Fortunately, the enigmatic witch chose to harbor Isolde and teach her to control her power.
Eleven years later, outlaws seeking a pardon attacked the coven. Isolde fought to defend the witches, but was gravely wounded.
A devil-touched gunslinger, Axel Reed, arrived to claim the bounty, but turned on the hunters to protect them at the last moment.
Both dying after the battle, Isolde entwined her soul with Axel’s to save their lives.
Now bound together, the two wander Deadstone until encountering a Realmstorm.

Name: Isolde Forvelkanta
Class List:
Spiritist [★] 
Enropist [★]
Orator [★]
Arcanist [★]
Floralist [5]
Loremaster [4]
Physical Description: A young woman often seen with a warm smile and a relaxed posture. She has short, wavy platinum hair that has been seemingly dyed mint-green at the ends and bright green eyes. Her usual outfits consist of either her Warden uniform or simple and comfortable attire.
Story Summary:
A student of Gnosis Academy whose existence was once prone to fragmentation, leaving her forgotten by many despite her quiet acts of care. Over the past year, she has taken deliberate steps to stabilize her existence, successfully halting the fragmentation she once caused in others.

She aided in addressing the vampire threat in Kor’tarion and has spent extended time in Teisei, becoming familiar with its culture and earning the trust of its emperor. She is also a resident practitioner at the Serene Heart Medical Center, where she continues her work as a healer and as its secretary.

She actively supports her class’s efforts to save Kaiway and works closely with the Goldhearted, offering help wherever needed, whether through research, healing, logistics, or emotional support.

Name: Izanami Shoshio
Physical Description: A woman with long, red hair and an athletic build, she is dressed in the traditional warrior garments of her homeland. Her hazel eyes hold a sharp, determined gaze, and she wears sturdy battle gloves.
Quirks:
Heirloom <Soul Maw> 

Complication: "Soul Hunger" – Anyone slain by Soul Maw has their soul consumed by the blade’s insatiable hunger. This creates a compulsion for Izanami to kill any champion or villain she faces. However, death brings no peace. Every night at the witching hour, the voices of the devoured rise from the sword, haunting Izanami as they become one with Soul Maw’s unending thirst for souls.
Rare Equipment: Hierloom: Soul Maw

Name: Izumi Shiori
Class List:
Weaponmaster ★
Arcanist ★
Daoist ★
Loremaster ★
Martial Artist ★
Physical Description:
Shiori isn't outwardly a terribly intimidating presence. She is calm and quiet, often seen smiling when not in the middle of a battle. She wears a simple blue kimono and hakama, and carries a rather nondescript katana at her left hip. She'd almost be easy to miss if not for the striking white hair and icey blue eyes that make even her smile just a little disconcerting. Still, she seems harmless enough, and her light, cheerful voice always speaks words of encouragement and cheer.

Shiori stands with a confident posture. If there is one thing that she is sure of... it is that she is one of the best Swordsmen of any land she stands on.
Quirks: Cognitive Spectre (Living Dao - Resistance Dark and Poison, Vuln Fire)
Rare Equipment:
Senbonzakura (Katana w/ Multi)
Katon's Katana (Katana w/ Undodgeable)
Yami to Hikari (Katana w/ Inexorable Strike)
The Dao (Sword w/ Intent Quality)

Intent: When you target only your Cognitive Focus with an attack with this weapon, it loses its damage type, and the Accuracy check is made with a boon.
Story Summary:
* Was found in Hanae at roughly 4 years old with no memory of parents.
* Original guardians were disappeared. She became a vagrant.
* Was kicked out of Hanae during a food shortage :(
* Was found in the forests by Musashi!
* Trained by Musashi
* Returned to Hanae 4 years later
* Had helped keep the village safe in exchange for shelter
* Yoinked by the Worldhelm while scouting the forests.

Name: Jacomo "Jack" Seidita
Character Sheet Link: [*"Now you see me... Now you- Ah! Wait! Give me a second!!"*](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1uMF3FRT49KmBlmrQVlh_QdBJJlg_6Hd_qabZh2QQXdc/edit?gid=0#gid=0)
