His hair is a raven shade of black, and his eyes are a dull crimson hue. He dresses in dark robes, which conceal the many surprises he has up his sleeve.
Story Summary:
- Hidela Academy drop out, and overall hooligan.
- Penchant for flirting and pranks
- Attempted a very high level ritual which failed
- Ripped from space and time; saved by Antikythera
- Currently fading from existence

Name: Jaith Stolz
Character Sheet Link: [Take my hand. Let's bring it all down.](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1RyLeeCox9ShUMzunA21a7q55b9X9xZw3fGNJfAwEGc8/edit?usp=sharing)
Class List: Ace of Cards 10, Weaponmaster 2, Fury 10, Tinkerer 6, Malefactor 1
Physical Description: A rugged dark-haired man in his mid-twenties, his well-built frame betrays his military background. Jaith's eyes are a mellow blue, yet seem to sheen and ripple unnaturally due to the influence of the Anarchy Stone. Often wears loose-fitting attire suitable for fighting and wearing multiple bandoliers and belts with various tools and resources needed for travelling light. Jaith always carries a Wulforh-make broadsword and a violet locket on his journeys, never letting either from his side.
Quirks: Cursed - Under the covetous influence of Fey Duke of Autumn, Caeveac
Story Summary:
- A soldier of Markensburg for six years, often working as a guard for Council activities, witnessing firsthand its many injustices and corruption.
- His sweetheart Clara and her family moved to Wimcomb in Silverdale, yet Jaith could not follow due to his service.
- Jaith upended his life, selling all he owned to afford a dowry for her hand in marriage. Months later he was finally able to quit, free to travel to propose to Clara.
- Upon arriving, the governor Nefius Kaur's townguards extorted Jaith, seizing his entire dowry. In a fit of rage he lashed out and killed a number before fleeing on foot.
- Saved by the guard captain of a nearby caravan en route to Stalmer, who sympathised with Jaith and the citizens' plight under Kaur.
- He learned that the Crownless would be returning through Stalmer soon, and was advised to join their cause. Jaith met with them and gained approval, being taken to the Dissenter's Tower and soon becoming a Crownless under the Anarchy Beacon's blessing.

Name: Jane Martin
Physical Description: 6'3", 220 lbs., Lean physique supported by cybernetic enhancements to improve strength, long, wavy black hair, red eyes.
Story Summary:
. Orphaned in North Rock
. Grew up to join a street gang as an Enforcer
. Gang all wanted better lives for themselves
. Interest and proficiency in cybernetics
. Went into debt with ETA to fund her cybernetics
. Died during gang war with Goldnails, became Insolvent
. Assigned as Military TEMP in paramilitary squads for ETA
. Was forced to act against her own community in ETA's interests
. Figured it was better to dismantle systems rather than try to play in them
. Wants to end the Insolvency system and ETA's grip on current Insolvents
. Caught in Realmstorm trying to intervene during one of her former squad's raid

Name: Jing Táoshǒu 静 桃手
Physical Description: Jing is a short, pale man with dark hair, a slender frame bordering on feminine, and a constant, calm expression on his face. He clothes himself with simple traveler's garb, common amongst the people of Xiexie village, and carries with him a large variety of other recreational tools. A fishing pole, a walking stick, a peach basket, a flute, a gardening trowel, and many other strange accessories are stored within the basket that serves as his traveling pack.
Story Summary:
- Jing's original village was destroyed by a terrible and sudden flood when he was an infant. The only reason he survived was due to being rescued from the waters by a spirit beast; A great Cicada.

- The Cicada raised him until he could reasonably fend for himself, including teaching him Qi absorption techniques, starting him on the path of his Wood Qi cultivation. 

- After being left in the nearby Xiexie village, Jing continued his cultivation, as well as a myriad of other, more mundane hobbies. Eventually, through defending the village and aiding travelers, Jing became a Goldhearted, and wandered onto the Worldhelm.

Name: Jiān shī
Physical Description: 6"10, Jiān shī is a large man who is extremely well built and carries scars underneath the thick garments made of animal pelts he wears. His hair is wild and coarse; it covers the ends of all his limbs and falls down all the way to the middle of his back.
Quirks: Hunted Emissary, Boon of Self perfection
Story Summary:
-Was born in the small secret fern village, as a sign of good luck prophesied that he would help save them from spirit beasts that terrorized his home

-He would grow up in fear and hunting to survive alongside village hunters, as many of his friends and even his family died as years passed.

-Using his natural abilities as Jinshi, and with the help of village hunters, they studied spirit beasts and started to develop a martial art to fight back.

-However, for all the villagers, being a cultivator was a pipe dream, so they planned to hunt a wounded spirit beast. They were successful, and Jiān consumed it, cultivated its power, and then awoke on the worldhelm

Name: Jodi Finch
Physical Description: Jodi's curly short black hair frames a pale and unemotional countenance. She wears overalls with Tubal & Cain's logo, has a toolbelt and miscellany around her waist. Often has coffee to hand. She lives in a battered old helicopter, which doubles as her workshop.
Story Summary:
- Talented engineer from a young age with a promising future, ended up working at Tubal & Cain for weapons development.
- Awakened to psychic powers mysteriously one day. Jodi became disillusioned with their life and their work which supports war and Terra's status quo. Felt the need to make a change.
- Began procuring military supplies, gadgets from T&C contacts. A decommissioned heli falls into their possession before being scrapped. Wanting something new that breaks their stifling routine, Jodi works on it, renovating most of the passenger bay into a workshop/sleeping area where they now live.
- About six months into this phase of Jodi's life of adjusting to psychic powers, they find themselves on the Worldhelm. Is this a second chance to do good?

Name: Jodie
Physical Description: A tiny woman, she stands at 4'11 and has a very lithe, lean body that contorts well. There aren't any major blemishes in her skin, although she does carry a few scars beneath her cloak from close calls. She has bright orange hair and always has a stupid smirk on her face

Name: Johann Ackroyd
Physical Description: A lanky man with long red hair pulled into a short braid with a rapier and parry dagger sheathed over a long coat.
Story Summary:
*Used to be a full time detective
*Took up the blade to fight against those who get away with crime thanks to money/corruption
*Breaks into houses under the guise of the Night Thief Dismas comiting the perfect robberies
*Strong sense of justice and abhorrence for murder

Name: John Sawyer
Physical Description:
A rugged man with a confident demeanor and a relaxed smile, he stands at 6'2" with a fairly sturdy physique, though his fighting style relies mostly on the use of firearms.

His clothing and equipment are well-worn, bordering on disrepair, with the exception of his two guns (a rifle and a revolver) and a pair of glasses (which have no clear benefit to his vision) that are maintained almost religiously.
Story Summary:
- Hired gun operating out of Sinner's Rest

- Originally traveled with his dog named Roy and his lover, Felicity Clover.

- After years of travel, Felicity shot John twice, stole his dog, his horse and his money, abandoning him in the desert.

- Before he ended up dying, the legendary Stinger appeared, leaving him some jerky and a fistful of zenit to get him to the next town.

- Ever since he has worked alone. taking odd jobs and trying to regain his lost wealth (and his dog) and have a good time along the way.

Name: Josef Hrodwulf
Physical Description: 5'11 well built male with fair skin, blue eyes, shaggy brown hair and beard. However, its rare to see as Josef is usually seen with his equipment adorned. The gear consists of his well worn steel plate and surcoat that lies underneath and peaks out over armor on his upper leg & in the gaps of the armor towards his gauntlets. Pairing with his steel plate armor is his greathelm providing ample protection. Sometimes he's seen with his fur lined cloak adorning him should the weather permit it. And Lastly, his flamberge he wields usually sheathed on his back.
Story Summary:
-Knight-errant, formerly of House Lionheart. Took leave of his position in order to find more power in order to combat the growing calamities

-Believes that it his duty to help those who cannot protect themselves from the ever growing list of calamities within Eurys. Regardless of nationality/banner they belong too.

-During his travels he eventually took some time in Silverdale to learn and hone in on his magical prowess, adding it in combination with his martial prowess.

-Befriended fellow Goldhearted companions Celestyn & Leopold on his journey as well as accompanied with them on the expedition into the Runewall where he himself became Goldhearted as well.

Name: Julia Moors
Physical Description: Appearing as a normal human should appear as, Julia stands at 5'7" and due to her cursed nature, has a set of horns upon her head and two serpents along her body.
Quirks:
**Cursed**
Due to her theft, they are forever warped by the fae. Changed to show their greed to all as serpents now lay upon her body, horns upon her head, and at moments of seeing something they want, they change to reflect that desire. Because of that when there are items that interest her greatly, her greed will take over. Taking what she desires.
Story Summary:
Once a simple girl from Old Melin, Julia wandered into the Gwaed forest looking for food after her home fell under rough times. At once point she found a simple fruit and took it for herself to eat.

Now she pays the price of taking something without asking.

Name: Juna Azelhart
Character Bio Link:
[“You want to know more about me? Very well, 
If I must…”](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1PkR2tC78e82tze2dnaAVsemjiVslaM5DwDFrl0il_mI/edit?usp=sharing)
Character Sheet Link: ["Doctor Azelhart, on call. I'm here to ensure you all get home in one piece.”](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1Fk2N0K1JjftstHHukIxFIoMpH4RrB22Q331YKZPhNQQ/edit?usp=sharing)
Physical Description:
“I stand at 5’3 and weigh 72.8 kg.

I was allowed some liberty in how I adorn the typical uniform for a practitioner of Lumina Prime.

Coat, dress, tights, heels. 

Black eyeshadow and lipstick. I've done it that way since my university days.

I find it comfortable and it certainly does not impede my abilities."
Story Summary:
- A medical practitioner & professor from Lumina Prime , Terra.

- Known for her distant nature , she took on an assistant so she may open herself up more.

- Mentoring the assistant, eventually they brought in their sister for treatment for an undiagnosed condition.

- Juna and her assistant committed themselves to her care, however one day her condition reached critical and she died.

- Unbeknown to Juna , her assistant started dabbling in into unethical practice , desperate to find a cure for what took their sister away to save others from the same fate.

- The assistant was arrested eventually, however Juna feels she could've prevented the situation.

- Due to the encouragement of her fiance Frederick & aided by her robotic drone dog Bertram, she's been showing her more caring side while on missions.

Name: KIIR SOLDIER
Physical Description: A seasoned Leytikan rider with storm-toughened features, bright hawk-eyes, and crimson markings under his eyes
Story Summary: Born on the wind-swept steppes of Leytik, Kaigan was one of the few chosen to ride a Khünchin, a sacred harpy-beast. His settled tribe kept the old ways until the Void Monks declared them heretical and slaughtered them, leaving Kaigan and his mount the lone survivors. He keeps a small steppe eagle as a living tie to his people—where the Khünchin binds him to the heavens, the eagle grounds him to the earth. Swept into the Heaven’s Sea by a storm, he now carries his culture’s last memory beneath the endless sky.

Name: KOBOLD WITCH
Physical Description: A heavily armoured knight in full armour that rarely takes it off, but is generally quite jolly, despite his imposing stature
Story Summary: A caravan knight who helped guide caravans in the night keep travelling, until he lost a shipment to the fae, the merchant behind the shipment never forgave him and sent brigands after him

Name: Kaiten
Physical Description: Kaiten-Shi is 5ft 10 inches tall. He has short, unkempt black hair. His face sports permament peach fuzz adorned on his tanned skin.
Rare Equipment: None

Name: Kana Hyderlan
Physical Description: A short, pale human girl standing at 5’7”. Her horns are the result of a volatile reaction between her magic and her brand, and her clothes over her tribe’s tattoos.

Name: Kaneko, Ichirō
Physical Description: While Ichirō is fairly tall, standing at 6'1, he doesn't have much muscle to go with it. He is usually seen carrying a parasol but is most recognizable due to the black and green eyepatch that covers his left eye.
Story Summary:
- First born to a small merchant family
- Was a fairly rowdy and mischievous child
- Once his first sister was born he seemed to calm down, growing more protective of her and his family
- While protecting his youngest sister, he was injured and lost most of the use of his left eye

Name: Kanon (賀音)
Physical Description:
5'7"
silky pink hair, mysterious and kind pink eyes	
Androgynous with feminine curves
If you do a double take for how attractive he is, they wouldnt blame you.
Story Summary:
(Maiko) geisha trained under a palace geisha in Teisei.

Dual cultivation

Became a slave

A proud geisha who's only real intelligence is that, a himbo in most aspects. Who needs intelligence in their own head when he will live rent free in yours ( ͡° ͜ʖ ͡°)

Name: Kasagi Miyuu
Physical Description:
A very tall young lady, 6'6" (198cm). Thin and lanky build. Beanpole.

Long light-grey hair, wavy, put up in a ponytail with a large red bow, faded by age.

Pale skin. Has one small horn on the left side of her forehead, the same color as her skin.

Wears a simple paper mask dangling over her face, covering where her eyes would be, with one large central green eye drawn on, among other designs. It is opaque, but she seems to be able to see just fine.

Wears simple kimonos with hakamas, with another large bow on the obi belt. Always carrying a red umbrella with her.
Story Summary:
* A half-yokai, child of a more benign *karakasa-obake* who raised her protectively. Her father was absent and never spoken of.
* Isolated. The few times she saw humans they thought her a monster, often an oni.
* One day oni overran their home. Her mother hid as just an umbrella, but Miyuu was found. Mistaken for half-oni and the spawn of a white oni at that, they thought she would make a useful tool. Expected she'd inherit those powers.
* Miyuu was taken to Ishiyama, and witnessed horrible cruelties to the humans there. Her mother met her each night, teaching her and bidding she obey for now, to spare her what the humans faced.
* She honed her cultivation of demonic qi, healing arts, and onmyōdo to make herself useful. The onis waited for her soul-devouring powers to develop, not bothering to train her in corrupt cultivation.
* Impatience mounted as she aged. Eventually Miyuu and her mother made a desperate escape, only to be split apart when they encountered a Realmstorm.

Name: Katsura Mako
Physical Description: A white-haired, red-eyed half-kitsune with a scar across her nose whose closed-off posture and standoffish demeanor give the impression of a stray animal. Her garb is adorned with plenty of charms and ornaments, and while her large hat somewhat obscures her pointed ears, she can do little to hide the large, fluffy tail swishing behind her.
Story Summary:
- Born to parents she'd never meet, Mako was raised by farmers in a village that didn't trust her heritage
- Was run out of town when a bad harvest was blamed on her— the villagers believing they had incurred Inari's wrath by harboring her
- Saved from a violent death in the wilds by a local cultivator named Katsura Yukisuke, who took pity on her
- Seeing potential in the girl, he trained her in the ways of cultivation and the Dao of Cycles, raising her to protect the village from the shadows
- One summer, a particularly vicious spirit beast mortally wounded her teacher. On his deathbed, he imparted on her three gifts:
- His hat, to shield her from the rain;
- His name, to guide her in the dark;
- And his dream of a peaceful Teisei, so that hope may never leave her heart.
- Left to find her way alone in a world that shunned her, Katsura Mako later joined the ranks of the Goldhearted.

Name: Katya Yakhina
Physical Description:
3'8" (112 cm) tall

Orange eyes with distinctive 'bar' pupils

Long, shaggy grey hair

Pale greyish skin, getting progressively greener in her extremities

Dresses in practical, worn clothing, fairly covered up; fit for the desert. Has a big, wide-brimmed hat. Looks so much like a witch.
Rare Equipment:
Formulaic Accessory (Roll +1 dice when using Alchemy)
Volatile weapon (IP potions do +5 HP heals and +5 damage)
Mindful Item armor (IP items restore +5 MP)
Story Summary:
* A septid who grew up in a random dying podunk in the deserts of Central.

* Her mother was formerly with NT-Tech working in the Old World, and Katya grew up as an NTT booster who loved the sound of nature. Something went down and had her uproot so drastically. Her other mom had grown up in a Septid slum, and went to Central as a step up, whoof.

* Likes scrap and fiddling with things, doing repairs and kludges. Especially loves working with plants and medicines, got real good at it.

* Found a weird engineered snake somebody had dumped after their exotic pet got too big to be cute anymore. Named her Kelly. Quickly became inseparable.

* Her mom had some unburnt connections good enough to help get Katya a TEMP license from NTT.

* Did a bit of travel around Central, selling things and doing repairs, trying to make a living and also breathe some life back into her home and places like it.

Name: Kazuhiko Sojizaki
Physical Description: Kazuhiko is a lanky human with some animalistic body modifications. With a purple scaled tail and and his sharp fangs, he looks like some cross between dragon and snake. He is seen almost exclusively in urban streetwear including an oversized coat to help obscure and enlarge his silhouette, only changing when he has to. Though his clothes appear normal, they are of somewhat higher quality than one would expect, revealing themselves to be made to last and resistant to damage. Despite his height coming at around 6', his posture often has him slouching, making him appear shorter and subsequently more approachable or easier to miss as a result. The natural eyeliner he has only helps add to the vibes he gives off of either being overly casual or sleazy. Lastly, often seen wrapped around his neck, one of limbs, or sticking out of a coat pocket is a slender, serpentine reptilian creature with wings matching him in color scheme.
Story Summary:
-Kazuhiko was an impoverished orphan the majority of his life. His only other family was his brother, Sasuke.

-He grew up forced to become a con man and thief to survive. In the course of this, he met and tamed his companion, Ryuga. He knows very little about Ryuga personally beyond the obvious.

-As he was starting to make some money, he was approached by the Goldnails for a job. He was offered a ton of cash which made him ignore his warning instincts.

-The job was a set-up so that Kazuhiko would be the fall guy for a crime(s) that were getting too hot for the Goldnails.

-On arrest, Kazuhiko was sentenced to life imprisonment. The last thing he remembers before becoming a Goldhearted was being transported to a prison.

Name: Kelda
Physical Description: A 6'2" woman with sliver-ish hair and white skin. Under her armor is muscular/toned kind of body. Covers left eye with her hair.
Story Summary:
* Parents, both Ald and Yokai, killed while she was young so became an orphan.
* Left eye shows that portion of her Yokai heritage, but hides it after the ire of others causing her to run away.
* Taught how to fight and survive from a loner Yokai that help her survive.
* Part ways on good terms with the Yokai.
* Likes to collect weapons after hearing stories of the Aesir, Tubalcain.
* In no clan but does stay around places that have Ald and Yokai in peace.
* Caught in a realmstorm after battling monsters.

Name: Kelden
Physical Description:
Kelden is a taller man, knocking about 180cm/6'. He has long black hair braided behind him, a single teal-and-pink horn protruding from above his right ear. He's dressed in loose Tian Yin clothing and always has a determined expression on his face.
Hos most striking feature is the snake wound around his shoulders though, adorner with a pair of the same horn and a haughty expression.
Rare Equipment:
Wolfsblood Razor - Left Hook
Blackscale Halfglove - Specialist (brawling)
Story Summary:
Kelden grew up as the prodigy of a small Leytik village that believed in a philosophy of "Cycles". 
He was imprisoned for wanting to leave, and so was a snake spirit beast the village's elder had captured. The two, putting their strength together, escaped and hid in the mountains while Norbu taught Kelden cultivation. Eventually they found themselves on the Worldhelm as they fell into a ravine where a Realmstorm saved them.

Name: Kenji Midoriyama
Class List:
Lvl 7 Weapon Master
Lvl 4 Elementalist
Lvl 2 Fury
Physical Description: - Brown haired, about 5'10", has green eyes. Usually sports black garb.
Rare Equipment: Vengeful Steel Plates - Energy Thorns (1300z)
Story Summary:
-Kenji Midoriyama is a mercenary swordsman from Central Terra. Although he started to live a normal life, he eventually takes up a more dangerous tasks around combat, mostly escort missions around various land based transports ranging from civilians, logistics, etc. 

-He lives with his twin sister and aunt within a motel town after his mother went off had work in NTT and his father passing away.

-he initially takes up different construction related jobs in Vinland.

-He shifts to mercenary work after a bandit attack in a transport he was in on his way home. Not wanting to allow people to die meaninglessly and regretting not being capable enough to prevent the incident from happening.

-He gets sucked into the Realmstorm after a mission. He somehow retains his damaged nagamaki that somehow looks more like a katana in it's current state.

Name: Keres
Physical Description: Almost always keeping themself in perfect appearance, wearing relatively fancy but always functional clothing ready for work. Their most common clothing that of travellers equipment ready for crossing eurys.
Story Summary:
Born originally in Cronia Mastrasz.
Ran away while young living a rather dangerous life away from civilisation.

Eventually made it to silverdale and tried to get back into civilisation, getting accepted as a servant

Got bound to victoria to ensure loyalty

Was forced to follow victoria when they ran away, getting trapped in their soul

Finally managed to escape their soul back on the worldhelm and now seeks to look after their charge.. and live up to the standards of hero victoria puts on them

Name: Khaal
Physical Description: Khaal stands tall at 7'8 feet, with an athletic, muscular build. Tiger ears emerge from his head, complementing his slitted pupils, black stripes that run down his body, and lethal claws.
Story Summary: Born a half-Rakshasa, Khaal is the son of a Rakshasi woman and a father who relentlessly honed his mind and body. In the Tiger Lands, he walked the middle path between humanity and the bestial spirit. From his father, Khaal learned the importance of self-improvement, striving to be just a little better each day. His mother instilled in him a deep connection to the land and an unwavering courage. With these principles guiding him, Khaal faces the world, always ready to test his claws and be a steadfast ally and supporter. Now he travels to discover who he is apart from devotion to his home and its myriad conflicts.

Name: Kim
Physical Description: Kim has short and messy black hair, gray skin and red eyes. they are often seen wearing a lab coat alongside a purple shirt and black pants. they stand at a height of 171 cm (or 5,6 in freedom units)
Story Summary:
-father is biology teacher and they tried to follow in his footsteps by becoming a scientist.

-went into debt and let themselves get killed by a random gang  on purpose to become an insolvent. 

-became an insolvent  to stop aging and be able to do research forever

-had an assistant called Elena and considered her as an intelectual and friend but they unfortunatly stopped being friends after kim made the reckless decision of becoming an insolvent without informing her.

Name: Kit Grannus
Class List:
Floralist ★
Loremaster ★
Merchant ★
Tinkerer ★
Entropist 4
Spiritist 4
Wayfarer 2
Physical Description:
Standing at 5'9" with an average build, Kit has tanned skin and hair that is dyed blue. His right arm is a prosthetic, a replacement for the mutated limb that was amputated.

His arboreal characteristics allow him to grow bark and magical plants from his body.
Story Summary:
A discarded experiment from North Rock who was raised by a street doctor. After the doctor's violent death, Kit took up his mantle for three years before becoming a Goldhearted. 

As a Goldhearted he worked as a researcher at the Serene Heart, became its director after J'yuto's death. Eventually became the Evaluator of the Heaven's Pavilion and the inheritor of Eden's tree.

Name: Klein
Origin: The Southern Colonies, Old World, Terra
Physical Description: Light Hair, Blue Eyes, Short, Dark Clothing with one pauldron.
Story Summary: Klein is a SoulNET-Runner and Geomancer from Terra

Name: Klein Blitzwolke
Class List:
Invoker Level 3 (Invocations SL 3)
Rogue Level 2 (See Ya Later, Soul Steal SL 1)
Origin: Southern Colonies, The Old World, Terra
Physical Description: Short and slight, with a dancer's build. Blue eyes, medium length spiky light hair and pale skin.
Story Summary:
-Was genetically designed to be a living conduit for ambient elemental energy as part of a program to produce more Geomancers to serve the Southern Colonies. Received Arcane Implants to further boost his capabilities at the age of ten.
-Grew up with a revolving door of tutors and caretakers.
-Became severely ill around the age of seventeen. A rare but known side-effect of Arcane Implants.
-Received Elemental Infusion to reduce the ambient noise of other elements. However, this left him physically weak and vulnerable particularly to Earth.
-Spent much of his time jacked into the Soul-Net and became quite adept at Cyber-Infiltration and Extraction (stealing data.)

Name: Klyra
Physical Description: Klyra is usually completely obscured by a massive dark purple cloak that reaches the floor, containing a plethora of archaic technology from The Old World, and a mask that covers her face. In this outfit she appears around 190cm but in actuality she's a shortstack who wears stilts and the intimidating garb to try and look more villainous. She's always accompanied by a pair of floating masks similar to the one she wears, one blue, the other a dull magenta.

Name: Kohaku Aiuchi
Class List:
Orator 10
Arcanist 10
Loremaster 10
Rogue 2
Esper 3
Commander 3
Physical Description: Kohaku is a slender man, standing at 5'9" typically wearing formal garments - strangely immaculate and obsessively clean exterior though suitable for his vocal occupation.
Story Summary:
- Born from a fallen noble house as a consequence of the shattering.
- He became a negotiator of Murata that aided the mayor directly.
- Occasionally, he traveled to surrounding villages to ensure safe transport of food and other supplies from Murata. 
- He left when the first goldhearted returned.
- He later became the Senechal-in-Training on behalf of Teisei.
- Upon the ascension of the emperor, he was relieved of his duties and returned to become an advisor and protector of Murata and Teisei.

Name: Koishi
Physical Description: Koishi is a half-red oni girl approaching 20 with two red horns protruding from her head, slightly covered by a huge mane of white hair. She stands tall at 6.5ft, and tends not to hold back her strength.
Story Summary:
Born a half-red oni in the oni stronghold Ishiyama, she and her frail mother had to beg to survive. 
At the age of 6 Koishi's mother passed away, leaving her wracked with anguish.
The pain and anger of losing her mother, and the tyranny and poverty they all endure, solidify into Koishi's motivation to keep on living.
Koishi continues to grow and train, biding time until unleashing a revolt against the oni masters and reclaiming the name granted by her mother. She has a propensity to fire qi thanks to her tutor and her Dao, but truthfully she is not innately talented in that aspect.
Koishi pursues the Dao of Fire, with less of an emphasis on destruction ever since reaching the World Resonance phase due to coming to terms with her inner anger and realising that Teisei needs not another blazing inferno, but a nurturing warmth.

Name: Koishikawa "Kawa" Sasaki
Class List:
Loremaster ★
Sharpshooter ★
Tinkerer ★
Malefactor 6
Merchant 3
Arcanist ★
Physical Description: Kawa is 4'11" with a thin frame and pale skin. With long, white hair that is typically stylized and well-kept. She is fairly expressive, wearing a smug smile in conversations with strangers. Typically wears a green jacket, with a tank top underneath, as well as brown shorts, and boots. But likes to dress up often.
Story Summary:
Partner Bond: Saki
Rival Bond: Fernia

- Their mother is Sayumi Sasaki, an executive in 100G Security.
- Was the highest scoring student in her school. Almost entered a prestigious college sponsored by Orrery until she declined.
- Became a TEMP with her twin sister, "Saki", using Sayumi's connections to get a license.
- Both of them briefly worked with the Goldfingers.
- Their main goal is to help gather funds for their younger sister, "Mina", to a good school and to look out for her.

Name: Kori von Kleist
Physical Description:
Kori is a relatively tall woman at 5'6. The best word to describe her would be: Well put together. Her brown hair is immaculately kept, her glasses are always clean. If she is not wearing her school uniform (always pressed), she is wearing a lovely, regal green dress (always immaculate). The closest to 'unkempt' one could argue for her is her freckles, which she never bothers to cover up with her make up.

Kori never wields a weapon, and the reason why becomes very clear as soon as conflict begins: She becomes a long, heavy spear. The spear has an impressively keen edge, and seems to truly come to life when battling truly impressive foes.
Rare Equipment:
Riot-Starter Scabbard
Pride of the Concordia [ATT UP Accessory]
Antixtoxin Bangle
Story Summary:
* Born fifth generation of an old family. 
* Her parents expected her to follow the family tradition of enrolling as a Paladin. 
* She tried to help her brother get ready to also enroll, but her parents were awful to her about it.
* She passed the entrance exams well, but surprised (and angered) her parents by joining the House of Treasures.
* Sped run through getting to the rite of binding. Her father is angry and wants the rite removed from her, but even if it could be she wouldn’t.
* Father has been harassing her non stop. This has affected her ability to get good grades and socialize.
* To alleviate this, she is yeeted off to the remedial class.

Name: Kris Terasu
Physical Description: 172 cm tall, paleish skin, blueish green eyes. slightly spiky brownish blonde hair, commonly wears a blue jacket and dark orange jeans, headphones and respirator
Rare Equipment: None yet
Story Summary:
A second generation racing prodigy from Terra, Kris was expected to carry on his parents legacy in the augmented reality racing leagues and potentially win the Grand Prix. During his school days he usually kept to himself, focusing on his studies mostly due to people picking on him for being "different".

On his 17th birthday, both his parents suffered bad crashes and  mysteriously disappeared forcing Kris to sell off most of his family's racing machines and tech in order to stay financially afloat, and even entered the league himself to find out what happened to his parents.

During one such race, he was struggling due to heavy resistance from the other racers, and was close to his racer breaking down. Instead of pulling in and retiring from the race, He found a fire within and contuined on, and on the final lap, a Realmstorm hit, just as he crossed the finish line, disapearing in a bright light, which was assumed to be a pyrotechnic stunt.

The line that runs across their back is not coloration; it is a long row of teeth and fangs which open to a terrible tendril-filled maw that spans its entire body. Story Summary:
A monster created in secret beneath Caer Moryd. He rejects the urges of his nature to do good and has a mostly-positive track record of doing so.

Since becoming a Goldhearted, he's pursued academia at Hudal Academy, cast his lot against the crown with the Truehart coalition, taken up his own crown as the King of Hearts, and dreams of perfecting a place where folks like him - unusual but well-meaning - can find peace.

Name: Ky Kusho
Physical Description: He has a refined yet sinister appearance, usually having a constant smirk or glare, his red eyes often glint a supernatural glow especially when ushing his magic. He exudes a cold confident energy surrounded by a faint dark aura, on his neck a tattoo of a snake biting a dagger atop of some flowers
Story Summary:
Raised under the shadow of the corrupt sects in Xuanwu City, A kindhearted man by the name of Ky Kusho was a misfit untalented in their methods.

Seeking a different way, he uncovered an ancient, forbidden cultivation method called the Art Of Pain buried beneath the ruins of a forgotten monastery.

It required the cultivator to embrace their own death, to treat the boundary between life and the afterlife as a membrane to slip through. To go deeper meant letting go of the ego the desire, even the heartbeat until all that remained was a sliver of self.

It nearly killed him. But in that moment, caught between life and death, he broke through, allowing him to commune with spirits and the ability of flight.

However this method was not without its flaws. he is constantly plagued by the voices of the dead and a lapse of concentration may prove fatal.

Despite this, he intends to create a new path of cultivation. one that protects and heal rather than harm and destroy.

Name: Kylean Z'kirio El'dialso V
Physical Description: A 6 ft tall fox like creature, with one half of his fur being white and the sleeves of fur on his right arm having green colors with his left arm having purple, the bottom half being black fur and the only coloring near the knees with 2 green stripes on both sides of 1 large purple stripe. He has many eyes, 7 eyes total all of them different colors as they constantly swap between colors.

Physical Description:
A short and meek boy, Köll wanders the tundra of Aldistir. His pale skin and silver hair clash with the black of his eyes, revealing the Godblood within.

Altough he is a Yokai, his only bestial trait are his sharp claws and teeth. He wears a fur mantle to keep the cold away, and his hood is decorated with fluffy canine-like ears to be more easily recognized as a Yokai.

The slight smell of blood follows him around...
Story Summary:
- Lost his memories after being touched by Godblood.
- Koll is basically a draugr, with all that entails.

Name: Ladora Cascella
Physical Description: A young woman whose presence is marked by long sapphire curls that cascade and ripple over her figure, adorned with golden beads which glint softly when she moves. Even in simple clothes, Ladora accents herself with carefully chosen jewelry. She typically carries an iridescent grimoire close at hand, cradling it like a cherished companion,  attuned to the melodies and stories woven into the land around her everywhere she goes.
Quirks:
Mysterious Grimoire [3/10]
Book: **The Chord of Resonance**
Story Summary:
- Ladora was born in Delsatz to the Cascella Muses, a line of talented hedge witches who practiced Anima and Eidola magic.
- As the Calamity weakened the bloodline’s reach, only her mother remained to teach their sacred craft.
- Inherited The Chord of Resonance, a living grimoire containing their bloodline’s songs, stories, and secrets across Eurys.
- Later journeyed away from home to study the grimoire and its stories more deeply. During this period she traveled the lands, seeking to understand the magic and people around her.
- Eventually crossed the Runewall to preserve these memories and keep them alive during the Calamity; searching for ways to heal and restore the land through song and memory, while continuing to unearth The Chord of Resonance.

Name: Lady Kezhari
Physical Description: A tall, lizardlike humanoid standing at 6'2". Kezhari's purple scales are smooth to the touch, and she has floppy ears with a doglike muzzle to boot. She typically wears a long, flowing robe and hats of questionable fashion sense.

Name: Laeli
Physical Description:
A towering, 6'5" hare yokai with white fur and rough scars. Powerfully built, uses both plate mail and a heavy waraxe in battle. She has an eyepatch on her left eye, which partially covers a brand-mark on the left side of her face. The mark resembles the visage of a snarling wolf.

Laeli's strength and height hardly match her demeanor. She's pensive, thoughtful, and exudes a gentleness that shouldn't belong on someone as scarred as she is. If her appearance indicates anything, though, it is that the young yokai has endured a great deal.
Story Summary:
- Laeli grew up a slave in the Black Wolf Warband, along with her younger brother Ikko. Having grown up around suffering, the sight of another's pain never failed to wound her--so she offered her strength to those who couldn't bear their burdens. She knew how little it mattered--but if she could do anything to make their lives better, she did.

- The chance came to help in an escape, and the two siblings stayed behind to distract. They fled last, but the results were disastrous: Ikko perished, and Laeli was dragged back. The death of her brother destroyed her spirit--even after lashings, she wouldn't work--so she was sold to the now-Blood Wolves for sacrifice.

- Later in the year, the day came. Still gripped by soul-crushing anguish, Laeli bargained herself in place of three children. She could endure far more before passing, and her suffering would appease the Great Wolf. They listened. Just moments before she succumbed to their terrible work, a realmstorm snatched her from the end.

Class List:

Physical Description: Jiafei is a just under six foot tall thinly built man. He has a mane of thick white hair that frames his face, and falls far down his back to nearly his knees. His two lion ears flick side to side passively at each noise or voice.
Story Summary: The only member of this generation of his family of guardians. A family who had protected the Jijing Xiantiao for as long as they've been around. While normally they have many children, which all train to be powerful warriors, the hard times of the recent century have limited offspring. Only Jiafei has managed to survive to adulthood. Despite this, he fails to live up to his families warrior reputation, and has been cast aside by the common people as the end of his lineage. The Lanying family has lost it's prestige.

Physical Description:
Laura stands at a tall 6’ 7”, with a lean but athletic build; abs but not bulky. She has tan skin, olive eyes, and long, strawberry blonde hair that’s tied into a single french braid that runs down to her back. She only has one natural arm, with the other one- her left arm specifically- being ghostly, monstrous, and spectral in nature.

Being the perfect distillation of both a cowgirl and a witch, her style is a combination between the two: From top to bottom, she wears a long-brimmed witches hat, and two golden rings as earrings hanging from both earlobes. She wears a cropped short-sleeve shirt that shows off her belly, a short poncho around her shoulders that stops at her elbow on one side and shoulder on the other, and a fingerless glove on her normal arm alongside a chain bracelet that connects to a golden ring on each finger. She wears an open skirt below all that, with long boots with heels that go over her pants.

Story Summary:
• Her father was a wandering cowboy jumping from town to town, and her mother was a Warlock of the Qilin Coven. They met when Laura's father wandered into the coven town where her mother resided, and his interest in the mysteries of magic sparked a connection, and eventually they got married.
• Being a Warlock, Laura's mother naturally spent a lot of her time studying demons and demonic phenomena, and even wrote a fiction novel based on her findings. Due to the limited functionality of the printing facilities, not too many got fully published, but the most important one she gave to Laura to keep.
• During a summoning gone wrong, Laura's father was taken, and she lost an arm trying to save him. Her mother was also injured in the conflict by the devil's gun, but Laura wrestled it away soon after and before her arm was severed, which left her near death. However, as they were over a leyline, Laura's mother used that and a magic lightning bolt to revive her, and grant her a second chance.

Name: Lauren Faust
Physical Description:
They have pale, light beige hair with brown streaks near the ends, tied loosely at the back with a small green clip that matches their outfit’s accents. They wear rectangular glasses, often perched on their head or slightly tilted forward, giving a mix of intellect and casual confidence.

Their eyes are golden-yellow, with a focused, slightly tired but alert look. The character wears a white lab coat with green and black trim, over a black shirt, black vest, and black trousers. A green necktie adds a sharp contrast, coordinated with green details throughout their outfit. They also wear black gloves and black boots with green lining, maintaining a consistent and clean color scheme of white, black, and neon green.
Story Summary:
-Born in Karlsgard
-Wandered the lands Karlsgard with his travelling merchant adoptive father
-They mainly trade in Merran tech that was salvaged from defeated Merrani forces
-Their routes oftenpass by hedgeberg to buy brand new parts
-Father would support his interests by buying him books and materials
-With what he was given Lauren would make very impressive gadgets for his age
-When he was 16 his father died he would use his inheritance to sustain himself further his craft
-Part of his inheritance was a special gun called the Dismantler
-It lets the wielder get supplies from defeated enemies
-He would learn as much as he can while living off his inheritance
-He would become a travelling merchant like his father selling his own creations
-He would often prioritize routes that passed villages that needed supplies the most
-He would create an exoskeleton that allowed him to get to different villages faster and carry more wares
-During his travel he would get caught up in a Realmstorm

Name: Lei-Lei
Physical Description: A slight vanara with poofy brown fur. He's just as tall as his sister, and dresses in clean reds and blacks. His firework cannon is always on his back, and if it leaves him, it always returns to him eventually.
Story Summary: Vanara raised with his twin sister in a solitary village in Xiaohai. The village revered them, but they wanted more and more personal relationships. So, they set their wanderlust at the helm and departed.

Name: Leilani
Physical Description: Standing at a glorious 5'6, with her head covered with short silver hair and a large pair of ears. Her golden eyes rarely stand still, always looking around. Over her feline tail is her bag tied to her waist that she carries around at all times.

Name: Leoniel Chevalier
Physical Description: A man standing at 5'6ft with a posture that makes him seem to stand taller and seem broader shouldered than he is, a walk and posture of someone with a steely decisiveness and cool head while under stress and considering what he does, its nothing out of the ordinary.
Story Summary:
- Grew up in north rock with a crew of people who had a love for racing and cars. They did illegal street racing in that scene in North Rock that spanned multiple locals in central.
- Made a promise to each other that whoever if anyone made it out of living in North Rock to not look back, so no one felt like they were holding each other down.
- Came upon an Experimental Prototype T&C Vehicle left at a site of a botched transportation attempt, after bringing it back to a garage he got an idea and secretly kept the vehicle.
- Now uses the vehicle in the North Rock Racing scene to earn money from the winnings to help both pay for the easy of his old crew's living situation and maybe help them leave North Rock too under the racing alias Rex.

Physical Description: A tall 6'2 man, Leopold has dark skin and long hair. It is usually tied up in a big ponytail to contrast his light colored outfits. Leopold sports a number of accessories: piercings, necklaces, rings, and golden ribbons tied on his forearms (heirloom). Leopold sports kind eyes and a small smile; he prefers vocal expression rather then facial expressions.

Story Summary:
- Born with uncontrollable magic in their voice
- Silently worked at their family's enchanting shop and wrote about his mother's stories
- Was gifted Golden Tethers, a magic suppressant crafted by their father that let Leopold speak
- Became obsessed with adventuring parties and their stories
- Indiscriminately aided parties in Delsatz, writing of each hero he found
- Met Josef Hrudwoulf, and traveled with him
- Went to Silverdale with/for Josef and started writing about the warriors there
- Felt stagnant until Josef suggested going to the Runewall; a congregation of heroes with stories
- Met Celestyn on the way to the Runewall
- Runewall blood bath.

Name: Leslie Shay
Physical Description: A male standing at 5'7 with dark brown hair and similarly colored eyes. He is often seen wearing a dusty poncho, wide brimmed hat, and dark sunglasses. Has the kind of smile that makes you clutch your purse or reach for your gun.
Story Summary:
- Born to a family of smugglers, learned the trade as he got older. Law eventually caught up with them. With his family's help, he managed to escape.

- While selling off the last of their contraband, he was ambushed by outlaws. Outgunned and running on empty, he resigned himself to his fate.

- At that moment, a certain drifter joined the fray, dispatching the outlaws. After the gunfight, the two engaged in a long conversation.

- Changed by their words, he spent the next few years wandering around doing odd jobs.

Name: Levan
Physical Description:
Levan is lithe, sun-kissed and slightly shorter than his brother, standing at 6'0" (6'10" with his ears upright). His hair and fur are the same striking white, though his features are softer—his face framed by long bangs and a calm, almost wistful expression. His eyes are a warm amber-gold, more curious than piercing, with a faint melancholy lingering beneath them. Unlike his brother, Levan’s presence is quiet and subtle, with a grace that borders on delicate.

He wears light, travel-worn garb—white layered cloth and fitted leather armor, practical and modest, with subtle patterns hinting at Windhaven craftsmanship. A choker sits snugly on his neck, etched with the symbol of his family’s patron.
Quirks:
Heirloom : Turul

The bow of the first son, handed down through generations in Levan's family.
 While it was not meant for him, the original wielder is no more.

Drawback: Occasionally the bow refuses to obey Levan, choosing to rip themselves out of his hand during a turn and looking for a more worthy wielder, or simply flopping on the ground.

Story Summary:
- Born into a Hiear merchant family in Windhaven; younger twin to A'shibah.

- Grew up inseparable from his brother, bonded in both spirit and habit.

- Lived a peaceful life traveling in their family’s caravan, steeped in tradition and faith in Musta’khan.

- On their 17th name day, their caravan was ambushed by Kiir; A’shibah died protecting him.

- Levan attempted a forbidden revival ritual—however the ritual failed and drew someones ire.

- Akhir answered instead, but A’shibah’s spirit returned and forged a pact to save him.

- Levan refused to lose his brother once more, as he'd forcibly alter the rite. His desperate plea would be answered by Musta’khan who would bind their souls together permanently.

- For years, wandered Nezmira with A’shibah’s spirit dormant within him.

- Recently awakened together after a strange event that brought them to the Worldhelm.

Name: Levius C. Kennedy
Physical Description: Levius stands at a modest 6'2" and currently sports a short crop of spiky black hair. Recognized by his impressive athletic build, he draws no questions to the moniker he has earned -- **"Underground Champion"**. Curiously, his eyes seem to change in the heat of the moment, going from dull almost lifeless pools of black to living embers of gold. His dress style leans on the edge of guady, a leftover relic of his delinquent days, as Levius is often seen barechested in bright orange, fur-lined coats and training shoes. And in his troubled youth, as an act of rebellion, Levius acquired two magical augmentations: **a devil's tail and horns**. He's kept this hidden from his mother for years, as he can adjust when they appear, but those in the slums of North Rock know his moniker well -- **"The Devil's Luck"**.
Quirks:
**Cursed - Extreme Misfortune**
At a young age, Levius was indoctrinated to a life of crime by his father. The most egregious of these offenses involed the grand larceny of hundreds of thousands of zenit from a 777LC casino. For his crimes, Levius' father was blacklisted by the corporation executives; and eventually, Levius' further involvement after his father's sudden disappeance left him blacklisted as well. Since then, Levius' seems to suffer bizarre streaks of bad luck, if one believes in such a thing.
Rare Equipment: *"I'm just getting started."*
Story Summary:
- Born in the slums of North Rock
- Was a delinquent, reformed by boxing
- Close ties to Keith Walker (boxing mentor)
- Wants to be a hero like his idol
- Wants to do Mama proud

Name: Liam Renault
Physical Description: Liam has shoulder length black hair and a short beard. He stands at roughly 6'4" and 280 with mass of muscle to accompany.

Name: Lilac Brightshield
Physical Description:
Standing at around 5'10" and wielding an oversized pair of scissors, Lilac appears intimidating, to say the least, despite her elegant dress sense and slender frame. She has long, white hair, purple eyes befitting of her name, and carries herself with poise and precision.

The strange scissors she carries everywhere is made of a pristine silver, inlaid with gems of varying purple shades.
Rare Equipment: Soulshearers

Name: Liliwen Bremblebery
Physical Description: At 4'10" with massive furry brown ears and a pink tail, Liliwen looks mousy in more ways than one. Despite her stature, she is strong and built with the muscles to show it. Not that they're often visible, with the gilt steel plate she wears over deep green padding. Her hair is long and pale blonde, falling quite far down her back when not tied up neatly to fit in her helmet. Her eyes are ruby red, and when she opens her mouth one can notice slightly pronounced buck teeth.
Rare Equipment: Shining Plate: Runic Plate with Composure quality
Story Summary:
* From a common-born family with a history in and around Tradefair (and Honeydew before it). She was born in Tradefair.

* Her father had an encounter with a fae that left him changed, marked by the ears and tail of a mouse. He has not spoken of what happened or what fae he encountered to Liliwen. She inherited these features herself.

* Liliwen grew up a scrappy little rascal and matured into a scrappy little lady. She channeled her competitiveness into work as a mercenary with the Iron Anvils, and made a name for herself despite some misgivings and prejudice.

* In the middle of a job gone bad, Liliwen approached a Realmstorm and was whisked off to the Worldhelm. She has done heroics while also returning home often to do her job there.

Name: Lillian Vox
Physical Description: Lillian is a living burst of carnival chaos—decked in vivid reds, purples, and electric blues stitched into a deliberately asymmetrical ensemble that seems stitched together by whimsy itself. Golden bells and patterned fabrics dance with her every step, while her patchwork jester’s cloak swirls like a stage curtain in motion. Her silver-white hair cascades in tousled waves, crowned by a flamboyant hat adorned with feathers, cards, and just enough flair to draw every gaze. Her heterochromia—one eye bright and curious, the other bold and mischievous—only adds to the mystique with quirky makeup always in place and cards never far from her fingertips.
Quirks:
Outcast Fairy:
Lillian is a changeling (Though she does not know so herself yet.)

She has the spell Gamble,

Flaw: Lillian is always smiling and rhymes outside of personal mental anguish, if she is not, bad things tend to happen to herself and those around her. This persists until someone rhymes several sentences together to cheer her up.
Story Summary:
Arianwyn Wood, born and (mostly) raised in Brightshield, rejected the town's gloom and reinvented herself as Lillian Vox, a traveling entertainer. While many believe she's a true mage, she insists she's just a street magician: “Real magic? I’m not that blessed.” 
Others whisper she’s faetouched, mistaking whimsy for otherworldly ties. Driven to spread wonder, she roamed from town to city, going wherever joy was needed. One day, she stumbled upon a realmskipper and, trusting in luck, stowed away. Arriving at the Worldhelm, she realized it wasn’t luck—it was fate. Ever eager to dazzle, Lillian keeps a card in her hand and a trick up her sleeve for anyone willing to watch.

Name: Lin Baimei
Origin: Tian Yin, Wujing Guo, Xuanwu City
Other Names:
Lin (Family Name)
Baimei (Given Name)
Madam Lin (Business Name)
Chosen of Xuanwu
Physical Description:
A pale lady seemingly in appearance around her late twenties, with long white hair and a keen eye. Standing at 170cm in height, she carries herself with grace until she loses herself, in which case she becomes enthusiastic and eccentric to a degree.

Though she is missing her left arm, a wooden prosthetic can be seen beneath her sleeves.
Story Summary:
* A widow in her mid 40's; having once lost her son and her husband, she was forced to fend for herself in Xuanwu City. She often bowed her head as to not be noticed and not seen. 
* Due to low funds and lack of work, she had gone to the Blood Mines to try to earn some money to survive. Not being a cultivator, she did not fare well and would have lost her life. Luckily Lady Baozhai, a Spirit Beast that resided within Xuanwu, had saved her and she only lost her arm to hypothermia.
* With this new lease on life, she was able to become a Cultivator and began her new life as one. Though she still kept her head down, to be unseen and unnoticed by those in power. She spent a few years being trained by the Beasts.
* Prior to her return, she was gifted a pendant of black ice; a fragment of Xuanwu's power. This pendant was later used in the fight against the Midnight Lotus, to restore Xuanwu and begin his healing.
* Now, while he slumbers, he has made her his Representative.

Class List:
