1 Rider
★ Elementalist
★ Spiritist
★ Arcanist
8 Orator
Origin: Tian Yin, Wujing Guo, Jinjing Xiantiao, Bingchuan
Physical Description:
A tall and imposing man, this Jinshi warrior possesses a powerful, towering physique. His broad shoulders and well-defined muscles sculpted through years of battle and cultivation, his chest and arms are marked with scars, each a testament to past conflicts. A thick, wild mane of dark hair flows around his face, further emphasizing his guardian lion-like heritage. His clawed hands are large and calloused, built for both combat and protection. His legs are equally formidable, covered in patches of fur that lead down to powerful, clawed feet, giving him a beast-like stance.

He wears a flowing green robe adorned with subtle, intricate patterns, tied at the waist with a wide, crimson sash decorated with cloud motifs. A large fur pelt drapes over one shoulder, hinting at past victories over formidable beasts and spirits alike. Hanging from his waist are gourds and additional cloth ornaments, resembling ceremonial talismans and protective charms against corrupt cultivators.
Quirks: Hunted Emissary : Boon of Self Perfection
Story Summary:
- Born to a relatively respected family, Lin's life was marred with tragedy before he was even born.
- Lin struggled under the weight of expectations from his family and pedigree both. Having been born a Jinshi he was expected to achieve more.
- He struggled with fundamentals that others took to easily, however he had a strange connection to the wildlife around him.
- Having had enough, on his 17th summer he vowed to prove himself. After saying his goodbyes to none save his mother, he'd take his fathers Guandao and leave the village swearing to prove his worth.
- In the bamboo forests surrounding Bingchuan he'd find his prey. A spirit beast beset by corrupt cultivators. In the end he'd choose to aid the beast, giving it a chance to fight back.
- As a reward, the beast would instruct Lin. Imparting their knowledge that in turn would allow him his own breakthrough.
- Lin now prowls the forests with Xuhu a descendant of the spirit beast, hunting corrupt cultivators.

Name: Lindsey Beck
Physical Description: A gorgeous, flamboyant man dressed in fine silks, tight leathers, and adorned with a greying blonde mane and a luxurious mustache. Shirt eternally open baring a hairy chest, or an armored chestplate when in his exosuit. Yes, thats right. The shirt goes over the exosuit, eternally open.
Quirks: Heirloom: Beck's Bulwark, the signet ring of his family. A ring laden with history and sweat, it bears the will to live till the war is over inherited from the Beck family line giving its wearer resistance to physical. On the finger of the man who threw that legacy away, no matter how righteous an act it was... it feels incredibly heavy...
Rare Equipment: Beck's Bulwark, 1000z, Accessory, Quality: Resistance to Physical.
Story Summary:
* Born to an affluent military family in Caldera
* Spent his youth rebelling however he could from his strict father
* Upon inheriting the family fortune upon his father's passing, and with no other family to speak of, he donated all but a small fortune of his wealth to various charities, dissolving his estate.
* Using what remained of his fortune he purchased an airship "The Gleaming Goose" and an exosuit named "Throne"
* Spent a few years blissfully independent until he and his ship were comandeered for the war effort.
*Many years with the military wore down his hope to ever escape his legacy until a plucky young Welkin pilot was assigned to his ship.
* When she realized she no longer wanted to serve Merrane he followed her happily into Vigilantism (piracy is such a droll word) as the Violet Barons!

Name: Lindwa Ddraig
Physical Description: Lindwa is a clumsy, lumbering woman, measuring at 6' of height, and weighing over 400 pounds, due in large part to the draconic horns and huge, unwieldy tail she has, as if someone took the parts off of a fairytale dragon, and placed them onto her. She dresses simply, in a fashionable and exquisitely crafted dress not unlike one a princess or noble would wear. Her demeanor is generally calm and collected, though there is always some level of movement present in her body even when at rest.
Story Summary: Lindwa is a Dreamite, hailing from Castle Ladon. Having put herself under a powerful spell of slumber for countless years beforehand, she excitedly seeks the adventure and intrigue that the Worldhelm has to offer.

Name: Lionel
Physical Description:
About 6ft tall, Lionel Il'Hrarra is a fount of little guy energy. To combat his little man aura, he dresses up in a style reminiscent of sailors and their ships in Ripplith, always decorated in a coat and a set of boots, usually with some sort of net for an accessory.

It is a rare event to see him in normal clothing.
Story Summary:
- Born to a noble family in Ripplith, Lionel was the firstborn daughter, and the heir apparent, set to inherit the authority of the family.
- They come out as trans, and go to a Seamother to undergo the ritual to fit into a body of their own.
- Now a man, and unable to hold authority in the matriarchal society of the Galeo Empire, their family looks down on him for throwing away his birthright and responsibility.
- He is then sent off to the Gnosis Academy to find his own path, and so as to no longer be in his mother's sight.
- Lionel takes well to the classes and the trials of becoming a Regalia yet all the while there is a sense that something is wrong. He struggles to make friends and socialize, and after some months his grades begin to slip...
- Thus, he is in the remedial program.

- After many trials, Lionel has renounced his family name and birthright... He wanders no longer, now he is the Wayward.

Name: Lisa Aeingradt
Physical Description: Lisa is a young woman with a fairly serious expression and demeanor at all most all times, someone who takes things generally serious especially when it comes to tasks or jobs of any sort, failure is something she simply desires to not need to content with. None of this means she is unknown to the taste of defeat, as a tech trial and error can become common place to find solutions to issues. She stands at 5'6 without her heels on and is a rather beautiful looking individual with her blue eyes.
Story Summary:
- Merrane raised aspiring logistics and technician who tries her best to go above and beyond at what she believes in.
- Connections were used to make her a subject for Esper pilot projects to become better use for the military service of the empire.
- Due to the shift of roles, she came under the protection of Johnathan Southworth, a POW turned to asset for the military.
- During a mission near Suntower, she was protected by Johnathan from the sudden emergence of Vanagandr, nearly costing his life.
- She convinced and authorized the use of the Pandora serum in the hopes of saving Johnathan's life, though at a cost.
- She remains protected by Johnathan but is now in constant worry about his state of being and feels an panging guilt about being the reason he is the way he is now and the fact he so readily nearly died for her.

Name: Lloyd
Physical Description: 5’6 feet tall, 140 lbs. Looks somewhat scrawny, but is just rocking a sleeper build. Never seen without his helmet on and his weapons close by, even when relaxing and sleeping. The only thing you can make out through the helmet's visor are piercing blue eyes. Gives off an intimidating aura that very quickly melts away the moment he speaks.

Name: Lochlann Carlisle
Class List:
Tinkerer :star:
Merchant :star:
Esper :star:
Symbolist 1
Guardian 3
Orator 1
Physical Description:
Principally a healer, Lochlann is a lion-augmented businessman flecked with white, gold-tipped fur who stands at an impressive 6’9”. Contouring his muscular frame is a kevlar-lined suit that protects him in the boardroom and the streets of Terra.

His gentlemanly demeanor and typically warm smile can quickly turn cold when his friends and colleagues are threatened. In addition to gauntlets capable of creating energy shields, a rectangular black device affixed to his belt produces alchemical reagents.
Rare Equipment: C.A.T.S. (Heirloom) [Formulaic], R.O.A.R. [Volatile], P.R.I.D.E. [Constitution], M.A.N.E. [Composure]
Story Summary:
- Created as an augmented clone of his father, Magnus, the necessarily ruthless CEO of Regenekhan Pharmaceuticals on Terra
- Befriended Caelan Blacklaw (another PC) at a high school in Haven. They lost touch but has since reconnected and become romantic partners.
- Employed as head researcher of Regenekhan using his degrees in medicine and business 
- Regenekhan is a "family"-owned biotech company and medical supplier that contracts with every Prime Company to ensure its independence 
- Raised by Magnus to be second in line in the Carlisle family and supports his older brother and top executive, Alistair
- Seeking a change in life after the events of Skyfall and his disillusionment of Terra's corporate regime on everyday people
- Carries an heirloom device called C.A.T.S. (Chemically Adaptive Thermo-Synthesizer) that fabricates randomized compounds, but it’s a prototype that agents from other companies want to copy or steal

Name: Lock
Physical Description: hte Fob :fox:
Rare Equipment:
Kinetically Ejected Therapeutic Chemical Holistic/Universal Pyrolizer - Accessory, Extra Potency (+2 to Secret Formula skill)

Wearable Reusable Ice Shard Tosser - Custom Weapon, Sticky Fingers quality (Soul Steal value increases by 100z)
Story Summary: See character bio

Name: Locke 🔥
Physical Description:
5' 9"
190 lbs.
Locke wears a bandage-esque talisman wrapped around his torso, as well as baggy pants tucked into metal combat boots. which binds him to the flame demon arcanum, Tubalcain. Locke's right-half is perpetual inferno, while his left side is (most of the time) skin.

Name: Loveno Beaumont
Physical Description: Loveno is a tall, broad man, with a body that has been conditioned through rigorous physical activity throughout the years, hidden away by his SIA uniform. On his hip is a pair of holsters, containing his SIA service pistol on one side, and a heavy, serrated shortsword in the other. There is always an amicable smile painted on his face, an expression that never really changes unless the situation is dire, or he's working on repairing and upgrading his beloved vehicle.
Story Summary:
- Loveno grew up with his father, a mechanic, in a small town outside of Veyrhold. His father was killed in a werewolf attack, amd Loveno drove the two of them to Veyrhold for help.

- After arriving, Loveno became a junior agent in the S.I.A, hoping to help the organization in their efforts to protect the people from the supernatural, taking a special interest in the DSC.

- After years of training and solving cases, Loveno was taken by a realmstorm, into the Worldhelm.

Name: Lucia
Physical Description: Lucia has a lithe-lanky mix figure - a result of physical training/work, as well as malnutrition. She stands just under average height - about 5' 3", and has shoulder-length grey hair. Her usual attire is a large jacket or hoodie, paired with whatever combination of combat boots and shorts or pants she fancies that day. She speaks with a rough tone, and is quite quick to resort to physical violence when things aren't quite going her way.
Story Summary: Ended up at an orphanage with her younger brother, who quickly got adopted. She failed to find a permanent family of her own, due to 'attitude problems'. One thing led to another, and eventually she started working as a for-hire thug for a local gang leader, among some other miscellaneous jobs.

Name: Lucia Vitarex
Physical Description: Lucia is a young woman with red eyes and red hair which she wears in a bun. She stands at 5'2 and weights about 130 lbs.

Name: Luka Penrose
Physical Description: Luka is extremely bubbly. He enjoys talking, but really loves listening to people talk about their past, or things that interest them. He is often seen writing in a notebook of sorts, though his notes are indecipherable because his handwriting is god awful.  Except to him, it seems. He is somewhat short, but that doesn't appear to bother him at all. He has reddish-purple hair, and orange eyes that are almost always wide in fascination. He sometimes has wings and a halo, thanks to his exoskeleton, Seraphim. He loves learning how anything works, and will often take things apart to see what inner mechanisms drive them - except for living things. He is very kind, and well-intentioned, even if he can be a bit much sometimes. He has had an easy life, full of pursuing his passions, and wants nothing more than for everyone else to have the same.
Quirks:
Heirloom - Servare, the People's Guard

Obtained off of a dying KPLA soldier (Vincent) south of Suntower, this jacket is meant to help its wearer protect their allies. This soldier also told Luka of the truth behind Merrane, and the reason the KPLA fight. This information turned Luka's views of Lhodos on their head, for the better. Though Vincent may be dead, Luka is intent on carrying his legacy forward - and sometimes, the jacket's magic mixed with Vincent's latent desires causes him to act uncharacteristically.

Flaw - Soul of a Warrior - Luka is, by nature, not a fighter. He prefers to let others handle danger, though he is happy to heal and support the team. However, the runes imbued within the jacket, mixed with the soldier's latent desire for justice, may spur him forward, causing him to act against his will.

Quirk - Healer’s Ward - When Luka heals an ally or allies, they have resistance to the next instance of physical damage that they take before the start of his next turn.
Rare Equipment: Servare (Combat Tunic, Healer's Ward Quality)
Story Summary:
- his mom used to call him 'angel,’ so he adopted it as a nickname
- began messing with magitech in his free time
created Seraphim, his exoskeleton suit
- became proficient in hard light tech
- learned how to replicate spell effects
- the ascension of Prince Damian in his hometown made him wonder - why would he change sides if Merrane is supposed to be great?
- in a moment of rebellious curiosity, he wandered south of Suntower, and after some time, he came across a battlefield, strewn with bodies
- found a dying soldier named Vincent, who told him about how Merrane truly is
Vincent gave him his jacket, Servare, asking him to continue the fight and defend justice where he found it
- he explained that there were runes in the jacket, meant to protect one’s allies when they may not be able to protect themselves
- he inscribed ‘Angel’ along the sleeve, wanting to protect Vincent's ideals
- used Seraphim to fly back to Suntower, but she malfunctioned, sending him into a Realmstorm

Name: Lumio, Idyll's Last Warden
Character Bio Link: [“Why are you asking.. we have a job to do.”](<https://discord.com/channels/1169852846083153941/1170111183869706362/1320861999034269759>)
Class List:
Guardian ~ 🌟
Empath ~ 🌟
Fury ~ 6
Weapon Master ~ 2
Chanter ~ 1
Origin: Fourth layer of Idyll, Maze Elysia
Physical Description: Lumio is semi-ethereal, 5'6 man that looks in their mid twenties. Their limbs, as well as their hair seem to fizzle into wisps on certain parts of their body. After Echo's death Lumio barely smiles. Their glasses are discarded, their hair is unkempt, and their orange eyes grow darker in the shadows that follow them.
Quirks:
**__Idyllic Soul__**
- Communicate with demons, elementals, & undead. 
- RES Light and VUL Dark
- Can cast Dispell
Weakness: Has hallucinations of dead people they've failed to save
Rare Equipment:
**__Equipped__**
Memory of **Echo** (ABS Bolt)
Pulse Reflector (Retribution)
Bittermoune (custom, dark elemental powerful, Brutal Counter)

**__Unequipped__**
Shining Spotlight (Immortal Bulwark)
Havoc-Bringer Scabbard 
Achillean Aspis (Warden)
Story Summary:
- Died and entered Maze Elysia in Idyll
- Entered groups to find a way out, but ran away when they would die
- Led others out of guilt with a new name, ‘Lumio’ 
- Spent two hundred+ years leading groups with a fake smile 
- Escaped to the Worldhelm and met Echo
- Echo gave them hope, positivity, a real smile
- Echo died.

Name: Luna
Physical Description: blond hair, ears, and tail. she has fair skinned, is 5'6", she has fuzzy shoulder pads and brigandine with long white leggings and brown snow boots.
Story Summary:
*  Parents left when she was a young Kitsume
* She started hearing rumors of people needing protection and started to learn to be a lightblade
* She quickly learned how to wield a sword from her uncle
* Set out on her own adventure to find her parents
* Fell through ice during a storm and woke up on the world helm

Name: Lunira
Physical Description:
5'6"
Glowing white skin.
Horns that curl up from either side of her head.
Fingers that form into sharp claw-like points at the end of the nail.

Name: Lyle Whitlock
Character Sheet Link: [I hope for a World free of the Arcana](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1NSaHZa4imX5QuTVOQ-_Xx1yjzHYmPjDMwwgo4MUqwmQ/edit?usp=drive_link)
Class List: Tinkerer 10 | Wayfarer 10 | Rogue 10 | Gourmet 1 | Guardian 1 | Weapon Master 1
Physical Description:
162 cm (5'4") tall, young, effeminate-presenting person. They have short, dark brown hair and sharp violet eyes that shift between guarded and expressive. Clad in dark tactical gear under a white medic’s jacket, their outfit is accented by a red scarf, the standard Gnosis academy shield plate, and a gloves with grappling hook

Whilst at downtime he wears his Gnosis academy uniform, wearing a red scarf and an emblem of the House of Paladins.
Story Summary:
- Lyle was born in Heartdom to a family of Couriers and has a robot companion, Vial, from Steelbin, who loves exploring the Reflections of Lilith.  

- Vial met Lyle while Lyle was making deliveries and being chased by a monster. Lyle trapped the monster under debris, saving Vial.  

- A Warden, impressed by Lyle’s quick thinking, recommended that he enroll at Gnosis.  

- Lyle’s parents approved, though hesitantly, and he joined Gnosis after finishing his deliveries.  

- Vial, rebellious and independent, enrolled at Gnosis without their parent's knowledge.  

- After 3 years of studying, Lyle discovered his body couldn’t channel any magic.  

- He joined the Remedial class to uncover why and to support Vial, who sought distance from their family.

-Since his first match in the tournament they've gained a boost in  their confidence. Portraying themselves as a more confident and capable Field Savant.

Name: Lynne-4
Class List: Weaponmaster 10, Fury 10, Arcanist 10, Tinkerer 5, Martial Artist 4, Loremaster 10, Rider 1
Physical Description: Lynne is a sturdily built, wild looking woman, with a mane of untamed indigo hair, and a mouth full of sharp fangs. She wears a custom fitted Terran bodysuit underneath heavy plates of armor, which she often repurposes into brutal weaponry.
Related Arcana:
Vanagandr(Bound)
Lillith(Bound)
The Liberator(Tubulcain, Bound)
Adam(Lillith, Bound)
The Explicator(Revelation, Tubalcain)
Story Summary:
- Born in Steelbin on Kaiway, Lynne-4 and her family were governmental intermediaries, in charge of management and logistics of resources in their area

- During a trip outside of a civilized zone, Lynne was separated from her group during an ambush, and was left to wander and fend for herself, until she was found by a paladin and their regalia, who recommended her to Gnosis Academy

- After three years of attendance, Lynne was consigned to the remedial class, and sent to the Worldhelm to grow stronger alongside the goldhearted and her fellow classmates

Name: Lyrric Dust
Physical Description: Lyrric stands at around 5'6" with a slender build. Usually found in a comfortable robe with a high collar to keep the wind off some of his face. He does have a scar that travels down the left side of his face that seems to be from a burn or claw.
Quirks: A Steadfast Desire-Staff [WLP+WLP] +1(100z) [HR + 7] Dark(100z), Antistatus (Dazed) (500z),  FLAW:Due to the indirect connection with the Desire Stone when Lyric or those around him make requests of what they desire it may manifest in their most literal sense of the matter
Rare Equipment: Feather of the Serpent-Elemental Rebuke
Story Summary:
*Travelled with his family and helped train magical beast as mounts and work forces.
*Deserters from an army turned bandits attacked while they were on the road. During the attack Lyric desperately prayed for help and Something answered.
-This Gifted him his Elementalist powers and gave him his staff.
-The deal meant he would be called on in the future by said power.
*He left to travel the world so that any stigma of him being a "warlock" as his magic was not really his, would not stay attached to his family or the lively hood.
*During his travels he was caught in storm near the Runewall and the winds forced him and his mount through.

Name: Lyssa 🪄
Physical Description: Slightly above average height, dressed modestly, brown hair/fur, tail usually concealed
Rare Equipment:
Accessory: Heart of Entropy [Spell Splash]
Armor: Wampum of a Bygone Era	[Soothing]
Weapons: 
- Crystal Ball of Aqueous Restoration [Memorize (Heal)]
- Baleful Voodoo Doll [Magic Up]
Story Summary:
- A Lerisin that practices Anima as a Shaman by learning from the forest spirits of Rocadian
- As the spirits began to go mad through the calamity, a morbid curiosity leaned practices into Thauma 
- Despite the spirits of the forest going mad and being more violent, has a fascination with possible strength that chaos can bring
- Wants to protect her homeland and believes chaos must meet chaos to restore order with the spirts
- Desires to explore and study other places and magic
- Has a heroic bond with Franz Alberic

Name: Mabilis Na'ulan
Physical Description: An old man who's appearance is hides his true age, Mabilis stands at 6'1 with an athletics build, bearded with a disheveled head of grey hair held up by a headband. He wears light clothing covered in a heavy cloak dyed a blue reminiscent of the ocean, a style recognized easily as that of a martial artist hailing from Tian Yin. His face is deep set with scars and wrinkles alike, but Mabilis often wears a smile despite the clear toll the life of a cultivator has taken.
Story Summary:
- Cultivator who trained in secret alongside two other students under a surviving master of the war against heaven, Ghatu Na'alon
- Fought against corrupt cultivators and spirit beasts in his youth during his training
- One of the other students turned to corrupt cultivation in the hopes of gaining power to change the world more quickly
- His master was slain by his fellow student, who was his best friend
- He and Alab, the grandfather of the yet-to-be-born Hiya Salamin, went on to chase down their traitorous friend for years.
- Upon finding them, they were both defeated, Mabilis survived only due to their past friendship, while Alab died refusing to accept mercy.
- With a broken cultivation base, Mabilis spent a long time recovering, eventually finding Gan-Gan at the base of Mt. Magayon and learning to once again cultivate from the old spirit beast
- He would later come to become a local healer, and eventually mentor Panlinggo Umaga as an older master who might provide some guidance.

Name: Madhuri Somasundaram
Origin: Tian Yin, Bahata Khajaana, Little Lantern
Physical Description:
Madhuri stands 5'10", or 178cm. Her frame is slight, pear-shaped, with very long legs... Which resemble that of a chicken, scaled from the knee down, with ankles resembling reversed knees and ending in very large feet. She wears fitted metal claws for use in combat.

She wears baggy, concealing clothing; not out of shame of her scales and feathers, but simply because she likes how she can move around in it. Her hands are also scaly, and end in claws, fairly blunted by work. She likes flower motifs.

She has long hair, which she tends to put up in a high ponytail. *(It's not nearly as much as in the picture.)* With very pale skin and white hair, Madhuri is noticeably albino; her eyes are even fully red, rather than the normal colors in human albinism. At home, though, it's not particularly remarked on. Few colors are exactly *unusual* for demonkin, after all.
Story Summary:
* Madhuri is a demonkin born in the underground city of Little Lantern in the Bahata Rajanate.

* Impulsive but stubborn, learned to be a fire cultivator.

* Impatient, chomping at the bit to somehow help: Hunt down dangerous spirit beasts, or resist the Maharaja's soldiers somehow, or defend a smaller village, or something.

* Encountered Goldhearted in Little Lantern, surprised and awed when they told her who they were and resolved to help them on their task: Preventing the assassination of the Demon Prince of metal, Dayaram.

* Upon visiting Dayaram, however, the aqra The Pale turned its attention to her and she fell prey to its words, the promise of glory, and lowered inhibitions. She challenged Dayaram to a fight, and attacked with more power than ever before. Eventually, the Goldhearted intervened and pulled her away before either could get hurt. She was ashamed, but Dayaram held no grudge.

* Soon found herself in a Realmstorm and on the Worldhelm. Wait, _she's_ Goldhearted?

Name: Mae Lavery
Physical Description: Mae is a young woman who stands at 5'8". She normally wears a bit of an angry expression when she is in thought or not actually speaking, which things then quickly change to a smile and she gives off a more upbeat energy. She skin is pale and her eyes read giving clear signs of insolvency to those who are familiar with it. Her normal attire would be a bit punkish in style.
Story Summary:
- Born and raised in Babyl City in Dawnstar Valley.
- Raised by a single father who worked in one of the manufacturing plants ran by Tubal & Cain
- Proved to accel academically and skipped a grade during school where she befriended Alec Lyon, who was a grade below her.
- Preferring to do engineering work Mae had an aptitude for working with explosives and eventually started doing work for T&C
- Moved in with Alec to help keep bills easier to manage, and shared an apartment. The two eventually formed a romantic relationship.
- Does Temp work to give field demonstrations of T&C explosives.
- About a year ago while working with an experimental explosive in her lab, something went wrong leading to an explosion that claimed Mae's life, but due to debt from research this lead to her being brought back as an insolvent.
- Using her unique explosives she was able to help clear and break down many of the rocks the fell during the Skyfall, leading to her being taken by the ship as a Goldhearted.

Name: Mafqud Gazzlan
Physical Description: slender man, about 5'4"/164cm tall, almost always wears a skeleton mask (which is easily recognizable as such), carries a cabinet on his back
Quirks: Heirloom (Accessoire: The Cabinet of Lost Things)
Story Summary:
His family was in the business of guiding people to the Ruins of Ista and also through the insides, at least those that were somewhat safe. 

When Mafqud inherited an artifact from his Grandpa, a cabinet he found inside the ruins, Mafqud had to flee, as this cabinet was magical and he didnt want to be branded. 

The Cabinet attracts things people lose and other random trinkets - a side business of his family Mafqud never thought too much about before he knew where they were coming from. 

He fled, posing as travelling peddler to avoid persecution but still was almost caught - receiving the call saved him.

Name: Magnum Opus Resbina
Physical Description: 5'10" | 200~ lbs. | Porcelain Skin w/ Black Sclera (One with Golden Iris). Break Over Left Eye.
Story Summary: A creation of the secretive Puerluna, the Magnum Opus Resbina is a homunculus born of moonstone who has since escaped his makers and now journeys to explore the world, and any others he can find.

Name: Mahuizoh
Physical Description: 5'10, wiry muscle, blind, tattooed up
Quirks: Heirloom (Some evil people in Aranova are on his ass)
Rare Equipment: Ouroboros (custom weapon)
Story Summary:
* A wandering exorcist following the path of finality, worked with other like-minded nomad exorcists
* An unknown, great evil was discovered
* Exorcist gang decided to seal it away
* The sealing ritual was interrupted by an unknown faction, most of those exorcists died
* The great evil ended up sealed in Risata (other PC)
* Now job is act as guard/warden combo for Risata
* Fell in love after a long time of that, now looking for solutions to the great evil situation

Name: Mako Torres
Class List: Daoist 6/ Weapon Master 4/ Martial Artist 10/ Guardian 3
Physical Description: Standing at about 5'9 with a very twinkish build, he's wrapped in bandages and has scarfs surrounding his neck and waist. He has brown hair dark brown eyes and emits this balanced energy of light and dark.
Quirks:
Death Root Physique
Your body has been reconstructed by the god of Death, drastically altering your affinities to qi. You gain Absorption to dark; additionally, whenever you deal damage of a type other than physical, that damage automatically becomes dark and its damage type cannot be changed nor lost (this effect has priority over any other rule in the game). However, you are also Vulnerable to light.


You also gain the ability to perform Death Rituals of the Arcanist discipline (use WLP/WLP for the check). The Vulnerability granted by this Quirk cannot be altered or overwritten by Qualities, or by Skills that grant you permanent Resistance (such as the Dark Blood Skill or the Glass Resistance Quality).
Story Summary:
- Descendant of the Goldhearted Iroh Torres
- Studied and trained in the ancient technique of
memory cultivation
- Was hidden within Kuliling Village
- Village was destroyed by Mabisa's Forces

Name: Mara Zofia Jedvaj
Physical Description: A wild and scruffy looking woman in her mid 40s, with long unkempt hair, and a lanky frame that hides a surprising amount of muscle. Dressed in comfortable clothes, somewhere in between city wear and outdoors attire, and always with her signature round crimson glasses she claims let her see magic better.
Story Summary:
Born in Veryhold Myist and grows up as a bit of delinquent to a family selling and repairing crank cars.

Gets into a whirlwind romance with a werewolf, unknowing of her nature until she one night lost control even just for a second. She was saved by the SIA, and begged for her partner to be saved. She was, but was sent out of the city, joining a heretic group.

Mara for her part, now knowing of the unseen world, joins the SIA, and bounces around the different departments for a few years, until she settles as a werewolf liason for the DSE.

She has spent many years with werewolves, learning their ways, traditions, ways of suppression and magic.

Name: Marcus Robinson
Physical Description: A scarred 6 ft man with blond hair, he keeps a nice suit despite his rough apperance. His bare back has a scracthed out tattoo of the Goldnails
Story Summary:
- Born in the poorer areas of North Rock and lost his family during childhood, Marcus was took under his wing by an expereinced Goldnail to be brought into the family.

- Was unable to afford any martial weapons or proper training so  Marcus relied on his fist, training and using them on various jobs to the point he did not need other weapons

- He saw the Goldnails as new form of family in his teenage and young adult years gleefuly taking on missions to prove himself earning the title of "Goldnail's Fist" when he offically joined the Goldnails

- While the year goes on by Marcus started to notice the corruption that runs rampant in the crime family which he had ignored due to blind faith until an extortion job went wrong in which he took a bullet for a hostage with the remaining Goldnails leaving him behind.

- The hostage ended up being an 100G asset which thanks to their explanation of the scene granted Marcus a path he did not think would get after so many years, one of redemption.

Name: Mari
Physical Description: A man with a thin, but muscular build. Blue eyes and brown hair that partially covered his face. Carrying scars across his entire body. Around 180 CM tall, and weighing 71 KGs.
Rare Equipment:

Reaper's Baseball bat (HR+9 fire, Finisher)
Invisible hand (HR+8 light, Extra Range)
Anti-Avian Knuckle (HR+8 ice, Extra Range)
Sakura's Pipe (HR+6 physical, Boastful)

**Armor:**
Mountain-Blessed Hoodie (1/2, Beggar's Luck)

Cyclone Wristband (Damage change Air)

Name: Mari and Mori
Origin: The Silent Jester of Kingdom Road
Physical Description:
Mari is a 4'8'' girl wearing baggy mismatched patchy clothing. She has jesters cap on her head with a pair of red striped horns that rests over her messily cut hair. She weighs about 80 lbs, and is built like it. She walks with a dance to her step and never speaks. Inside her collar is the stitched name `Mari`.

Mori is a pink dog-mouthed stuffed toy, with patchy spots where holes have been filled. They're soft, and smell like an attic. They have heterochromatic button eyes, and are stuffed with something that feels akin to wool. Though, squeezing them reveals the metal bones that fill them, and the warm crystal at the center of their chest. Inside his collar is the stitched name `Mori`.

Name: Maria
Physical Description: Dresses in relaxed comfortable clothing, t-shirts, skirts, ect., long read hair with purple eyes that almost seem to shimmer. Has spiked horns as an augment. Once in character however into a black dress with with murrey colored material on the underside and edges that seem to smolder paired with a jacket with black sleeves and gloves that have a harmless heatless flame around the wrist.
Story Summary:
- Lost place of residence and employment during the events of Skyfall.
- While searching for new work to be able to pay the bills stumbled upon a job listing for SWORD.
- Mistook the listing as just running and action on a social media account for a character created by - SWORD.
- Had a history of being in fights and the ability to use some magic.
- SWORD found reports of her abilities and police records of fights, which helped her actually become a good candidate.
- Got the job and became part of a SWORD TEMP group called EntroPRISIM who act like a magical girl team for entertainment reasons while handling proper jobs.
- Took on the role of "Flare Gem Phixia" as part of the EntroPRISM Squad
- Loathes her current employment but is stuck with a long-term contract she doesn't have a good way out of. Despite this she plays her character well.
- Is always thankful when work is out of the way of public eye and she can drop the character act and really let loose with her true feelings.

Name: Maria "Sabuesa" Irene
Physical Description:
5'4" foot tall woman, auburn eyes and brown hair. She often wears a relatively heavy dress with many frills, black gloves, black boots, and a large jacket she often keeps wrapped around herself.

In addition to a couple other accessories, such as her hat.
Quirks:
The Thinning - Spell: Stop

Unique Weakness: Away From Home? - Maria is always used to being within the dark and isolated from others. When in areas of bright light or large crowds her mind falters and begins to create delusions of darkness from anything shadowy or suspicious. When this happens, paranoia overtakes her emotions, making her act irrationally as if she is being hunted or should be on the hunt
Rare Equipment:
- Crimson Purification ✦ (Firearm) | Quality: N/A

- Colorless Midnight (Accessory) | Quality: Nature's Pulse
Story Summary:
- Respected Officer in Ashreach, as well as in the Investigations Branch of Veyrhold

- Often found at night times, doing patrols or in scenes of various crimes. Shootouts are common if she's around so, people stay wary

- To some her presence is a bit unnerving, to others not so much. Strange, but unexplainable to most

- Any from the SIA would know about her work within the DMI as an on field investigator, though she has tensions with them. Most her friends are from the DSC

Name: Marlo - ᵀʰᵉ Deadweight
Physical Description:
An athletic and loudmouthed 5'9 shark merfolk. 
His Regalia form is that of a 6'0 tall steel anchor. It sometimes gets covered in ice.
Story Summary:
- Abandoned his loanshark family while young, and worked dangerous jobs
- Enrolled at Gnosis dared and helped by a friend, Edgard
- Became a Regalia and partnered with Edgard for over a year
- On his second year, made a scene at the Rite of Binding with him and broke it

Name: Marzanna
Physical Description:
Marzanna is a strange, solemn young woman standing at a mere 5'2" with stringy, pale-white hair and worn, heterochromatic eyes. Her abnormal frame quickly gives the impression of a possessed doll, her movements stiff and uncanny and her breathing eerie in its irregularity. Upon closer inspection, one can notice the strips of patchwork flesh and synthetic skin keeping her body together. Most notably, her shadow is unnaturally stark, and bears the distinct outline of a monstrous wolf.
Despite her off-putting nature, Marzanna acts rather polite and cordial in conversation. She possesses a unique mannerism and etiquette that captivates the attention of most she speaks to, one that's combined and contrasted with a curious, almost naive outlook toward her environment.
Story Summary:
* Served as a vessel for the Aesir Vanagandr under the Black Wolf Warband of Aldistir.
* Followed one clear purpose: Enact the cycle of death, exorcise that which should not exist.
* Eventually, realizes that she is being used as a weapon, begins to change and self-actualize.
* Bonds with her companion, Fenrir, another effigy of Vanagandr imbued in her shadow.
* Breaks away and becomes a wanderer, acting as a conduit for the cycles of change and death.

Name: Matilda Shaw
Physical Description:
Matilda is not outwardly an intimidating woman. She is commonly smiling, standing an average 5'5. She is often wearing a lovely suit jacket on her shoulders with a very femme blouse and long skirt. By all accounts, surely she is normal.

Well. "Normal." In battle, she seems to channel dark energies that physically change her. Long horns grow out of her head, and that normal smile becomes more than a little sadistic. As if she is... enjoying the suffering being caused.
Story Summary:
Born to the Shaw family, a perfectly normal family in Brindlewatch.
Always talked to what she called imaginary friends. Her parents assumed she was just an odd girl. None really knew that she was talking to a creature of the Black.
One day, while traveling to Veyrhold with her parents, creatures of the Black assaulted the trolley they were on. Her parents pushed her to flee, and she fled until an SIA operative found and protected her.
The agent brought her to an SIA facility, where they initially were just studying her connection to the Black. This eventually, though, turned into splicing experiments where a particularly unscrupulous agent began splicing her with a gargoyle. These efforts largely failed, but she did end up with a pair of eerie horns from the experimentation.
The agent was eventually found out, and she was set free.
In that aftermath, she joined the SIA officially.
On a routine mission, she is realmstormed.

Name: Max Unicron
Physical Description: Max is a 6' tall man with a slender build, a kind face, and kind demeanor. He is usually seen with a smile on his face, and a spring in his step. He often wears frivolous clothes (though that's just to garner attention for the fledgling card game... right?)
Story Summary:
- Max was born in Haven, grew up wanting to make a game anyone could enjoy
- Went to college for business, but graduated as a Game Developer
- Approached SWORD about a potential new game idea
- Their R&D dept. gave him experimental AR + Hardlight technology that lets him physically manifest the creatures in his game

Name: Max Volume
Physical Description: Max is seldom seen without his exosuit on- most people never getting to witness the face beneath. He stands at a somewhat imposing 6'2'', usually wearing some manner of coat or suit over his armor, and on some occasions, is accompanied by rather loud music blaring from a set of speakers that seem integrated into the apparatus.
Rare Equipment: Rare Accessory (Heirloom); Quality: Accuracy Up
Story Summary:
A life in North Rock came with its challenges, especially for an older brother such as Max. Born as the eldest of three children, it would always fall on his shoulders to keep his younger siblings out of harm's way in the dark alleyways of his home district. Being conditioned to endure hardship from such a young age, both his body and his resolve would be tempered as steel in a forge.

In his later years, in a bid to protect his family and the rest of his community, he would join the reformed Saitos, acquire a TEMP license, and get his hands on his signature exosuit. It was during his activity within the gang that he managed to recover a decades old neural implant dating back to the Baylore Company days, a veritable relic that served to enhance his combative capabilities even further.

Alas, as luck would have it, while on a mission in the deserts of central, he was swept up by a realmstorm, and his traces were lost...

Name: Maxilos
Physical Description: Maxilos is clearly spotted by the tear in their left cheek exposing their teeth. They're 5'10"and gaunt, with very pale skin with an almost greenish tint. They tend to dress in Sturdy workers clothes or on rare occasions very dark suits. They also tend to wear masks that cover their mouth.
Rare Equipment:
Lunar Talon

Arcane ◆ Two-Handed ◆ Melee ◆ Damage dealt by spells you cast with a total MP cost equal to or lower than 20 ignores Immunities and Resistances.
Story Summary: Maxilos is an Insolvent for the ETA acting as a consultant on more magic oriented matters and security. Outside of that their past is unknown, the only clue being the extensive damage done to their body that either was to great for the ETA to fully fix or that the ETA didn't care to fix...

Name: Maximilian
Physical Description: A lightly armored and fairly tall green haired young man.
Story Summary:
- Born in a Military family from Merrane, specifically the Wall.
- Raised to be a hardline believer of Merrane propaganda.
- Believe hardened further from living at the Wall and seeing the Colossi.
- One day transferred as part of war effort against KPLA and as test pilot for prototype magitech, an Exoskeleton.
- The war against KPLA causes him to doubt.
- Doubt intensifies after the easy abandonment of Pikeway and their citizen.
- Doubt reaches its peak when Prince Damian defected.
- Feels lost
- Doesn't know if what he believed in is right or wrong anymore
- Results in running away with the prototype Exoskeleton to try reaching Suntower City
- That's when he found himself in Worldhelm

Name: Maxwell
Class List:
Lvl 1 Pilot
Lvl 4 Tinkerer
lvl 3 Sharpshooter
Physical Description:
-164 cm/5'5" in height.
-light green hair with dark green ends, resembling a leek.
-Legs and left arm are cybernetic. Head, right arm, and torso (lower torso half burned) still natural.
-Horns are curled.
-Green eyes.
Rare Equipment:
Humming Bird T90 SMG Maxwell Use  (1350) - Multi
Targeting Red Dot Sight  (500) - Efficient Barrage
Story Summary:
A self taught roboticist who thrived in Babyl City. At a very young age, she was very fond of robots and machineries to the point where she finds joy in recreating most of what she sees through trial and error, and a few books she either found or borrowed.,
Given how useful her intellect and proficiency with machinery is, she was given a job at the Steeldome Facility.,
She gets caught in an accident during a test run that rapture her legs, and left arm while searing her lower body at the same time.,
Maxwell would later be outfitted with cybernetics of her own design. She can only feel what's left of her torso and right arm. She still struggles with the off feeling she has wish her current body.,
Maxwell owns an old, run-down cargo aircraft she bought and modified to her needs to transport equipment and cargo easier.,
While transporting her exosuit she bought from the Zhuanli Union, she was caught by the Realmstorm before making her way to the Worldhelm in a nick of time.

Name: May Shuggar
Physical Description: Pale skin, freckles, dyed hair, unnaturally pink eyes, relatively short

Name: Mei Takamaki
Physical Description:
A taller than average, bewitching woman. She carries herself with a stern expression while at work, as if walking with a consistent barrier to entry around her.

But beyond that stern expression, lies a hidden passion that loves to talk about history and chronicle it for future generations. Despite her professional demeanor, she is a very outward and positive person.

Outside of her combat uniform, she wears a white blouse and a tight pencil skirt, paired with black nylon pantyhose and high heels. She cares greatly about her appearance, almost to a model-like sense, much to contrast with her mother, who couldn't care less.

She transforms into her combat uniform using a device, instantly donning a skin-tight vinyl dark blue bodysuit with glowing blue power cords stretching across her body, powering her weapon systems as well as regulating her body's condition.
Rare Equipment: N/A
Story Summary:
- A Soulrunner operating as Tubal and Cain's living weapon. 
- Mei is a former adventurer recruited by T&C for her combat prowess and esper qualities, participating in a secret experiment that enhanced her abilities. 

- They equipped her with new experimental weapons technology, which allows her to transform into a new bodysuit uniform and morph her arms into various armaments. (Mutant and Akromorphosis)
- Along with materializing digital beings to assist her in combat (how I'm flavoring Therioforms). 

- Long family legacy, known for long military service and engineering. A line of adventurers that  participate in defending against monster attacks.

- Right now, Mei lives a lavish life in Vacation City and does missions for T&C. But feels restrained due to their control and seeks a life of adventure and to chronicle knowledge.

Name: Mei-Mei
Character Sheet Link: [Thirteen Unique Wonders! Full Score Limit Break : 777! Pay Up Chump~!](<https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1ggHEFxJyNPEL-rq9S7dsT0y4fXpPas84jlYPTP58P2U/edit?usp=sharing>)
Class List: Ace of Cards (★) | Entropist (3) | Wayfarer (3) | Elementalist (3)
Physical Description: Mei-Mei is a 5'8" Vanara girl with an incredibly light and nimble frame. With every step, she carries a natural, floral-toned scent of wild berries, matcha, and ginkgo leaves. Her hues of pink and purple clothes and fur ribbon downward and compliment her light brown skin.
Rare Equipment:
Accessory: House's Cards
Armor: Eggshell Stockings
Shield: Terran Auto-Table
Story Summary:
Mei-Mei is the twin sister of Lei-Lei. She grew up with him under a cool old man she calls "Gong-Gong." He taught her how to fish, how to fight, and most importantly, how to play mahjong. She vows to be able to beat him in a game one day, and to do so (but also cause she was bored) she leaves to go on an adventure with her brother. After making one funny chaos formation, they end up in some trouble.

Thankfully, a realmstorm saved the day! :D

Name: Meira Sarasti
Physical Description:
Around 5 feet 9 inches tall, she wears casual clothing for someone from Terra, her hair kept in a double bun with smaller framed circular glasses worn never hiding her red eyes.

She carries an umbrella and a shoulder bag with her at all times, but never actually openly armed.
Rare Equipment: Urban Explorer's Garb (Armor) - Exotic Explorer
Story Summary:
- Born in Helios, though moved to Haven

- Runs Sarasti Debt Collection in North Rock

- Offers her services to Gangs & Criminal Organizations on the side as well, seen as a brutal Debt Collector who uses time to extract her price

Name: Mel
Physical Description:
Mel stands at a moderate height, around 1,75 cm. A dense high ponytail, woven with an intricate braid, showcases her striking yellowish orange hair, resembling that of a lion. Her brown eyes bear sparkling traces of yellow, showing to the future a bright view with optimism. 

She dresses in hot and sunny colors, which complement the looks of her hair and the little but furry tail on her back. Those colors exhibit her liveliness and her bright, positive view in life.

Name: Melinda Monroe
Physical Description:
Melinda is a slim, tall and sharply dressed female human from Terra. Her white hair is often arranged in a high ponytail with little hair streaks by the side, hiding the handles of her round reading glasses she sometimes puts to good use.

Her style is often high class, usually sporting a black tie as a habit from her monster hunting days at Parabellum.
Rare Equipment:
- **SEVERANCE, THE NEGATIVE EDGE WEAPON (N.E.W)** 
> A sword-type N.E.W created specifically for Mel back in her prime, when these were less regulated. These are dangerous and unstable pieces of technology that can go through through any material. They must be kept in special containers, or will degrade all matter around them. When used, it leaves a negative energy trail that can be detected by high tier magic or tech. Their existence is secretive, their creation is closely regulated by the Prime Corporations, and some percieve them as portable nukes.
Story Summary:
- Monsters Hunter for PARABELLUM ever since young.
- Rose quickly through the ranks because of efficieny and morals.
- Got married late in life and decided to stop working at 50 years old.
- Spent the last 10 years in love, but then wife died.
- Widowed, became just a rich old lady.
- At 62 years old, got called for one last job by an old linker to save a Goldhearted, and then joined the ship.
- Old friend from the job, probably the last one, Marilyn, died to help the Goldhearted.

Name: Melinda Valentine
Physical Description: Melinda stands at 6'4" with pale skin and slender figure. Her short hair and eyes are white, a pair of fuzzy antennae sprouting from her head. She is often accompanied by a swarm of moths attracted to her like a flame.
Story Summary:
- Born to a noble family in Caldera to parents that controlled her life. Left her family on bad terms to start a life as an anti war activist in Hidela.

- While working as an activist she met a thief that would become her husband.

- She has a child, and slowly falls out of doing activism wanting to raise her child without worrying. Before she could quite she was captured by Merrani soldiers.

- While under Merrani control she was experimented on, her body mind and soul fused with a colossus. This gave her strange new abilities that she used to escape form her captors.

Name: Melinoe
Physical Description: A woman, with long tangled grey hair on her head that hangs down to her lower back. Her face is fair, and always emotionless. Her skin nearly snow white and pale, it even glistens a little like freshly fallen snow. The dress she wears a black combat dress with a short skirt with white frills. The black blindfold around her face is lacy and likely wouldn't block sight at all if she could see. A small cape wraps around her shoulder, that flutters around her.
Story Summary:
Before Melinoe was born, the Village of Morde was under attack by a powerful Winter Fey called Meillath who wanted control of the town. The people, in desperation, made a deal with the fey, promising “All the love and joy they would have, and every wonderful sight they would ever see” of the next baby born in the village. In return Meillath would instead protect the village from other fey hoping to claim it and leave its inhabitants alone.

Melinoe was born with her sight taken by the fey, and the inability to feel any positive emotion. She had no last name, as she was in essence the savior of the village and claimed by all... and none of them. Growing up a pseudo outcast, when she was old enough she left to wander Kor’tarion rather than stay in a village. There she met wandering fey, and was taken in by them until ending up on the Worldhelm.

Name: Melissa Reina
Physical Description: Melissa is a tall, curvaceous woman with the pale complexion, red eyes and fangs typical of the Insolvent. She favours high-class tailored outfits, switching between sharp suits and elegant dresses on a whim, each framing her long, raven black hair. She moves with the grace of someone born to power, her posture flawless, her steps measured, her body commanding the room, yet there is a warmth in her low, silken voice that leaves them wondering whether the cold, corporate monster is real outside of the exterior.
Rare Equipment:
Credit Pull
While at 0FP, gain 2 interest weariness and 1 FP
Story Summary:
- A budding Chequeromancer in training and one of ETA’s most fanatical supporters, Melissa gave everything to the cause, even opting to volutarily enter insolvency to prove to herself and to other that it was the way forward. 
- As one of the biggest up and coming soulrunners and her skillset into Chequeromancy, wealth came easily, and her insolvency almost became a null-issue. This left her with a broken view of insolvency, seeing it as simple and easily manageable, no matter what others said. 
- Though she clung to her beliefs, she was swept up onto the Worldhelm, some say just weeks before her point of no return, before she became a corporate monster like so many others. 
- Now she stands at the precipice, at the edge between her blind faith in the ETA propaganda and the cold realities of corporate life. Perhaps there are more out there willing to invest in such a “great opportunity” to become the best version of themselves, just as she still believes.

Name: Merrick Wolfsgar
Physical Description: Merrick is a taller blonde human man with hazel eyes and a Godblood infection spreading across his body. Some simple tattoos are visible from under his armor: celtic knots and valknuts alike.  His stature is sturdy, but less so than the typical Ald warrior's, even before considering his infection.
Rare Equipment: N/A
Story Summary: Faithful Vanagandr Runemage loses best friend in battle to Godsblood rain, becomes infected himself while ending his bloodbrother's torment.  Film at 11.

Name: Mervei Retz-Yiloğan
Physical Description:
Mervei is a dark tan-skinned young woman with curly brown hair and sharp, dark eyes. Her armor is of fine make, gold-toned and filigreed and worn atop a muscled figure. She often wields a spear in hand, utilized with deadly power and practice.

Rhauzaten is a heavy-set drake with scales the color of rust, arched horns, and massive wings. His tail is thick and deadly, heavily scaled at the end with protruding spines and built to be swung as a lethal weapon. His four legs are stocky with thick claws. There is a perpetual scent of salty sea about him, and... well, blood.
Story Summary:
- Grew up fishing with her father in Atreus
- Sea monster killed her father, and in the event she was rescued and taken in by the knights of Daermon
- Became a squire, and eventually was given the opportunity to have a dragon hatchling to imprint on her, Rhauzaten
- Grew as knights, protecting the triangle surrounding the Great Drak Nest
- When the call went out to storm the Runewall, she followed it with Rhauzaten, insisting on her place there despite her inexperience.

Name: Metzli
Physical Description:
A young woman with brown skin and dark hair, she is decorated with fins and gills. She has softness to her that allows most to read her emotions that are written across her face.
She is often languid and hold some moisture to her skin.
Story Summary:
- The eldest daughter from a coven member, she showed promise and connection before one of the last acts Lorelei did in person was claim her to be her successor.

- Was raised mostly secluded, only having been visited by Lorelei her toddler years before Itzel took over her studies.

- Once she entered young adulthood, she was tasked with learning from her the other coven members. So acting as a student, she joined in being one of the students who make the Hermandad de las Estrallas.

Name: Michael Adder
Physical Description: Large 6'7" man, typically dressed in a hat and trenchcoat and usually reading a newspaper. Stony-faced and tends to speak in short sentences.
Story Summary:
- Born in the Kígyó tribe, raised to be one of the Shapers
- Later joined the heretics and learned of the Forbidden Research, wanted to investigate theories on werewolves further
- Went to visit Ashreach to find information, took to living on the outskirts for his own salvaging
- At some point, found a discarded work harness and refurbished it to be used for protection, also incorporated silver elements to it to further restrain his transformation

Name: Mika Uhara
Physical Description:
A tall woman with Green hair. Her professional clothing is always worn exceptionally loose. Very rarely seen without a cigarette in her mouth.

She wields a weapon near twice her size like it was nothing. It is very concerning.
Story Summary:
"* Born as a test tube baby. Biological parents unknown.
* Experimented on as a child to create a perfect soldier.
* Was one of ten children to survive trialing. Considered too head strong and anti authoritative to be sold to 100g or the like (plus Chihiro Uhara, the chief scientist, took a liking to her)
* Instead was given limited freedoms on the basis of becoming a Tester and Agent for RWO and other SWORD properties.
* Chihiro adopted her officially to give her cover and be able to properly supply her with Identification.
* Began playtesting new RWO expansions. Showed a penchant with her Swordsmanship and use of SWORD proprietary technology. Started being used for lower level raid testing.
* It was during an RWO playtest, in fact, that she was ripped from her pod by a realm storm*

Name: Mikael Everest
Class List:
Malefactor 10 🐺
Arcanist 10 💎
Spiritist 4 💖
Ace of Cards 7 🃏
Loremaster 2 📖
Physical Description: A young Looking Rat Demihuman standing at 5'0 wearing either a casual looking dress or their mages robes and a hat, they have a deck of tarot cards in which depict the previous incarnations of the cecrae that blessed them when they woke up. They have black hair, fairish skin and a black rat tail that they use to carry things around. When Casting Mikael summons weapons and or entities via his arcanum cards that help harm or even heal members of the party.

Weapons:

- Antikythera's Timekeeper (See Sheet or Hudal Shop)
Accessory:

- Mulligan Acessory (See Sheet)
Related Arcana:
Antikythera - Blessed by a Cecrae to avoid their death

Vanagandr - Creation of Vanagandr from Kortarion
Story Summary:
- Was found in the middle of a field near the Broken Vortex
- Adopted by Professor Everest after the roamed and Arrived near Hudal
- Now studies at Hudal Academy
- Is now in their last year and about to graduate from the Academy
- Made the Radiant Archives the local library on the Worldhelm
- Was part of the 50 Goldhearted that had gone against Loftur
- Got engaged to his boyfriend J'yuto before they died
- Now continues the work of their dead lover by helping others find their way through the realms and by being a Hero
- Recently recovered and let go of their dead lover's soul to rest but in doing so they were left with the last vestiges of their power, The Pale Heart.

Name: Mikail Arlae
Physical Description: He is a dark blue haired guy, with white skin and generally using pirate robes over his armor, his heights can be called short just being 5.5 feet, you can say he has an aura similar to that of a wise old man.
Story Summary:
* Mikail was born in Sandsailor's city
* At young age he got interest for books
* Being a human in Nezmira his access to books was short
* Having no more options he started to steal them
* Quickly his talent for stealing was recognized by a group of pirates with the promise of giving him food and books he was recruited in a crew
* years passed and he was captured
* He lied about being the captain as thanks for his captain help giving her less time in jail
* When he became 19 he was placed in the execution list
* There, in jail, at few days from his execution, he was transported to a different place, starting his adventure

Name: Mikkel Oaks
Physical Description:
A man with features that do not demand attention, shaped more for passing unnoticed than for being remembered. His bright blue eyes cut through the ordinary, sharper than the rest of him allows, set beneath hair of dulled, dirty gold. His skin is weathered, marked by scars that have long since settled into place. He stands at 5'9, lean but solid, built for endurance rather than display.


His armour is blackened by time and fire, its surface dulled to a scorched, lightless sheen. Scrapes and cuts run across it without care for symmetry, layered and old, never repaired. Dents remain where they were struck, edges worn from use. It is not pristine, not renewed, it has endured, and it shows the brutality through its creation.
Story Summary:
- Mikkel grew up poor, hunting rabbits, foxes, and other small game. However, he could not afford a bow and arrows so he hunted with a wooden dagger.
- His home, Yorme, was attacked by Merrane when he was 9.
- His entire family was killed, or they escaped and he will never find them.
- Mikkel was imprisoned by Merrane, shortly moved to the Great Monastery.
- Mikkel learned how to clean, cook, and fight from his mentor and the scholar Thorne.
- He ignored his mentor and went into the forbidden part of the library, learning Necromancy.
- Learning Necromancy was a part of his downfall. 3 years after reading these books, he became Grave-born.
- The Necromancy books that were locked away were, because they messed with the person both physically and mentally.
- These books messed with his mind so badly, that he thought Thorne could not teach him anything anymore and left the Monastery.
- Mikkel was given the option to go back home, in Lhodos, or stay on the Worldhelm. He chose the Worldhelm,

Name: Milo Fleiss
Class List:
- Pilot [10]
- Sharpshooter [10]
- Guardian [10]
- Arcanist [3]
- Chimerist [3]

Physical Description: Milo is light skinned man with furred ears and shaggy blonde hair. He stands at 6', 6'2'' with the ears. He's about 180 lbs. of muscle, but isn't the brightest.

Story Summary:
- Milo was born in Hedgeberg to a small family. Aravik and Yvette Fleiss. He was the eldest, with a sister eight years younger than him named Reeve.
- When Milo was 16, his father left to Bastion to work on the ramping production of his design for the Undercity. Aravik was a member of the KPLA, working alongside Angelo Letterman as their earliest chief engineers.
- During that first year, a strike meant to kill both Letterman and Aravik Fleiss, executed Milo's father. In the wake of this, Milo become the man of his house.
- Within the first few years, he snapped at his family. The housework and the many cousins he'd been left to as his uncles and extended family joined the war effort had gotten to him. He had an argument with his mother and sister, then left home.
- He's been a distant caretaker of his family, fighting as a Drake in the KPLA (despite attempts to promote him) since. The Resistance's Ace Courier.

Name: Mithreign the Fourteenth
Physical Description: Towering and regal, with golden scales on his skin and horns circling his head, this is clearly a man of unusual origin. There's a sense of classical noble presence to him somewhere in his thin, aristocratic features, his lofty demeanor or his impeccable dress. He's often cupping a goblet in his palm, and apparently sips from it when in thought.
Quirks: **Outcast Fairy:** Mithreign is fae, demon, or other such weirdling. His power of belief sustains him, as do so many things in the Faerie Realms. ||He believes himself a ruler. Having his authority questioned can trigger a rage or cause him to lash out. He also occasionally has a ravenous desire for salt.||
Story Summary:
* This is the ruler of all demons, fae, flora and fauna. Just ask him and he'll tell you. *He is absolutely certain of this, and you should be too.*
* How or why? Exact titles? These may change but you can always ask him again. He'll tell you. He may be the Grand Duke, a crown prince, an exiled king, or something else. Maybe he's all of them.
* Besides the ruler of all things, Mithreign may have been something else once but his memory may shift or it may just be his words. It's hard to tell these things apart.
* Once, when wandering the lands of humans, Mithreign asked an old drunk makes someone a king. The human looked him in the eye, laughed and shrugged his shoulders. This was a defining moment for Mithreign. That very moment, Mithreign decided he was king. He's not sure what else he is. He changes his mind often.
* Though a Fae from Kor'Tarion, he is quite curious of other realms - and specifically, their kings, rulers, and authorities of varying sorts.

Name: Mitsuhime
Physical Description: A petite woman with white hair, amber eyes and delicate features. Always wearing either priestess's robes or traditional Tei Sei's long sleeved kimono, Mitsuhime has an air of serene grace and a kind expression. If her ethereal aura is not enough to convince you of her youkai heritage, the large white wings on her back certainly will.
Story Summary:
*Born in Sakai as a descendant of one of Amaterasu's emissaries' who fell in love with a human.

*Raised by a small group of people still loyal to the Sun Goddess and was taught healing and cleansing rituals since an early age.

*Was tasked to help safekeeping her community's last remaining sacred sites from evil spirits as well as heal the wounded.

*Mitsuhime is a firm believer the Sun will shine once again and vowed to do her best to keep people's hope alive.

Name: Mizuki
Physical Description: Mizuki is a thin young woman of around 5’2” in height with long straight black hair that falls down to her lower back. Her eyes are a deep crimson that almost seems to glow when she taps into her powers as a medium. Usually she is dressed in Miko robes befitting her current station as a shrine maiden of Izanami.
Story Summary:
Mizuki was left in the Temple of Hotei as a toddler after her family could no longer deal with their daughter’s awakening powers as a medium. This temple taught her to control those powers as well as prepared for her role as a shrine maiden in the future. During this time she still struggled to connect with other normal people, having few friends among the other orphans in the temple.

Later, when she reached her majority, she was taken in by the Konoe clan, as a gift to Shion Konoe, one who shared her powers and was a well known exorcist in the region. She works under her new teacher at the temple of Izanami in Mugestu, learning the trade of the exorcist under their careful, and often harsh, eyes.

Name: Mokah
Physical Description:
Mokah is a small rabbit yokai with white fur covering their body, occassionally with spots of blonde and grey.  They're usually fully covered by several layers of cloaks, mittens, boots, and a wooden mask.  They carry a black staff with several small bells on the top.  They're typically shy and say little, and can move very quietly.

They are accompanied by Vigdis, an ice spirit in the shape of an owl.

Name: Morgana
Physical Description: A four-legged, rabbit-like creature, standing at around 3 ft at the shoulder and measuring 5 ft from nose to tail. It sports snow-white fur, pale gray eyes, and long lop ears, and its brow and left tight are adorned with vines and flowers, serving as their Floralist's Garden.
Story Summary:
Once the guardian a sacred grove in Deleria, Morgana bore witness to many of the Dreamites' greatest stories. That's in the past now; the Brecilient, along with the rest of Deleria, is no more.

When the people of Deleria were reborn from Wulfric's dreams, Morgana stayed aslumber even as the others awoke; Regus had erased the pain of what they'd lost, but Morgana? They had lost it all, their identity inseparable from a home that no longer existed.

It was only when memory began to return to the Dreamites that Morgana awoke. For weeks, they were consumed with grief, refusing to leave the Castle's garden. But when Ladon reappeared to defy the Fate of Heaven, something stirred in her heart.

*"I am an echo, a memory of a being created to guard a place that no longer exists. I am nothing. I am not real. And yet; I **am.** I live. I breathe. I dream. And I **refuse** to let it all be for naught."*

Why he did what he did back then, or why he has returned now, is anyone's guess, but one thing is certain: Mutt can't run from his past forever. Story Summary:
The boy formerly known as Myeongjun Shin grew up an isolated and quiet kid among Heartdom's mossy skyscrapers. He found comfort in scavenged electronics, but the specter of Vanagandr and the grand designs of Lilith always loomed over him. Unable to stomach the idea of staying idle, he enrolled in the academy, and threw himself into the House of Blades.

In becoming a Regal Vessel, the Hegemon has chosen to surrender himself to the convictions and judgements of both Sylvaine, his childhood friend, and Lilith herself. And now, he surrenders himself anew to the Worldhelm and Yubel. But it can't be that bad. They all probably know how to save the realms - or at minimum, they sure know a lot better than he does.

- She went to Erdelkeith with Yuel and the rest of her family for the pilgrimage.
- As the two were taught by the Soul Witches of the Erdelward Order, she took to like oil and water. She couldn't connect to the stone and use the stone powers at all and at the same time, Yuel could.
- Through the various teachers she may have had, the underlying belief that Yuel would have been a better successor remained.,
- She managed to understand the other forms of magic to a certain degree, magic inspiring wonder in her as always.
- They left for the Runewall, surely even this can be understood as it is terrifying as it is wonderous. The land must be protected and surely even she could learn something from what lies beyond.

Name: Natalia
Physical Description: Natalia has incredibly pale skin and snowy white hair and her eyes grey. Noticeably the gemstone like crystals on her face give away her status as and heir to the Anarchy Stone. However with her recent goals she has taken to adopting wearing things that reference the other stones to mark her goal of unity.
Quirks: Next in Line - Bend the power of chaos in her favor to incredible effect for surprising feats of power. However at times chaotic energies can run wild around her producing effects similar to those around the Anarchy Stone.
Story Summary:
- Grew up in the Dissenter's Tower after having being brought there at the age of 10 when some Crownless came though her village, that has since been destroyed.
- Traveled around Eurys with Crownless causing unrest as they do with their form of liberation. Got word of expeditions to pass the wall and went to see them out of curiosity.
- Witnessed a noble sending slaves though in droves abusing his power over them. She dragged said noble though the Runewall as she crossed it herself, however only she arrived on the Worldhelm.
- While doing as Goldhearted do, helping those who need it she finally found her goal, change the Anarchy Stone to Unity and bring the stones together to work to save Eurys, rather than them all working separately as they are now.
- During the battle of Eden against Lucifer and Sariel the spear of Adam, the Hasta Longina The 33rd Holy Sword, chose her as its wielder. Now she continues to work to achieve her goal and the Heir of Unity.

Name: Nathan Porumbel
Physical Description:
A young, pale man with black hair and strikingly yellow eyes.

He often wears a suave smile on his lips and, though he is dressed sharply, his shirt is never buttoned up all the way and his tie is always loose. 

The multiple pieces of jewelry he wears, rings on his fingers and ears and a choker often around his neck, glitter enough in the dim street lights he walks under that many never truly notice that two of his teeth are longer and sharper than the rest, despite his frequent grinning.
Story Summary:
Nathan fled the suffocating rigidness of his home at the age of 20 and has never looked back since. He wandered a while, till he found purpose and interest after joining the SIA, specifically to research The Black.

Nowadays he prowls the bars, clubs, dance halls and night-time establishments of Veyrhold on a nightly basis. On one hand to go about his work, on the other hand because the nightlife sustains him. In more ways than one.

Name: Neishin
Physical Description: Neishin stands on the shorter side of around 5' with a neutral to angry expression on her face. She wears fairly plain worn and tattered clothes as well as an iron collar and manacle that she refers to as a reminder. Both her hair, which has streaks of white in her bangs, and tail are a dark grey that fade to white as it reaches the ends. One of her ears clearly had a piece taken from it as one point, she also has a scar over her left eye which is pure white unlike the golden brown of her right. Her left arm is notably completely wrapped in bandages.

Vanagandr (Aldistir) - "Betrayed"

Lilith (Bound Arcanum)
The Great Pack (Revelation)

Kuzunoha (Bound Arcanum)

- Was abandoned by her pack when she was injured and dying for being "weak" and passed out from exhaustion and injuries.
- Awoke to Kuzunoha offering her the gift of becoming yokai, which she accepted as she was not ready to die.
- Travels from yokai settlement to yokai settlement as they do not trust her but will give her place to rest as she did receive Kuzunoha's gifts.
- Actively seeks to rebel against Vanagandr and his followers.
- Was captured and intend to be offered as a sacrifice to Vanagandr in a ritual, but was offered gifts by Lilith, should Neishin continue to amuse her by fighting Vanagandr.
- Since becoming a Goldhearted has set out to unite the wolf yokai of Aldistir as other outcasts.
- Founded Heartgarde as a place for the "The Great Pack" to gather and live.
- Felt power from having begun to unite the outcast yokai in Hearthgarde and finally shed her iron collar she had been wearing since escaping being a prisoner.
- Will lead "The Great Pack" to defend Aldistir.

Name: Nero Roux
Physical Description: Nero stands a commanding 6'4", his broad frame undeniable. Yet he carries himself with effortless poise and unshakable grace. After all, manners maketh the man.
Quirks:
Old Transport: "Regalia" Inspired from FF15

>Can fly and transport myself, party and 2-3 Guests at maximum

>You have a unique vehicle or form of transport that directs the course of your life, even if not the most reliable.

>Once per session (approximately four hours of play), the Game Master can give you 2 Fabula Points in order to make the transport’s engines fail, cause an enemy missile to damage its hull, or introduce similar story-based complications. However, the transport can never be destroyed without your permission.
Story Summary:
Nero Roux was born into a bloodline of assassins. His mother, a designer of assassins under the Vignettes, fathered each child for specific strengths. He was one of five, part of her cold pursuit of the perfect operative. But heritage meant nothing without blood spilled to earn it.


Raised in a covert cohort of assassin hopefuls, Nero trained alongside Adrien, Juno, and Wren. His makeshift family. They learned to kill as one, relying on each other not through love, but trust born in shared survival. Nero was always the quiet one: calm and courteous.


Their final trial shattered everything. Only one could move on. Adrien struck first, severing friendship for ambition. Nero fought back, hesitating only once, before defeating him. But even then, there was no victory. Their handlers executed the wounded without warning. Nero alone was spared.

He cast aside the sword that day.

Today he is known under the alias "Vigil", he is a man of elegance, restraint, and relentless resolve.

Physical Description: Soldier that rarely takes off his helmet to show his face, though it is musky with possibly days of sweat building behind it. The iron caked blood on his armor hides his own smell coming from his 5' 11" and 196 pound frame.

Name: Niaouli
Physical Description: A big, muscular tree-like humanoid that has pale white bark skin normally stained in red. Very angular and pointy features, along with a fangs like facial smile. Stands around 1,89m (6'2") tall, weighting around 250kg (550lbs). Carries a very heavy shield on his back.
Story Summary:
Born in Aldistir, this Yokai was corrupted by the draugr thirst for blood and violence, but could focus this only on evil, wrathful and violent people.
Started to protect and help people against monsters, quickly growing to be known as the quiet giant demon of the woods of Kald.
After being named a non-official hero of the few people who needed it, became a goldheart and was taken to worldhelm

Name: Nico Bastion

Name: Nikki Lovebloom
Physical Description: Nikki Lovemoon, from the Faerie Realm of Kor'Tarion, is a tan brunette faerie with blonde highlights and sports pink-green ombre wings and pink flowy clothing. She seems to be a half-pixie; her wings aren't large enough for her to fly to great  heights. She is very tall compared to full blooded pixies but still short compared to most  creatures which she makes up for with heels.

- Lived in the Spring Court of Kor'Tarion's Fae Realm for most of her life, but was looked down upon for being a mere half-fae.
- Never got to meet her human parent, so she decided to journey out of the faerie realm into the mortal realm to find them when she reached the age of 18.
- She wouldn't find anything on her journey, as before setting off, she only knew her mortal parent's name, David Timberwood.
