Name: Nora Farkas
Physical Description:
Nora is a relatively tall woman, standing just under six feet, with a broad and naturally strong build. Her frame and physique  is thick with muscle, giving her the look of someone used to relying on strength rather than finesse. Her hair is an unkept and messy raven black color which she wears just past her shoulders. Red tinted round glasses hide similarly predatory red eyes that seem to glow as her emotions escalate.

Strange dark tattoos run down one arm and across the back of her hand in sharp geometric patterns While her other arm is covered in a runic language only her people could make sense of. She dresses simply but neatly—black slacks, polished shoes, and a vest over plain white shirt with the sleeves rolled up.
Story Summary:
• Born within the forest of the Hollow Vast, raised among the nomadic Sólyom tribe
• Taught from childhood that the wolf is freedom and that captivity is the greatest sin
• Dreamed of becoming one of the Talons, elite raiders who infiltrate cities to free captured wolves
• Never the strongest of her kin, but endured every trial through sheer will
• Earned the scars and title of Talon, joining raids against hunters, researchers, and vampire prisons
• Took part in a raid near Veyrhold that was compromised before it began
• Stayed behind to break the facility’s containment systems so her fellow Talons could escape
• Captured during the assault, a fate the Sólyom consider worse than death
• Refused to reveal tribal secrets despite prolonged interrogation
• Given a choice: remain imprisoned forever, or aid the agency hunting supernatural threats
• Accepted, hoping she could still prevent wolves from being caged again
• Now walks the cities she once raided, a wolf in an uneasy alliance.

Name: Nyx Selenbourne Atramentis
Physical Description: Nyx is a short woman who to Kor'Tarian eyes might appear a fairy: silver hair, pointed ears, big purple eyes, butterfly-winged outfit that might appear to be growing out of her body. However, Terrans would notice that she's just a human with quite a few body mods. People with better RWO experience would even know she's wearing an ultra-legendary mage outfit.

Nyx's parents died in the crossfire of a gang shootout when she was young, and she was left providing for her sister.

She decided to keep digging in case she came out on the other side of the planet, took out more loans to body mod herself into her RWO character and commission cosplay, and fight petty crime in her neighbourhood to keep her sister safe. She was taken by the Realmstorm as an extremely enhanced stylish exit.

Name: Oliver Bloom
Physical Description: A 5'11" dour man who adorns himself in mostly greys and black. He stands up straight and often keeps his hands in his pockets. His lab coat and tendency to carry remedies and elixirs at his hip gives off the vibe of a researcher. And the bags under his eyes would seem to indicate many sleepless nights. - Made great effort to enter into Hudal Academy on scholarship
- Graduated in the field of Historical Studies
Joined under a professor studying Theory of Hyperbiology

- Continues research into the cause of the moon's shattering independently until he realizes traveling alone is far too deadly.

Name: Ook Nii-Suu
Physical Description: Ook is a 4'3" frog with ever wet feet and skin. She is usually dressed in an oversized, old traveler's cloak made of traditional plant fibers. She smells strongly of wet moss and of lotus flowers, but it fails to mask the magical signature identifiable as the blight. Her toxic green eyes see all.
Story Summary:
- Ook comes from a family in the Glass Ponds, including her parents Nii and Suu, and was gifted with a pretty singing voice at a young age

- They went with the Fox Covens 10 years ago and didn't come back
- Ook didn't go, and then without any family, she trained until she went all by herself
- She came out changed and an outcast, unable to return to the Glass Ponds, surviving off of moss and living in caves
- She met an old bat in the woods, lived with him, followed him as he went to train a mice man and his friend, and then their journey beyond
 - Ook doesn't remember what happened deep in the blight, all she knows is that she can never truly sing again

Name: Ophelia
Physical Description: Ophelia has dark skin, purple eyes and long golden hair. She has green scaled ears typical of a mers along with some green markings on her face. She wields a spear and a hand held harp. She wears a purple bandeau and a long green scarf skirt that fades into blue with some sandals. She also dons some blue seaweed bracelets along with a pink sea shell pendant on her neck along with a crown.

Name: Ophiuchus
Physical Description: Edith is short and slight in stature, at 4'8, with a pale complexion from her nocturnal lifestyle. She wears big, round glasses over pale blue eyes, and a dark bob of hair atop her head. She's changed to a more Terran look, with sweater and jacket, and on her back, carries an intricately designed telescope, folded up for ease of transport, and built by the long gone civilization responsible for the Ancient Observatory.
Rare Equipment:
Cosmosuit [600z]: Spacesuit that protects from the environment.
Kármán Prism [2100z]: Crystal prism holding a chunk of the cosmos. +5 spell damage.
Starseeker Lens [1000z]: Telescope, [SLOWED] targets halve MP cost.
Story Summary:
* Was a street urchin in Nezmira with the idea that only the night sky held a chance at freedom
* Used simple magical ability to survive
* Was drawn to the lost Ancient Observatory by the stars
* Locked herself away there to study, killing scouts of the Scalefire Empire that would come
* Was invited unto the Worldhelm during a larger-scale assault on her claimed home
* Has been made a Board Member of Orrery, and changed her name to Ophiuchus

Name: Orbeen
Physical Description: A small plant-humanoid who is 116cm long and wights 66kg. The head looks like an onion with orange hue on the "leaf/hair". He weilds a waraxe that is longer than him.

Name: Organa Bataar
Physical Description: Organa stands at a commanding 5'6". A height that belies the formidable presence she exudes. She is clad in Mongolian-inspired black and white furs, each layer tailored to balance elegance with practicality. Her short hair is adorned with a crafted jade hairpiece and intricate beads that tell stories of her heritage. At her side, she carries a gracefully curved bronze sword, its edge gleaming with a promise of precision, while a sturdy round shield rests securely on her back, ready for any battle.

Name: Orion Marduke
Class List:
Rouge **M**
Sharpshooter 2
Wayfarer **M**
Merchant **M**
Orator **M**
Dancer 2
Guardian 6
Physical Description: 5'9 ft tall, has brown hair (dyed to blue). Wears almost comical noble attire including the frills.
Rare Equipment:
Sun Bow
Bonded Bracelet (Flynn)
Moon Bow
Trade Ledger
Story Summary:
- Born and raised in Tradesfair

- Orion grew up entrhalled by heoric tales and books

- Was well off with a family owned business called Marduke Mills

- Family business went bankrupt in the fallout of the Clarian Cull 

- Headed out to earn a noble title

Name: Orizuma ⚙ 🏹💢💰🐍🛡️
Class List:
[★] Tinker
[Armaments][Infusions]
[★] Sharpshooter 
[★] Wayfarer🐍 
[3] Fury
[4] Merchant 4
[5] Guardian
Physical Description:
Average height and slim. Pale skin, elven ears, and white hair with red and black streaks.
Equipped with custom armor plates used to invoke electricity and magic through infused metal. He also has a mechanical, snake tail that's very realistic and dexterous.
Rare Equipment:
Accessory: Terrifying Visage [Discomposure]			
Armor: Scaline Body Armor [Vitality Up]
Firearm via Quantum Armament: Faellow Through [Bag Bash]
Story Summary: Magitech inventor that specializes in metallurgical, electrical and chemical engineering. Has tech have patents, but mistrusts large corporations.

Name: Orpheus
Physical Description:
Orpheus is a young man from Terra accompanied by a virtual assistant. He stands at 5'3'', though his lean into his hoodie makes him look a little shorter. 

His outfit is comfortable, casual, and bears a little ID tag indicating his affiliation with 100g Security. He's often carrying a coffee while he watches a fight, seemingly happy to be tactical support rather than a fighter himself.
Story Summary:
- Born to aging parents in Haven who got laid off by NT Tech. His parents are the most important thing to him.
- Started working early to support the household. Odd jobs, ETA call center, later gets an internship with 100g Security
- Moved to Secura for work, now works as basically a mix of IT and border security as he "Okays" peoples paperwork to enter Secura.

Name: Orpheus (#2)
Physical Description: A large, ghostly armored figure in heavy mail emblazoned with tales of legendary members of the Seven Slaying Arms sect and their Sword Saints. His form is translucent enough to make it obvious he isn't entirely physical, and wisps of energy seem to lick off as he moves in space. Typically, he hovers behind the shoulder of a living person, those wisps of misty energy pooling around their feet as they walk. However once detached those wisps form into legs that "touch" the ground, but provide little in the way of weight in each step.
Rare Equipment: The Sepulchre
Story Summary:
- Born in Tessalia as part of a Trailblazer caravan passing through the city, Orpheus has lived a life walking across the entirety of Aranova.

- His caravan fell ill to disease brought about by an encounter with tainted monstrosities. Orpheus struck out to try and find the monstrosity in hopes of learning how to heal his caravan.

- Orpheus found himself quickly outmatched, but before he could die in battle a sect of Exorcists seeking glory in the hunt saved him. Witnessing their faith and courage, Orpheus would join them and begin walking the Path of Eminence alongside them.

- Years after, he would lead members belonging to the Seven Slaying Arms Sect to search for a new Herald, eventually finding Eurydice.

- As part of walking the Path of Eminence they undertook the impossible challenge of making the pilgrimage to the 5th Grave, Apep.

- Once they arrived at the grave they all died to a horde of undead. Now wandering as a spirit, Orpheus is bound to Eurydice's side.

Name: Oscar Smith
Physical Description:
An androgynous person with short, dark hair that has a subtle purple hue, and striking golden-yellow eyes. They have fair skin.

They're dressed in a more intricate, tactical outfit. They're wearing a black hoodie with some sort of ornate design on the shoulders over a dark turtleneck. They have a wide, layered belt with straps on the thighs and knees, and a pleated, dark gray apron or skirt-like piece attached at the waist. They're also wearing black gloves and heeled boots with a laced pattern that goes up to their knees.
Quirks:
Heirloom: Eidolic Dagger

Flaw:
- The Weapon emmanates witht the power of the Virtue Stone being a prime target for those who seek it's power. Due to it's nature it is also psionically tied to Oscar meaning those who attain this dagger are able to seek them out wherever they are in Eurys.
Story Summary:
- Was an enslaved adopted orphan Wulforh Fashion Designer in a Noble House

- Went Missing from their noble when the call for the expedition happened.

- Met Naomi on the way there becoming their retainer.

- Trained in Anima from Naomi to learn how to summon the power of the Virtue Stone.

- Spent time with some friends in the expedition camp.

- Went through the rune wall and arrived in the worldhelm.

Name: Oskar
Physical Description: 6'2'' and 230 pounds, Oskar is a fairly large man. Bald, and has a generally gruff demeanor. Wears a heavy jacket and holds a large sword and a larger crossbow. Cautious around things he hasn't encountered before, which is most things.

Name: Oswald Knight
Physical Description: A somber individual who carries himself in a rather reserved manner. Adorned normally in dark formal clothes save for a white jacket he's grown into. An air of cold always around him, even his skin chilled to the touch. Dark eyes with visible bags under them, a constant lethargy in his face and speech. Standing at six foot even, far more on the leaner side than taking up too much space. A black sea of hair hangs down his head a set of crimson horns parting this sea. A sword always on his hip. On his back and the most eye catching feature of him, a set of dark black feathered wings that let him fly.
Story Summary:
- Born in a rather tame, upper-middle household with both parents working within an ETA owned research facility.
- Was the youngest of three siblings, a 'spare parts' kid.
Parents at his birth had him experimented on and utilized for unorthodox testing through ETA, grafting wings onto him genetically.
- Grew up relatively timid and solemn life, very withdrawn.
- Due to his parents attempting to screw over and con ETA out of funds, hitmen were hired to take them and the family out.
- His family was gunned down, with him slipping out and escaping.
- Grew up on the streets and resorted to crime to survive.
- Attempted to rob a woman named Valerie Knight, did not succeed and due to his young age got 'adopted' by her.
- Now works alongside Valerie occasionally as a Temp, and doing the occasional mercenary work to make ends meet.
Is soon taken into a Realmstorm alongside his two sisters.

Name: Otani Kasai
Character Sheet Link:
[ "Good things come to those who wait... and I consider myself rather patient. " - Otani Kasai
](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1S9erS6uFlcNjPra3tUjUkXenHGP4wgg7GWJSyEraiV4/edit?gid=185905381#gid=185905381)
Origin: Amagi, Capital of Teisei, Tian Yin
Physical Description:
Otani Kasai is a large man with a laugh that stems from his belly and a smile that creeps eternally into his eyes. At a glance he would seem honest and foolish to a fault, though those close to him would know of his wisdom and strategic mind. In battle, he wears black composite armor, wooden plates laced together with rope and steel, with the plates like wings upon his thighs and upper arms. Though most of his battle uniform is understated and dark, his foes would find fear in his mask - the red mandibles of a spider, carved of wood, worn upon the lower half of his face.

Now missing an arm, taken in combat, Kasai boasts an empty sleeve with no less confidence.
Story Summary:
Born to a ruthless assassin lieutenant and a woman suspected of being a demon, Kasai was raised to be a warrior fine enough to defend both his father's name and rank. And he was.

Along the way, he found a brother in Zaizen, and would care for the younger boy as family, shielding him against the rules and abuses of the clan as he could.

Though he would give his life for the boy, there is one thing he can never do - tell Zaizen the truth of his sister. The tension still grips the man's heart, and the regret mounts each day.

Name: Otani Zaizen「財前」
Origin:
Amagi, Capital of Teisei
Realm of Tian Yin
Physical Description: It was once said in jest that Zaizen has an affinity for metal qi because he wishes to cultivate coins. His massive hunger for money is drastically disproportional to his relatively smaller frame and stature. Only his eyes clearly tell the greed that has taken hold of his heart, as their soft honey hues often burn with an intense golden light. Zaizen has black, unkempt hair and his face is typically obscured by a dark and gilded kitsune mask. His attire is that of a traditional ninja, with long ebony robes and flowing sleeves capable of hiding precious tools and resources. Though callous and crude at times, Zaizen is fiercely loyal and will readily give his life for his mission.
Quirks:
Forbidden Ninja Arts: Limit Break
(Fugitive Experiment)
Rare Equipment: *"Wouldn't you like to know"*
Story Summary:
- Enslaved by oni at birth, then forced into assassin clan
- Survived brutal training thanks to mentor and brother figure, Kasai
- Affinity for metal cultivation; martial Dao of Shifting Claws
- Learned of a sister enslaved to Oni as well
- Desperate greed to find valuables to earn her freedom

Name: Ox Deadbeat
Physical Description: A pretty rough-looking build of a bot running an outdated, scrambled version of the system that wasn't meant to do much more than to be pummeled into ground by other players. The only few things this model can boast is integrated roller skates in its legs and an insufferable personality.
Story Summary:
- was a crap bot training dummy in Triworld
- got quite used to getting beaten up as a result
- spent idle processing time watching  crappy action flicks
- it reinforced its delusions of one day becoming a real hero
- its contract with SWORD was about to become void and it was about to be recalled
- the realmstorm picked its shiny ass up before he could get scrapped
- THE WORMS, THE WORMS, THE WORMS

Name: PAS-C41
Physical Description: A sleek robotic frame topped with a glowing blue monitor. Emblazoned across their chest is their affiliate 100G.
Quirks: Automaton: No need to eat, sleep or breathe. Immunity to Poison, but vulnerability to Bolt. Can equip some support modules instead of armor if desired.
Story Summary:
* Created as all LUA are by Lorel.AI
* Developed a desire to use its durable body to protect others
* Scooped up by 100G Security and trained in law enforcement
* Debuted as an effort to put a friendlier face to 100G
* Became a rather beloved face among local children and elderly.
* One day, while saving a child from a speeding vehicle, found itself whisked away to the Worldhelm

Name: Palamedes
Physical Description: Palamedes is a Dreamite who has many of the features of a Serval Cat. He stands at about 6 feet tall and has lean build. He tends to wear a simple green tunic, brown pants, leather boots and a dark green cloak.
Story Summary:
Palamedes woke up with the rest of the Dreamites two years ago with no memory. After showing exceptional skill in swordsmanship he was made a knight of Ladon by King Wulfric and Archmage Regus.

Palamedes time in the Castle was deeply dull with the only things giving him a bit of excitement being training sessions with Octavian and Wulfric’s attempts to entertain him.

When Octavian made his case to leave the castle and many Dreamites left the castle. Palamedes left with them excited at the opportunity for a new adventure and wanting to ensure the safety of the other dreamites who headed down.

With Morningstar and Klein defeated Palamedes was encouraged by Octavian to go help the Goldhearted as the adventure and challenge he wanted would be out there and not on polis.

Name: Panlinggo Umaga
Physical Description:
Panlinggo is a very tiny mountain, standing to a straight 4'9" high. His almond shaped eyes are deep as volcanic smog, and bare an ember of red sparks within. He has soft, round features, a pudgy, short nose, and big, circular ears. His earthy, tan skin is speckled all over with dusty freckles, and scuffs from burns and bare body strikes. A fluffy mop of deep brown bounces on his skull, the longest of it tied in a ponytail behind them and in two short tufts of blond at the front.

Pan wears a loose, patterned, bright red poncho overtop a snug, black shirt cut at the midriff and elbows, and high at the neck. Two wide, gold bracers cuff at their wrists, and a drape of gold lanyards hang from his neck. Around his waist he wears two sashes, red and sky blue, tied and draped to cover the back and front of their lower half. Loose black shorts end with similar patterns to their poncho, and gold bands wreath their ankles.
Story Summary:
All Panlinggo can know is that he was born under auspicious circumstances, which left his mother chronically ill, and his father missing. Panlinggo and her stayed further out from Pagapalay, the villagers worried they would grow sick, or cursed, leaving the boy alone to take care of her when he came of capable age. Despite occasional visits from the master Mabilis, and medicinal care from well-meaning village shamans, the mother's illness would not cede. So when Mt. Magayon rumbled with dire warnings, the choice was made clear.

Poor Panlinggo could not handle the pain, and sought Mabilis for aid. He begged the old master to teach him Cultivation, but Panlinggo's Qi seemed seized, locked somehow. In desperation Panlinggo climbed to the top of Mt. Magayon, and threw himself into it's belching maw. Nobody had seen Panlinggo for quite some time since, but he has found himself in the worldhelm, the rage of the mountains swelling inside him.

Name: Paraluman
Physical Description: Paraluman is a fair lady with snow white hair adorned with an intricate headpiece and eyes that are as blue and as reflective as the sea. She usually wears a teal and white dress covered by a white robe with a fur trim. She often is also seen with a fan that is made with feathers that gradate from white to black by the tips.
Story Summary:
- Paraluman grew up in the harsh barren lands of Lupaing Dinungisan, fending for herself against the selfish evil cultivators on top of sustaining herself. Through her wish to not wanting a life of savagery, she had cultivated her magic and wit, and used those to escape to greener pastures. She ended up within a Grove in the Tikba Forest. 
- Among the residents and travelers of Sampaguita Village, there were rumors about a mysterious maiden exuding a comforting, revitalizing aura, yet shy enough to remain elusive. On sightings of her, the abundance of blooming flowers is one thing people say consistently - prevalently Sampaguita, its scent filling the area.
- Then one day, Paraluman shook off her born distrust of people keeping her isolated in the grove and stepped out into the village. She was easily accepted by the locals, maybe mistaken as one of the Kabaya. Paraluman nowadays is often seen resting besides the shade of a tree or walking around, greeting them with a gentle smile.

Name: Patience
Physical Description: Patience is a 6'3ft tall woman, covered in green and copper armor from head to toe, barely leaving anything visible on herself besides her head and her scarred hands. Her hair is a blackened, brownish color, which she keeps in a ponytail, but it seems to shift into white as it goes down. Pointed face, hostile features, and a nasty scar the blankets her eye, possibly due to magic damage.
Story Summary:
*Patience was once a resident of Brightshield by the name of Charlotte De Peyran.

*She lived with her father and mother, Reynard and Chloé, and lived a fairly peaceful life all things considered.

*Reynard taught her to write, read, and even read as a man of faith. Chloé was a knight who young Charlotte looked up too, and eventually followed in her.

*She lost her father for a year when the Brotherhood of the Brand kidnapped him nearly a year ago.

*Both her mother and herself were relieved to have Reynard returned when the demon Sanctimony was defeated...but something was different.

*Aiming to make a new community of followers in Sanctimony's name, he sacrificed his wife and daughter as an example.

*Patience refused to die and disrupted the ritual her father attempted with her blood, swearing revenge for what he had done.

*Now tainted with magic, she wondered the land looking for her father. Until a near death encounter brought her to Worldhelm.

Name: Patli Nequiz
Physical Description:
A 5' 2 woman with a soft face and long dark hair, Patli can often be seen with a dozen or so herbs on hand along with small potions and remedies. Her clothing often matches those of Cauthlan, letting knowledgable people know her origins at a glance.

Besides her herbs, she can often be seen with an older tome and jewelry designed with roses and thorns.
Story Summary:
- Born and raised in the outskirts of Cauthlan, where she learned magic in herbs, potions, and sigils.

- Another group noted her talent. Besides her skill, they noted her ambition, her need, and her drive for power through her means.

- Due to a series of events, she separated from this group and found Morrigan.

- Now with Morrigan, she raised him like her own and has had him by her side since then. Their most recent path led them to the Guild due to their resources offering just what she is looking for.

Name: Pavi पवि
Physical Description: A small boy from the desert, with a remarkably positive and brave attitude. He walks as if invincible and talks as if willing to conquer the world, even if visibly weak. For the observant, the foolishness seems to be a disguise for the swordsman that lies underneath.
Story Summary:
- Orphan raised in Parvital working as a servant
- When the city was overtaken by Kartikeya, he rebelled as well
- Became one of his hundred retainers, but practiced the sword during breaks
- Got a single compliment from a god and instantly felt powerful enough to become a hero
- Got raptured by a realmstorm the following day

Name: Peishan
Origin: Neel Village, Xiaohai, Wujing Guo, Tian Yin
Physical Description: A lanky Vanara always lightly encumbered, preferring simple, flowing garments and carrying as little luggage as possible.
Quirks:
Hunted Emissary: Boon of Felicitous Mischief
- You are one of the Vanara, the simian people of a mysterious origin. You gain the ability to perform Arcanist rituals of the Chaos domain. Once per session, when you or an ally fail a check (including a fumble), you may spend 1 Fabula Point to turn that failure into a critical success. Fumbles negated in this way do not generate Fabula Points. 
- You constantly carry the weight of heaven’s ire, and your foes receive heaven’s benediction for stopping you. Whenever a villain includes you amongst their targets for attacks or offensive spells, the Accuracy Check or Magic Check gains the boon effect. When you Surrender and a villain is on the scene, they may choose to gain an Ultima Point instead of another Surrender consequence. This cannot take them above the maximum UP for their tier. If this happens, all player characters in the game except you gain a fabula point.
Rare Equipment: Monkey’s First Weave (Accessory: Iceborne, but for Wujing Guo)
Story Summary:
- Born in Neel Village at the edge of the Xiaohai Skysea, Yu Jiaxian was taken from his home at a young age following a deadly raid by corrupt cultivators.
- Seen as a mark of good fortune, the Vanara was kept and raised by the raiders as a lucky charm. They called the child Peishan.
- For every kindness in raising them, Peishan witnessed a hundred cruelties, though never done to him: pillaging, theft and intimidation, and murder where intimidation fell short. Tyranny, pure and simple. By way of "teaching him cultivation," Peishan was made to help.
- Despising their captors' ideologies, they turned their foul lessons on their head. "Gravity is meant to hold down the weak" became "Gravity is meant to stop the cudgel-wielding hand." Those they stole from would have their goods returned in secret, those they intimidated would be met with a sly kindness repaid to them. Little things they could get past their captors became their only means of real escape. Until the day they disappeared.

Name: Percival Alain Coeur de Pierre
Character Sheet Link: ["Together, our guns will shine a radiant silver! Quickly, the enemy is approaching. No refuge!"](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1oyljmnlbB0E_qbdHzu5v_Pou7cHgho_PIBYCaQ8YoEc/edit?gid=0#gid=0)
Physical Description:
A Wilkin with a slightly tan complexion and snow white hair, with floppy fluffy white ears trailing down the side of her head and a small tail behind her. She has a single yellow eye and an eyepatch with a cross design covering her injured right eye.

Her typical combat fatigues are a oversized black coat with a long violet scarf wrapped around her neck that flows behind her, emblematic of her crew. She is also usually seen wearing a black military cap.
Story Summary:
* Percival grew up in Caldera, Merrane from a prestigious military family. She is recruited to White Wing Academy and trained to be a fearsome riflewoman and pilot.

* She is traumatized by her first battle, where she violently loses her squad and forced to fight against a people who only wished to survive, blood staining her hands. She loses an eye due to an explosion.

* When she recovers, she is assigned to a small airship owned by eccentric noble Lindsey Beck. She takes this opportunity to steal the ship for herself and defect from Merrane, becoming a sky pirate fighting for the freedom of Karlsgard and peace for Lhodos.

* They end up at the Worldhelm due to getting caught by a Realmstorm during a squall.

* She works as the captain of the Violet Barons, together with her benefactor Lindsey Beck and her engineer, Evelyn Antonov.

Name: Percival “Percy” Blackwell
Class List:
Ace of Cards - ★
Entropist - 7
Sharpshooter - 1
Dancer - ★
Physical Description:
Percy is a well dressed, average-sized young man standing at roughly 5'9" with dark eyes and curly, silver-blue hair. Freckles dust his cheeks and nose, paired alongside faint dimples at the edges of his smile that keep his expressions soft and approachable. His clothing is tailored and well-kept, wearing a burgundy suit jacket over a white collared shirt, rust-colored trousers, and black boots, all with muted gold affects. Alongside this, he almost always wears white gloves and thin framed glasses, giving him a somewhat elegant and bookish appearance.

Despite his faintly awkward mannerisms, his posture is relaxed and he moves with a deftness that betrays his unassuming nature, especially when handling a deck of cards. When utilizing his magic, Percy emits a crimson-white glow from his cards and eyes, sharpening his features to give way to a more confident and focused demeanor.
Story Summary:
- Percy grew up with his twin brother Corwin to a commoner family in the lower districts of Reven, Delsatz.
- Due to the struggles brought on by Delsatz's social stratification, they quickly learned to live defiantly in their own way. Percy found his stride in community, connection and cunning, and Corwin in conflict and change with the Liberation Army.
- Percy was cautious about the prospect of a bloody revolution, whereas Corwin felt emboldened by the promise of independence.
- Things came to a head when fighting drew near, up until the nobility unexpectantly offered concessions to halt and uprising.
- Percy was relieved with the resolution, but his brother grew frustrated and bitter, seeing it as a temporary fix.
- After an emotional argument, Corwin disappeared. Percy learned later that his brother had traveled towards the Runewall in search of power to overturn Delsatz.
- Percy followed his brother, intent on stopping him from making a mistake, ultimately ending up in Worldhelm.

Name: Perseus of Dreadlan
Character Sheet Link: [You ready to become a footnote in my story?](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1pxTLLmDPBiktJqLdTk-XF5-ksxslN9ZdyEHN7jRBBm8/edit?usp=sharing)
Physical Description: Before you stands a monolithic man, clearing well at and past seven foot when standing with a width to him that matches such heights. His appearance from head to toe gives off the appearance more befitting a monster than a man. Deep scars along his body and face, heavy furred body, piercing yellow eyes, and large teeth visible when he smiles or speaks. Despite resembling a hyena like monster, Perseus comes off as either focused but more often jovial and good natured. He makes himself the biggest man in the room simply by being in it, be it by standing grand or being bigger than life in presence alone. His attire ranges from the blue Gnosis Academy uniform and Paladin Crest, to the dark black armor along with crimson cape resembling the style of Dreadlan. If he is seen carrying a weapon it is more often than not his Regalia 'The Overture', an oversized and unruly yet regal Gunblade.
Quirks: Next in Line [Queen Akala of Dreadlan]
Story Summary:
- Born from Dreadlan Paladin Argos and Dreadlan Witch Aegea.
- Raised to serve Queen of Beasts Akala as a knight.
- At the age of 16 was sent to Gnosis Academy to grow his combat talents and be educated.
- Met Apollo, a fellow Paladin in training who was struggling in school.
- Apollo instead became a Treasure, deciding to become Perseus' Regalia so both their dreams could come true.
- Perseus now aspires to be one of the best Paladins to ever live, and rise to a similar if not same position as Akala for his people's benefit.

Name: Petra
Physical Description: Petra is a short, young woman with wild black hair and green eyes.  She often runs around on all fours.  She has a cheerful personality but tends to bite people.  Transformed, she grows to over 7 feet tall, grows thick black fur, and takes on a far more monsterous wolflike appearance.  Her clothing is ragged and clearly scavenged.
Story Summary:
-Part of Solyom Tribe
-Separated along with some other kids during a Winged Pilgrimage due to an attack
-Lived with the survivors for her childhood
-Kidnapped by rogue SIA agents
-rescued by a legit SIA agent and became part of the SIA

Name: Petra (#2)
Physical Description: 5'6, Light for her height, Petra sports a somewhat lanky lean build, but is covered in cyan tattoos that crawl all the way up to her neck. She does not think herself worthy to cover her face in tattoos as of yet, she has not become a true warrior yet.

Name: Phoebe
Physical Description: Phoebe is a 5'2" human woman. She has black long hair with some scars upon her head. She wears a simple outfit with suspenders. With her whenever at the Worldhelm she holds a mech, though not able to be operated at this time, it appears a Merrane ace and has been dubbed "Stolen Valor". On the left chest of the mech, there is a purple heart sprayed onto it. As a memory of her final medal before the surgery.
Related Arcana:
Designation: Seraph
Designation: Caladrius
True Seraph \o/
Story Summary:
- Once a loyal officer of Merrane, she was given a demon originating from Designation: Seraph.

- For her safety and from orders, her demon wiped her memories.

- After a confrontation within the Soul Network she regained those memories and purified her Mind Demon

- Phoebe and her demon now stride to a better tomorrow. Uncaring of anything that may attempt to hinder them.

Name: Phoebus "Fee" Scium
Physical Description: Average build. 5'10 (177cm), dark brown skin, braids and cornrows. Always wearing some sort of overcoat.
Rare Equipment: Experimental Qi-Based Medium - Shuriken with Energy Vamp

Name: Phor
Physical Description:
Phor is a 5'2'' Faetouched with White hair and a small pair of goat horns atop his head. His slight build makes him seem fragile even for his size.
He always carries a worn-looking satchel on him and smells faintly of herbs.
Story Summary:
-Apprentice herbalist from Hyacinthus VIllage, Kor'Tarion
-Teacher and fellow apprentice killed while gathering herbs together with him
-Rescued by travelling Adventurers
-Has survivors guilt
-Took up magic to avoid a repeat of events

Name: Pierre Galois
Physical Description: A very young looking man wearing the classical Silverdale noble attire modified for dueling and carrying a elegant rapier.
Quirks: Heirloom (The Virtuoso has a Virtue stone crystal empowering it, making the rapier sought after by duelists, bandits, or something more nefarious)
Story Summary:
Born to minor noble house Galois

- Grew up privileged, never seeing pass the upper quarters

- Trained in dueling and was able to win his family heirloom, a rapier called The Vituroso, with a inter-house dueling tournament

- One day in his teenage years he was able to sneak off to see where majority of Belfrost live in poor conditions.

- When he just reached adulthood he spoke out about the poverty in front of the Major Houses causing a scandal

- Galois's head of house first reponse was to disowned and exile Pierre to save face in front of the other houses

- Pirerre left for the Rune Wall with his family sword The Vituroso to prove that he is worthy of the blade and hopes to one day return to Belfrost.

Name: Poppy Sparks
Physical Description:
Poppy stands at 5'0", with long pink hair that is usually tied in a braid held by a ribbon and a headband. Her animal ears curved down, and her pink tail swaying with a darker color at the tip. Shy, innocent, and yellow eyes darting around would be what people would see when they look at her. Typically dressed in casual Terran attire, with a skirt, pink jacket and a backpack.

Poppy's vocal pitch is considerably soft. She has trouble maintaining eye contact in conversations, and stutters in her speech. Her emotional state is telegraphed in her motions and tone, such as slumping when feeling down. One can rightfully assume she wears her heart on her sleeve.
Quirks: Neo-Human - Upon releasing her limiters, it can cause an unintended consequence based the on primal magic. Specifically the spark of Growth. This power is barely controlled.
Related Arcana:
Qilin (QiLink) - Student from their school and Bound.
Antikythera - Bound.
Nimue - Works for SWORD, not bound.
Story Summary:
Mentor Bond: Tzera le Blanc

- Born in Lumina Prime, Zhuanli Union to a TEMP father and a strict mother.
- Since she was young, Poppy has a very natural affinity to primal magic that used to be common in Terra's history many years ago. However, it lacks control and causes constant issues around her.
- Poppy has a limiter implant granted by QiLink to control this magic, also serves to monitor her. Requiring semi-weekly visits to a QiLink-affiliated doctor who practices magic.
- Currently a student in one of the most prestigious universities in the world, attending on scholarship due to her intellect.
- As part of a contractual agreement for her scholarship, she is to immediately work for QiLink upon graduation. Granting her an early access to their arcana under certain conditions.
- Works part time at a coffee shop.

Name: Primrose
Physical Description: A 5'5'' petite young woman with pale yet pink-toned skin that's soft to the touch like flower petals, yet with dark veins here or there. Dark red scleras make the bright burning pink of her irises stand out from beneath her equally bright pink head of hair with ends that fade into remnants of her blonde hair that's tied into high pigtails trailing from thorn-wrapped buns. Fingers are pointed into sharp wood-like tips, and thorns dot up and down her spine from beneath her skin-snug white clothing and her favorite luminescent jacket.
Story Summary:
- Lived in South Silver Rock as a dancer from a more or less well off family. 
- After an unfortunate accident, a surgery, and a run in with a gang, she was thrown down a chasm which happened to have a very ancient plant. 
- The plant merged itself with her existence, and so now she has a new lease on life.

Name: Priscilla
Class List:
Loremaster★
Entropist¹
Spiritist¹
Commander⁸
⁰ ¹ ² ³ ⁴ ⁵ ⁶ ⁷ ⁸ ⁹ ★
Physical Description: Clouded Pink Eyes

Name: Prof. Elvis Alden
Class List:
Loremaster ★
Wayfarer ★
Orator ★
Floralist 8
Darkblade 3
Commander 5
Physical Description: A scrawny elf with the complexion of a vampire and a ludicrous amount of untamed bushy red hair.
Rare Equipment:
Custom Weapon:
**Roaring Stick** - Eloquence
Story Summary:
* Raised to be a scholar
* Enrolled in Hudal Academy
* Became a shut-in for a decade doing nothing but studies
* Decided to change his life after losing his room during the Night of the Red Moon
* Spent another year studying travel
* Finally set out and stumbled into the Worldhelm
* After growing as a person through many adventures, became a professor at Hudal Academy.

Name: Professor Ozu
Physical Description: A masked man clothed from head to toe. His outfit is a mix of light grey and purple with accents of gold throughout. The most obvious things about him is the giant Spider symbol on his chest. He has a slim, but not too thin of a frame. His baggy clothes hide the true physique underneath.

Name: Professor Sigma
Physical Description:
6'2'' man with messy black hair, pale skin, and heavy bags under his eyes. Clearly has the dress-code of an academic that contrasts with the build of an Athlete. Always seen dressed in a suit and tie if he can help it, with a labcoat that stays on top at all times- though it's disheveled enough to not be up to par in a lab environment.

His spine is pronounced to an unrealistic degree, as on his back usually is a compressed S.I.G.M.A. suit; a black, blue and white exosuit that integrates his normal suit and labcoat into its look.
Story Summary:
• Born and raised as Logan Briar in Haven, university student turned professor. Focus on both physics and metaphysics.
• Scouted for R&D by PARABELLUM, began working as a researcher.
• Breaches in containment by monsters & para-normal entities that were studied couldn't be wholesale prevented, watched a few colleagues die and almost lost his life a few times as well.
• Drew up specs for S.I.G.M.A., Suppression & Immobilization Guardian Mobile Apparatus. An exosuit with protective functions to handle breaches.
• LOGI approved the design, commissioning Orrery for the suit's base hardware, and Lorel.AI for base software.
• Logan was assigned the codename Sigma, and assigned the suit to handle research & containment. Was granted a temp license to provide on-the-field post-capture support with BED on occasion.
• Was part of a mission to capture/eliminate an entity on the moon. Went to investigate when the BED team's comms went down, stumbled onto a realmstorm.

Name: Qu Fuling
Physical Description: A daintly pale beauty with long black hair. She is 5ft 4' and thin. She dresses in greens and whites, often wearing a white veil covering lower half of her face. Her skin is cold and almost like stone to touch, and careful observation will reveal that parts of her skin are in fact white jade rather than skin.
Story Summary:
Qu Fuling used to be a statue of the Kami Jizou near the village of Hanae. One day, the curse Yato no Kami manifested in a young red-headed boy who used to use the statue for protection together with his brother Kidomaru, but when he grew to adulthood, the protection of the statue was gone. The statue animated then, but the now Qu Fuling was too weak to do anything but send him "on a different road", which even then drained all of her powers related to the domain of "Road".

She spent a few months afterwards cultivating to delay her return into the statue, until the ship picked her up to help people of the many realms.

Name: Quill, of Iburri
Class List:
Dancer Lv. 4
Rogue Lv. 2
Sharpshooter Lv. 2
Physical Description: A lithe fox who stands proudly 4'3" with a bright coat and dull green eyes. He's dressed nice-ish, in clothes that have clearly been worn many times and to many places; a fiddle and a bow rest with equal importance on his back. He hardly ever seems anything but relaxed.
Story Summary:
A stray fox from the Iburri Coven. A brother lost to the expedition to the Blight and a mother lost to grief left him alone, but unbroken; his new independence hammered into him courage, independence, and confidence.

He travels the Firwood now, seeking thrill and fame and good deeds in equal measure to protect and inspire his fellow kinfolk.

Name: Quincy Ashlock
Physical Description: Quincy is a red headed, and rebellious individual. Standing roughly at 5'7 she is usually seen with spray paint stains on her clothing or hands. Materialized fragments of the soul network float around her and form a shape akin to wings behind her back. Besides for her youngish appearance and the soulnetwork fragments she seems to have nothing very notiable about her. Usually having a temp license hanging from the front of her shirt given by Lorel AI.
Story Summary:
- Was the only child of a minor company beneath Lorel.AI in Genesis. Father wanted a son so he named her after himself.
- As she grew up she was forced to work under her father to study the Soul Network. She was a natural at manipulating it and controlling it to assist her with magic.
- Realizing her potential her father tried to tie her down to the company as a worker for its offices. Keeping her always nearby for whatever experiments they wanted to attempt.
- Over time she grew to hate her father's work and eventually ran away with her close friend Odette Cordelia to escape Genesis.
Using her status as a Temp Worker for Lorel.AI to find odd jobs along the way. Mostly taking jobs that involved protecting people or cargo till she eventually was picked up by the Realmstorm during one of the missions.

Name: Quivira
Physical Description: She is a human girl with blue cloths and a cute hat. likes all kinds of games but likes to win even more
Rare Equipment: King In Blue Survival Guid - You resist all damage caused by enviroments

Name: RVN-A77-H1 "Reaver"
Character Sheet Link: ["We're live, baby! It's go time! *Kids, do not try this at home.*"](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1P1364dEFf1uRBegtSBMyeIAAW6myMW4qalxhI116hZM/edit?usp=sharing)
Class List:
Entropist ♠
Rogue ◆
Elementalist 4
Pilot 1
Martial Artist 2
Physical Description:
He is a forged likeness of some human ideal, with a million-zenny smile and aura self-assured enough to mog fake temps and soft, squishy meatbags into desperation bonesmashing.

Cybernetic enhancements pulse, blink, and scan his immediate surroundings, at least one often indicating that all he does is a moment from being clipped for the next upcoming highlight reel that posterizes the opps. 

A barcode and a **777LC™** logo are emblazoned beneath his technological, glowing-red left eye.
Quirks:
[Experiment: Prototype Cybernetics]
*__Disclaimer__: **777LC All-In Unlimited™** is built into his core and wired directly to sponsorship financial valuation; on command, it can charge his tech endlessly with the unholy powers of gambling and capitalism. Or, until he goes bankrupt anyway.
Story Summary:
* A street kid from the Outer Ring, he traded his identity and much of his biology out for metal, success and a shot at the good life. There's no going back now.
* Takes a soft pass on Yubel Kool-Aid, but zenny's zenny and he's got his crew's back, no matter what. Besides, these gigs have been great his for views and engagement numbers!
* Recent highlight reels of Reaver dunking and styling on Moonfallen and other twisted abominations throughout Termina City, along with a live recording of his crew duking it out with the Hound have gone viral. Once small-time, Reaver has made his mark across streaming platforms and media outlets, though he's not quite A-List yet - much's he might disagree.
* "*Brought to you by 777LC™! A portion of all proceeds go directly to 777LC L'il Gamblers Orphanage©! Entertain them kids!*"
* Known to have an anti-authoritarian streak, a proclivity for risks, and sympathy for the downtrodden - especially criminals and people pushed to desperate measures.

Name: Rachael
Physical Description:
Rachael is a 4'11 short and stocky woman, having many prominent features that are sheep-eqsue. Her arms and legs up to the lower thigh are covered in soft plush wool that she regularly grooms to keep fluffy. Her hair shares a lot of similarities to the wool, though is less dense.

On her head are two spiraling heavy horns. She wears quite fine looking robes that hold markings of the Archmage Regus, and on her back is a backpack sewn to look like a dragon, it has the size of a backpack one would give for a child.

Otherwise, on her hip, she holds a tome bearing Regus' Symbol which she regularly flips through absentmindedly.
Story Summary:
- A Figure rarely seen by other Dreamites, any that would know of her from Castle Ladon would mostly identify her as the Archmage's Apprentice.

- She has a tendency to be quite timid, and skittish. And so not much is known about her besides the rarity of her appearances. She is an extremely rare sight, only appearing once or twice from her where she calls home during her two years as the Archmage Regus' Apprentice

- She says with reluctance that she's here to help learn to control her magic involving dreams, and to continue to develop her aptitude as Regus' Apprentice. She keeps a dragon backpack close to her at all times.

- She is very adverse to going out into the world after her long solitude, but has deemed her task too important to hide away despite her fear.

Name: Rahim
Physical Description:
Hair: Brown
Eyes: Black
Skin: Brown
Height: 172 cm (5'8")

A young man with simple clothes often wearing a cloak or poncho to hide his disfigured arms and scarred body.

He often carries a blank expression as if in contemplation most of the time. Although, he also shows a friendly demeanor to offset the quite scary nature of his mutations.
Story Summary: A slave living in The Last Hold of the Nezmira Empire and a victim of the Empire's disregard for human life. He was abducted by scholars and was used as a test subject.  In his confinement, he was force-fed Kiir  parts and Kiir blood to figure out its effects on Humans.  During one of the experiments, he manifested mutations which allowed him to escape the facility. He survived but  not unscathed - the experiments resulted in both his body and his mind being damaged resulting to permanent mutations on his body and amnesia.  Deformed and mentally scarred from the experience, he currently roams as an escapee, he seeks to figure out his true identity and the truth about what happened to him. The only thing he knows about himself is what he assumes to be his name written in a band attached to his legs.

Name: Raia
Class List:
Elementalist ★
Chimerism ★
Gourmet 1
Weaponmaster ★
Arcanist ★
Empath 1
Other Names:
Raia Katsujinken
Raia of the Closed Sheath
Physical Description:
Raia is 5'10" (178cm) tall with a very fit body. White hair that ends on his shoulders, icy blue eyes, fox ears with gray tips, and a noticeably large tail that is very soft to the touch. Along with red highlights that radiate traces of magic.

He currently a set of white and red kimono robes, with black fur trim around his neck. Usually wears a smile on his face when in safe company.
Rare Equipment: The 7th Holy Sword, Oikazuchi
Related Arcana:
Kuzunoha (Arcana)
Caladrius of Aldistir (Arcana)
Nimue of Aldistir (Arcana)

True Nimue (Arcana)
Story Summary:
Partner Bond: Tomiko
Rival (Aggressive Partner) Bond: Neishin
Mentor Bond: Tzera

- Was a normal fox, almost starved until Raia was fed by a figure with wings and a red scarf.
- Founded by Kuzunoha, blessing him to become a kitsune with the ability to create foxfire.
- He trained to use simple weapons, both to hunt for food and to fight in the war against Vanagandr.
- Learned to cook food, and wanted to recreate joy for others.
- Became a shaman after deeply befriending a sacred fox, who later was killed by Sakura.

Name: Rain
Physical Description:
Standing about 5 feet tall, Rain has a rather frail appearance. Wearing a ragged yet refined white dress and obstructing black shackles from her wrists, ankles, torso, and neck that seem to glow a dark redish hue from time to time. Having feline traits, Rain has two cat ears instead of normal human ears and a cat's tail that normally sways rather lively since coming to the Worldhelm.

Besides her physical appearance, her shackles seem to construct two blackish red crystalline shields that protect Rain from any danger that approaches her. She is often spotted laying on top of one of her shields from time to time as it flies around the Worldhelm, like a sleeping cat on top of a moving box.

Name: Raine Levia
Character Sheet Link: ["This is my world. I will do whatever it takes to protect it. Even if it means a little overtime..."](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1JQ9kC78-ZZX_dJYvWlk3tfPSrFVnMCWAyQrcacJK2cw/edit?gid=0#gid=0)
Physical Description: A petit Septid of 4'3" and very slender, almost sickly, build. She has long flowing lavender hair tied into loops and pigtails with piercing red eyes. She typically wears an oversized medic's cloak adorned with metallic blue decorations and patterns and a long red ribbon wrapped around her neck. Her body is coated in light green, mint colored scales, with a thick lizard-like tail trailing behind her.
Rare Equipment:
* Stag's Horn (Scaremonger)
* Time's Spiral (Custom Transforming Dagger)
Story Summary:
• A Septid from the slums of Terra who was abandoned by her mother, a higher-up from GaleForce, to avoid a scandal.

• She is noticed by the companies due to her skill in navigating the Soul Network, and was moved to Haven as a part of PARABELLUM to work as a "cyber medic", handling Daemons and other threats on top of providing  tactical support.

• She uses her talents against various other black companies and rival hackers, proclaiming herself a guardian of the digital realm she was so closely connected to, beyond the Daemons she had been hired to fight.

• She reaches out toward a storm and wakes up on the Worldhelm, somewhere that is much more pristine than she's ever seen. She becomes an adventurer to bring order and solitude back to the realms, hoping to grow stronger herself.

Name: Rajke Kolev
Class List:
Arcanist 3
Guardian ★
Chimerist ★
Entropist 4
Martial Artist 1
Physical Description: A well-muscled Leirisn, Rajke is of roughly average height with a clearly athletic build. A pair of alert, rounded ears atop his head are partially buried under a mane of messy dark brown hair descending to his shoulders, interwoven with a few pieces of tasseled jewelry. His dark skin across his body and equally dark fur on his ears, clawed hands, and long, patterned tail harken to his desert-dwelling homeland. A pair of fangs are occasionally visible when he smiles wider than the cocky grin he typically has. His clothing is often casual and loose but, like himself, well-maintained and well-groomed. He carries himself with a calm and confident ease, but there is a distinct hunger burning in his mismatched, heterochromic gold and brown eyes.
Story Summary:
* He was born in the deserts of Grestazs
* His Family wasn't well off, traveled as hunters
* Parents made up grand tales of the World Heirs
* They disappeared in a haunted storm in his youth
* He learned to fight the evils of the deserts, defending travelers and traders
* Picturing himself a hero, he traveled to Wulforh to try to become a successor
* Failed, but thinks he didn't try hard enough
* Continued fighting in the desert, disappeared into the Runewall in the first expedition

Name: Rama Huracupriya
Physical Description:
A rather tall and agile girl, Rama stands at 5'9'', with light dark skin and pale blonde hair. Her right eye is blind, with a scar through it, a wound taken in battle.

Rama usually wears large green ponchos or cloaks, usually to resist the strong currents of wind she rides using her blessing.
Story Summary:
- Born in the Shiva Tribe near Second Grave*
- As a newborn, was blessed by the Mitos of Wind
- Spent her teen years following the Shiva Tribe on hunts, using her connection to the winds to fight
- During a solo hunt, got injured and lost her right eye
- Decided to strike out on her own, leaving the safety of her tribe

Name: Ranmaru
Class List:
Darkblade Lv. 7
Entropist Lv. 2
Rogue Lv. 3
Weaponmaster ★
Physical Description: Ranmaru is 5'7, and hides a lithe figure beneath heavy cold-weather dress he doesn't seem to want to depart from. His faceless mask is supernaturally expressive, eyes moving like lights, and it never comes off. That, his clothes, and his wild white hair that is only sometimes tied into order leave no skin visible most of the time.
Story Summary:
- A fox from Aldistir. While Kuzunoha gifted him sapience, he was provided with no special power or influence, and felt helpless to intervene in the conflict that pervaded his realm. 
- He sought the faithful of Lorelei and their outlook; while they provided him with the mask that grants him human form, he felt their views were yet wrong.
- So, he took the mask for himself and wandered.

Name: Rasho Tenderfoot
Physical Description:
Height: An astonishing 4ft!

Weight: 100lbs of pure fur, muscle and heart!

Rasho has deep black fur, broad shoulders and a smile that brightens even the blackest of nights. His golden honeyed eyes can be seen from atop the walls as he stands guard. He carries three vertical scars across his left eye and one on his cheek.
Story Summary:
- Refers to the night he lost everything as "The Silent Night"

- Searching for a wolf with heterochromia ( blood red left eye, poison green right eye) and a heavy stench of blight

- Will defend Hearthhome ( The place and its people).

Name: Ray Midnight
Class List:
Dealer(Ace of Cards) 10
Arcanist 3
Orator 2
Merchant 3
Physical Description: Ray is about 5'10" tall with a fit build. He has dark nearly black hair slicked back with the sides buzzed nearly to the skin.  A dark gray stingy brim hat with a Joker tucked into the ribbon of the hat. He is usually wearing a white dress shirt with the sleeves rolled up and pinned in place. Over his shirt he wears a Violet vest with a pocket square tucked into the breast pocket patterned with different card suits. He wears black slacks with a belt and black boots. On the belt a set of Throwing knives can be see one one side and two cases on the left, one for his phone and one for cards
Quirks: Old Transport-Terrestrial Vehicle-Fit up to 6 people, An old van with a fold out tent side and a gambling table an enough space for people to sleep.
Story Summary:
Member of a Travelling Carnival/ Circus/very large extended family
Midnight Carnival
“Everyone Deserves and Escape”-Family motto
Was contracted to/Joined 777LC to ensure they could continue what they do
Gambling, performances, and some shady dealings
Acted as Barker and Poker dealer for both Midnight Carnival and for some members of the 777LC corp.
Was selected to run a poker game for a member of 100G Security
Over the course of the game, he convinced them to give the 777LC a better deal
Undermining the goals of the 100G Security agent
This led to him being able to Bind with 777LC
Continued to work as a deal softener for 777LC
Eventually returned nearly full-time to Midnight Carnival and became a full-time dealer there
Inherited his grandfather’s Van, old, but it works well.
On a trip from the Carnival to a 777LC office, he ends up getting caught in a world storm, ending up on the WorldHelm.

Name: Raymond
Physical Description: Raymond stands at a height of 5ft 7inches tall, weighing about 165 pounds. He has sandy blond hair, blue eyes, and tends to wear fancy clothing that's ill-suited for long travels.

Name: Rayyan
Physical Description:
An athletic and sharp young woman, Raye’s muscles are not flashy or toned; her body is simply built for labour. Whether it be physical work or physical violence, Rayyan is perfectly capable. Her face is often stern, her eyes resting in a narrowed position and her lips pulled into an intimidating scowl, though her expression often takes on a cynical edge when she speaks.

Raye’s outfits change often, often not of her own desire. Shale simply will not accept either of them looking as casual as Rayyan would often prefer to.

Name: Reflection of Summer's Shine
Physical Description: Tall as an elder oak sapling and heavy as a sun-dappled rock in a summer river, Reflection of Summer's Shine is shrouded in mystery. That's not quite a metaphor. Their cloak is stitched together from the thousands of grasses within the Emerald Forests they called home, lending them familiarity even in strange environs. The mask of their face is expressive, but a large majority of their expressions seem to be curiosity or vexation. This world of mortals truly is a strange one.
Quirks:
Outcast Fairy:
Learn Mirror.

As a reflection, they are often compelled to copy the exact movements as someone they see who has a strong pull on the emotions of those around them, such as particularly beautiful figures, inspiring displays, leadership figures, or creatures with significant empathic magic
Story Summary:
- Born in the Emerald Forests of Summer.
- Curious about the world, learning from the creatures and fae there, but something always felt missing.
- Eventually, they came across something new, stepping through it and passing into the Realm of Mortals.
- Immediately set upon by a human hunting party in a strange forest under a strange sky, Reflection of Summer's Shine fled. But this meant something to them. Experience.
- Eventually finding another Crossing, the season had changed. They stepped into Autumn, and another unfamiliar sky.
- Wandering the fields, they found something else. Maybe this will lead to answers.
- They found themselves next to a strange fountain in yet another strange sky. But this felt right.

Name: Reginn
Physical Description:
Standing at 6'3'' with swept back hair that is turning white on one side, with eyes of an unnatural blue glow that marks him as touched by magic. He tends to have a patient approach with people, slow and gentle.

More striking than the man by far, however, is his adolescent drake with animalistic features and shining, iridescent wings that resemble stained glass.
Quirks:
Cursed 
Eye of the Aurora - a magnet for natural phenomena, while these events are rare, when they occur you are the center of it. By its nature it attracts the eyes of people, leaving animals and creatures restless in its presence.
Story Summary:
- grew up begging in Hallenrup
- fled to Wulforh to avoid being drafted, lived as a fence in Myrdel
- was part of a heist to kill a knight and steal dragon eggs from a Mastrasz caravan
- attacked by a monstrous moth, cursed along with one of the eggs, which then hatched
- abandoned banditry to go into exile and raise the dragon
- went to the Runewall to investigate a rumor

Name: Reino "Archangel" Valerius
Physical Description: A 5'11" foot tall man, of average build. He walks around dressed in an average two-piece suit colored black with a white dress shirt. Though, this is mostly covered by the quite long black trench coat he wears, allowing only his white shirt to be visible.
Rare Equipment:
- Channeler of The Nine (Arcane Weapon Module) | Quality: Magic Up

- Deliverer's Guidance Module (Support Module)

- Credit Pull (Accessory)
Story Summary:
- Born in Terra, Haven

- Family took out a loan from ETA under his name, him only find out upon his death

- Worked for ||ETA Elimination Squad, A not publicly known group of heavily indebted people who's task consists of 1 thing. Eliminating high threat subjects from other companies who've made a breach of contract, or possible criminal organizations.||

- Upon dying and being raised as an insolvent, his contract was bought out by 100G to join Gate Crasher Squad is designed to deal with high threat criminals. Their goal to create a highly weaponized group of people who're capable of assessing crimes during combat, as well as passing judgements to said criminals on the field and executing the proper sentence.

Name: Renard Sinclair
Physical Description: A 6'1" blond vulpine man who wears a robe that seems to contain an almost uncountable number of pockets. Those sensitive to magic (and also likely some that are not) are easily able to tell that he is Fae in some manner.
Quirks:
Cursed (True Mark of Unity)
You carry the fragments of unity that have died. Slowly, your features are becoming more and more demonic that attempts to hide it are futile. All fey are hostile to you as you appear and read as a demon to spells and other magical effects.
Story Summary:
- Former denizen of the Autumn Court until he accidentally did a thievery of a certain noble's family heirloom, exiled after that incident
- Having been dumped in the mortal realm around Lastport, he now has a gig as an apprentice tinkerer and merchant working under Karl Meyer
- Is starting to get used to hanging around the poor, mortal fleshbags around him?
- Recently, has absorbed energy from the Puppeteer, one of the minions of the Demon of Unity. Now has a newfound appreciation of the arts. Hooray?

Name: René le Sanctuaire
Physical Description: A young man in his mid-twenties who carries himself with an easy grace. Dark shaggy hair sways with his movements, parts of it permanently stained with ash. He wears loose, breathable garments, paired with a bright cloak shaped from feathers. The cloak itself always carries a strange sheen to its color, the sunset palette rich and flickering with a dark warmth, edges glow with magic. In combat, rising energy dances alongside him, striking out as whips of flames resembling the tail of a phoenix.
Quirks:
Heirloom - Ishara's Gift: A fiery cloak of feather and down, suffused with chaotic and wild energy. Created by the spirit Ishara over many years as an attempt to separate the corruptive effects of the Calamity from herself, it is still connected to the phoenix and the well of elemental energy the spirits draw from.

Downside: Similar in function to a Void Stone, this relic houses two opposing forces within it; Longevity and Calamity. The combination of these elements can be... unpredictable.
Rare Equipment:
Ishara's Gift - Energy Vamp
Indomitable - Heaven's Will
Wanderer's Boots - Wanderer's Luck
Story Summary:
Found as a child near their Sanctum, René was taken in and raised by the People of the Ashes. Trained as a warrior due to his tactical acumen and strong will, he himself preferred to adventure into the forest, playing and dancing with the creatures there. One spirit in particular, a cantankerous spitfire of a phoenix named Ishara, was offended by René's meager skills and took him under her wing.

He left the People of Ashes shortly after their assault on Rocade. Distraught by the destruction, and humbled by the heroes for being the ones to ultimately cure the phoenix spirits, René followed the Goldhearted's trail back to the realm storm. As he did, he was joined by Ishara, who carried with her an artifact from the Sanctum that had often fascinated the dancer as a child.

Drawing upon his courage, will, and bond to Ishara, he delved into the storm, and found himself aboard the Worldhelm.

Name: Requiem
Physical Description:
Requiem shifts in appearance between a range of stringed instruments, depending on its user. Its most common forms are a golden-stringed ivory guitar bearing the sculpted likeness of an angel, while another is an ornate, full-sized standing harp larger than most people. Celestial motifs and disguised weaponization are common also in these forms.

Requiem does not normally appear as anything else.
Story Summary:
* One of the Gilded, Requiem is ageless and has spent so much time in the forms of stringed instruments that it barely conceives of being anything else; some might have thought it cursed, but it has come to simply prefer the life of a stringed instrument.
* Since being "freed," Requiem is glad but still not entirely thrilled about it. It feels lost and aimless but would never admit this, excepting through melody.
* Requiem seeks a worthy musician, hero, warrior, and/or luxurious setting like it preferred in the Worthworks ages ago before its master Coia went insane. Requiem is now concerned that bipedal things regularly go mad and is very judgmental about this, dubious about full-on dedication to anything on two legs. Yubel at least is not bipedal. If Yubel goes insane it will lose faith in rabbits.
* Eternal and patient, Requiem is aware it has all the time in the world. Its sense of urgency is completely apart from the likes of people who have spent less time as inanimate objects.

Name: Retti
Class List: Entropist 10, Spiritist 10, Loremaster 10, Sharpshooter 3, Symbolist 3, Chimerist 1
Physical Description: Retti is a 5ft tall elf with pale skin and light blond hair. A slim but firm frame, usually garbed in fine clothes and jewellery, his smiling visage gives off a natural air of confidence and cheer. Lines of emerald-green magical conduits shine dully from within his body.
Story Summary:
- Grew up among his kin in the Fae Domain of Pryn, in affiliation with the Spring Court.
- Strived to be a knight, protecting his people from injustice and peril, but never quite had the skills to bring this to fruition.
- Fled his home out of embarrassment and feeling useless, hoping to start a new life - which he found on the outskirts of Tradefair, doing his best helping people with chivalry aplomb, although it was no easy task and many hard lessons were learned. Years later, Retti considers Tradefair his home away from home.
- He continued to work to become his ideal knight, using the tools of all the realms at his disposal to supplement his perceived incompetence.
- Retti returned home and took the trial of knightship once again, passing with flying colours. After this he left his lack of confidence behind, along with the reliance on technologies from other realms, instead embracing his home's culture anew.

Name: Rex Deckard
Physical Description: Rex is a rugged-looking, weary-eyed middle-aged man wearing a Terran leather coat. Tall build, thin unshaven beard stubble, and some mildly greying hair.

Name: Reynaud Girardin
Class List:
Weapon Master 10
Orator 2
Elementalist 2
Martial Artist 6
Other Names: The Snow Covered Swashbuckler, The Brilliant Bastard, The Steel Poet, The Mistcutter, The Wandering Comet, Reinosuke the Wise, The Legend He Wrote Himself
Physical Description: Dressed like he is fresh out of a romance novel, the garish clothes of this man are well worn and have seen much travel and use.
Rare Equipment:
Westerly Wind
1h | Melee
Multi 

The Swashbuckler's Luck
Combat Robes
Heaven's Defender
Story Summary:
-A well traveled man of middling repute, traveled Kot'Tarion on odd jobs. 
-Wrote hyperbolic verses about his adventures.
-Got lost in a blizzard, was snatched by a Realmstorm and got spat out onto the Worldhelm.
-Writes poems about his time as a Goldheart.

Link to Poetry Google Doc
https://docs.google.com/document/d/1l72f3Lu3ecoLkgGHCim6rhmWmWkfhthfqgxlQ8st-b4/edit?usp=drivesdk

Name: Rezul
Physical Description: He is a pretty skinny and fairly tall warrior monk, who in the shrine has trained his mind the most, at the cost of his finesse and body.

Name: Rhea Hart
Physical Description: Human woman of average height, cropped beach blonde hair, piercings, spikey jewelry (temp art)
Story Summary:
-Grew up in a low income family in North Rock, Central Terra

-Parents were musicians, lived and breathed music and tech

-When she got older her music got darker and more angry reflecting the inequality in the world

-She protested and wrote political songs as she screamed into the night

-One day while headed out to a gig in an old abandoned motel in Liberty Dessert she got caught up in a Realmstorm and transported to Worldhelm

Name: Rhea Hart (#2)
Physical Description: Human woman of average height, cropped bleach blonde hair, piercings, spikey jewelry
Story Summary:
-Grew up in a low income family in North Rock, Central Terra

-Parents were musicians, lived and breathed music and tech

-When she got older her music got darker and more angry reflecting the inequality in the world

-She protested and wrote political songs as she screamed into the night

-One day while headed out to a gig in an old abandoned motel in Liberty Dessert she got caught up in a Realmstorm and transported to Worldhelm

Name: Rhys Caldrith
Class List:
Successor(arcanist) - 3
Netherblade - ★
Weaponmaster - 2
Heir of Wisdom (loremaster) - ★
Guardian - 4
Other Names:
Warden of Wisdom
Successor of Wisdom
Physical Description: Rhys bears a delicate, almost androgynous grace, alongside crimson hair and vivid green eyes often causing him to be mistaken for the fairer sex. Slender and resilient, he dresses in burgundy garb reinforced with dark steel plates, practical for both travel and survival while faint crystalline markings along his cheek and neck betray the otherworldly gift he carries.
Story Summary:
- Born in Stratford, gifted at reading sea and ice, sharpened through study in Silverdale’s archives.

- Guided his family’s pearl-diving, leading them to fortune beneath the waves.

- Lost his elder brother Aelric to a leviathan despite his warnings.

- Grief left crystalline marks upon his skin, sign of a deeper calling.

- Summoned by the Beacon of Wisdom and named a Successor of the Stone.

- Traveled distant shores, peaks, and ruins to seek greater knowledge.

- Formed a lasting bond and occasional rivalry with fellow disciple Galavan.

- Now called to the Runewall, where peril and discovery await.

Name: Rika Carpenter
Physical Description: Rika is a few inches over six foot, weighing around 180 lbs of leaner muscle. He's a rather unkept person, with greasy dirty blonde hair tied back and kept beneath one of a few trucker-style caps he hides it under. He's not particularly fashionable, and his body language and ways of speaking are similarly inelegant.
Rare Equipment:
- Overload Impact Axe Module		
- Focus Stimulant Shield Arm Module
- Experimental Bloodflow Plating
Story Summary: A boy who grew up in the slums of C-Sec in Hidela, and eventually found himself enlisting in the military to help pay for his families expenses. He was with the Peoples' Guard for a number of years, joining when he was 18 and remaining until he was discharged and arrested for disobeying orders when he was 22. After an operation went poorly, and an unlikely series of events resulted in the deaths of his mother and sister, Rika demanded his unit call off their mission. He was rewarded with swift punishment for his bravery. He remained in Heaven's Gate, where he withstood the near-isolation, until recently.

Name: Riley Knight
Physical Description: A woman standing at 5'5, with short white hair and large curved ram horns, Riley is often seen dressed well by Terran standards.
Story Summary:
- Riley grew up without a mother and memories of a father who didn't deserve the title.

- When she was 13, her father died due to a job as an assassin. This was a positive for Riley as her sister took over as her guardian and pushed for her education.

- Riley discovered that she had an innate skill in the soul network that she ingrained into herself, even at the detriment of herself, as the soul network was unstable.

- Was prepared to follow her sister into the crime part of Terra, learning more backhanded skills before she was reprimanded and pulled away from it by said sister.

- Became the more educated between her sister and later...adopted brother? She took this privilege and did well with it, learning to become a soulrunner for a small subsidiary of Qilink, AEC Network.

- Realmstorm picked her up with her two siblings.

Name: Rin
Class List:
★ - Mutant
★ - Chimerist
1 - Weaponmaster
8 - Arcanist
★ - Darkblade
1 - Guardian
Physical Description: Rin is a Half-Kitsune standing roughly at 5'10 (180cm) with a head of messy black hair and tall fox like ears. A pair of yellowish irises that faintly glow in the shadows. Due to their cultivation they often dress lightly with baggy pants or other clothes they've managed to piece together. Their forearm and legs are covered in a thick, matted black fur that goes into a pair of claws and padded paws respectively. Different animalistic parts may grow due to their cultivation technique but those are not always present.
Story Summary:
- Born in Murata, and forced to leave at a young age
- Kitsune attempted to corrupt Rin with corrupt heavenly cultivation teachings
- Started using the teaching but is countering it with their own demonic cultivation
- Forced to leave Murata after villagers found Rin with his body cultivation. Making Rin seem like a monster
- After an encounter with Ayoto, a Kitsune Purifier, Rin lost his Qi base as the heavenly cultivation began to kill him.
- Resolved his issues with his Qi base and slayed Ayoto. Took over the House of Purity and turned it into a place where half-kitsune and others can train together.

Name: Rin (#2)
Physical Description: Extremely pale skin, red-tinged horns, bright crimson eyes, squishy, wears a loose-fitting light gray tunic with a sash and sandals

Name: Rinchi Amaya
Physical Description: Rinchi is 167cm tall, has teal hair that reaches to her elbows and has teal fox ears and a tail that both have white tips.

Name: Risata
Physical Description: 5'10" | Indigo Eyes | Lavender Skin
Story Summary:
- Risata grew up in an orphanage in Providencia, when she turned 18 she was appointed by a councilman to take over as the matron due to the previous one passing.
- After 30 years, an incident happens that causes several children to die/become kidnapped. Her failure to protect the children causes the councilman to revoke her position.
- Risata joins the exorcists to try and do good in the world/gain power to protect people.
After 11 years they discover an ancient evil, she seals part of it in her, but fails. Mahuizoh and her are the only survivors.
- After 9 years on the road, she learns how to keep her magic stable at the cost of all those years of training in magic. She's back at square one for the third time now.

Name: Ritveja
Physical Description: Ritveja stands at 6’2” of height, with a somewhat broadly built frame, as is typical of all of her kind. Her brown fur, which is kept manageably trimmed at all times, is often speckled with simple braids and beads made from shells, rocks, and leather, complimenting the strange ensemble of items that dangle from her robes, causing a light clinking noise whenever she approaches. Apart from her various baubles and curios, she has precious little in the way of other possessions, aside from the large staff she uses to walk, and a large knapsack by her side, always empty.
Story Summary:
Ritveja was born to a collective of void monks in Leytik, and was taught techniques on how to cultivate her own special kind of void Qi by intaking new experiences, and meditating on them to flush the ones she could not learn from out of her mind and body

When she came of age, she left the monk's compound, in search of ways to learn about the world, and apply her teachings to make it a better place. She began setting up a fledgling trade network between settlements in Leytik, trading things like beads, furs, clean water, and nonperishable food in exchange for their unwanted items, so that she could determine what things were good and bad for society, and more precisely flush out that which caused harm.

Eventually, her altruism and charity led her into a Realmstorm, which she almost cluelessly wandered into, ending up on the Worldhelm

Name: Robbins
Physical Description:
A 1.25m penguin. Wears a sweater-like bodysuit that covers his whole body from the neck down. Also brings along his ever-so-trusty, but clearly too big for his head, helmet.
Quick to strike conversation and to offer help, but not as quick in most other ways.
Story Summary:
- Was given spacience by Kuzunoha later into his life.
- Has a partner and three kids in the Kullroc Glacier.
- Identifies more with Nimue's values than Kuzunoha's
- Left his family after Nimue's death to try and bring peace to the realm and, by consequence, bring safety to his family.

Name: Rococo 🦔
Physical Description: 4 ft tall, somewhat scruffy, spines have a iridescent sheen to them
Quirks:
Old Transport
Hedge Homestead: Magical fauna that has congregated into a small home, walking on long plant-like legs. Provides refuge to Rococo, magically records all past travels, and means of travel for the Rootway and beyond. During the Blighted Tragedy (Caravan travelling to Kiln from Hand of Omoth), Scylla, a good foxkin friend, had passed and Rococo has been using it and carrying her memory ever since.
Rare Equipment:
Home's Caretaker [Empath Attuned]
