Thorned Ribcage [Energy Thorns - Physical]
Story Summary:
- From the porcupine tribe and travels the world both in the physical world and the Rootway
- Home in the Grand Repository was destoryed in recent Wolfkin raids
- Consequentially, goes from place to place; never staying too long, but enough to improve the lives of local Kinfolk and does his best to uphold the Hedgehog's code
- A great focus of his is emotional stability, prioritizing mental stability (or lack thereof) who he meets
- While not attuned to older traditions, his spikes have a natural coating that pierces the spirit

Name: Rokuro Tamashii
Physical Description:
Brown hair but with streaks of a white that almost looks like the color was scraped out of it over time.

Often seen in his travelling clothes he always wears a calm smile. Because of this he is often seen as shady even by those he conducts business with.

He's taller than most at 6 feet yet not so much that it would seem abnormal.

Name: Roland Pearce
Physical Description:
https://malekdesc.neocities.org/ROLAND/Roland little card, if you prefer.

A butler dressed prim and proper, with tired eyes and occasionally brushed shoulder-length hair.

Standing at the fairly average and unremarkable height of 5'8'', the fragrance of flowers and herbs can be easily caught in his presence, by the ever-present air of cinammon and cardamom, his inclination towards teas is no secret.
Story Summary:
• A child left at Hearthbright Orphanage, a Brightshield based orphanage known for training children to become professional servants should they not become adopted.
• Was taught how to cook, clean, garden, and even some basic hand-to-hand self defense.
• A request was made for a servant, from a wealthy out of town mage. The price was too significant for the orphanage to ignore.
• Others at the age of 'servant in training' rather than orphan were wary.
• Roland opted to volunteer. Though the mage immediately traded him in to a family of elves.
• On top of the normal duties expected of a butler, he was subject to magical experiments.
• He did not protest, and while the family didn't find the results they hoped for, Roland's biology became adaptable, he was able to summon the flowers he gardened and sprout wings of the bees he cared for.
• Furious with his incompatibility, the family fired him. On his way back home, he was caught in a realmstorm.

Name: Rolando Yitters
Origin: Exiled Fae from the Kor'Tarian Realm
Physical Description: 5’ 10” and weighing 177 pounds, he has a rather light stature, but not one that makes him look thin as he is most definitely not malnourished.

Name: Romer
Physical Description: A male with red hair and bottle green eyes, tanned skin and a slender build.
Quirks:
Heirloom - Railcannon

May occasionally jam or overheat requiring to be cleared of the obstruction and reloaded.´
Also a unique firearm within Merrane with Armor Penetrating qualities thus highly sought after.
Rare Equipment: Railcannon - Pierces Physical Resistance

Name: Ronan
Physical Description: At 6'2", Ronan cuts an imposing figure. His skin bears the deep, weathered tone of a man long exposed to sun and hardship. Black hair hangs in wild, unkempt strands, hiding one eye entirely while the other, pale and reddish, stares out with quiet intensity. His cloak is tattered, and the clothing beneath it is the patchwork of a wanderer who’s lived more on the road than under a roof.
Quirks:
Heirloom:  Dread Tamer

His chains are a dark Fae birthright. Powerful but unpredictable. They react dangerously to his emotions and openly reveal his mixed heritage, making him both formidable and conspicuous.
Story Summary:
Ronan was once someone. Born to a proud line of hunters, raised beneath a name that carried weight. But truth has a way of cutting deeper than any blade. When his Fae blood was exposed, the life he knew collapsed, and the people he trusted cast him into the wilds without a backward glance.

Then came the heartbreak that finished what exile began, hollowing him out until even his name felt like a lie.
Now he walks the world as a ghost in his own skin. No family, no clan, no claim, no past worth keeping. A wanderer shaped by loss, guided only by instinct and the faint, flickering hope that somewhere in the dark, he might still find purpose.

Name: Rongshi Hui 「容时慧」
Physical Description: A Rather Feminine looking man, Hui is 6'2", with Black Hair and Dark Brown Eyes. He is often seen wearing long, flowing robes, and carrying a Fan, though even noticing him at all is surprising, given that he tends to remain quietly in the background.
Story Summary:
- Born and Raised in Xiexie village
- Grew up with a natural talent with cultivation, and an Affinity for Shadow Qi.
- Would occasionally adventure beyond the village
- On one such occasion, got placed in a Life-or-Death situation
- Took in large amounts of the ambient Death Qi to survive, at great personal cost
- Now, he looks to find a way to prevent the inevitable death that seems to be creeping throughout his body.

Name: Rook
Physical Description:
6’4”
Short Brown Hair
Green Eyes
Very Muscular Build
Tanned Caucasian skin with many scars from prior battles.
Story Summary:
Was encouraged through atrocity to become an adventurer.

Takes the role of frontline tank.

Is more than willing to put others safety and well being before his own.

Name: Rosanna Westwood
Physical Description: Rose is a pale 6'2" young woman with bobbed pink hair and brown eyes, usually dressed in black or dark purple.

Name: Rose Meiki'tari Albertus
Physical Description:
A 5'4", slimmer girl, Rose Mei has Black Hair and Green Eyes. Her Cat Ears are often hidden underneath a classical wizard's hat, and her simple clothes are often covered by either a hoodie or a cloak. 

They're often seen carrying a worn Grimoire, and reading whatever book they have on hand.
Quirks: Outcast Fairy (Weakness: If she would learn of any new magics she's never/seen heard of, she **must** learn everything she can about it.)
Story Summary:
- Rose Mei was formed from the remnants of the Ki'tari tribe from Kor'Tarion, and the soul of Zophiel's Father, finally given form by the last magics of Naiki'tari's Grimoire.

- Having watched her parents, Vanille, Erin, and countless others storm in and defeat Sanctimony in their own domain, Rose Mei began to learn what she could from her parents.

- Finally having been deemed decent enough with magic and alchemy to go out on her own and into the realms, she plans to pick up where her parent's legacies left off.

Name: Rowan Sondergaard
Physical Description: Rowan stands at 5'11" with a frail build befitting a researcher. He is always seen wearing his hat and visor, which glows a slight blue hue. Rowan sports a blonde beard he keeps well trimmed, although it can get unkempt if he delves too much into his research notes.  He wears a purple robe adorned with jewels and carries a botany textbook which doubles as a magic tome.
Rare Equipment:
Shard of Vengeance
Holiday Cap
Studying Rocks! Intermediate Geomancy Theory
The Blade
Cloak of House Peppermint
Electrostimulant Helmet
Electrostatic Cloaking Garments

Name: Rowan Vale
Physical Description: A skinny and androgynous figure, often hunched slightly as if listening to something distant. A long, worn coat hangs from their shoulder, fur collar raised, with gloved hands usually holding a notebook. Two tones of black and ginger hair kept loose fall near observant, distant eyes that rarely seem fully focused on the present. In certain light, their outline seems to blur slightly, as if shadows linger closer around them than they should.
Quirks:
The Thinning: Gamble

**Weakness:** When Rowan attunes too deeply to the emotional residue of a person or crime, the echo of that individual’s motive can overwhelm them, briefly possessing their body and compelling them to reenact behaviors or impulses until the emotional imprint fades.
Story Summary: You were born in the dense city of Veyrhold and grew up in a municipal orphanage. Life in the city’s crowded districts taught you to observe people closely, noticing details others ignored. That talent eventually drew the attention of the Supernatural Investigation Agency, who recruited you for training. After years of education and field preparation, you earned a position as a rookie field agent within the Department of Supernatural Enforcement. Your intuition and strange investigative instincts make you useful when cases refuse to explain themselves. Even when it pulls you ever closer to the darkness.

Name: Royce Blackwood
Physical Description: Royce is a 5'7 woman dressed in common Kor'tarion clothing. Her teeth have become unnaturally sharpened due to her dealing with demons as well, but beyond that she looks like a normal sailor.
Story Summary:
- Royce Blackwood was a young face on the docks of Lastport who learned many of her skills to survive and thrive.
- While trying to rob one of the docked ships, she was caught.
- Rather than suffering any punishment, Royce was given the chance instead to join the ship that was named the Red Otters.
- During a terrible storm, Royce fell overboard and nearly drowned before reaching out and making a deal with a demon out of desperation.
- The effects of her deal have left her mark with visual effects, a supernatural bloodlust, and the ability to call on the demon’s power.
- Upon returning to the crew and a member leaving, she was caught in a realm storm.

Name: Ruby Rivers
Character Sheet Link: [She can, and WILL, falcon punch you to death](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/192Hoxiy3uBQPpR1tqFmiorLtr7J2n_eeffJ35JSf37Y/edit?gid=0#gid=0)
Class List: Mutant ★, Weaponmaster ★, Arcanist ★, Guardian ★, Rogue 1, Commander 3, Sharpshooter 6
Physical Description: Ruby is 6'0", weighing 174 lbs. She wears light, breathable clothing.
Rare Equipment:
**Wildhunt Wraps** - If you have Counterattack, the Skill also triggers when the result of an enemy’s Accuracy Check is an odd number.
**Nimue's Suit of Blades** - If you have not yet attacked with a weapon you are wielding, your Defense and Magic Defense increase by 1.
**Incorporated Biomass** - Your **melee** attacks deal 5 extra damage.

**77th Holy Sword, Damocles**
You can spend 10 Mind Points to forgo damage dealt by this weapon, and instead have the hit target lose Hit Points equal to the amount of damage you would have dealt.
Story Summary:
* Created as a biological weapon for the war effort - a soldier that's grown rather than trained, capable of infinite adaptation. Apparently was also used as an attempt to recreate the powers of the Arcana.
* Crafted by DNA recombination and grafting of assorted creatures, including a human child as a base. Ruby has no memories of them.
* As far as she's aware, she's the only "successful" result of this project.
* Proved to be VERY brutally efficient and effective in combat testing.
* Swiftly broke free of control and broke out, slaughtering many in her path.
* Got yoinked by the Worldhelm, presumably in an attempt to redirect this force towards good.

Name: Rulekeeper
Origin: The Faerie Realm, Domain of Equinox (Kor'Tarion)
Physical Description:
Rarely is his true appearance observed as he keep himself tightly bound in robes. Even his face is covered in a mask to better represent his new status among the fae.

Those who have seen even a small amount of skin from his wrists or the rare moments when he might remove the mask would see most of the color drained from his complexion.
Quirks:
Outcast Fairy
Weak to breaking rules or getting an unfair advantage in any situation. Must be pointed out.
Rare Equipment: Tear of Lorelai - Frost Aura(Slow)

Name: Runihura
Physical Description: Runihura's scaled tattoos would run along their neck and chest depicting their knowledge in Entropism. He stands around 5'9 with long black hair that goes past his waist.
Story Summary:
- A ex-servant in the palace of the Alaoui family, witness to the destruction and decay left by Vanagandr/Akhir.
- During this period of time, he viewed into the actual jaws of death, his lack of running and complete acceptance of death intriguing Akhir for a moment.
- Thus, Runihura has received the blessing of Akhir.
- The ruin left in the wake was enough for Runihura to flee the city and so he did. 
- His status since the incident has been vague with the occasional spotting in various Nezmiran cities..

Name: Russo "Basil" Abetti
Origin: The Zhuanli Union, Lumina Prime, Terra
Physical Description: An average built 5'11 individual, nothing about their appearance truly is striking or eye catching when it is in comparison to the everyday people of Terra. A face and body that falls into a crowd easily, with a casual lethargy in their face though they look to try and be friendly. Their hair is a messy long brown mop of hair either tied up or back, it hanging longer than they like when it's fully down and gets in the way. Their clothing is more often casual, save for when they are working or demanded to dress professional by their higher ups.
Story Summary:
- Born to parents both who worked within QiLink, both parents killed during a "hostile takeover" when they were younger.
- Adopted by the company, raised and joined QiLink's Paramilitary as one of their mech pilots.
- Piloting a full dive suit mech after undergoing extensive surgery to perform within a mech called "The Dauntless" the runs on QiLink state of the art technology.
- Works under the AEGIS branch of QiLink, their handler being Tiberius Crowne.
- Has built up loyalty to Tiberius Crown & QiLink, more so Tiberius due to the shadier aspects of the company.
- Also performs in Pulsefire/Mech combat during his free time as he simply enjoys mech piloting both leisurely & workwise.

Name: Ryan Janus
Physical Description: Tall man wearing a purple suit and tophat.

Name: Sable
Class List:
Chanter⁹
Esper⁴
⁰ ¹ ² ³ ⁴ ⁵ ⁶ ⁷ ⁸ ⁹ ★
Physical Description: 177cm beautiful feathered songbird Ixitali

Name: Sacha Astier
Physical Description: An auburn haired Leirsin with clawed hands and feet, bright green eyes, and a generally optimistic attitude. He dresses in traditional clothing reminiscent of the spirit-speakers of Rocade.
Story Summary:
- Born and raised in Melery alongside childhood friend Raphaël
- Was protective of Raph due to his chronic condition
- Stayed behind when Raph left for the Longevity stone, but stayed in correspondance
- Trained to commune with the Rocadian forest spirits, as well as in their primal magic, never once stepping outside his hometown
- Grows to be dependable, but always finds himself wondering about the world on the other side of the fence
- 10 years after leaving, Raph returns with news of the other kingdoms, and of the expedition to the Runewall
- Leaves Melery and accompanies Raph to the expedition, seeking to reconnect with his friend, as well as to discover why the spirits of his homeland have gone quiet.

Name: Saga
Physical Description: A white haired woman covered in ink and ink splotches
Story Summary:
- The book she was made to be was a Saga about Aldistir, generations of authors trying to record their history.
- The rest of her book has since been destroyed by time including the name of her author and most of the pages.
- The destroyed book was brought to Kuzunoha by a follower who stumbled across it and thus Saga was made.
- Upon on her travels where she was continuing to record Aldistir history, she was taken into a realmstorm.
- She has since recorded the stories she finds and hears on the Worldhelm.

Name: Sahar'divh
Physical Description: Standing at 5 ft 10 inches with an meek build a pale non-threatening looking scholar adorned with purple robes, meanders about. A monocle adores his one eye. Whether or not it serves a purpose is hard to tell from a glance. An unkempt mess of light purple hair sits atop his head. At his side and often in his arms resides a book that is often different from day to day ranging from many topics. To describe him, physically, as a bookworm would be an understatement.

Name: Sama Shihitsugi
Physical Description: Sama stands at a height of 5' 9" with an athletic build, due to his genetics he has naturally white hair and purple eyes that can sometimes be found in people with albinism but he seems to lack the pale skin that tends to come with it. He tends to dress very reserved and not flashy at all.
Story Summary:
- Parents died when he was a baby so he was raised by his grandfather.
- His grandfather held a position of respect within an organized crime family.
- As he grew he developed magics within his voice that allowed him to subdue and harm people without actually laying a hand on them.
- Worked as an enforcer for the family because of his talents.
- Even though the family is in crime they actively work to keep gang street violence and more dangerous substances off the streets in their territory. Sama pushes this a bit further personally using his leverage in the family.
- While wandering the streets during a storm enjoying the rain he gets wrapped up in a Realmstorm and finds himself on the Worldhelm.

Name: Samir Zaid Jabari Calsada III
Physical Description:
Weight: 78kg
Height: 190cm
Tall with amazing poise and posture
Clothes are always neat, creased and perfectly fitted.
Brown moisturized skin
Hair and Zappa always neat and clean
Rare Equipment: Tansir Regalia
Story Summary:
- Born in Ormen
- Raised as part of the Valdera family and became their attendant
- Helped raise The Valdera twins and taught them just as his parent taught him
- Through mysterious means the twins went missing in the middle of the night
- Samir without hesitation walks into the Runewall

Name: Sara Langley
Physical Description:
Standing at 5'4, Sara nevertheless cuts a pronounced, proud demeanor. Her head? Held high. Her sheriff's badge? Well shined. Her clothes? Well pressed even during travel. She's never seen without her trusty six shooter, and intense blue eyes search for injustice to fix.

She is always joined by a black horse she calls Socks.
Story Summary:
* Came from a dead drifter town to New Jamestown.
* Her stepfather was caught smuggling
* She declared her desire to become a Sheriff the day he was caught.
* Now she's a traveling Sheriff, righting wrongs and upholding justice.

Name: Sarah Harding
Physical Description: Sarah stands at 5'10" with long blonde hair. The left half of her body covered in burn scars. She is often dressed in a military uniform.
Story Summary:
-Grew up amongst a wealthy family in suntower. Was sponsored by the House of Lances and attended the White Wing academy to train to become a Merrani angel

-At the academy she was put in charge of a squad of seven. As she worked with them they grew attached to each other acting like a family. 

-During a field mission she led her team straight into an ambush. Her mech getting critically damaged and getting severely injured as her cockpit was set ablaze. Before her entire squad could be massacred a regiment of People's Guard managed to save them.

-Due to the severity of her injuries she was discharged from White Wing Academy, being separated from the remaining survivors of her Squad. She would remain in the city of Caldera ashamed to return to her home. She would do menial work for the military while staying there.

-In the wake of the end of the cease fire she is called back to her duties. Being offered to undergo an experimental implant that would allow her  to link to a mech.

Name: Sarah Montrofier
Physical Description: Her skin is a deep tan, her short hair pitch black like the night sky, and her eyes are a grayish blue. She stands at 5'8ft with a slim yet lean athletic figure. Sarah wears a red cape with a hood over herself and her chest covered by a crimson wrap. Sarah's ears and neck are decorated with gemmed silver and gold jewelry, though most of it fake. Below the waist she wears incredibly baggy cloth pants held up by a leather and iron belt with a satchel attached, on her legs are leather boots the go up to her calf and shin. On her hands are fingerless leather gloves with bracelets gemmed with large opals, which are also fake.

Name: Saroja
Physical Description: Standing at 5'5 , Saroja is dressed in the simple and traditional clothing of her home. Now, she is often decorated with flowers to regain any semblance of who she was before.
Rare Equipment:
The 6th Holy Sword, Azreal
Kingslayer's Cradle
Sage's Urumi
Story Summary:
- She was born in one of the few scattered villages in the Viper Gardens, where she was surrounded by death but knew freedom from the Maharaja.
- Became in tune to the world around her and began changing to reflect her Pakriti.
- Lost her parents to the Garden as they would have originally walked endlessly together rather than maybe facing the unknown apart.
- After being a Goldhearted, She lost a piece of her Purusa to help a woman and lost her reflection to her Pakriti.

Name: Sasha
Physical Description: Tall, well built human, usually wearing tank tops, cargo pants and other comfortable clothes. When in mission favours a dark tunic that offers limited protection and helps mixing with shadows. Has two daggers of different intent, one white, the other black
Rare Equipment: Kanshou and Bakuya, Daggers

Name: Saya
Physical Description: Saya appears to be in her 20's with white hair tumbled into a bushy ponytail. Her eyes are violet, matching the color of the shadow flame within her reliquary hanging from her belt. She stands roughly 5'6" with a lean frame. She wears a white and black kunoichi garb accented with red bronze. Her bracers are inlaid with two amethysts from Ishiyama which she once called home. In her hair, a bronze ornament in the shape of two parallel horns. She wears an ornate katana at her side.

Name: Scarlet Alba
Physical Description: Scarlet stands tall and slender, her entire form devoid of colour—a striking canvas of pale white. The only contrast comes from the vivid crimson markings that slither across her skin like living tattoos, shifting and flowing at her command.
Story Summary:
- Escaped containment from a Secura lab, speech and social knowledge impaired.
- Her blood is her weapon, morphing into various appendages at will.
- Learned basic social skills from the slums of Secura, but somehow managed to stay out of insolvency.
- Was collected by the Worldhelm but still doesn't understand why.

Name: Selene
Origin: The Pavilion - The Fourth Floor - Heaven
Physical Description:
Selene - In her humanoid form she stands at 5' 5", golden blonde hair, and pink toned irises for her eyes. Usually dresses in a nice silken white clothing with red on its inside, with golden accented accessories.
ᵀʰᵉ Shredspire - A massive 5' diameter dual ring saw blade attached to a gem encrusted sickle by chain.
Quirks:
Regal Vessel
ᵀʰᵉ Shredspire
Heavy - 2 Handed - [Varies] + 1 - [HR+9] Fire - Quick, Elemental (Fire)
Potent Damage - Fire damage you deal ignores Immunities and Resistances.
Story Summary:
- Lived on the fourth floor of the Pavilion.
- Snuck around when younger to attempt to watch the Deliverers work to keep the Gilded of the floor safe.
- Being one of the few Gilded of the floor capable of fighting eventually approached the Deliverers to let her work with them when needed when she became old enough.
- Due to being of the few capable of fighting, did develop a habit of seeming insulted if not proactively picked as a weapon.
- Spent years working along side the the Deliverers to keep the other Gilded of the floor safe.
- Once released into Heaven from The Pavilion decided to join up with the Goldhearted to keep working to help people.
- Taking what she learned from the Deliverers, who helped shaped what she seeks in an ideal wielder, she closely evaluates individuals to eventually find that individual.

Name: Sella Askelson
Physical Description:
* Ald woman with a all, muscular build, 190cm
* Blonde hair she wears down, ice blue eyes
* Knight outfit (sword/shield), accessories copied from Ald fairytales
* White wings she can extend and retract from her body at will
Rare Equipment:
Hope's Brand - Sword (Quality: World Saver)
Sun Blessed Blade - Sword (Quality: Energy Vamp)
Tsuchiikazuchi - Sword (Quality: Omnishield)
The First Line of Defense - Shield (Quality: Vitality Up)
Warding Moon - Accessory (Quality: Composure)
Dandelion Plate - Armour (Quality: Air/Light Potent Damage)
Story Summary:
* parents killed at Kald Forest, passerby warrior saves Sella
* brought to camp von Kibo, grow up
* aim to become a warrior to protect the weak
* in a nearby village when kitsune raid
* Sella attacc, Sella protecc
* Sella barely kill a big fox kitsune
* Nimue blesses her
* later kidnapped by snowstorm

Name: Selvaria Lightheart
Physical Description:
Standing about 5’11, Selvaria has a rather refined yet somber appearance. Wearing a long radiantly snow white dress with black accents, an ornamental pendant on the left side of her chest, and a shoulder pauldron to protect her from any light attacks. Being blessed as one of the Oni in Aldistir, Selvaria has a pair of long black horns fixed on the top of her head. 

Having long pink hair with redish tips, Selvaria conducts herself with grace and care as her vibrant light red eyes look around the Worldhelm for anyone needing assistance with any particular task or matter. Yet even as she conducts herself normally in her new found environment, Selvaria occasionally shines brightly like a beacon - like a heavenly angel with loving etiquette to match.
Story Summary:
Not much is known about Selvaria besides the fact that she cared for those that resided in Camp Von Kibo as if they were her own children, helping the sick, the mournful, and the lost. Her history as being a prominent figure of tending to the wounds within the camp has led her to be known as a motherly woman, always willing to help others with grace even though she didn’t gain anything from doing so.

Even though her transfer to the Worldhelm was abrupt, Selvaria showed no sign of resentment towards her new surroundings but instead extended her own love and care to those around her once more - after all - even in the camp she tended to strangers, there was nothing different than tending to those who are deemed fit for this vessel. Though she often worries about those in the camp, hoping they’re alright - she hopes to visit them soon and aid them once more

Name: Senna Florenz
Character Bio Link: ["Sure! Manager'll flip if I say too much though! Those Terran NDA'S are no joke!"](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1GlqpalnjJJZTAf4Vu1y5ylzkzvdhyEmnvoihHwR0xns/edit?usp=sharing)
Character Sheet Link: ["Dude I've got a mix ready for any occasion!"](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1M04wZuUaPerewUCT1NKKFyOhXxv7ws19KA2y3u3Show/edit?gid=0#gid=0)
Physical Description:
A bubbly DJ from Terra and former idol, her hair is a kaleidoscope of dyed colours held up in twintails , wearing lilac bodypaint over her skin and when performing wears a customized biker helmet that shows different emoticons, capped off with tall laced leather heels making her seem taller than she actually is.

Flips between her flirty party girl stage persona to showing a more soft-spoken tomboyish side when not performing. Which is her real self is a mystery to all but herself.
Story Summary:
* Born in Terra Silver Rock, Haven,

* Raised by their dad, a mechanic,

* Helped their dad around the store, taking in what he taught them from a young age,

* Was anxious at a young age, got into music to make friends,

* Auditioned for tryouts with a girlband and got accepted,

* Eventually went solo, rebranding herself as a DJ using her mechanic knowledge to create a custom mixing kit,

* Members of her old band had begun to go missing, an illegible calling card left at the sight of each disappearance,

* The same calling card was sent to her, so she was travelling between gigs to try to find her old bandmates,

* Was in the middle of a set before being brought to the Worldhelm, not realizing she was even somewhere different until someone pointed it out

* Modified her DJ equipment to be able to use chanter abilities

* Friendly and bubbly but incredibly airheaded and ditzy

* Loves mechanics and music

Name: Sephi
Physical Description: Black, short-haired girl, red eyes, wearing a black dress with a small tie and a baggy overcoat. Cyan Magitechno markings strewn across her arms and clothes. She is 160 CM tall.

Name: Ser Bedivere the Grey Wolf
Other Names:
The Wolf Knight
The Grey Wolf
Physical Description:
Bedivere is a tall man who stands at 6'3" with long silver hair that reaches to the middle of his back and tied in a messy ponytail. One of the notable details is his ears and tail that are akin to a wolf, much like the beastlike humanoids previously found in Deleria. A muscular figure that has years of experience in the battlefield, capable of achieving great feats of strength that could be considered to some degree superhuman. Typically wearing a coat or a knight's attire, pants, and boots. His expression usually on the less emotive side.

He carries himself in a rigorous fashion, akin to a knight of his station. Having a surprisingly calm tone when speaking, even if his vocal pitch is deep and has the capacity to be booming.
Quirks:
Heirloom - Latorem Somnia

Consequence: As the weapon's wielder, Bedivere would randomly enter the dreams of people he's spoken even a single word to. He has no control over when this effect occurs, and is on occasions forced to act as one of the characters of said dream or have to make the dream come true.
Story Summary:
Much like the rest of Dreamites, woke up two years ago. Possessing very hazy memories of his past life, with occasional flashes in the rare dream he has with limiting detail. The only hint was that sword he typically carries.

Chose to be a knight, as he believed his purpose is to fight for the people of Ladon. Finding himself either being sent out into the Forest of Loss, or doing weapon and armor maintenance. Though found himself listless, wanting to go out but is bound by their own sense of duty.

Occasionally experiences the dreams of various people that he's spoken to at random intervals. He has a small reputation of suddenly acting eccentric in inopportune moments. So takes to reading all about he could find on dreams, and developing an interest of reading fictional tales.

Then dream of Deleria ends. Wakes up properly is told by his King and the Archmage that they have to leave the Island. From there, he starts a new journey while still having a new home in Polis.

Name: Seraphina
Physical Description:
Standing about 5’7, Seraphina has a sleek yet foreboding appearance that could often be described as boyish. Wearing a white blouse with long sleeves and black accents, black trousers, and shin high steel tipped black boots. With long silky onyx black hair and crimson red eyes, her appearance leaves a striking impression with the addition of her pale white skin and the adornment of her pitch black draconic horns extruding from the top of her head.

Seraphina acts with suspicion yet expresses a friendly outgoing attitude, even on board the Worldhelm, she conducts herself with respect - one couldn't even know from a glance what her true emotions are underneath her protective facade. A part of her that she doesn't aim to reveal, not to no one but solitude itself.
Story Summary: A girl from Nezmira, looking for a way to become stronger ever since she was whisked away by the Worldhelm. While she lives in better conditions, she doesn’t completely trust those around her - a defensive mechanism that she unwilling developed during her time growing up in Nezmira.

Name: Serena Ansaze
Physical Description: Serena is a 5'3" girl with pink hair that is tied into pigtails. Out of costume, she dresses very plainly, a yellow blouse, brown skirt, and fake glasses to hide her identity. She walks with a hunch and is usually seen either frowning or a deadpan face. In costume, she wears a frilly, flowery, sparkling dress and carries a microphone. She always has a smile plastered on her face. Every now and then, wires can be seen running through the dress, connected to different speakers and mics in the costume.
Rare Equipment: Seri-Nya's Secret 🤫IV Kit

Name: Sharry Skelter
Origin: An unnamed village in the Albury Hills, Kor'Tarion
Physical Description: She is about 6'0" tall human woman. She has pale white skin, silver-white hair, and red eyes. She usually wears black outfits, dresses for non-adventuring and dress pants and suits for adventuring. She always wears long, thick leather gloves and she never takes them off. She also wears the same black boots for all her attire.

Name: Shaw Jaeger
Physical Description: Scarred faced and large frame. Roughly six foot four inches tall, with scars across his face and arms. He almost always has long sleaved suits and sunglasses regardless of time of day.
Story Summary:
-Grandson of Sophia Jaeger
-Middle child of Sophia’s son Jacob
–Works in the Metalurgy side of the family buisness
-Was being groomed by the family to become a face for the family Philanthropy work
-After a Fundraiser event Shaw was kidnapped by a rouge cell of SIA scientists
-Shaw was experimented on for 6 months, He was injected and fused with material from The Black and other creatures.
-Was eventually rescued by SIA agents, though the damage was done
–Most of the Rouges got away,
-After being recovered, Shaw joined the SIA
–Works to control the new abilities he has
–Taught to channel his new condition to create radiant energy
-Given training as PI for his Cover, Shaw works for the DSC.
-He has two rings, one with a family crest and the other a snake

Name: Sheetal the Hornless
Physical Description: Standing at at imposing height, Sheetal makes for weary presence in any room she occupies, with dark circles under her green eyes and darker hair kept in a neat cut. "Hornless" is but a misnomer, a slight, a tongue-in-cheek mockery of her thin, branch-like antlers unfitting of a true demon. Raised as a guardian of the Tulasee fountains, Sheetal has developed many of the demonic features natural to her trueblooded kin. Her prim style of dress belies a well-defined form of toned musculature, and whatever looks she possesses are buried beneath a perpetual frowning visage, the weight of her responsibilities and unhealed bitterness physically drawing the corners of her mouth ever downward.
Story Summary:
-Born and raised within Prince Kashika and Suniti's domain to a single refugee mother.

-Identifies more with her demonic peers than her human heritage, viewing herself fully and completely as a demon serving under Prince Kashika. (much to her mothers chagrin) A viewpoint somewhat justified by her celestial attunement manifesting as a child.

-Out of gratitude for the safety and succor provided to her and her mother, Sheetal has taken a position in guiding and protecting refugees from elsewhere in Bahata Khajaana, training intensely.

-She held idyllic dreams of freeing the oppressed and overthrowing the vile, but over a decade of fighting to scrape out the tiniest of victories amid a sea of losses has crushed her spirit (or so she likes to tell herself, to make the failures more bearable).

-Awakened as a Goldhearted during a mission gone wrong, in which a refugee was bribed with a better life to rat out on her peers, leading to the deaths of several of Sheetal's comrades.

Name: Shibana
Physical Description: Shibana is a yokai born from a rosebush drenched in the blood of warring Ald and yokai. Parts of their body are soft and light fleshy green like a stem or leaf, others are coarse and grey like scar tissue. Brambles and purple roses wreathe their neck and form what might normally be hair. Their clothes and armour are usually of Ald make.
Story Summary:
- During the War of Fox and Hound, a battle in the Feywyrd spilled a great deal of Ald and Yokai blood, feeding a rosebush which then inherited the blessing of Kuzuonha
- Shibana was born from this plant as a humanoid yokai with fully formed sapience, still retaining the memories, dreams and grudges of those deceased warriors
- Hesought to broach peace between the modern Ald and Yokai, empathising with both sides' plights
- After the resolution of affairs within Aldistir, Shibana stayed on the Worldhelm to pursue peace across as many realms as he can

Name: Shiel Don
Physical Description: standing at around 6’3 with brown somewhat messy hair and a small beard wearing powered armor bearing the iconography of the KPLA

Name: Shing
Physical Description: Shing is a lithe humanoid primate with a normally joyful expression, if a bit more... shifty at times.
Quirks: Boon of Felicitous Mischief/ Curse of Heavenly Emnity
Story Summary: Kicked out of his tribe for too many hilarious pranks when trying to cheer up the kiddos, He now pranks the baddies to cheer up everyone!

Name: Shizuko and Tsubasa
Physical Description:
Shizuko is a humanoid Yokai. She has a mane of pale white hair which extends far passed her shoulders, seeming to operate under slightly less gravity than the rest of her form as it flits and floats behind her while she moves. From her top of her ear extend two vulpine ears, clad in the same white hair, which twitch often in response to noise, as if always on guard. Her adornment is mostly simple, remaining lightly armored, apart from a white mask which often covers her face almost entirely, shielding her eyes from the sun's reflection on the snow of her homeland.
Tsubasa is another vulpine Yokai, though her form is quadrupedal and much more bulky and athletic than Shizuko's. Her posture is similar to a typical canine, with rending claws and a thick mat of grey and white fur, though patches of incandescence give her the impression to sometimes be gleaming with a spectrum of light. Tsubasa is larger than most other fox Yokai, and is very capable of carrying another on her back.

Name: Shizuru
Physical Description: Shizuru is a girl who is short in stature and has reddish gold straight long hair. She wears an eyepatch over her left eye, her right eye is emerald colored. She wears a military camouflage pattern scarf, and a maid outfit. While her face is beautiful, her emotions can be hard to read.

Name: Shu Meilin [舒美琳]
Character Sheet Link: [We've all lost something, we can at least try . . .](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1vgjCiOstdcww-vxrHxexYXkoqM2OEd-HHvhSxebVou0/edit?gid=0#gid=0)
Origin: Tian Yin, Wujing Guo - Xuanwu City
Physical Description: A 5'11" tall pale skinned woman with short black hair, she wears fairly fancy clothing that identifies her as from Tian Yin, Wujing Guo specifically. The only skin visible on her would be her face, everything else is fully covered.
Quirks: Qi Specialist - Wood - Poison Resistance | Fire Vulnerability
Rare Equipment: N/A
Story Summary:
- Born in Xuanwu City

- The Great Tree Sect (Sect she was born in), was destroyed by the Burning Pyre Sect, a sect of corrupt cultivators. She was forced to join them or die

- Her mentor took her place in sect activities, so she didn't have to participate in corrupt cultivation

- While naturally gifted with wood qi, she learned how to control fire qi while in the Burning Pyre Sect. Specializing in Smoke Qi after not too long

- Eventually had to run away as the Burning Pyre Sect decided they wanted her active participation after long enough

- Lost her mentor in the scuffle and escaped, her cultivation gaining a massive boost from the manual her mentor gifted her releasing its power

Name: Shēnruì Er Xián (申瑞儿咸 )
Origin: Tian Yin, Wujing Guo, Xuanwu City
Physical Description: A lean, wiry man of about 5'8". His long, dark brown hair falls in uneven layers, often partially obscuring half-lidded eyes that carry an amused, watchful glint. He keeps a perpetual slouch and a lazy grin. His clothing is worn and loosely fitted, often hanging open to reveal a scarred, well-defined torso marked by old cuts and burns, while his forearms are wrapped in bandages stained by age and use.
Story Summary:
- Born a Fire Qi prodigy in Xuanwu City, was relentlessly trained from childhood, treated as a resource rather than a son, and denied the freedom his older brother enjoyed.
- The pressure and loss of a normal life burned him out; he deliberately stopped cultivating and vanished without warning, abandoning sect expectations and family ambition.
- For five years he roamed both the abandoned districts of Xuanwu’s city and its outskirts, surviving through theft, brawls, courier work, and constant motion, using his Fire Qi only in brief, reckless bursts to avoid notice.
- During his travels, he learned to read people, escape danger, and observe the rot of corrupt cultivation, pretending not to care while remembering everything, until a near-death encounter made him realize returning home was the only safe choice.
- He returned disheveled and penniless, dismissed as wasted talent, now working in his family’s restaurant as an aloof, laughing slacker.

Name: Shī kuǐlěi & Stagehand
Physical Description: Pay no attention to the lithe young woman draped in black. Your eyes should ever be glued to the resplendent shimmering robes and handsome face of the puppet in front of her!
Story Summary:
* Left on the doorstep of a theater in Xuanwu City and adopted by the leader
* Grew up under his training and developed a talent for crafting props and puppets
* Always living behind the stage looking out caused her to become awkward but fond of her audience
* Surrounded by performers, some being cultivators themselves, she was trained in her off time to try and judge her talent, revealing a connection to Earth Qi which she used to breath new life into her shows
* Began noticing audiences shrinking as the world outside grows harsher and people had less time/desire for entertainment
* Deciding the world needed heroes outside of storybooks she crafted her finest puppet ever Shī kuǐlěi
* Despite her fear of the world outside the backstage, she took her puppet forth and began protecting people
* Letting the fiction of the character get to her head she threw herself into an impossible fight  but was saved on the brink of death by Yubel plucking her to the Worldhelm

Name: Sienna "Sweety" Gordon
Physical Description:
Sienna is a 4'1" Septid who wears a dirty trimmed jacket for a security firm located in Babyl City.
The jacket belonged to her father and was made to fit him so she trimmed it crudely.
Her black hair is always unkempt, her eyes are bright yellow, and her skin tone is a dirty green.

Due to her septid nature, she smells of lime soda and her ears are fairly long.
She may or may not have a tail and will never confirm it to anyone.
Story Summary:
- Worked night shifts in a dockyard.
- Wears her father's jacket.
- Barely escaped a daemon attack by abandoning a couple of friends in an derelict arcade.

Name: Sierra
Physical Description: short in stature, has aquamarine eyes and a hair. Hair braid is twice and a half her height. wears winter clothes
Story Summary:
- found and raised by a fae in the woods
- Met a hunter who taught her how to hunt larger prey
- Protected the avian species from predators and poachers,  ends up specializing in hunting during heavy storms, even after becoming an arcanist by accident
- Walked into a realmstorm to hunt by accident.

Name: Silida
Physical Description: A boyish looking man of fair features and mid-length hair, he exudes an aura of scholarly wisdom...and mild trepidation.
Rare Equipment:
Cloak of the Crypt Keeper
The Bestiarium
Story Summary: A sage and scholar of the Blue City, he was raised to not fear the magic he was born with...turning to brush, spell, and page to defend him and the discoveries he makes upon the world.

Name: Simone Katsav
Physical Description:
Simone is a 6'4" Nezzim with Crimson colored scales, fiery orange eyes, and curved horns. She can normally be seen wearing either her commemorative sunrise armor or her an assortment of military vestments. She carries herself a level of rigidness almost akin to a model soldier. The biggest oddity to her looks is the two large wings on her back, something that is not at all typical for Nezzim.
Her choice of armaments is usually a spear or some kind of polearm, supplemented with a large tower shield for protection.
Rare Equipment:
- Ashen Pendant of Draconic Will
- A General's Memory
- Plate of the First Sunrise
- Heatwave Defender
Story Summary:
- She has a family, and they run a butchery in the city of scales.
- A Veteran General took Simone under their wing so she wouldn't fail her military training.
- Any military personnel from her career.
- Due to Simones job as a Captain within the military, She has a lot of experience in dealing with Kiir, and has also led multiple allies to their death in the name of protecting Nezmira.
- Owns a small plot of land as part of her Military Accolades, Has an estate in the City of Scales with branded of her own working there to maintain it.
- Simone had Blood Kiir stuff in her body due to forced experimentation upon her by Theoris. (Why we have wings) More recently Sloan did a ritual to have all of it removed and replaced.
- Used to be a supporter of Theoris due to ignorance and Naivety, now hates him with a burning passion.
- Assisted the rebellion on multiple fronts. Helped in the saving and eventual defeat of Eleleth.
- Was part of the final strike team to take down the Kaas

Name: Sir Mordred
Physical Description: Mordred is a 5'6" Dreamite of Deleria who's appearance harbors similarities to Dragons and Canidae. His furcoat is white with some black accents, and his eyes are skyblue. He typically wears a mix of leather and steel armor, and can be seen walking around with a bag and greatsword on his back. He typically carries himself in a rather lax and carefree manner, but can get quite competitive.
Story Summary:
- Woke up in Castle Ladon, memories of previous life hazy, Knows who they themself are but not much more.

- Continues his life as a squire to the Knights of Ladon. Doing typical chores like equipment maintainence, and taking care of their companion animals.

- His martial instructor was initially Sir Octavian, Arcanist of True Nimue, and so was taught Arcanism alongside Swordplay.

- Became aware of his repetitive and stagnant life when Sir Octavian and others leave the castle, though stays out of obligation.

- When the staleness felt particularly heavy, Approaches King Wulfric Ladon and asks if he could borrow some books from their study. Proceeds to gain a hobby in reading fantasy adventure novels, and longs for the wonders of beyond.

- The dream of Deleria ends, Become properly awake and is told by his King and their accompanied Archmage that they have to leave the Island for it's destruction is imminent. Takes the opportunity with excitement and over the prospects of new sights.

Name: Sirius Proudmoore
Physical Description: Sirius is a warrior in physique and attitude.  Short red hair top a head left scarred, and an eyepatch covers what remains of his left eye.
Story Summary: The mercenary commander of a small company on Kor'Tarion that does not exist anymore.

Name: Sister Durian
Physical Description: A slender and light woman wearing a mask representing that of a skull mask made from fools gold, dressed in nun garb. She holds a crossbow to her side, and a religious symbol that for anyone familiar, resembles that of lilith. when she walks, it's almost as though she is barely touching the ground with each step
Story Summary:
Did something Horrendous in the Fey Realm and was forever banned from it, living in the mortal realm for Hundreds of years
Through trials and Tribulations, She found Lady Lilith, providing her the opportunity to shed her previous skin to adopt a new form
She now is a devout follower of Lady Lilith and will do everything in her power to spread the word of her lady

Name: Siwu
Origin:
Secret Fern Village,
Shouwang Senlin,
Wujing Guo,
Tian Yin
Physical Description:
Standing at 6'0", Siwu has tanned skin, as well as a rugged physique from long hours of manual labor and farming. He bears no scars or other signs of physical conflict, and his cheerful smile is seemingly always present.

His attire is simplistic and his only possession of note is a stone rod covered in talismans which he carries at all time.
Quirks:
Heirloom: Shitou Jianyu (石頭監獄)

Consequence: ||While Shitou Jianyu has allowed Siwu into the world of cultivation, the spirit within has its own motivations. Possessing an absolute belief that the weak belong to the strong, the spirit can twist Siwu's actions towards its own view. Siwu may be forced to take the violent actions when he would otherwise not, engage in acts of cruelty against his own will, or even kill someone he intended to spare.||
Story Summary:
Being from the Secret Fern Village, a settlement hidden from the world and exposed to the cruel tyranny of Hu Bao and the threat of spirit beasts, Siwu has entered the world of cultivation by seeming chance and the acquisition of an ominous inheritance.

Siwu is a man entering a world that is foreign to him, facing down adversity with a smile and a reckless form of cultivation.

Name: Sizz
Other Names:
Birth Name: Reginald "Reggie" Edwards
Call Sign: Sizzle
Physical Description: A 6' tall, 180 lb orange-and-red-feathered avian gentleman with a passion for body modifications. His wings bear tiny devices at the ends of his feathers (affectionately called "Wingtips") which allow him to manipulate moisture to create various elemental effects. Despite the size and power of these wings, however, he cannot fly.
Rare Equipment:
Quantum Armament Quality: Cartridge Boost (+5 damage when using Infusions)

Eternal Blue (Soul-Attuned): You halve the Mind Point cost of all Rituals tied to the soul network that you perform through the Cognitive Ghost Quirk or the Navigator Skill.																																												

Academy-Issue Machina Communication Muzzle: You can communicate with Constructs as if you shared a language. This complex item can only be Equipped or Unequipped by a Tinkerer with an Objective Action.
Story Summary:
- Born to a moderately wealthy human family in South Rock, owners of a body modification clinic.

- Became obsessed with body modifications from a young age and underwent the initial process as a young adult at his parents' workshop.

- Studied under his parents, though chose not to take over their shop. Instead, he decided to help them develop a series of self-defense modifications.

Name: Sloan Katsav
Physical Description: The once Blue-Scaled Nezzim now bears dark black scales, the occasional glint of purple and blue hues along them. A change in her very magical nature altering her physical form, showing the severing of her magic from the Dragonlords of Nezmira. Standing taller than most women due to her draconic nature, her stature denotes her as a scholar of the Arcane. She now bears the clothes of a wizard or witch, the styling that of Kor'Tarion of all places as if she found a fascination with their style. Even the looks of her magic altered and strange, now taking on dazzling colors and an otherworldly nature to it. Her eyes now sparkles like the stars amidst a night sky

Prayer Bead Necklace [1000z Bound Accessory] - Ritual Up

- Born a Pureblooded Blue Nezzim noble, mother was an archaeologist & father handled politics.
- They died during an investigation of a temple being overrun by Kiir.
- Growing up she made friends with a vagabond human, two became very close, and at 18 she got pregnant.
- Had the child in secret by living in another village in the desert for a year.
- Upon having the Ophidiyan, she left him with her spouse Micah and they went into hiding. Sloan knowing nothing about their situation.

Name: Sol

Name: Storm
Physical Description: Nearly six feet tall (6'10" if you include the ears), Storm has dark skin that contrasts her silvery-white hair and ice blue eyes. She typically wears a sky blue coat fringed with white and her entire right arm, up to the shoulder, has been replaced with a metal prosthetic. (She always gives a different story when asked how it happened.)
Story Summary:
- Born without name to unknown parents, Storm only remembers the hardships of trying to survive on the streets with her sister. 
- Ex-sailor turned pirate, she quickly became a captain due to her charisma and ruthlessness.
- Made a small name for herself by stealing primarily from Merrane's wealthy and giving to the less fortunate.
- When the Merrane began their invasion, she was more than happy to accept the request for help from the KPLA.

Name: Stormbringer
Physical Description: The young man comes in at 5'7” (to his dismay), 140 lbs, bright blue eyes and dyed snow white hair. Wears an all black outfit: Jacket, boots, pants with some rips in them, and a compression shirt with a face mask. It's always pulled up. Despite his apparent slim form, a large railgun always accompanies him-strapped to his back. He swings it around like it's weightless.
Rare Equipment:
Thunder Reigns (1300z)

- Powerful
- Elemental (Bolt)
Story Summary:
- Lucius was born in Haven to parents who made enough to get by.
- They worked a lot, so he had a lot of time to himself. He made good use of his solitude studying.
- He was fortunate enough to be sent to university
- His classes were a breeze, but he felt deeply unsatisfied with life
- He figured it out after catching a news report on the Temps of Terra. That was the life he wanted.
- Work on his next first project started immediately; a weapon that would set him apart other mercs.
- His peers found his diagrams unrealistic and childish, while his parents discovering his aspirations sparked a huge fight.
- He ran from both, and spent the next few years with obsessive determination on his project.
- After many prototypes, his weapon was finally complete. A railgun titled “Thunder Reigns”, the shock and awe from his blasts earning him the moniker “Stormbringer”. He loved it so much, he discarded his old name.
- He took a job in the Old World, where he was swept up by a Realmstorm.

Name: Strabo Brightfeathers
Character Sheet Link: [The bird does a little jig. It's cute.](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1tGlwoZapRje75NWSJGv4jiVSNGEuGqOq0c8dmvQBxkg/edit?usp=sharing)
Physical Description:
Strabo stands at a bubbly three saplings tall, his feathers black as night and eyes as blue as the sky. Despite this, he's always considered a colorful individual, garbed in brightly colored fabrics that allow him to be picked out in a crowd, and his dancing talons always causing a scene.

Strapped to his person is always an instrument of some kind, never the same as the last and always perfect for the occasion. His favourite, however, is a metal disk shaped like a stone that reverberates when struck, forged by a friendly lizard within the group he travels with.
Story Summary:
- Born as the smallest of his nestlings, fell from the nest as a fledgling and recovered slowly.
- Never had interest in trinkets unlike other Ravens as a child, instead did weird movements that caused ridicule.
- Supportive parents disappeared one day while hunting, leaving no one to defend him.
- Revealed his talent along with his first trinket, an instrument, during his Coming of Age ceremony, shocking the murder with his unconventional storytelling through dance.
- Still attempting to be accepted by the flock, wanders the lands in search of inspiration and experiences to commit to memory and song.

Name: Sumati
Physical Description:
At a lithe 5'1, Sumati is by no respects an intimidating woman. She is a simple girl in mostly practical clothing, though she does often like spots of jewelry, especially her well worn earrings.

Her Father began her on the path of Shadow Qi, teaching her how to defend her family by killing interlopers and Spirit Beasts Both in full shadow.

When she was old enough, she inherited the Hearth Daggers, the weapons passed down from her family to protect Kata.

She took over the village when her Father died. Not long after, she married her husband: Akar.

Together, they had a child, Palkyi

While she was heading home from hunting a particularly tricky spirit beast, she accidentally fell into a realm storm.

Name: Summer Rain
Physical Description: A tall, heavily dressed person. None of their skin is visible and they wear a scary mask.

Name: Swarm
Physical Description: The Swarm appears as a female humanoid with a pair of small wings upon their back, pale lavender skin, short pale lavender hair, one red eye, and a Crocus flower blooming where the other eye should be. The Swarm wears a black and purple dress which seem to be well tailored for the body the Swarm lives in.
Story Summary:
Before inhabiting the vessel they find themselves in. Swarm was a mere flower amongst many within the Gwaed Forest.
A Sarracenia Colchicum, otherwise known as the Pitcher Crocus was once a normal flower before the shattering of the moon. After contact with one of many fallen shards, the flower changed to a carnivorous plant which now attacked wild life and at times humans. The shard has also granted it thought, with the inflorescences of these flower forming a hive-mind. Working single handedly to survive. Nothing more. That was what the hive was to do.
Decades would pass as the flowers stayed put. Never spreading, staying in one region of the forest. In recent times, bodies were dropped off. Dropped off where the pitchers hid and they were disposed. Though one did not make into the pitchers, only tossed away to the side. Safe from the horde a flower bloomed from the empty eye socket of the body. Time passed and Swarm was born. Able think on its own. Maybe able to form its own tale.

Name: Syl'thra
Physical Description: Syl is about the size of a human teenager and looks similar, with pale skin and a humanoid body structure. However, what sets her apart from a human are her gossamer wings, which hang like a cloak from her back, as well as dainty antennae which twitch inquisitively atop her head. She is clad in robes that are seemingly made from the remnants of a silk cocoon, and clutches a curiously-shaped tree branch close to her at all times.

Name: Sylvaine Corinth
Physical Description: Sylvaine stands roughly at 5'10 without her heels on but stands closer to 6' with them. She holds herself to a level of prestige that many would make fun of. - Met her friend and now bonded Regalia, Myeongjun Shin, during some of the outings. Becoming close friends with him during her childhood.
- Enrolling in Gnosis Academy as a Paladin to Lilith at an early age of 16. Excelled in her classes and become the class rep for her year.
- ~~Something happened here, but I can't remember~~
- Now she is joining the third year at the Academy after her brother, Myeongjun Shin, passed and entrusted her with ᵀʰᵉ Hegemony. To carry their dreams together.

Name: T.R.E.E
Physical Description: T.R.E.E stands at about 5'6", and is unnaturally dense and heavy due to their construction. Each footfall leaves a dissonant clang as they walk. Where cogs and scrap metal fail them, however, overgrown, seemingly magical flora keeps their form together, and assists in their movements, as vines lace in-between each joint. They carry around a simple binder of magitech cards, and are able to capture photos of whatever they are looking at, as upon closer inspection, the magitech lenses in their eye sockets appear to extend and retract, and change aperture.

Name: Taavi

Taavi is a light-skinned man with shortish brown hair. He wears a rather wide-brimmed green hat, sometimes decorated with multicoloured flowers.
The coat he wears is rather old and shabby looking, yet it has pleasant look about it.
He carries a bag on his back that contains all the things he needs in life.
Story Summary:
- Human from the aldish Clan in Gravernmarq, left some years ago to learn more about cooking in other dwellings.

- Since he seldom returned to his birthplace, he often had a longing to belong to the places he studied at.

- So when a group of Wandering Merchants came along, all from different parts of the Realm he joined them. The call themselves "Catalysts of Commerce"

- While on a trip to Blood Pools to gather some bloody thistles for a dish, he was swept up in a Realmstorm and woke up in the Worldhelm

Name: Taiki Ibuki
Physical Description: 5'11'' horned half-oni with long dark hair and dressed in a simple robe. Figure well-cut when seen. Usually wears a mask. Usually seems a little inattentive.

- Picking up work as a fellow in Arzen's Fellowship and as an intern at Maclain Network Solutions, looking to branch out to discover for himself where he should be going

Physical Description:
Kiyo cuts a conspicuous figure at 6'4" (194 cm) tall and with one very large brown wing at her back, resembling a kite's (or hawk's), on her right-hand side. Her left side has none, a scar visible where it would have been let through her clothes. She has long dark hair which hangs straight, and inhuman golden eyes. Her feet are *quite* large and notably avian, yellow and scaly with three toes in front and one behind, ending in talons.

Her clothing is loose and flowing, ornate but generously layered. Beyond the practical needs of any clothing made on Aldistir, it was made to catch the eye and accentuate movement. Her sandals resemble tengu-geta but are interestingly shaped, given her feet.

* Grew up idolizing her older brother Masayuki and eventually joined him as one of the defenders of their community from Ald attacks and other dangers.

* Kiyo grew very jaded about all this violence that failed to protect her family, and was pained by thoughts of the family of all the people she had killed. She retreated to desperate idealistic belief that peaceful coexistence must be possible, a rejection that all this pain and death was the only way.
* Swept into a Realmstorm by reckless curiosity, she took well to having a purpose. She may also be running away from things. Just a little.

Name: Tenzin Enkh
Physical Description: He is a tall and weathered looking man, broad shouldered and big stature like someone who was made to crash against rocks. All from his time in the Temple of Fortitude that built up his body to be a walking wall with calloused hands that can crush stone between them. He is 6'4ft and weighing at currently 258.
Story Summary:
- Was from a small village around the Zham-Hira Brushlands that was ruined completely by a spirit beast and in the process lost his entire family at a young age.

- Was taken in and saved by Empty Monks, who took him under to teach and train him, seeing his potential and affinity to void qi and willingness to adhere.

- For years he followed the teachings and as a part of the training began to train at the Temple of Fortitude being where he started and watched those he got to know beat each other nearly to death.

- Overtime something in him disconnected with the instilled ideology of Self Annihilation. He tried to continue to follow, the sights he saw, the memories he held and the suffering he recalled he couldn't let go of.

- He ended up eventually running away and disconnecting from the Empty monks while in the Temple of Strife, escaping their pursuit into the wilds where they believed he would surely die, but instead was saved by those of the Holy Harmony from near death.
