- she made her way up the mountains, wanting to scout ahead, only to be caught off guard by a Realmstorm

Name: Teyac
Physical Description: An effeminate Zen, about 160cm (5'3) tall, with a very long and fluffy mane of white hair. Rather noticeably however is the mask half worn on their face, sharing their red skin, tribal markings and black eyes.
Story Summary:
- Teotlāni Warden that wore a Folkin mask
- Fled to Providencia, then was taken in by an Exorcist
- Chased by Wardens because of the mask
- Brought to the Guild after being attacked by Delvers
- Offered help to remove the mask but refused
- Joined as an Adventurer, but avoids most people
- Leaves weird beads around, sometimes magic
- Caught in a Realmstorm while helping prepare a fishing contest

Name: Thalia Cornerstone
Physical Description: A short female human standing at 5'2 with short brown hair and green eyes. She is consistently found in her armor.
Rare Equipment:
Ring of Tales
Frost Shield
Scarlet Shield
Chains of Contrition.
Necklace of Two Parts
Story Summary:
- Born in the slums of Tradefair, taken in by a bandit king.
- Helped as bait for bandits for many years until she was 14.
- The bandit king was defeated by the Golden Claw Mercenaries and she was taken in after they paid for the bounty on her head.
- Spent many years redeeming herself and acting like a knight would.
- Became the squire of the Marshall of Brightshield.

Name: The Assistant
Physical Description: The Assistant is 7'8". They appear to be made of boulders and rocks, with assorted vines and foliage holding it together.
Rare Equipment:
Atlas' Benevolence - Can increase the SL of Made with Love by 2 if not feeding self
Hearthside Manner - Healing makes allies resist next instance of Physical
Lightning Rod - +1 to Magic Checks
Humming Bloom Shield - Spells that target up to 3 creatures can target up to 4 instead
Story Summary: See the bio

Name: TheresioldaGaratsumiYumikoDraugr
Physical Description: A small and seemingly fragile looking person, Due to his past he looks extremly effeminate and it would not be wrong to assume he be a woman. A fact he likes, simply because he likes womans fashion more than mens
Rare Equipment: Swordmasters Pride: World saver Katana
Story Summary:
- Grew up in the garatsumi caravan.
- was made to act like a girl for traditions sake.
- killed a draugr at 12, but got affected by godsblood.
- after struggling, the godsblood "sleeps" now remaining inactive.
- left their caravan to make a name for themselves, but got realmstormed

Name: Theta-13
Physical Description: 6'2, pale skin, white hair, a thin tail, horns, one green eye one blue eye, pointy ears, it's outfit consists of a sleeveless shirt with basic armour plating over where his guts would be [y'know.... IF IT HAD ANY], as well as heavy duty black pants and combat boots.
Rare Equipment: nothing.

Name: Théodore Pascal
Physical Description:
Théodore is a leirsin man standing at 5'11" with long white hair, a large spotted leopard tail and rounded feline ears. Freckles coating his face and parts of his body. Yellow eyes that analyze the world around him, but gives a friendly smile when interacting with people. Typically dressed in a garb designed for travel, his figure being lithe and athletic.

His vocal pitch is rather soothing to hear, much like that of a gentleman. His mannerisms generally polite, moving with certainty and nimbleness. Sometimes prone to emotional outbursts.
Quirks:
~~Next in Line (1/10)~~
~~Flaw: You are compelled to not stop someone that is committed to actually improving themselves or on Eternity's path. If anyone proven innocent is in danger, you must protect and endure the danger for them.~~

~~Cursed: Usurped's Injustice~~
~~Flaw: You have become the inheritor of a hollow and ruthless ideal. Your feelings of bias and despair have been ripped to the surface. In order to return to the path of a true judge, you must banish this darkness, you must face your flaws directly.~~
Rare Equipment:
Bastion of Law:
When you merge with the Arcanum **Seraph**, you gain **Immunity** to the damage type you choose instead of **Resistance**. Your allies still gain **Resistance** as normal.

You can tell when a Soldier or Elite rank enemy is lying to you while merged with **Seraph**.
Story Summary:
- Born in northern Rocade to a hedge witch mother with a shady past and a father. Both leirsin.
- Migrated down to Mastrazs with parents.
- Around age 7, his father and Theodore were captured by bandits. Forcibly pitting the two together until Theodore was the one who survived.
- In a fit of powerlessness, requested his mother to teach him how to use Magia. But instead imparted a principle to not misuse Magia for wicked purposes before properly teaching him Thauma to exercise an important aspect: control.
- At age 16, climbed up the 99 Steps and performed the Rite of Vows. Then he was chosen as an Heir of Eternity.
- Furthered his journey as a Witch, learning Anima to fully control his newly gifted powers as an Heir.
- Age 20, ventured forth to the Runewall with a few trusted Followers of Eternity in search for a way to stop the Calamity. Becoming the only survivor to make it past.

Name: Tika & Bow
Class List:
Loremaster Lv. ★
Merchant Lv. 1
Tinkerer Lv. ★
Wayfarer Lv. 2
Physical Description:
This duo consists of a tiny pink engineer girl and a cat-size robot that's always either following her around, perched on her shoulders, or folded up into a briefcase somewhere on her person.

Tika's bag has downsized over time, but lots of technology is strewn about her person: a big capacitor on her hip, the butt of a bespoke rifle poking out of her pack, and all the tools somebody might need for impromptu invention.
Though it's usually hidden, a 3"×3" metal device is implanted in her, just to the left of the small of her back. It whirrs and glows gently at all times.
Story Summary:
Tika was an engineering prodigy in Merrane. She's one of the youngest ever to attend the Caldera Engineering Academy, where work for the crown is designed and constructed. When the conquest of Karlgard began, bright minds from Caldera were put to work to win the war, Tika among them. 

She didn't approve, but she kept quiet and put herself to work on infrastructural studies that could prompt a more peaceful joining of nations. When she presented her findings to the regent, she was dismissed for her dissent.

Name: Tilly Howard
Physical Description:
Standing at 5'6", Tilly's strength is bizarre considering her thin frame and little apparent muscle.

She has light teal dyed hair, green eyes, and is notably missing one of her teeth. Her equipment is ramshackle to say the least, with her preference in weapons often being whatever is the heaviest object she can swing.
Story Summary:
- An unregistered Steelbin native born in the Uncivilized Zone, Tilly spent most of her life living underground in a settlement called the Warrens in order to avoid Treasure Hunters.

- One she decided to risk everything to live freely above ground, escaping the Treasure Hunters with her parents' help, before (rather recklessly) being launched at the Kaiway Metro as it passed overhead, getting onboard after losing a tooth in the impact.

- She headed straight for Gnosis Academy with dreams of becoming a Paladin, got accepted and has been attending since, just recently entering her third year.

Name: Timotee
Physical Description: A slim and short human

Name: Timothy "Heimdallr" Maclain
Class List: Darkblade 2, arcanist 10, esper 10, loremaster 10, Fury 10 Tinkerer 5, Merchant 2
Physical Description: Timothy stands a relatively small and scrawny 5'5ft wearing what can affectionately be described as the cyberpunk equivalent of clothes you would throw on in a hurry to get to to work, glasses and having risen through the ranks of Terra's temps has finally decided to upgrade his computer to something more modern
Rare Equipment:
Get!Away Headset: the cost of soul network related rituals performed through navigator or cognitive ghost (if i had it) are halved
Daemonsbane Psirifle: Worldsaver Infantry rifle
Flatliner: Multi custom firearm
Soulrunner’s Devotion: reassuring custom firearm 
MK 20 MOD D high caliber precision rifle: villainous infantry rifle 
Ace soulrunner jacket: magic up combat tunic
Daemon summoning drive: arcane reservoir
Fractalized Memento: Volatile elements (air, dazed) custom sword
Related Arcana: Nimue, Yubel, Cupid, The Baylore Ideal, Adam
Story Summary:
Timothy was born in North Rock, while growing up in the most dangerous areas of haven was tough at times, he could always find solace in games which would eventually lead him to wanting and eventually getting a job at SWORD

Freelance soulrunner who has previous connections to SWORD (hence the arcanum) who got bad intel on a job gone wrong and ended up getting sent through a realmstorm

Since becoming a goldhearted Timothy has aspirations of turning his soulrunner gig work into a proper company which he has been growing closer and closer to every day, he does however have a very difficult relationship with the Crimson Specters which could make this difficult

Name: Tomiko Umikiri
Physical Description: Tomiko is a 5'8" tall Half-Kitsune from Owaga, Teisei. She wears bright orange and blue clothing, and is never seen without her cooking equipment.
Rare Equipment:
A Flash of Fur and Fang [One-Handed Sword, Multi]
The Roar of the Fox and Wolf (狐と狼の咆哮) [Transforming Sword, Multi]
A Chef's Trusty Wok [Shield, Buckler]
Related Arcana:
Yebisu
Jizou
Adam

Favors for:
- Vanagandr
- Dahaka
- Caladrius
- Kuzunoha
- Musashi
Story Summary:
- Tomiko was born in Owaga, Teisei
- In her teens, she found her cooking equipment
- She was recently brought to the Worldhelm after having met other Goldhearted

- When Aldistir closed, she lost her closest companions
- Has worked her way up to having friends again
- Saved Jizou and Omoikane in Teisei
- Saved the temporary creation of a new realm, losing her Heirloom in the process

Name: Tonis
Physical Description: Skinny 6 ft mute human male wearing a blue overcoat with a feather. Sporting a blond pompadour and carry around a wooden cello.
Rare Equipment: Queens Warmth (Quality: Loaded Dice)

Name: Topal Kavi 📜
Physical Description: Slightly above average height, lean build, simple garbs
Rare Equipment:
Moonstone Bracelets [Multi]
Poem of Rebirth [Zhuque Attuned]
Gold Cuirass [Constitution]
Story Summary:
- From a family of transcribers practicing in secret cataloging the atrocities committed under the Maharaja's rule
- Ultimate wish of wanting to serve the Great House of Kalyani
- Purusa (calligraphy) passed and taught as a family practice, but heavily suppressed by the war
- Family Keeping and relaying written records and transcribing copies of poems, scrolls, and cultivation manuals. Some had to be disguised as coded messages through anagrams and cyphers
- Family works discovered by the forces of the Maharaja
- Father killed for practicing Cultivation and Topal was imprisoned 
- Escaped as a refugee and lived in Tulasee Village until the Maharaja was defeated
- A quill from Zhuque was passed down through the family
- Possesses a tattoo on his arm as a direct gift from Zhuque

Name: Torva
Physical Description: A large (about 100cm tall, 150cm long) wolf. He has grey pelt with a lighter grey chest and almost white belly. Near the nape of his neck is a red patch of fur. His eyes are bright red and scrutinizing.
Story Summary: Torva lost his young kits to an Ald warband and he and his mate, Skadi, swore revenge. They took it, but soon they heard the cries of orphaned fox kits - orphans whose parents the same warband took. Torva decided that enough blood had been shed and convinced Skadi to help raise them... just as the warband returned for revenge of their own. Skadi was killed, but as Torva was ready to give his life for the kits, Kuzunoha granted him her blessing. He killed the warband and became the kits' self-appointed father until they grew up and dispersed. He set out looking for more children to look out for when the Realmstorm took him.

Name: Trif
Physical Description: A short 4'10 gal, often found in baggy clothing that hides most of their physique, often stained with dirt given her prior and current occupation.
Story Summary:
- Trif was born in The City of Nest and worked with her father at a young age to maintain the fields or the machines that do so. 
- She was raised on company values and often found herself attached to her plants that she had once she was young.
- She had made a name for herself, amongst others in various plant bioenginnering projects in Nest though never as the head researcher.
 - Occasionally, she helped fix up any accidents within the workplace, if someone got injured handling a machine and so on and so forth.

Name: Trina Fellwar
Class List:
Professional Artificer (Tinkerer) - 4
Passionate Heart (Arcanist) - 2
Arms Dealer (Merchant) - 1
Physical Description: A 5'9" tall pale skinned woman, she wears a well crafted and expensive looking set of black and red clothes. Her chest, legs and shoulders covered in various metals for better protection. One of her eyes blue, the other red and with short red hair she's often found with a neutral expression on her face.
Quirks:
Heirloom (Eternal Ignition)

Description: Red & Black vestments with extended white sleeves, forged by Trina Fellwars' great grandfather. It was handed down to her in recent years, it imbues its wearer with an intense flame protecting them from dangers.

Flaw: While meant to protect its wearer, in times of sufficient stress it can often do more harm than good. Having the wearer to lose control of their actions, or cause them to feel the full force of the flames made to craft it.
Rare Equipment:
Eternal Ignition (Heirloom) - Sage Robes | Quality: Elemental Echo

Everfrost Necklace - Accessory | Quality: Iceborne

The Unending Desire - Accessory | Quality: Glass Resistance (Dark & Light)

Beginner's Forgehammer - Heavy, Melee, One-Handed | Quality: N/A

Aegis, Gelum - Shield, One-Handed | Quality: Resistance (Ice)
Story Summary:
- Born in Wulforh

- Forced to go to Karsbren to work an apprenticeship with a blacksmith from there that worked for The Silver Castrum. Often pressured and overworked.

- Near the end of her apprenticeship, she was given her heirloom which was crafted by her great grandfather. A special garment imbued with intense flames.

- Once her apprenticeship was over, she went back to Wulforh. Learning business from her mother, and eventually finding most her work with The Silver Castrum.

- Father signed her up to go to an expedition through the runewall without her knowing, and thus she went in fear of what would happen if she declined.

Name: Trinity Heartwell
Physical Description: 6 foot tall human with blue and purple robes. Trinity is high energy and cheerful with a higher pitched voice.
Story Summary:
Trinity grew up in KorTarion as a magical human. He finally got accepted into Hudal Academy and was a student there for some time. His dream is to be a professor there and give magic to any creature who desires it, as he feels its a net benefit to society. 

One day while traveling to a beautiful lake he got caught up in a realmstorm and woke up next to a fountain...

Dul, a pumpkin person from KorTarion, introduced Trinity to the Ropes of the Worldhelm.

Name: Tson Gongn
Physical Description: He wears a long read robe with blue pants, and black slippers. He has a pair of black, armless sunglasses. His hair is a blazing red hair an his ponytail moves like flames, pointing up and flickering and moving. On his for head is a Bindi and has pointed ears, signifying his half-yokai heritage.

Name: Tsuihō Hira
Class List:
Entropist **M**
Spiritist **M**
Esper 2
Arcanist 3
Invoker **M**
Chimerist 8
Physical Description: White hair fox ears. Wearing a blue overcoat with a set of flowers on them. (White Anemone)
Story Summary:
- Early life he was raised by his kitsune parent who he does not have any memory of

- At 15 he was left to fend for himself near the outskirts of Hanae

- To survive, he uses the limited range of Inari's Will he has to find and heal both humans and kitsune injured from conflict

- Before getting on the ship Tsuiho made a vow of pacifism as the humans of Hanae are still weary of him and the kitsune treats him as a foolish child at best.

Name: Tsumugi
Physical Description: A pale woman of athletic build, a limber dancer who always paints on a smile. White horns tipped in crimson curl out of a white cropped bob that ombres from pink to red. Red eyes pointed ears She wears a white silk robe covered in a cherry blossom pattern that is trimmed in red.
Story Summary:
Born in Heavenly Mountains to an abusive Oni father and a human mother.
She became a dancer and entertainer
sought the protection of of another half-Oni woman she would come to know as Yuzuki Kagayami, the two would grow closer. 
After the battle of Amagi Tsu began to grow more fearful of her father. Tsu and Kagayami later fled the city in search of a better life after Kagayami reconnected with her human father. After they set out they got swept up in the Realmstorm and taken to the Worldhelm.

Name: Tsumugi (#2)
Physical Description: A pale woman of athletic build, a limber dancer who always paints on a smile. White horns tipped in crimson curl out of a white cropped bob that ombres from pink to red. Red eyes pointed ears She wears a white silk robe covered in a cherry blossom pattern that is trimmed in red.
Story Summary:
Born in Heavenly Mountains to an abusive Oni father and a human mother she will never meet
People pleaser with a fake smile out of fear and neglect becoming a dancer and entertainer
Sought the protection of of another half-Oni woman she would come to know as Yuzuki Kurayami
The two half-Oni grew closer the cold and intense Kurayami warming to the lively dancer
After the battle of Amagi Tsu began to grow more fearful of her father and others in the city
Tsu and Kurayami fled the city in search of a better life after Kurayami reconnected with her human father
A few days after they set out the two half-Oni women got swept up in the Realmstorm and taken to the Worldhelm

Name: Tsuru Inoue [井上鶴]
Physical Description: She stands at 5'7ft tall, very unthreatening looking yet stands with a quiet fire and resolve within her eyes. Not to be taken lightly as she uses her thin and unassuming form to great use as she equally acrobatic to make up for her lack of strength and quick reacting. Her greyish-blue eyes hold nothing close to coldness within them, only honesty and drive.
Story Summary:
- Is the Daughter of a Samurai and former Bandit who used to be at conflict in border skirmishes, now work together under the Ito Clan in their military
- Had a way with words at a young age that drew people to her and caused them to listen to her at times.
- Lost her father in a battle against a Ronin with a long scar across their eyes and her mother was wounded with one of her eyes being damaged.
- She took up the Sword and Bow full time and became a samurai, inheriting the spirit of honor her father instilled in her growing up, becoming a Samurai under the Ito Clan.
- Secretly swears vengeance in her heart against the Ronin that took her father from her and wounded her mother.
- Was elevated to a Samurai Commander under the new Daimyo Ito Kumiko, serving a new role than just defending the border point.

Name: Tsutsuji
Physical Description: Tsutsuji is a large gracile fox, standing 4' at her shoulder with pale blue eyes and a pure white coat. However, when flowers begin to bloom across her body and the branchlike antlers between her ears, the fur beneath turns an earthy black. She has three ribbony tails, flowers and vines perpetually growing upon them and falling away in an endless cycle.
Story Summary:
Born from the very concept of a warming breeze and the hope of new life, Tsutsuji awoke in the Feywyrd five years ago on the first day of what would become known as spring.
With duty written in her bones, she raced through the forests, leaving a path of flowers in her wake and providing gardens of respite for the wounded allies of Kuzunoha and those fleeing the dangers of the Blood Grotto.
She was forced to flee her domain when an army of Draugr marched upon it, stumbling into a realmstorm before she could be surrounded.

Name: Tucker Kawasaki
Physical Description:
`I'm a demon. Jet black cloak and jet black soul. I got soot cooked into my kevlar from all the chain smoking I be doing. I gotta maintain the haze. Blood in my nicotine streams.` 
`Like a lesbian I'm out here strapped. Limited edition portable card game playmat that transforms into a pistol. I be shooting my shot like it'll be my last ever.`
`I got those black air force one's, them timberland highlander series combat boots. I tread where lesser men would cry and shit and piss themselves. I'm a real man. I follow through. The left one is smaller than the right one.`
`Combat helmet is bugged. My vitals all read in Esperanto, my HUD screams at me in Hadza, I have to order groceries in Ngbinda. My password is three full sentences of Swahili. Ain't no motherfuckers cracking my subnet.`
`Chest pocket's full of that premium flour. I'm talkin max concentration goblinoid dandruff, powdered symbiotes with instructions in High Shenwa but you already know wtf is going on, I'm snorting this up.`

Name: Tyra All-Mother
Character Sheet Link: [So I have seen it, so it shall be.](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/16wNkaKwFcNWFRCgSrxfeNbmtlWtEZK7bbp1B4r4N590/edit?gid=1549097104#gid=1549097104)
Class List: Arcanist ★, Necromancer ★, Wayfarer 5, Spiritist ★, Entropist ★,  Elementalist 3, Chimerist 2
Other Names:
The Corpse Witch
Tyra Godbinder
Tyra Halfborn
Physical Description:
Tyra is an odd woman, standing at 6' with a build that ends up just on the chubbier side. Unlike before, she bares her arms and scars proudly, no longer will she be shamed for her past, not her present. She is covered in Aldistiri runes and tattoos, and scars from battle and blood sacrifice. Her cheek is marked with the brand of the archdemon Sanctimony, and her hair is tinged with gold and an otherworldly teal. Now missing her right eye from a deal, she has covered it with a simple patch.

Her 'son', Utsuki Halfborn, is a hulk of a man, some eight feet tall with dark hair and fair skin. His flesh is marked across with stitches, and even though he doesn't talk much, there is a doubtless innocence in his eyes.
Related Arcana:
Cupid (Bound)
Yubel (Bound)
Vanagandr (Bound, Oracle of)
Qilin (Bound)
Banshee (Bound)
Kuzunoha (Bound)
Caladrius (Bound)
Story Summary:
Apart from her parents, Tyra spent all her life in Aldistir being rejected and shunned for her half-blooded nature. Once they passed, she was left alone... just her and the snow. And so she wandered. She wandered until she found company in a fellow outcast, an old witch by the name of Olga, who taught her the blackened art of necromancy.

After some time, Tyra put theory to practice, and put life to the lifeless. With her talents, and some months of work, she created the being who would be her son. Though he seemed monstrous on the outside, she loved him with all her heart.

Recently, after an extended stay with the demon Sanctimony and their cult, Tyra has found a measure of confidence. Should the world shun her for her being, then let them do so. But never will she hide herself again.

Recently, her antlers were taken from her by the Aesir Kuzunoha, now she wears them as magical charms at her belt.

Name: Tzera Crawford
Physical Description: A tall red haired woman with pointed wolf ears on the top of her head that seem to constantly be shifting towards the nearest sound. Her long mane of red hair is scruffy and full of split ends that seem to curl upwards. Her figure is on the more muscular side with thick arms and legs that are usually covered by the dark tunic and pants that she is wearing.
Story Summary: Former Vanagandr cursed of Kor’tarion that broke her curse and now hunts the wolf wherever she can.

Name: Uto Masahide Miyabi [宇土 将秀 雅]
Other Names:
Uto (last name)
Masahide (chosen name)
Miyabi (given name)
Physical Description: Tall at 6'2", Masahide is well muscled, clearly working out beyond just stacking boxes in his store. A katana's hilt seems to constantly be at his side, and his build suggests he knows how to use it. He has black hair and always has a bit of stubble on his chin. His amber eyes have a hint of mischief within their intelligent gaze.
Story Summary:
- Once a captain of the Imperial Guard
- When the Shogun took control of the Guard, he had been unable to stop it, though the signs had all been there
- Instead of taking his own life, he decided to flee
- He fled to Ishihara, and learned to trade as a merchant

Spoilers for DMs to read:
||- The above is the story of Uto Masahide. But while fleeing to Ishihara, he came across a kitsune pup, and decided to take him in.
- He named the pup Miyabi, and adopted him, teaching him the sword as they figured out their lives as merchants.
- Eventually someone recognized Masahide, and he was finally put to death.
- Hidden away, the kitsune saw it all, and now wears his form, though slightly changed to keep anyone else from figuring him out.||

Name: Valen
Physical Description: Tall, pale skinned man and with scars, his brown eyes holding the burning signs of life in them. His unbeareded face along with little signs of aging in his face betrays his age allowing many to see his youth.
Story Summary: TBD

Name: Valen Bell
Physical Description: White hair novice looking male guard wearing outdated armor with a sword and shield.
Rare Equipment:
Chivalrous Plate
Travel Toboggan
Lucky Wristbands
Story Summary:
- Born and raised in Ironholde

- At 18 was a full time guard and was aspiring to become a Brightshield Knight

- Valen's Father Tadem Bell, died covering one of Valen's guard shift

- In his grief, Valen joined the rising Atee religion

- Valen left his town to go a pilgramage to find a way to redeem himself when seeing his father's death as his fault in his eyes.

- Thanks to a heart to heart talk with Zophiel, Valen reafirms his own will to live and enjoy life

Name: Valentin
Physical Description: Valentin is a 6'4'' tall augmented human, likening the appearance of an anthropomorphic tiger. His fur has an orange/cream tone. Usually he is clad in a tidy and expensive-looking suit, as well as a few distinct adornment, such as his gold necklace that holds a beautiful amber gemstone in it. Valentin's posture is quite proper and polished, adding to a perhaps imposing impression at first sight.
Story Summary:
Valentin was raised in a laboratory, subjected to genetic experiments and cybernetic enhancements before escaping due to a series of strange coincidences.
He spent years surviving on the streets, developing a deep hatred for technology and constantly fighting to stay alive.
After a desperate chase, he stumbled upon a medieval-style estate, where the head butler, Archibald Bernstein, took him in and trained him in the ways of servitude and discipline.
Valentin thrived under Archibald’s guidance until a technologically advanced force attacked the estate, leading to Archibald’s death.
Not long after, Valentin was chosen as a Goldhearted, and is now joining the Worldhelm

Name: Valentine O'Loshio Torres
Character Sheet Link: ["Someone so wonderful as yourself should come get drinks with me, come, let me show you a good time~"](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1dsgknpAZOcLP0rMrALkAihpDgMGuCWqU-qEmPkEE8J4/edit?usp=sharing)
Physical Description: Valentine is adorned with a beautifully made suit and matching accessories of all varieties. They're so invested in their appearance Valentine's yellow eyes are hidden by red contacts, and they even sport a makeup filled heart to seem "memorable". When excited their slim body produces small sparks between their hair and fingers, causing a slight hum to be hear around them.
Rare Equipment: Dice Holder Necklace (House's cards)
Story Summary:
- Grew up in Merrane's propaganda in Rachet
- Went to Korala Acedemy for 2 years 
- Had a job as a bartender, gambled hard, had fun
- Got in a fight with his friends, learned the truth 
- Depressive episode solved by gambling high..
- Wrote papers to spread the truth 
- Approached by authorities to stop 
- Packed a bag to Rachet to tell his home of the truth but was beamed to the Worldhelm

Name: Valerie Knight
Physical Description: Valerie is a large frame with a lax and aloof posture. Standing at 6'3 (190 CM), she dwarfs most other people around her. She is very visibly an insolvent, having pale skin and crimson eyes. In spite of her now lacking a need for sleep, the signs of her mistreatment of her body are still visible, under her eyes are large dark circles, and any skin that is normally covered with her business-wear usually have some sort of painful looking scar. Other distinctive features are a sharp metal tail, and a pair of pointy horns on the top of her head. She tends to wear a consistent wardrobe of professional attire, with the only changing up between her outfits tending to be the color of her tie.
Story Summary:
- Born in North Rock with an absentee mother, an abusive father, and a little sister named Riley. Learned to be protective of her little sister. Father died when she was 18,

- Learned to pick up the slack financially for her little sister, hoping to scrounge up enough money to get by and get her sister a proper education with how talented she was.

- Got mixed in with the wrong crowd, soon she was doing any job she could get. Hoping that she could retire once Riley made a lot of money

- Found a stray by the name of Ozzy, saved him from being sent to juvenile prison and took him in.

- Only got more unhappy as she watched her sister and brother idolize her, but stayed on this path until it eventually killed her.

- She was brought back as an insolvent, swearing to herself that she could make an honest living now with her death wiping her slate clean. Takes any odd job she can get her hands on as long as it isn't too shady.

- Was taken by a Realmstorm along with her two siblings

Name: Vanigad Ensed
Origin: Forgotten Shrine of the Fallen God, Aldistir
Physical Description: A little shorter than average at 5'8", Vanigad carries himself tall and proud. He has short blonde hair and tends to wear comfortable and well-worn gear suitable for his frozen homeland, though he likes to keep a set of nicer clothing for walking about, and he wears an eyepatch over one eye. His irises seem to shift in the light, so the color is difficult to pin down, but he always has a smile on his face, as if he knows a secret no one else could ever guess.
Rare Equipment:
A Point of Light: Custom Possessed bow (ranged; accurate, light damage)/dagger (melee; accurate, cold damage)
A Shard of Warmth: Insulated (cold resistance, slowed immunity) accessory
Bolt Necklace: Damage Change (bolt) accessory
Jester's Mask: Beggar's Luck accessory
Jarl Aren's Burial Warhorn: Kindred accessory
Related Arcana:
Vanagandr (previously followed)
Lilith (previously followed after leaving family)
Antikythera ("sole follower") [Bound]
Yubel [Bound]
Story Summary:
- A blizzard blasted across the edge of the world.
- A lone Lilith follower sought shelter, finding what seemed to be a long abandoned shrine to the Fallen God.
- The Lilith follower, in return for using the shrine to outlast the blizzard, rejected his previous life and name.
- He gained power from the Fallen God, but in doing so put an expiration date on himself.
- He also gained a new name: Vanigad.

Name: Vanille Kuylenberg
Physical Description: Vanille is a somewhat petite woman, who would only be about 5'2" if she could stand. She has no use of her legs and so is always found in a wheelchair, either a ruggedized one for adventuring or a more basic one for more domestic affairs. Despite her disability, however, she maintains a strong physique, displaying lean muscles in her arms and upper body, though these are usually covered by her modest clothing.
Story Summary: See bio.

Name: Ven & Vid
Origin:
Sansarko Saas, Leytik, Tian Yin
(Technically Idyll, but they don't remember their death and soul-merging, only their resurrection)
Physical Description:
Ven is 6'0", weighing 136 lbs. They seem to be frequently tired, though they frequently look around to gauge their surroundings.

Vid is a small, dark sphere with a single yellow light in the center. It seldom leaves Ven's side, floating around them and acting as their form of speech.
Quirks:
Idyllic Soul
Technically dead, doesn't deal well with loud sounds.
Story Summary:
* The result of two great warriors - a demon named Cogitav, and an Empty Monk named Ergo Nonsum - clashing, with Ergo turning Cogitav's soul-rending against it.
* Both of their souls, and all of the collected souls within Cogitav, merged and mixed in a massive maelstrom as it went to Idyll.
* After a century of struggling to take form and passively absorbing souls surround it, the mass eventually congealed into the forms of Ven and Vid.
* This new gestalt soul has only lingering memories of who - and what - it was before this incident. It also hardly has knowledge of what it is to even be alive.
* Held together by force of will and curiosity, this new pair of bodies wanders to find out what life is about, and what its own unlife is for.

Name: Verdugo
Physical Description: 5' 10" with a split aesthetic the white and gold representing the "good" side of justice such as returning stolen goods to their original owner, but the red and black side to represent the "dark" side of justice such as carrying out a death sentence for a known killer. with more loose or comfortable clothing his movements are relatively unrestricted

Class List:

Physical Description: Verge is a tall, dark-haired humanoid with pale skin and red eyes.  Her limbs and a portion of her face and torso are covered in dark purple scales.  Her hands and feet end in sharp black claws.  Her most obvious feature is a massive second set of limbs that grow from her back which she can morph into different appendages.  She wears form fitting tactical armor and half-rim glasses.  Verge has a calm and unintentionally menacing demeanor.
Quirks:
Fugitive Experiment
When a rule or ability requires you to spend 100 or fewer Hit Points, Mind Points, or
Inventory Points, you may suffer 1d8 Instability Points to ignore that cost.
At the end of each session (approximately four hours of play), you lose 1d6 Instability
Points (to a minimum of zero).
If your Instability Points ever reach 10 or more, you are immediately reduced to 0 Hit
Points and must Surrender. The consequences of this Surrender should be closely tied
to you losing control of your abilities. Then, you lose all Instability Points.
Story Summary:
-Created in a lab
-sold to T&C
-tortured and experimented on
-escapes to worldhelm
-On mission, learns she has a sister
-recaptured but her and her sister are rescued

Name: Victor Cassidy
Class List: Sharpshooter 1, Ace of cards 5, martial artist 1
Physical Description: A roughly 5’11 ft (180.34 cm) man of fairly average build wearing fairly typical cowboy attire. Is very rarely seen without either his revolver or a deck of cards (or both honestly)
Story Summary:
- Parents ran a general store in Eckard’s Rise, which began to fail around the time Netherhill failed 
- learned how to gamble while looking for work in New Jamestown
- Got cheated in a game of cards and decided to confront the dealer about it
- this went poorly, maybe met Stinger however 
- since then has been trying to take justice into his own hands, and during one confrontation with a known outlaw who was exploiting the weak and vulnerable, got taken by a realmstorm

Name: Victoria Kaur
Physical Description:
Victoria stands at a rather short 5'4. She has a lithe, athletic build, meant more for running and endurance than raw strength or power. This useful for her most practiced ability - running away.

Victoria has a significant aura of melancholy about her. She very rarely smiles, she almost never laughs. And her existence on the Worldhelm has only exacerbated these feelings.
Quirks: Cursed - Craven's Curse [Forces her to cower or fear against significant threat... especially undead]
Story Summary:
"* Born 18 years ago to Nefius Kaur before she took leadership of Wimcomb.
* Had a rather strict upbringing. Always wanted to make her mother Proud.
* Trained in swordsmanship, she was never allowed to fight with others or go out on outside maneuvers.
* Ran afoul of one of her mother's advisors when she argued mercy for captured folk. 
* Her mother decided to finally test her, sending her out to fight a group of wights with a small party.
* This is where she discovers that her mother's advisor cursed her, causing her to flee in Terror.
* Once this happened, when she returned home her mother was incensed. She declared Victoria a coward, disowned her, then banished her from Wimcomb.
* Victoria wanders for a while, before she hears of the Expedition through the Rune Wall. Desperate for anything to give her a chance to redeem herself, she joins that expedition..."

Name: Vigo Mortenkaisen
Physical Description: Vigo is 5'10", with blonde hair and scarlet eyes. She has a slim frame, but that misleads from the years of built muscle. She can be usually found wearing a simple combat tunic, and a cheerful smile.
Story Summary:
- Vigo was born to an Aristocratic family in Brightshield, known for their mastery of the sword.
- As is custom in her family, she left home and gave up the family name at 21, and took to wandering Kor'Tarion 
- Arrived on the Worldhelm about a year ago
- Has quietly worked in the background, helping those whom she could, becoming more relaxed and changing her appearance
- Is now stepping back into the "limelight"

Name: Viliana Atent
Physical Description: Viliana is a woman with mid-length hair, with bit of red. Wears gothic style dresses typically in black and red of color. Finds herself easily cold while at rest, so its not uncommon to also see her with a large jacket.
Story Summary:
- 3rd eldest child of one of the current Prime Chroniclers.
- Seen as both one who has potential to become a Chronicler and someone to has no drive to learn something practical at the same time.
- Thanks to this potential she underwent the trials and succeeded in being able to access the power in her bloodline.
- She will follow the strangest threads in pursuit knowledge for her own goal of trying to make the "perfect" world, following-up on the strangest threads of knowledge.
- The strange energy coming from the chamber of The Black Tear though? That seems to be the first serious thing she wanted to help look into.
- It would be during this a spark of energy would engulf and bring her to the Worldhelm.

Name: Viola Molie
Physical Description: A 5'2 woman with light hair, she often is dressed in finer clothing but rarely anything with much note. She is rarely one to see, but she seems to hold herself with something one can consider discipline.
Story Summary:
- Viola is a younger vampire, but she is also one who was quick to fall into her role for the Molie family.
She took to her role as a Steward very well, becoming another nameless face in the crowd for many.
- In playing her part, she met a man who aided in her goal of appearing as a simple young woman. A performance of a spur-of-the-moment young romance that was cut short. Something that was supposed to be a mundane moment.
- In the most recent years, she was given one task. Find a Forsaken who has caused too many problems with her family and others. So for reasons not given to her, she was tasked to work alongside the man from her previous years until the job is done of her family no longer saw it beneficial.

Name: Viola Zabala
Physical Description: Standing at 5'10" with a slender, serpentine frame, she has a body adorned with smooth white and peach-colored scales, accented by aquamarine markings along her ribs and tail. Her eyes are a striking rose-red, and she has Ruby Red horns. She typically wears light armor in shades of white and gold, leaving her midriff exposed for a balanced blend of elegance and agility.

Name: Vista Wynn
Class List: Ace of Cards ★, Elementalist ★, Malefactor ★, Symbolist ★, Chimerist 2, Necromancer 3, Arcanist 2
Physical Description: Vista is 5'3", weighing 159 lbs, dressed to the sevens. It's like being dressed to the nines, but not *that* fancy.
Quirks:
Outcast Fairy
If the odds aren't 100% against her, Vista is compelled to gamble for results that will bring the most good possible for the people involved.
Rare Equipment:
Ambient Tychokinetic Gloves - At start of turn, may cause all **weak** characters to lose 5 HP..
Blackjacket - +1 to all Magic Checks
Blind Luck's Bluff - Offensive spells cost half as much if a target is **weak**.
Turn of the River - Offensive spells **weaken** the target.
Story Summary:
* Was sired as a result of a deal with the Star-Eyed Stranger - one of those "give you great power in exchange for your firstborn" kind of deals. Upon taking the deal, Vista's human parent went "okay, so when do we start?"
* Grew up as an adoptee of a mob/mafia kind of deal. Used for her innate tychokinesis - manipulation of luck. Got herself out when she was young.
* Went to Tradesfair to be a dealer at a shady gambling den, with the intent of scamming rich fucks out of their money. Not many of those types show up at the place she worked at - she found she was just taking from those who didn't have much money to begin with.
* Leapt at the opportunity to do something better with herself.

Name: Vital Courtemanche
Physical Description:
A boyish gentleman with pale skin and porcelain hair. With a lean and relatively small frame, he walks with a confident swagger and moves with swift precision.

He always dresses to impress, making sure his appearance is always up to snuff. Maintaining the image of a gentleman is one of his top priorities.
Story Summary: A young man who was disowned by his merchant family due to his antics. The cutthroat trade didn't suit him, and he grew aloof as a result. After some chance encounters with a mysterious woman, his eyes were opened to the wonders of life. Leaving his old life behind, he struck out to bask in and protect the beauty of the world. During his travels, he thought he'd caught a glimpse of the woman once more. Chasing after her, he got lost in the forest; when he emerged, he found himself in a settlement he'd never seen before: the Worldhelm.

Name: Vivian Ashblanc
Physical Description: Vivian stands at an average height of 5'6", a lean figure draped in lightweight hunting gear of mixed leather and cloth with a black mantle edged with black feathers over her shoulders. Pitch black armor can be seen beneath the gear she wears. Pigment seems to be lost in a patch on the right side of her face and on other parts of her body,  interspersing her dark brown hair with locks of white with patches of skin bleached of color. Her right eye has a layer of ice over it, leaving the iris only faintly visible, but her unaffected eye is an inky black.
Rare Equipment:
`Tuerlanu` [Custom bow - Dual Hunter (Undead/Demons)]
`Malbriseur` [Custom bow - World Saver]
`Stygian Hunter's Armor` [Flawed Immunity - Dark IM, Light VUL]

Other: Homebound Snowglobe, Caladrine Coercive Censer, Quiver of Verdant Enmity, Mind's Pendant of Isolation, The Mask of Camila,  Heart's Blade of Obsession
Story Summary: Born to the Ashblancs in Dryholde, Vivian lived her life happily betrothed to Ronan Ashwynd. Hunters of the night, trained, tempered, ready to fight alongside the Ashwynds against the monsters that would bring ruin to the pockets of humanity across Kor'tarion. All that was changed when Ronan was cast out, Vivian nearly killed by a Moonshard monster as she pursued him, and left infused with ice magic as she was taken home. Sent to Hudal academy for years to deal with this new curse, she stagnated, only for her life to be upended once again at the blood moon. Fighting off demons and surviving, she finally returned home- only to find Dryholde shattered, house empty, and her family missing.

Name: Void
Physical Description: A chitinous carapace covers much of Void's form including over where their mouth should be, carved or broken in places until it seems somewhat like clothes, it does seem to require constant maintenance for it not to grow too far or grind against the ground. Between cracks in the carapace or even on the exterior is the same purple eye that rests across his form, always staring in the surrounding area or focusing on whoever Void may be interacting with at a time. A tail along with four or so tendrils each begin to form a sharp claw, grasping at nothing as if the tendrils themselves are exploring the surrounding area.
Story Summary:
- A human who was once taken as part of the a program within Termina City, led by Baylore, something meant to help all of humanity.
- During preparation of the operation they found another volunteer that later became Subject Xan-17. The operation led them to becoming Void, a human-moonfallen hybrid with few memories of human life.
- Spent most of his life in a stasis chamber.
- For the last 60 years, he has been suck in that suspended animation chamber, the only person he could mentally communicate with was Willow/Fenja.

Name: Void Thunderstar
Physical Description: A white-haired young human male with average size and weight, brown skin, grey eyes and usually uses a lose ponytail. Was born with a natural affinity to electricity and can sense storms. Usually wears black clothes that favor stealth, the suit and weapons can be charged with its own electric power (neon-blue light). The main weapon he uses it's his Neo-Wakizashi, the color of the blade and the hilt can change depending on the elemental power it carries, if it's "turned off" it emits no colorful light and is completely black instead.
Related Arcana: Gazer Nova, the beast of the stars(Minor Arcanum)
Story Summary:
-An orphan born in the Southern Colonies, learned to work, steal and survive by any means available, learning early in his life how to control and charge electricity into different objects.
-For that reason he ended up working for Nova Wardrobes at a special space suits, accessories and gear workshop in Silver rock until he decides to try to make the Southern colonies a better place for the creatures.
-While living and surviving on the colonies, understanding each biome and necessity for the creatures, he suddenly discovers that NTTech also sells creatures no matter what purpose they're being bought for.
-Void decides to try to sabotage or maybe even stop any attempt of selling creatures.
-5 years later, he's sucked into strange storm in one of his expeditions, and expands his motivations to protect any creature and lifeform from the Realmstorms.

Physical Description:
Dark skin, black hair, golden eyes, and angular features, Waylen's looks apparently take after his mother. Standing at 6'1", athletic, and about 75kg, he physically takes after his father. Clothes tend to fit him well, if a little loose, though they never hang off of his frame. He tends to wear casual clothes, but he has some fancier outfits if he needs them.

Recently, he's upgraded his usual outfits to be less casual, and include a two-toned, black-and-silver jacket with only one sleeve, and a single long glove that seems to be made of a synth-fabric.

With his Driver activated, Millenium wears a suit of purple tech-armor over black and dark blue synth-fabric, and a helm with wolf-ish angles and fiery electronics. The Driver itself has been recently changed to have a single coin slot in the top, an augmentation slot on the right side, and a crank on the front to turn to activate the Driver.

Story Summary:
- Mother died before he could remember
- Father took care of him throughout his whole life
- After getting a job at a startup company, his father disappeared
- He searched for his father, to no avail
- However, that search made him realize that people were hurting, and turning to the gangs that only drag out their suffering
- He quit his job, stealing the prototype they had been working on
- He took up the mantle of Millenium to take on the gangs that make things worse, to help the people that need it, and eventually, to take on the corps that leave the gangs in charge

Name: Web
Physical Description:
A lithely built elf of average height, Web is often seen with a disinterest gaze on her face. Her violet eyes are often hidden under a snow white fringe, the rest of her long hair kept in a long single braid that reaches down to her waist.

Most of the time she can be seen wearing dark clothes, favouring blacks and dark purples or blues. While she wears different styles, she generally favours looser clothing, and universally abhors sleeves.
Story Summary:
- Born in the Winter Court of Kor'Tarion's Fae Realm
- Skilled with healing magic at a young age
- Promised to heal a sick person and failed
- For breaking her word, was exiled from the Winter Court.

Name: Wen Tian
Physical Description: Wen Tian is a young man of average stature, standing at around 5'9'', with medium-ish length blue hair and a slightly tanned skin.

- is here now :)

- Becomes a Gold Hearted

Physical Description: 5'10", powerful, and a little intimidating with his facial scars, and demon-aesthetic arms and armor, though some of his muscles are partially hidden beneath the yellows, greys, and browns of his second-hand robes. He has olive green eyes and long, dark hair he ties up, but a decent amount still falls in his eyes. Recent events have quelled the rage within him.
Rare Equipment:
- Akuma no Migite: Hand of Fortune broadaxe
- Yubel's Guandao: World Saver custom heavy/spear
- Parasite Ring: Momentum Thief (Weak) accessory

Story Summary:
- At an early age, he learned his aptitude for demonic qi. It frightened the villagers around him, ostracizing his family, forcing them to the outskirts of Yotsuya Village
- One night, a tengu, the twisted form of Oiwa, an earth cultivator and friend to his mother, arrived at their house, killing his parents while he hid
- He first cultivated demonic qi from the aftermath of that tragedy
- Stalked Teisei, following yokai and corrupt cultivators to cultivate from their battles and killings
- He often tried to fight the yokai, to help those in need. He almost never succeeded
- After becoming Goldhearted, he has helped many more people than he ever thought possible
- Eventually, he fell in battle, and his darkness overtook him, creating a heart demon
- He faced the heart demon by confronting his past, setting the souls of his parents free
- He ascended to a new stage of cultivation and defeated Iemon, the corrupt cultivator who destroyed his village.

Name: Yin Yue
Physical Description: A woman with sun-kissed skin, her gaze is captivating. Light green horns emerge gracefully from her forehead, while two larger horns curve just past her temples. Her dark teal hair cascades around her, complementing the flowing attire of a traveling performer. Yet, it’s her eyes that demand attention. Expressive, enchanting, and filled with the allure of someone who knows the world is her stage.
Quirks:
BOON OF AUSPICIOUS WISDOM
You are one of the Bishi’e, a qilin-like people blessed by one of the sealed gods. 

>When you take the Study action, your check triggers a critical success if both dice show the same number (and the Check is not a fumble).


CURSE OF HEAVENLY ENMITY
When you Surrender and a villain is on the scene, they may choose to gain an Ultima Point instead of another Surrender consequence. This cannot take them above the maximum UP for their tier (for instance, this cannot bring a Minor villain above 5 Ultima Points). If this happens, all player characters in the game except you gain a fabula point.
Story Summary:
Raised in the **Jade Bloom Pavilion of Xuanwu City**, Yin Yue grew up in a sanctuary of music and culture, guided by her renowned mother, Yin Mei, who taught her to cultivate through song rather than rigid forms. As a Bishi’e, she possessed an innate talent for harmonizing with the Dao, shaping the elements and fortifying herself through melody.

Though sheltered within the **Pavilion’s Heavenly Blossom Theatre**, she could not ignore the corruption that tainted the city, where powerful sects practiced ruthless cultivation and mortals toiled in the blood mines. Yearning to restore harmony while forging her own legend, Yin Yue set out beyond her homeland, her voice not only a weapon but a promise. To bring balance back to a fractured world and leave behind a song that would be remembered for generations.

Story Summary:
- Grew up in Cronis rather peacefully as a farming lad along with his friend Nasaya, whom he would share wonderous visual magic.
- Parents believed he was going to become a successor as he had connected to the Soul Stone along with the great magical prowess within him.
- Along with his childhood friend Nasaya, who actually became a successor, traveled to Erdelkeith to learn from Soul Witches of the Coven and its practices.
- Showed to be highly adept with learning, handling and understanding magic, becoming treated high favored with Soul Mages.
- They are of a very curious sort, seeking answers to mysteries, magic and solutions to the problems that ruin and rot the green and life of the land he loves, he is open to understand all kinds of magical practice.
- They left with their long time friend to the Runewall to see if this mysterious and even lethal anomaly could provide answers about the nature of the calamity in their lands, but even more so curiosity about what lies beyond.

Name: Yueliang Er Xian
Physical Description: Standing 5 feet 8 inches tall, weighing 215 pounds of lean, cultivated muscle. Fighting out of Xuanwu City, he is dark of hair, and dark of eye. A deeply serious, brooding expression he wears, and a dark blue/black gi adorns his muscular frame. Hands and feet usually arraigned in tattered black hand wraps, posture stiff and stance always widened for support. Strut like a snow leopard, every step signing a gait that belays a preparedness for sudden violence.
Story Summary:
•Born a twin, no cultivate. His bro cultivate
•Childhood sad, but free. resentment, but love. 
•Bro burns out, He steps up
•Finds Cursed wraps, gets cultivation, but it appears corrupted though it isn't.
•Becomes tourney fighter, learns martial arts under a master.
•Bro comes back, now they're figuring this whole life thing out together.

Name: Yui Kiddo
Physical Description:
Yui has done everything she can to get away from being perceived as cute. Primarily this consists of body mods to make her teeth sharp with tusks that jut from the lower jaw, horns on her head, and red skin to make her look more a monster than a human. However she also carries herself with a tough no nonsense sort of attitude, standing at an impressive 6'1" and giving off a cool defiance to anyone who deals with her. She keeps her hair chopped short and dyed in an androgynous way.

Even through all the toughness she still likes to appear somewhat feminine, she prefers dresses, and can often be seen wearing feminine accessories. Though she draws attention away from them with tougher looking clothing like, belts, chains, and leather. Despite the façade, she can't always hide her gentler side, she sometimes lights up when she sees something she finds cute, though these moments are brief.
Rare Equipment: Mirror Snowflake
Story Summary:
- Yui never saw her dad and was raised by her mom, sometime in middle school her mom was arrested by a corporate security company for crimes she didn't commit.
- From there Yui grew up on the mean streets struggling to survive and harboring a hatred anybody who would pray on the weak.
- She started standing up for people against corpos and criminals, becoming known as a street tough private investigator.
- Not wanting to appear weak (or cute) she took on body mods to make herself appear more like a monster.
- Through her adventures she learned she had some kind of connection to the world itself, particularly the electricity that buzzed around the city. But this also seemed to include animals and other things as well.
- Eventually she was summoned to the Worldhelm where she's been spending most of her recent time.

Name: Yukari
Character Sheet Link: ["Can't get your eyes off of me, huh?"](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/15mxbbEZDuEwFXUf6gSAhXQshmBuFNtz1gruUPibzzdc/edit?usp=drivesdk)
Physical Description:
Standing a humble two and a half feet from paw to shoulder, Yukari is a white-furred red fox with a blue-gray pattern in her coat, piercing violet eyes, and an ever-present smirk that gives the air of someone who knows something you don't. Most often, she is seen wearing a pair of brass chimes as well as a brightly colored, intricately patterned sash, both tied together with braided cord. Tied to her outfit is an amulet depicting the Fox and Hound of Aldistir, as well as a wooden mask that once belonged to her mentor, Köll Akihiko Vol.

Tied to her back is a shimmering steel sword, with a wave-shaped blade that evokes the image of a lighting strike-- the Naruikazuchi, one of the storied Seven Blades of Thunder, prophesized to strike down the Fox and the Wolf.
Rare Equipment:
- Naruikazuchi - Custom Heavy - Anomaly
- Heaven & Hell Bangles - Custom Transforming (Brawling/Arcane) - World Saver
- Fox & Hound Amulet - Accessory - Weapon Up (Melee)
- Vulpine Mask - Accessory - Anti-Status (Enraged)
Story Summary:
- Raised by Kuzonoha priests to become a shrine guardian; shirked duty and snuck out often

- Met, healed, and befriended an Ald lad named Jesper-- the two became very close over time

- Brought Jesper to her village in secret for a festival. The next day, he was strong-armed into bringing raiders to her door.

- Was exiled for treason, spent two years wandering the snowfields alone

- Witnessed Ragnarok, thought about fleeing, but chose to stay and help civillians to safety. For that act, became a Goldhearted and was brought to the Worldhelm

- Met the Band of the Branded, trained under Köll, and inherited Brandr's dream of a kinder Aldistir-- as well as the legendary Naruikazuchi (which currently refuses to speak to her)

- Sought out Jesper, forgave him, and helped him reach the Sunfire Citadel. Learned of the war between her village and his camp in the process. Now seeks the Seven Blades of Thunder to slay the immortal Godi Sigurd.

Name: Yuki-Na
Physical Description:
Standing at 7'3" to the top of her head, and upwards of 9' with her 'horns', Yuki-Na cuts an imposing figure.
Somewhat fox-like in appearance, by day her soft white fur flows across her pelt like snowdrifts and down to a long but flat, fluffy tail, while at night, the fur shifts to an onyx black.
From her head sprouts horn-like tree branches, their appearance shifting with her mood and goals: at times, the branches spring with eternally falling cherry blossoms, while at others, they alight with a ghostly blue fire.

Name: Yuri Sokolov
Physical Description: Yuri Sokolov is tall, sports a lithe frame with short brown hair and brown eyes. He has a state of the art combat attire, and an experimental bow. His demeanor is distant, he clearly has trouble making friends.

Name: Yuzuki Kurayami
Physical Description: Kurayami is a towering force of presence, standing taller than most normal humans. Her deep red skin stretches over a physique carved from strength and survival—thick with muscle, marked by scars, and impossible to ignore. Her form is a battleground of contrasts: raw oni power wrapped in undeniable feminine human curves, a blend that both defines and defies her heritage. She typically dons a sarashi across her chest and traditional samurai garb at her waist, exuding a rugged, warrior grace. Always seen with her tetsubo and katana at her side, she rarely needs to draw them—her cold, commanding voice and sheer presence speak louder than steel.
Story Summary:
Born in the Heavenly Mountains to Oni Warchief Gomako and a human father, she was soon estranged from the latter after he was recalled to Amagi as a spy. As a child, she trailed her cold, commanding mother like a shadow—earning the name Kurayami, not from love, but ownership. Though disgusted by her half-human blood, Gomako saw value in her daughter's strength. Kurayami trained relentlessly, desperate for praise that would never come—after all, the expectations of a warchief’s daughter were insurmountable.

Though shaped for war, Kurayami often protected Tsumugi, a half-oni dancer who offered warmth where she gave only silence. Tsumugi saw something in her others missed, and in return, Kurayami began to feel.

After the battle for Amagi, she reunited with her father, who welcomed her and gave her his surname: Yuzuki. The act awakened something human in her. Conflicted, she fled Amagi with Tsumugi—only to be swept into a Realmstorm. Now on the Worldhelm; their goal to be something more.

Name: Zahn Rimebow
Physical Description: Stands at around 6' 9''. Lean Body with Ashey Grey Skin and Bluish Silver Hair, His eyes are icey-blue. His outfit would comprise of Regal Looking Dark Teal robes with moon iconography on them. With his bow appearing to be made of ice.

Name: Zahra Gantzmann
Physical Description:
A taller and scarred woman at 6'1", Zahra Gantzmann is as blunt as her boots and decorated as he coat. Not used to having money, or even being able to buy things at a shop, she's taken up the bad habit of wrapping herself up in jewelry, to the point that she wears nearly every zenit she's ever made.

By her side, the size of a big dog, is an eyeless demon of gluttony, uninspiringly named Glöetts. He is often, if not always, chewing on something. Often it is Zahra's boots.
Story Summary:
- Born in the Ashlands, grew up hearing stories of better places.
- Grows up.
- Takes an old notebook from her mother that details a demon binding ritual. Pulls it off, though it does cost her a chunk of her soul in the process... Worth it though, because now she has a little demon of hunger named Glöetts, and his being involved opens *so many doors.* Demonic doors.
- Hops the border to live out the "good life" in the New Empire.
- Get there. Shit sucks, but the merc pay is good, especially when she comes with a demon as a package deal. Fill my pockets, but I need something better. 
- Cut ties with the empire, join the Adventurer's Guild instead.
- Get eaten by a fucking tornado or some shit.

Character Sheet Link:

Physical Description: Zaid is a white-haired, dark-skinned human in his mid-twenties. Around 6ft tall and lean. He has long white hair and wears distinctly Nezmiran clothing, under which lie the religious tattoos of his family; golden scales on his arm, and a black winged serpent above his covered eye. He manifests aspects of the serpent god Falak-khan [Dahaka] through art and prayer.
Quirks: Heirloom - Relic of The Serpent Who Dreamt of Sky (Air vuln and Earth abs)
Story Summary:
- Travelled around the sand dunes of Nezmira with his family's caravan. They are aspirants who revere the god Falak-khan.
- As the scion of his family, Zaid inherited the heirloom 'Heraldic Robe of The Serpent Who Dreamt of Sky'.
- Through worship and the trials of life on the dunes, Zaid matured into a capable adventurer.
- Zaid fought for an end to slavery in Nezmira, the rejuvenation of the lands, the quelling of the Kiir... and for the Dragonlords to not unleash their magic upon the realm. These were all seen through.
- He remained on the Worldhelm as his home's realmstorm drifted towards the horizon, wishing to repay the noble kindness of the goldhearted.

Name: Zamitra
Physical Description: a very tall man 215cm/7,0 feet tall and weighing 80 kg/ 176 pounds. He is clad in armor made from bugs material and a sword taller than him. He has red eyes dark hair.

Physical Description: Zaylee is a 5'5" toned woman that's happy about fighting, has a bandage/bandaid on her face and a sportsy look with some light armor around her body.

* Born in Lastport, Kor'Tarion.
* Was trained by her Father.
* Really liked to get into fights in her teen years.
* Also met a new friend during those years.
* Friend helped her set up small bouts as they traveled when she was at 21.
* Bouts slowed down during big demon attacks and the storm, but still did them when they could. Even if it was just for a little bit and to stay warm.
* Realmstorm happens while she was passed out after doing some late night training and looking out at the night sky.

The clients like that. They don't want to be seen walking around with some cheap North Rock kid. Had to take out a loan to get it, but it's done me well. Better than the first one, at least. I've always got my protective gear on, too - runic armor's nice because it doesn't interfere with what I'm wearing. Physical Description: Zinnia lumbers proudly at a cute 168 cm (5'6"), sporting a lithe, muscled build that packs a surprising punch. Her attire consists of a variety of pants and open shirts, of which she never wears properly as she enjoys feeling of the environment around her. - Tattooed her skin as a symbol of loyalty to the gang, later infused with nanotech with proceeds from ETA to make her job as the muscle easier.
- Brought to the brink of death during a con gone wrong, betrayed and left for dead by her crew as the fall gal. Survived and went dark, returning to society changed.
- Attempting to become a better person divorced from working directly with big corpo, believing her near-death experience to be the result of karma.

Name: Zlata Lyakhovich
Physical Description: A woman of smaller stature, standing at only 5'4. She has a short bob of blonde hair with a perpetual long curl that always sticks up. Her clothes are very common, but well maintained. Choices of armor tend to be on the lighter side, and only protecting what she feels is necessary. Her eyes are bright green, and always show a hint of the deep seeded loneliness buried in her heart.
Story Summary:
Orphaned as a baby, and forced to live with a curse she never asked for. Bad things just seem to follow her no matter where she goes.

Raised by a local "knight" of no renown, she was taught some basic magic, and how to defend herself with a bow. Many years later, when the city fell, Zlata would lose the only person in her life. With nothing left to keep her in the city, and her curse only getting worse with time, Zlata decided to strike out on her own.

For almost 20 years, she avoided any large settlements and spent all of her time on the road. Thanks to her training, she was able to see much of the world, though no where near all of it. With the constant harassment of the spirits that haunt her, she felt she always had to be alone.

That is, until she heard rumblings of an expedition heading for the Runewall....

Name: Zoe Michaels
Physical Description: Standing at 5'6 and always dresses in smart, powerful clothing, Zoe puts off something of a 'rich girl' vibe. She is constantly manifesting success, and as such she wears yellow shades. Well made up brown hair, and plenty of lovely make up.  But underneath the surface it all seems... superficial.
Story Summary:
Born to the Michaels Family, owners of ‘Michaels Strategic Tactical Solutions,’ an arm of SWORD.
Third child, first daughter. Doted on and *hates* it.
As she grew older, she was paraded around by her father and brothers at expensive networking events. She resented these, but played her part.
During testing on an experimental drug, she snuck into the family lab and took some drugs. These drugs seem to have given her certain minor magical abilities that she is learning to hone.
When she was informed that she was to be married to Edward Lowell Jr., she had a bit of a crash out. 
Gained a temp license with SWORD. Started Mercenary work. Is bad at it.
Her father, Alex Michaels, has cut her off until she has accepted “her destiny” (His words)
She is defiant still, and it is this defiance that caught the worldhelm’s attention…

Name: Zoi Katsaros - ᵀʰᵉ Talon
Physical Description:
Zoi is a quiet, unassuming girl, standing around 5' 7". She has long Black Hair, with equally dark eyes. She tends to wear a mix of Purple and White dresses, robes, or shirts, and can sometimes be seen with golden accessories in her hair.

ᵀʰᵉ Talon is a one handed dagger often seen on her person. It's edge is sharp, and a deep glassy black like obsidian, though some swear they can almost see a red flame-like color appearing in it's features.
Story Summary:
- Grew up in Grey Fox Castle, learning her best on how to navigate Dreadlan's perils, both physical and social,
- Learned from a young age that people with leverage tend to get the upper hand socially,
- Learned how to take someone's most valuable item from a subordinate of the King in Gold,
- Eventually was given the push to attend Gnosis Academy by her Father, who deals with the political landscape within Akala's domain,
- Became a Gnosis Student at 19, and undertook the Rite of Arms Ritual at 20, to show her commitment to the Academy's mission of killing the True Arcanum, but still has yet to find a Regent

A crusader from Brightshield with stark white hair. She stands at just over 5'5, with a trained, military posture, though her smile cuts through the severity.

She has small scar under her bangs where she once once burned by demonfire, but the other wounds have since healed.

She has an odd habit of putting her hand on her own right shoulder when troubled or afraid.
Story Summary:
- A fleeing survivor of the Night of the Red Sky in Dryholde. Her single father who raised her was killed by demons. Her mother is alive, though she is unknown to Zophiel.
- Zophiel was lost until reaching Brightshield, at which point she enlisted as a Crusader.
- Became a Goldhearted, following the sense of purpose she felt, believing this was what her father's spirit wanted for her.
- Her faith in the King was shattered by fellow Goldhearted who convinced her of his current "condition." Between this and some key experiences with a particular demon, she has become critical of the crusade and her own role in it.

Name: Ádhán
Physical Description: a 3'3" sparrow. A fluffy cream-colored chest with darker rust-colored feathers that run down his back. His wings layered with lighter-cream  and cinnamon feathers; longer feathers hiding smaller orange-creamsicle-like fine feather.
Rare Equipment: Polis' Heavy Brick
Story Summary:
- Born in the Singing pools
- At a very young age the little sparrow flew from the nest in a celebration after going through an oral tradition to receive their "Coat of Feathers"
- Ádhán followed in his family’s wind stream to become a courier.
- Craved the feeling under his wings that carried him throughout the Firwood far and wide. 
- Towards the end of the year and a half year the only requests that would pop up would begin to draw him closer and closer to The Looking Tree. 
- That’s when he met a small timid mouse that would grow to become his closest friend. The company was enjoyable and more lively than the skys were empty and free. His time apart grew less infrequent.
- At some point he always felt the currents pulling him towards the tree and it felt unlucky to fight it.
- Took a position to deliver letters and supplies, throughout Hearthome.
- At some point the bird too full of themselves found a flock among the Lion tribe and wanted to stick together.

Name: Óscar Serrano
Physical Description: Brown, 6'1 with an Athletic build. Typically seen in street clothes and a baseball cap, for the uninitiated he looks like the average Terran. But for those in the know, his "Nomad Tigers" jacket, spray painted and well-used is telling of his history as a once-member of the PCML. He always carries his bat bag with a smile on his face.
Quirks: Heirloom - First World Series, Champion's Bat
Story Summary:
- From a family of conservationists working for NTT within the Southern Colonies.
- Enamored with stories of his great grandfather's time as part of the NTT Nomad Tigers.
- Was passed on his bat, which scored the last home run of the first Baylore World Series.
- Throughout his youth Oscar trained to one day enter the Prime Corp Major League, eventually becoming a batter on the Nomad Tigers like his grandfather.
- Was a popular rising star for a time, before crossing the wrong people by trying to reveal unethical practices in the PCML and being framed for doping during a BWS Qualifier match.
- Now having been kicked out of the league, Oscar is brought onto the Worldhelm as he looks to clear his reputation and become a batter his great grandfather could be proud of.
